paras.en: The hour-long event, filled with both original and classic holiday songs, first premiered last year, but CBS is bringing it back to the airwaves this Saturday, Nov. 28 at 8 p.m. PT/ET. You can watch A Paw Patrol Christmas on TV through your local CBS affiliate.
paras.zh: 这场长达一小时的活动充满了原创和经典的节日歌曲，去年首次首播，但哥伦比亚广播公司将于本周六（11 月 28 日）晚上 8 点将其重新播出。 PT/ET。您可以通过当地的哥伦比亚广播公司附属机构在电视上观看狗狗巡逻队圣诞节。

paras.en: At a Glance: How to Watch A Paw Patrol Christmas
paras.zh: 概览：如何观看狗狗巡逻队圣诞节

paras.en: “Rubble can’t wait for Christmas to come this year as he’s especially looking forward to Santa bringing him a Lazer Drill,” reads the logline. “But when all of Adventure Bay learns that Santa has come down with a cold and Christmas is cancelled, Mayor Humdinger decides he’s going to go to the North Pole and take all of the gifts for himself. It will take all the PAW Patrol and Rubble making a sacrifice to stop Mayor Humdinger from ruining Christmas and learning the true meaning of the season.”
paras.zh: “拉布尔等不及今年圣诞节的到来，因为他特别期待圣诞老人给他带来激光钻，”日志中写道。 “但是，当冒险湾的所有人都知道圣诞老人得了感冒并且圣诞节被取消时，汉丁格市长决定前往北极，为自己拿走所有礼物。汪汪队立大功的狗狗巡逻队和瓦布需要做出牺牲，才能阻止汉丁格市长破坏圣诞节并了解这个季节的真正含义。”

paras.en: CBS is included in any of DIRECTV’s Streaming Packages: ENTERTAINMENT (90+ channels), CHOICE (125+ channels), ULTIMATE (160+ channels) and PREMIER (185+ channels). Each of these four plans offers a free five-day trial.
paras.zh: CBS 包含在 DIRECTV 的任何流媒体套餐中：ENTERTAINMENT（超过 90 个频道）、CHOICE（超过 125 个频道）、ULTIMATE（超过 160 个频道）和 PREMIER（超过 185 个频道）。这四个计划均提供为期五天的免费试用。

paras.en: DIRECTV’s Streaming Packages start at $49.99 per month for the first month after your free trial is up.
paras.zh: 免费试用期结束后，DIRECTV 的流媒体套餐第一个月起价为每月 49.99 美元。

paras.en: You can also watch A Paw Patrol Christmas online without cable using Fubo, another live TV streaming service. Fubo also carries a live CBS feed on all its packages, so you can use it to watch the Paw Patrol special in addition to more than 200 other live television channels.
paras.zh: 您还可以使用另一家直播电视流媒体服务 Fubo 在线观看狗狗巡逻队圣诞节，无需有线电视。 Fubo 还在其所有套餐中提供 CBS 直播节目，因此除了 200 多个其他直播电视频道外，您还可以用它观看狗狗巡逻队特别节目。

paras.en: Like DIRECTV, Fubo also offers a five-day free trial that will let you stream A Paw Patrol Christmas online for free. Fubo’s free trial includes free DVR so you can record the live airing on CBS and watch it back on-demand later.
paras.zh: 与 DIRECTV 一样，Fubo 也提供五天免费试用，让您免费在线观看狗狗巡逻队圣诞节。 Fubo 的免费试用包括免费的 DVR，因此您可以录制 CBS 的现场直播并稍后点播观看。

paras.en: All three streaming services above let you watch the Paw Patrol Christmas episode on your phone, computer, tablet or smart TV.
paras.zh: 上述所有三个流媒体服务都可以让您在手机、电脑、平板电脑或智能电视上观看狗狗巡逻队圣诞节剧集。

paras.en: Paw Patrol: Ultimate Film & TV Collection
paras.zh: 狗狗巡逻队：终极影视合集

paras.en: Want more viewing options? Amazon has this 10-disc DVD set of Paw Patrol content on sale for under $20 right now. The set includes PAW Patrol: The Movie and PAW Patrol: The Mighty Movie, along with three TV movies and more than 40 episodes of the hit animated series.
paras.zh: 想要更多观看选项吗？亚马逊目前出售这套包含 10 碟《狗狗巡逻队》内容的 DVD 套装，售价不到 20 美元。该套装包括《狗狗巡逻队：大电影》和《狗狗巡逻队：全能大电影》，以及三部电视电影和这部热门动画系列的 40 多集。

paras.en: You can also pick up this official Paw Patrol advent calendar, which features 24 mini storybooks and activity books to uncover on each day leading up to Christmas.
paras.zh: 您还可以领取官方的狗狗巡逻队降临节日历，其中包含 24 本迷你故事书和活动书，供您在圣诞节前的每一天揭晓。

paras.en: Amazon currently has this calendar on sale for 20 percent off for Black Friday weekend.
paras.zh: 亚马逊目前正在销售这款日历，黑色星期五周末可享受 20% 的折扣。

articles.title: Gerald R. Molen, Oscar-Winning Producer on ‘Schindler’s List,’ Dies at 91
articles.author: Mike Barnes

paras.en: Gerald R. Molen, the Oscar-winning producer who teamed with Steven Spielberg on films including Schindler’s List, Jurassic Park and Minority Report, has died. He was 91.
paras.zh: 曾与史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格合作制作过《辛德勒名单》、《侏罗纪公园》和《少数派报告》等电影的奥斯卡获奖制片人杰拉德·R·莫伦去世。他91岁了。

paras.en: A longtime resident of Bigfork, Montana, Molen died Monday, his great-niece Rachel Lorraine Pullan announced.
paras.zh: 莫伦是蒙大拿州比格福克市的长期居民，他的侄孙女雷切尔·洛林·普兰宣布，他于周一去世。

paras.en: Molen first worked with Spielberg as a unit production manager on The Color Purple (1985), after which the filmmaker offered him his first producing gig, as an associate producer on *batteries not included (1987).
paras.zh: 莫伦首次与斯皮尔伯格合作，担任《紫色》(1985) 的单元制作经理，此后，斯皮尔伯格为他提供了他的第一份制作工作，担任《*不包括电池》(1987) 的副制片人。

paras.en: After serving as a producer on the Spielberg-directed Hook (1991), Molen was named head of production at Spielberg’s Amblin Entertainment, where he shepherded such films as The Flintstones (1994), The Little Rascals (1994), Little Giants (1994), Casper (1995), Twister (1996) and the Spielberg-directed sequel The Lost World: Jurassic Park (1997).
paras.zh: 在担任斯皮尔伯格执导的《虎克》（1991）的制片人后，莫伦被任命为斯皮尔伯格旗下安培林娱乐公司的制作主管，负责执导《摩登原始人》（1994）、《小小流氓》（1994）、《小巨人》（1994）、《卡斯帕》（1995）、《龙卷风》（1996）和斯皮尔伯格执导的续集《失落的世界》等电影：侏罗纪公园 (1997)。

paras.en: “It was the best job in Hollywood,” he said in a 2023 interview, “because any movie [Spielberg] directed I got to produce, and any movie the company did I got to oversee.”
paras.zh: “这是好莱坞最好的工作，”他在 2023 年接受采访时说道，“因为我必须制作 [斯皮尔伯格] 执导的任何电影，并且我必须监督该公司制作的任何电影。”

paras.en: He shared the best picture Oscar for Schindler’s List (1993) with Spielberg and Branko Lustig.
paras.zh: 他凭借《辛德勒的名单》（1993）与斯皮尔伯格和布兰科·勒斯蒂格共同获得奥斯卡最佳影片奖。

paras.en: Molen’s producing credits outside of Spielberg and Amblin included the best picture winner Rain Man (1988), Days of Thunder (1990), The Other Side of Heaven (2001), Just Like Heaven (2005), The Meg (2018) and Meg 2: The Trench (2023).
paras.zh: 莫伦在斯皮尔伯格和安培林之外的制作作品包括最佳影片奖得主《雨人》(1988)、《雷霆壮志》(1990)、《天堂的另一面》(2001)、《就像天堂》(2005)、《巨齿鲨》(2018) 和《巨齿鲨 2：战壕》(2023)。

paras.en: Gerald Robert Molen was born on Jan. 6, 1935, in Great Falls, Montana. He and his family moved to North Hollywood in 1947, and his parents, Gerald Sr. and Edith, built a cafe across the street from Republic Pictures in Studio City.
paras.zh: 杰拉尔德·罗伯特·莫伦 (Gerald Robert Molen) 1935 年 1 月 6 日出生于蒙大拿州大瀑布市。 1947 年，他和家人搬到了北好莱坞，他的父母老杰拉尔德 (Gerald Sr.) 和伊迪丝 (Edith) 在斯蒂迪奥城共和影业 (Republic Pictures) 对面开设了一家咖啡馆。

paras.en: “I got to make friends with the studio guards,” he said in 2014. “They used to take me on the studio lot and take me to a soundstage or the backlot where they were maybe shooting a Western and stuff me down behind a bale of hay or under a wagon. I got it in my blood.”
paras.zh: “我和工作室的保安交上了朋友，”他在 2014 年说道，“他们常常带我去工作室，带我去摄影棚或外景场地，他们可能在那里拍摄西部片，然后把我塞到一捆干草后面或一辆马车下面。我的血液里就有这种感觉。”

paras.en: After high school, Molen enlisted in the U.S. Marine Corps; after 10 months in the service, he landed a job as a truck driver hauling furniture at Republic in 1957.
paras.zh: 高中毕业后，莫伦加入了美国海军陆战队；服役 10 个月后，他于 1957 年在 Republic 找到了一份运输家具的卡车司机的工作。

paras.en: He moved to Universal in 1959, and on Psycho (1960), he doubled for Anthony Perkins as the driver of a car heading to the Bates Motel (director Alfred Hitchcock was in the back seat giving directions).
paras.zh: 1959 年，他转投环球影业，在《惊魂记》（1960）中，他为安东尼·博金斯饰演一辆前往贝茨汽车旅馆的汽车司机（导演阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克坐在后座上指路）。

paras.en: Molen rose to head of transportation at the studio, and as a transportation coordinator/captain/supervisor, he worked on Escape to Witch Mountain (1975), Bound for Glory (1976), Coming Home (1978), Being There (1979), Ordinary People (1980) and Absence of Malice (1981).
paras.zh: 莫伦升任工作室的交通主管，作为交通协调员/队长/主管，他参与了《逃往魔女山》(1975)、《奔向荣耀》(1976)、《回家》(1978)、《在那里》(1979)、《普通人》(1980)和《无恶意》(1981)。

paras.en: He graduated to unit production manager on such movies as The Postman Always Rings Twice (1981), Tootsie (1982), A Soldier’s Story (1984) and the Spielberg-helmed The Color Purple before embarking on his career as a producer.
paras.zh: 他毕业于《邮递员总是按两次铃》（1981 年）、《Tootsie》（1982 年）、《士兵的故事》（1984 年）和斯皮尔伯格执导的《紫色》等电影的单元制作经理，然后开始担任制片人。

paras.en: Molen also had cameos in films including Rain Man, Days of Thunder, Jurassic Park and two other Spielberg-directed features, Amistad (1997) and Catch Me If You Can (2002).
paras.zh: 莫伦还在《雨人》、《雷霆之日》、《侏罗纪公园》和另外两部斯皮尔伯格执导的影片《Amistad》（1997 年）和《Catch Me If You Can》（2002 年）中客串。

paras.en: He produced 2016: Obama’s America (2012) and Hillary’s America: The Secret History of the Democratic Party (2016), two documentaries written and directed by Dinesh D’Souza that were critical of Barack Obama and Hilary Clinton. He wrote about the Obama doc in an opinion piece for THR.
paras.zh: 他制作了《2016：奥巴马的美国》（2012）和《希拉里的美国：民主党秘史》（2016），这两部纪录片由迪内什·迪索萨编剧和导演，批评巴拉克·奥巴马和希拉里·克林顿。他在《好莱坞报道》的一篇评论文章中写到了奥巴马的文件。

paras.en: In 2014, he sent a letter to 866 Christian and conservative leaders that accused Hollywood of “depravity” and causing “much damage to America.”
paras.zh: 2014年，他致信866名基督教和保守派领导人，指责好莱坞“堕落”并“给美国造成了巨大损害”。

paras.en: “Throughout my years in Hollywood, I tried to live my life differently and be a part of projects that I would be proud to have my grandchildren watch,” he wrote. “It hasn’t been easy, but I’ve at least tried to stand against the tide of depravity that has too often flourished there.”
paras.zh: 他写道：“在好莱坞的这些年里，我试图以不同的方式过自己的生活，并成为我为让我的孙子们观看而感到自豪的项目的一部分。” “这并不容易，但我至少试图抵制那里经常盛行的堕落潮流。”

paras.en: Pat, his wife of nearly 70 years, died in January 2024 at age 86.
paras.zh: 与他结婚近 70 年的妻子帕特于 2024 年 1 月去世，享年 86 岁。

articles.title: Semiconductor chips are the new oil. Here's why

paras.en: The artificial intelligence boom has pushed semiconductors past oil and gas in global export value for the first time, according to a Deutsche Bank analysis of International Trade Centre data.
paras.zh: 根据德意志银行对国际贸易中心数据的分析，人工智能的繁荣使半导体在全球出口价值中首次超过石油和天然气。

paras.en: Yet the milestone arrives at an awkward moment, just as investors reassess the outlook for artificial intelligence spending and drive down the price of semiconductor stocks. Last week, before Monday's breathtaking reversal, semiconductor stocks suffered their worst weekly loss in a quarter century, with the PHLX Semiconductor Index (SOX) plunging nearly 11% last Friday alone, capping a more than 17% weekly decline.
paras.zh: 然而，就在投资者重新评估人工智能支出前景并压低半导体股票价格之际，这一里程碑出现在一个尴尬的时刻。上周，在周一出现惊人逆转之前，半导体股票遭遇了四分之一个世纪以来最严重的周跌幅，PHLX 半导体指数 (SOX) 仅上周五就暴跌近 11%，周跌幅超过 17%。

paras.en: Nvidia soared more than 31% Monday after the leading maker of artificial intelligence chips had fallen for a seventh straight week, plunging 46% during that stretch. Then it fell again, dropping almost 10% on Tuesday and Wednesday. Advanced Micro Devices tumbled 20% in two days last Thursday and Friday. Micron Technology sank 27% over the seven days ended last Friday.
paras.zh: 领先的人工智能芯片制造商英伟达(Nvidia)周一股价飙升逾31%，此前这家领先的人工智能芯片制造商连续第七周下跌，期间暴跌46%。随后再次下跌，周二和周三下跌近 10%。 Advanced Micro Devices 在上周四和周五的两天内下跌了 20%。美光科技 (Micron Technology) 在截至上周五的 7 天里下跌了 27%。

paras.en: "For decades we've talked about the petrodollar. Perhaps increasingly we need to think about the chip dollar," Jim Reid, global head of macro and thematic research at Deutsche Bank wrote in a report this month.
paras.zh: “几十年来，我们一直在谈论石油美元。也许我们越来越需要考虑芯片美元，”德意志银行宏观和主题研究全球主管吉姆·里德在本月的一份报告中写道。

paras.en: Semiconductor exports overtook oil and gas for the first time during the January-March quarter of 2026, reaching about $1.61 trillion, compared with $1.53 trillion for oil and gas, the report said, using four-quarter rolling totals.
paras.zh: 报告称，2026 年 1 月至 3 月季度半导体出口首次超过石油和天然气，达到约 1.61 万亿美元，而石油和天然气的出口额为 1.53 万亿美元。

paras.en: The gap widened in the second quarter, when semiconductor exports totaled about $1.60 trillion and oil and gas exports reached about $1.47 trillion. Disruptions to oil supplies through the Strait of Hormuz after the Iran war helped widen the gap. Daily oil flows through the Strait collapsed nearly 77%, to 4.9 million barrels in the second quarter of 2026 from 21.6 million barrels in the fourth quarter of 2025, according to the U.S. Energy Information Administration.
paras.zh: 第二季度差距扩大，半导体出口总额约为1.60万亿美元，石油和天然气出口总额约为1.47万亿美元。伊朗战争后，霍尔木兹海峡石油供应中断，进一步扩大了差距。根据美国能源情报署的数据，通过海峡的每日石油流量从 2025 年第四季度的 2160 万桶降至 2026 年第二季度的 490 万桶，下降了近 77%。

paras.en: Yet the demand for semiconductors has proven insatiable in the face of soaring data center construction, boosting global trade in the increasingly scarce AI component. Hundreds of billions of dollars of orders for graphics processing units and data centers aim at providing AI computing power, Rothschild & Co. Redburn wrote in a report last Thursday.
paras.zh: 然而，面对数据中心建设的飙升，对半导体的需求已被证明是无法满足的，从而促进了日益稀缺的人工智能组件的全球贸易。 Rothschild & Co. Redburn 在上周四的一份报告中写道，数千亿美元的图形处理单元和数据中心订单旨在提供人工智能计算能力。

paras.en: "Compute will be the new commodity fueling this transformation on a global scale," Rothschild analyst Cara Thomson said.
paras.zh: 罗斯柴尔德分析师卡拉·汤姆森表示：“计算将成为推动全球范围内这一转型的新商品。”

paras.en: The shift toward chips has macroeconomic implications just as the explosion in oil trade did in the 1970s.
paras.zh: 正如 20 世纪 70 年代石油贸易的爆炸式增长一样，向芯片的转变对宏观经济产生了影响。

paras.en: Oil-exporting countries historically recycled much of their surpluses into the purchase of U.S. Treasuries and other bonds, helping finance U.S. deficits and underpin demand for other government debt.
paras.zh: 历史上，石油出口国将大部分盈余用于购买美国国债和其他债券，帮助美国赤字融资并支撑对其他政府债务的需求。

paras.en: Reid at Deutsche Bank said that since semiconductor-surplus countries in Asia are more closely tied to U.S. tech companies, some chip-export earnings could flow back into U.S. technology stocks, startups and data centers, further helping to finance the AI investment cycle.
paras.zh: 德意志银行的里德表示，由于亚洲半导体过剩国家与美国科技公司的联系更加紧密，一些芯片出口收入可能会回流到美国科技股、初创公司和数据中心，进一步帮助为人工智能投资周期提供资金。

paras.en: The changing dynamics in global trade could also tilt the mix of global financial flows, Reid said. "So welcome to the chip-dollar era: potentially more growth, more excitement, more volatility, and structurally higher yields" in corporate and government debt.
paras.zh: 里德表示，全球贸易动态的变化也可能导致全球金融流动的结构发生倾斜。 “欢迎来到芯片美元时代：企业和政府债务可能会出现更多增长、更多兴奋、更多波动以及结构性更高的收益率”。

articles.title: Microdrama apps chase profits as Hollywood moves into short-form, vertical video

paras.en: Bogdan Nesvit says his mission is simple: "We are essentially building Disney for the 21st century."
paras.zh: 博格丹·内斯维特 (Bogdan Nesvit) 表示，他的使命很简单：“我们本质上是在建设 21 世纪的迪士尼。”

paras.en: Nesvit is the co-founder of microseries app My Drama, built around the latest, bite-sized form of storytelling. Short, serialized "microdrama" videos are created specifically for mobile devices and have generated billions of views this year. They often feature romantic tropes and typically end in cliffhangers to keep viewers hooked.
paras.zh: Nesvit 是微剧应用程序 My Drama 的联合创始人，该应用程序围绕最新的小型故事讲述形式而构建。专门为移动设备创建的连载“微剧”短视频今年已产生数十亿次观看次数。它们通常以浪漫的比喻为特色，并通常以悬念结尾，以吸引观众。

paras.en: The category has exploded at a time when traditional media faces waning interest and YouTube now claims more viewing hours than individual streaming platforms.
paras.zh: 在传统媒体兴趣减弱、YouTube 目前声称观看时间比个别流媒体平台更多的情况下，该类别出现了爆炸式增长。

paras.en: The microdrama industry is projected to reach $1.5 billion in revenue in the U.S. in 2026, according to research firm Media Partners Asia. In China, where the format originally gained popularity, microdrama revenue surpassed what was made at the box office in 2024.
paras.zh: 据研究公司 Media Partners Asia 称，预计 2026 年美国微剧行业的收入将达到 15 亿美元。在这种形式最初流行的中国，微剧收入在 2024 年超过了票房收入。

paras.en: "It has the potential to evolve into mainstream entertainment and basically become mobile-first video streaming of the size of Netflix," Nesvit said.
paras.zh: 内斯维特说：“它有潜力发展成为主流娱乐，基本上成为 Netflix 规模的移动优先视频流。”

paras.en: Tech companies and startups such as My Drama currently lead the category in metrics like downloads and time spent on the apps.
paras.zh: 目前，My Drama 等科技公司和初创公司在下载量和应用时间等指标上处于领先地位。

paras.en: TikTok's PineDrama is the most popular microdrama app of 2026 so far with 13.2 million U.S. downloads through September, according to Sensor Tower data.
paras.zh: Sensor Tower 数据显示，TikTok 的 PineDrama 是 2026 年迄今为止最受欢迎的微剧应用，截至 9 月份美国下载量为 1320 万次。

paras.en: Startups DramaBox and ReelShort beat out entertainment giants Netflix and Disney in average mobile usage time in the U.S. in the third quarter, according to Sensor Tower.
paras.zh: 根据 Sensor Tower 的数据，第三季度美国初创公司 DramaBox 和 ReelShort 在平均移动使用时间方面击败了娱乐巨头 Netflix 和 Disney。

paras.en: As they see microdramas win over viewers, legacy media companies, Hollywood executives and actors increasingly want in.
paras.zh: 随着微剧赢得了观众的青睐，传统媒体公司、好莱坞高管和演员越来越想加入其中。

paras.en: Fox Entertainment was one of the earliest Hollywood investors in microdramas. The entertainment studio acquired an equity stake in Holywater Tech, the company behind My Drama, in October 2025.
paras.zh: 福克斯娱乐公司是好莱坞最早投资微剧的公司之一。该娱乐工作室于 2025 年 10 月收购了 My Drama 背后的公司 Holywater Tech 的股权。

paras.en: Fox agreed to produce at least 200 vertical video titles over two years that would be available on the Holywater app. Thus far, hits include dark academia series "Secret Society: Till Blood Do Us Part" and "Kiss of the Pirate King." Individual series have reached tens of millions of views, according to the company.
paras.zh: Fox 同意在两年内制作至少 200 个垂直视频节目，并在 Holywater 应用程序上提供。迄今为止，热门作品包括黑暗学院系列《秘密结社：直到血腥将我们分开》和《海贼王之吻》。据该公司称，单个系列的观看次数已达到数千万次。

paras.en: Nesvit told CNBC in an interview that partnerships like the one between Fox and Holywater benefit studios by providing the infrastructure to publish their short-form videos and get them in front of an audience.
paras.zh: 内斯维特在接受 CNBC 采访时表示，福克斯和霍利沃特之间的合作关系可以为电影公司提供基础设施来发布短片并将其呈现在观众面前，从而使电影公司受益。

paras.en: Beyond distributing the videos, Holywater offers advice for what types of content perform best in a short, mobile-first format, according to Nesvit.
paras.zh: 内斯维特表示，除了分发视频之外，霍利沃特还就哪些类型的内容在简短的、移动优先的格式中效果最好提供了建议。

paras.en: "One of the exciting things that we learned when we started talking to studios in Hollywood around two years ago is that all of them are super hungry for consumer data," Nesvit said. "They really want to see how people are interacting with each second of the content."
paras.zh: “大约两年前，当我们开始与好莱坞的电影公司交谈时，我们了解到的令人兴奋的事情之一是，他们都非常渴望消费者数据，”内斯维特说。 “他们真的想看看人们如何与每一秒的内容互动。”

paras.en: Nesvit said the company will provide studios with feedback on everything from the length of a camera shot to what color dress a character should wear.
paras.zh: 内斯维特表示，该公司将为工作室提供从镜头长度到角色应该穿什么颜色的衣服等方方面面的反馈。

paras.en: "Our goal is how we can drive audiences from YouTube, from TikTok, from Instagram to our platform, and also create those kinds of synergies [with] legacy media," he said.
paras.zh: “我们的目标是如何将观众从 YouTube、TikTok、Instagram 吸引到我们的平台，并与传统媒体创造这种协同效应，”他说。

paras.en: Holywater recently adapted Season 3 of Fox's reality TV hit "Farmer Wants a Wife" into a microseries fit for the platform. The company also plans to create a scripted series featuring 30 three-minute episodes inspired by Fox's "Fear Factor: House of Fear."
paras.zh: 霍利沃特最近将福克斯真人秀热门节目《农夫想要妻子》第三季改编成适合该平台的微连续剧。该公司还计划根据福克斯的《恐惧因素：恐惧之屋》的灵感，制作一个有 30 集三分钟剧集的有剧本剧集。

paras.en: Holywater currently relies on a combination of subscription fees, which make up about 80% of its revenue, and money from advertisers. Nesvit said the company is also exploring incorporating brand integrations. The company is already profitable, its co-founders said.
paras.zh: Holywater 目前主要依靠订阅费（约占其收入的 80%）和广告商的收入。内斯维特表示，该公司还在探索品牌整合。联合创始人表示，该公司已经实现盈利。

paras.en: Co-founder Anatolii Kasianov said creating the videos is "very cost efficient," with an estimated expense of between $150,000 and $200,000 for an average 70-minute series.
paras.zh: 联合创始人阿纳托利·卡西亚诺夫 (Anatolii Kasianov) 表示，制作这些视频“非常具有成本效益”，平均 70 分钟的系列视频预计费用在 15 万至 20 万美元之间。

paras.en: The company's partnerships with content studios, he said, help to bring down customer acquisition costs.
paras.zh: 他说，该公司与内容工作室的合作有助于降低客户获取成本。

paras.en: "You attract organically the audience that loves that [intellectual property]," he said.
paras.zh: “你有机地吸引了热爱[知识产权]的观众，”他说。

paras.en: While Fox saw collaboration as the way into the format, some longtime Hollywood executives are betting they can skip the partnerships and create microdrama platforms in-house.
paras.zh: 虽然福克斯将合作视为进入这种形式的途径，但一些好莱坞的长期高管认为他们可以跳过合作伙伴关系并在内部创建微剧平台。

paras.en: Jana Winograde, Susan Rovner and Lloyd Braun, who have collectively held leadership roles at NBCUniversal, Showtime, Warner Bros. Discovery and ABC, have jointly founded a microdrama startup called aTwist.
paras.zh: 贾娜·维诺格莱德 (Jana Winograde)、苏珊·罗夫纳 (Susan Rovner) 和劳埃德·布劳恩 (Lloyd Braun) 曾共同在 NBCUniversal、Showtime、华纳兄弟探索频道和美国广播公司 (ABC) 担任领导职务，共同创立了一家名为 aTwist 的微剧初创公司。

paras.en: The company, which officially launched in September, has garnered tens of millions of views as of late November across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, where content lives in addition to the app.
paras.zh: 该公司于 9 月份正式成立，截至 11 月底，在 TikTok、Instagram 和 YouTube 上已经获得了数千万次浏览量，除了应用程序之外，这些网站还提供内容。

paras.en: "One of the specialties that we have is really what it means to be a great storyteller," Rovner told CNBC in an interview. "I was president of Warner Bros. Television. I was there for 22 years. During my time there, we had over 18 series go over 100 episodes, so I definitely think we have an expertise in getting people to care about these shows, care about the characters, invest."
paras.zh: 罗夫纳在接受 CNBC 采访时表示：“我们的专长之一就是成为一名出色的讲故事者。” “我曾是华纳兄弟电视台的总裁。我在那里工作了 22 年。在我任职期间，我们制作了超过 18 个剧集，超过 100 集，所以我绝对认为我们拥有让人们关心这些节目、关心角色并进行投资的专业知识。”

paras.en: "A lot of our competitors' completion rates are very low, their churn rates are very high," Rovner said. "They can often bring people into the store but they can't keep them."
paras.zh: “我们的许多竞争对手的完成率非常低，他们的流失率非常高，”罗夫纳说。 “他们经常能把人带进店里，但却留不住人。”

paras.en: The average churn rate for the most downloaded microdrama apps is nearly 60% so far in 2026, according to Sensor Tower data. The market intelligence firm notes that the number of users lost in each quarter this year has roughly equaled the number of users gained.
paras.zh: 根据 Sensor Tower 的数据，截至 2026 年，下载次数最多的微剧应用的平均流失率接近 60%。这家市场情报公司指出，今年每个季度流失的用户数量大致等于新增的用户数量。

paras.en: ATwist seeks to keep viewers enticed through high-stakes, compelling characters and unique stories. The app has already ordered second seasons of shows and puts a particular emphasis on talent, according to the co-founders.
paras.zh: ATwist 致力于通过高风险、引人注目的角色和独特的故事来吸引观众。联合创始人表示，该应用程序已经订购了第二季的节目，并特别重视人才。

paras.en: Jesse Tyler Ferguson, known for his role as Mitchell on "Modern Family," and his husband, Justin Mikita, a Broadway producer, have collaborated on the musical series "Theater Kids vs. Zombies" for aTwist. It premiered on Oct. 15.
paras.zh: 杰西·泰勒·弗格森 (Jesse Tyler Ferguson) 因在《摩登家庭》中饰演米切尔而闻名，他和他的丈夫、百老汇制片人贾斯汀·米基塔 (Justin Mikita) 合作为 aTwist 制作了音乐剧《剧院孩子大战僵尸》。该剧于 10 月 15 日首播。

paras.en: Other series that debuted last month included "Honey, I Think Our House Is Haunted" starring Mario Lopez and "Unboxing the Killer Doll" starring Paris Hilton.
paras.zh: 上个月首映的其他剧集包括马里奥·洛佩兹主演的《亲爱的，我觉得我们的房子闹鬼》和帕丽斯·希尔顿主演的《杀手娃娃拆箱》。

paras.en: In May, aTwist announced an exclusive partnership with Skydance's linear television channel BET to create horizontal microdramas that air first on BET and later stream in vertical format on aTwist's app.
paras.zh: 5 月，aTwist 宣布与 Skydance 的线性电视频道 BET 建立独家合作伙伴关系，制作横向微剧，首先在 BET 上播出，然后在 aTwist 的应用程序上以纵向格式播放。

paras.en: "That brings a lot of awareness to our brand, a lot of marketing," Winograde said. "But it also gives these linear networks the opportunity to get programming at an incredibly low cost that, from what we're seeing, the audience loves."
paras.zh: “这为我们的品牌带来了很多知名度，也带来了很多营销活动，”维诺格莱德说。 “但它也让这些线性网络有机会以极低的成本获得节目，从我们所看到的来看，这是观众喜欢的。”

paras.en: Winograde suggested aTwist could strike similar partnerships in the future.
paras.zh: Winograde 表示 aTwist 未来可能会建立类似的合作伙伴关系。

paras.en: Large streaming companies, which have already faced competition from social media apps and YouTube, are exploring ways to incorporate microdramas inside their existing apps.
paras.zh: 大型流媒体公司已经面临来自社交媒体应用程序和 YouTube 的竞争，它们正在探索将微剧整合到现有应用程序中的方法。

paras.en: NBCUniversal's Peacock launched its own vertical video channel within the app this summer that features both original unscripted series and more traditional vertical dramas. NBCUniversal is also eyeing international development by investing in an Indian microdrama platform, EloElo Group's Story TV, earlier this month.
paras.zh: NBCUniversal 的 Peacock 今年夏天在应用程序中推出了自己的垂直视频频道，其中既有原创的无剧本剧集，也有更传统的垂直戏剧。 NBCUniversal 也在本月早些时候投资了印度微剧平台 EloElo Group 的 Story TV，着眼于国际化发展。

paras.en: "At NBCUniversal, we see significant opportunity in mobile-first storytelling and emerging formats like microdramas to engage audiences and meet evolving viewing habits," Deepak Arya, executive vice president for corporate strategy and development at NBCUniversal, said in a press release.
paras.zh: NBCUniversal 负责企业战略和发展的执行副总裁 Deepak Arya 在一份新闻稿中表示：“在 NBCUniversal，我们看到了移动优先叙事和微剧等新兴格式的巨大机遇，可以吸引观众并满足不断变化的观看习惯。”

paras.en: Disney+, Paramount+ and Netflix similarly launched vertical channels embedded in their services this year. Notably, the channels are meant to help viewers discover traditional content and so far haven't featured original, vertical-first series.
paras.zh: Disney+、Paramount+ 和 Netflix 今年同样推出了嵌入其服务的垂直频道。值得注意的是，这些频道旨在帮助观众发现传统内容，但迄今为止尚未推出原创的、垂直优先的剧集。

paras.en: On top of those media companies, head of Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios Mike Hopkins told CNBC's Julia Boorstin in an interview last month that the tech company was interested in producing its own microdramas.
paras.zh: 除了这些媒体公司之外，Prime Video 和亚马逊米高梅工作室的负责人迈克·霍普金斯 (Mike Hopkins) 上个月在接受 CNBC 的朱莉娅·布尔斯汀 (Julia Boorstin) 采访时表示，这家科技公司有兴趣制作自己的微剧。

paras.en: Despite the flurry of investment, Hollywood still faces the challenge of how to translate viewing hours into profit, especially for shorter content.
paras.zh: 尽管投资热潮，好莱坞仍然面临着如何将观看时间转化为利润的挑战，尤其是对于较短的内容。

paras.en: Leading U.S. microdrama app ReelShort posted a net loss of $12 million in 2025 despite bringing in total revenue of $785 million, according to research compiled by Media Partners Asia, or MPA.
paras.zh: 根据亚洲媒体合作伙伴 (MPA) 编制的研究报告，美国领先的微剧应用 ReelShort 公布，尽管总收入为 7.85 亿美元，但 2025 年仍净亏损 1200 万美元。

paras.en: The app, which was founded in 2022 by California-based Crazy Maple Studio, currently reaches about 65 million users every month, according to the company's LinkedIn profile.
paras.zh: 该应用程序由总部位于加利福尼亚州的 Crazy Maple Studio 于 2022 年创立，根据该公司的 LinkedIn 资料显示，目前每月约有 6500 万用户。

paras.en: However, high marketing and content costs have weighed on the company's bottom line. MPA expects ReelShort to reach profitability for the first time this year, with an estimated $40 million in net profit.
paras.zh: 然而，高昂的营销和内容成本给该公司的利润带来了压力。 MPA 预计 ReelShort 今年将首次实现盈利，净利润预计为 4000 万美元。

paras.en: Media Partners Asia CEO Vivek Couto told CNBC that acquiring new users is the largest cost, with ReelShort spending an estimated 55% of its revenue in 2025 on marketing.
paras.zh: Media Partners Asia 首席执行官 Vivek Couto 告诉 CNBC，获取新用户是最大的成本，预计 2025 年 ReelShort 将其收入的 55% 用于营销。

paras.en: Couto also noted high content spend, especially since microdrama apps typically require a high volume of content.
paras.zh: 库托还指出，内容支出很高，特别是因为微剧应用通常需要大量内容。

paras.en: "The content is very hit-driven … it wears out fast," Couto said. "The churn rate for this sector is high, so you have to fill that slate all the time, and you have to win back those users."
paras.zh: “这些内容非常受热捧……它很快就会过时，”库托说。 “这个行业的流失率很高，所以你必须一直填补这个空白，并且你必须赢回这些用户。”

paras.en: Correction: A previous version misstated Holywater Tech's full name in first reference. Co-founder Anatolii Kasianov also said expenses run between $150,000 and $200,000 for an average 70-minute series. A previous version misstated the average series length.
paras.zh: 更正：之前的版本在第一个参考文献中错误地表述了 Holywater Tech 的全名。联合创始人阿纳托利·卡西亚诺夫还表示，平均 70 分钟的系列剧费用在 15 万至 20 万美元之间。之前的版本错误地表述了平均系列长度。

articles.title: Trump demands probe into ‘record setting error’ after third-quarter GDP data gets massive revision higher

paras.en: President Donald Trump on Thursday falsely deemed the latest gross domestic product revision a mistake, claiming that it should be "immediately investigated."
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周四错误地认为最新的国内生产总值修正是一个错误，声称应该“立即调查”。

paras.en: Data released Wednesday from the Commerce Department revealed that the U.S. economy exhibited much stronger growth for the third quarter than initially estimated, showing that real GDP grew at a 4.3% annualized rate. That was revised upward from the department's advance estimate of 3.4%.
paras.zh: 美国商务部周三公布的数据显示，美国第三季度经济增长远强于最初预期，实际GDP年化增长率为4.3%。该数字是该部门预先估计的 3.4% 上调的。

paras.en: That revision was a "RECORD SETTING ERROR," Trump said in a Truth Social post, suggesting that the initial release could have influenced the outcome of the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, where Democrats flipped both chambers of Congress and even multiple governorships.
paras.zh: 特朗普在《Truth Social》帖子中表示，这一修订是一个“创纪录的错误”，暗示最初的发布可能会影响 2026 年美国中期选举的结果，民主党在这次选举中推翻了国会两院甚至多个州长职位。

paras.en: "I would like to wish a Happy Thanksgiving to even those who issued fake Economic Numbers, just prior to the Election, and corrected them yesterday, three weeks late, showing that the GDP was actually 4.3%, versus 3.4%, A RECORD SETTING ERROR, and one so grave that it should be immediately investigated," Trump wrote.
paras.zh: 特朗普写道：“我祝愿那些在选举前夕发布虚假经济数据并在三周后的昨天更正这些数据的人感恩节快乐，这些数据显示GDP实际上是4.3%，而不是3.4%，这是一个创纪录的错误，而且这个错误如此严重，应该立即进行调查。”

paras.en: However, the difference between the advance estimate and the figure in the second release is far from being an all-time record. It was the largest revision since the 1.2 percentage point revision seen in the second quarter of 2020.
paras.zh: 然而，预先估计与第二次发布的数字之间的差异远未达到历史记录。这是自 2020 年第二季度 1.2 个百分点修正以来的最大修正。

paras.en: On an absolute basis, the latest revision was tied for 16th among all revisions from the advance estimate to the second release since 1990. It also tied four other quarters with a similar 0.9 percentage point difference — and was approximately double the average revision of 0.43 percentage points for all 147 quarters.
paras.zh: 从绝对值来看，最新修订在自 1990 年以来第二次发布的预先估计的所有修订中并列第 16 位。它还以类似的 0.9 个百分点的差异与其他四个季度并列，大约是所有 147 个季度 0.43 个百分点的平均修订的两倍。

paras.en: The upward revision shows Trump's policies are "delivering results" that defy expectations, White House spokesman Matthew Middleton told CNBC.
paras.zh: 白宫发言人马修·米德尔顿 (Matthew Middleton) 向 CNBC 表示，向上修正表明特朗普的政策正在“带来超出预期的结果”。

paras.en: Revisions to U.S. economic numbers are not out of the ordinary. Initial reports count on partial survey data and early estimates. Those data are later updated with more survey responses — which sometimes leads to changes from the initial reports.
paras.zh: 美国经济数据的修正并不罕见。初步报告依赖于部分调查数据和早期估计。这些数据随后会随着更多的调查回复而更新——这有时会导致初始报告发生变化。

paras.en: GDP data is revised repeatedly over a five year period. By the time the final revision is done, the average absolute error from the second release to the final is 1.14 percentage points.
paras.zh: GDP 数据在五年内反复修订。到最终修订完成时，第二次发布到最终版本的平均绝对误差为1.14个百分点。

paras.en: The advance estimate for Q3 U.S. GDP, which came just days before Election Day in early November, was still better than the figure economists had expected at the time. It also showed a significant step-up in growth from the second quarter.
paras.zh: 就在 11 月初选举日前几天，对美国第三季度 GDP 的预先估计仍然好于经济学家当时的预期。与第二季度相比，增长也显着加快。

paras.en: Because that was a strong showing for the economy, some on Wall Street consider this week's revision to be a confirmation of the economy's recent growth trend.
paras.zh: 由于经济表现强劲，华尔街的一些人认为本周的修正是对经济近期增长趋势的确认。

paras.en: Jim Baird of Plante Moran Financial Advisors said immediately following the release that it "reinforces an increasingly familiar tension" that the economy is "performing quite well, but its resilience also gives the Fed an even stronger case for further rate hikes."
paras.zh: Plante Moran Financial Advisors 的吉姆·贝尔德 (Jim Baird) 在消息发布后立即表示，这“强化了一种日益熟悉的紧张局势”，即经济“表现相当不错，但其韧性也为美联储进一步加息提供了更有力的理由”。

paras.en: "The economy isn't merely hanging in there. It continues to demonstrate considerable resilience, with consumers spending, businesses investing and few signs that restrictive monetary policy is creating significant cracks in the broader expansion," the firm's chief investment officer said.
paras.zh: 该公司的首席投资官表示：“经济并不仅仅是停滞不前。它继续表现出相当大的弹性，消费者支出、企业投资，而且几乎没有迹象表明限制性货币政策正在对更广泛的扩张造成重大影响。”

paras.en: Traders are currently pricing in a nearly 100% chance of a hike at the Federal Open Market Committee's December meeting, per the CME FedWatch tool. They're also anticipating an additional hike in January.
paras.zh: 根据 CME FedWatch 工具，交易员目前预计联邦公开市场委员会 12 月会议上加息的可能性接近 100%。他们还预计一月份还会进一步加息。

paras.en: — CNBC's Jeff Cox and Fred Imbert contributed reporting
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 Jeff Cox 和 Fred Imbert 贡献了报道

articles.title: Who is Levent Alpöge, the reclusive genius behind AI’s math conquest?

paras.en: Levent Alpöge got back to the place he was crashing in New York City around 4 A.M. on November 20. He was almost done. He could almost sleep.
paras.zh: 凌晨 4 点左右，Levent Alpöge 回到了纽约市坠机地点。 11 月 20 日。他快完成了。他几乎可以睡觉了。

paras.en: All that was left was to download the 17 million lines of code he’d spent the night preparing for public release. It needed to go up on his personal website, alongside a four-page statement he’d tinkered with all week. But for the moment, the code still sat on the servers of his employer, the artificial intelligence company Anthropic—which had gone public just hours earlier with the largest valuation in stock market history, making Alpöge a rich man. Once the upload was complete, he would also be one of history’s most famous mathematicians.
paras.zh: 剩下的就是下载他花了一晚上准备公开发布的 1700 万行代码。它需要出现在他的个人网站上，同时附上他花了一周时间修改的四页声明。但目前，该代码仍然保存在他的雇主——人工智能公司 Anthropic 的服务器上——这家公司在几个小时前刚刚上市，估值创下了股市历史上最高的估值，使 Alpöge 成为了一名富翁。一旦上传完成，他也将成为历史上最著名的数学家之一。

paras.en: The code was the product of untold computing resources, months of work and decades of dreaming. It proved the Riemann hypothesis, a 167-year-old math problem so formidable that it is almost beyond words; in public talks, experts have tended to simply treat it as an over-the-horizon aspiration, a “vanishing point” perspective against which all other math problems shrink. Just weeks earlier Terence Tao—arguably the world’s most famous mathematician—had declared the hypothesis out of AI’s reach (let alone that of humans) until perhaps 2050.
paras.zh: 该代码是无数计算资源、数月工作和数十年梦想的产物。它证明了黎曼猜想，这是一个有着 167 年历史的数学难题，其难度之大几乎难以用言语来形容；在公开演讲中，专家们倾向于简单地将其视为一种超越地平线的愿望，一种“消失点”的视角，所有其他数学问题都会在这种视角下缩小。就在几周前，陶哲轩——可以说是世界上最著名的数学家——宣布这一假设在 2050 年之前人工智能都无法实现（更不用说人类了）。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Now the challenge is vanquished. Alpöge’s quiet upload capped off an epochal year in which AI has systematically conquered humanity’s oldest discipline in a sequence of escalating, dramatic and controversial discoveries. And in nearly every episode of this earthshaking war for math’s soul, Alpöge has figured somehow—part battlefield champion, part horseman of the AI apocalypse, part Forrest Gump. His eccentric ways have shaped this saga, maybe more than any other single person on Earth, and thereby the course of history.
paras.zh: 现在，挑战已被克服。 Alpöge 的安静上传结束了划时代的一年，在这一年中，人工智能通过一系列不断升级的、戏剧性的和有争议的发现，系统地征服了人类最古老的学科。在这场数学灵魂之战的几乎每一集中，阿尔波吉都以某种方式出现——一半是战场冠军，一半是人工智能启示录的骑士，一半是阿甘正传。他古怪的方式对这个传奇的影响可能比地球上任何其他人都要大，从而影响了历史的进程。

paras.en: That is perhaps why people are so divided over Alpöge. “Who is this person who’s behind some of the most striking applications of AI to mathematics?” says Henry Cohn, a mathematician at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. “This is a really interesting question that deserves a deeper answer than you can get from following him on X.”
paras.zh: 也许这就是为什么人们对阿尔卑格的看法如此分歧。 “人工智能在数学上的一些最引人注目的应用背后的这个人是谁？”麻省理工学院数学家亨利·科恩说。 “这是一个非常有趣的问题，值得比在 X 上关注他所得到的更深入的答案。”

paras.en: Depending on who you ask, Alpöge is a reviled online troll—an agent of chaos laughing as his fellow mathematicians watch their intellectual landscape get carpet-bombed by his Silicon Valley cohort—or a reluctant public figure—a shy academic who has integrity and wants to forge a future where AI is mathematicians’ collaborator, not their usurper. Or maybe he’s an arrogant genius who has a chip on his shoulder and is bent on leveraging his access, his internal models and unlimited tokens, to prove his doubters wrong by snatching every remaining mathematical trophy off the shelf.
paras.zh: 取决于你问的是谁，Alpöge 是一个被谩骂的网络巨魔，一个混乱的代理人，当他的数学家同事们看着他们的知识图景被他的硅谷同伴进行地毯式轰炸时，他会大笑；或者一个不情愿的公众人物，一个害羞的学者，他正直，想要创造一个人工智能是数学家的合作者，而不是他们的篡夺者的未来。或者，他可能是一个傲慢的天才，一心一意地利用他的访问权限、他的内部模型和无限的代币，通过抢走架子上所有剩余的数学奖杯来证明他的怀疑者是错误的。

paras.en: Whatever the truth is, it’s hard to know because Alpöge won’t tell. He refuses to speak to media. This article has been assembled from interviews with dozens of friends, mentors, collaborators and acquaintances.
paras.zh: 无论真相是什么，都很难知道，因为 Alpöge 不会透露。他拒绝接受媒体采访。本文根据对数十位朋友、导师、合作者和熟人的采访整理而成。

paras.en: Alpöge’s online persona is confusing and tempestuous. He topples famous conjectures with glib and gleeful social media posts—and then gets baited into emotionally replying to anonymous commenters. His X bio starts with the self-effacing descriptor “idiot” but follows with a litany of world-class accolades. There are few photographs of Alpöge online, but they all present a consistent picture: thick eyebrows over an angular, almost-elfin face, thin bangs halfway between a Beatles mop top and a bowl cut and an impish smile that reveals a slight gap between his front teeth and an unmistakable capacity for mischief.
paras.zh: Alpöge 的网络形象令人困惑且暴躁。他用巧言令色、兴高采烈的社交媒体帖子推翻了著名的猜想，然后情绪激动地回复了匿名评论者。他的 X 简介以谦逊的描述词“白痴”开始，但随后获得了一连串世界级的赞誉。网上很少有 Alpöge 的照片，但它们都呈现出一致的形象：粗眉毛覆盖着一张棱角分明、近乎精灵般的脸，刘海介于甲壳虫乐队的拖把上衣和碗形发型之间，顽皮的微笑显露出门牙之间的轻微缝隙和明显的恶作剧能力。

paras.en: According to numerous sources close to him, though, behind the irreverent visage is a fierce hunger for respect and recognition, paired with a boundless belief in his own capabilities—a drive shocking even to the world-class polymaths who know him. No goal is too ambitious. Even the Riemann hypothesis—math’s one true holy grail—proved to be no limit.
paras.zh: 然而，据众多与他关系密切的消息人士透露，在他不敬的面容背后，是对尊重和认可的强烈渴望，以及对自己能力的无限信念——这种动力甚至让认识他的世界级博学者都感到震惊。没有什么目标是太雄心勃勃的。甚至黎曼猜想——数学真正的圣杯——也被证明是没有极限的。

paras.en: “He has this will to take on the world and win,” says Scott Armstrong, a mathematician at New York University and a rare Alpöge confidant. “He’s got it in spades.”
paras.zh: 纽约大学数学家、Alpöge 罕见的知己斯科特·阿姆斯特朗 (Scott Armstrong) 表示：“他有征服世界并取得胜利的意志。” “他确实做到了。”

paras.en: In today’s world, where large teams are the norm for any assault on frontier research problems, Alpöge is an anomaly: he mostly works alone, except, of course, for the powerful internal models he has privileged access to. “Here is a person that is larger than life,” Armstrong says. “I keep asking myself, ‘When they make the movie, who is going to play Levent?’”
paras.zh: 在当今世界，大型团队已成为攻克前沿研究问题的常态，但 Alpöge 却是一个反常现象：他大部分时间都是独自工作，当然，除了他有权使用的强大内部模型之外。 “这是一个比生命更伟大的人，”阿姆斯特朗说。 “我一直问自己，‘当他们拍电影时，谁来扮演莱文特？’”

paras.en: Levent Alpöge was born on April Fool’s Day, 1992, along the central stretch of Long Island.
paras.zh: Levent Alpöge 诞生于 1992 年愚人节，位于长岛中部。

paras.en: His parents, both Turkish immigrants, realized their son’s intellect was remarkable when he was just three years old. As his mother told a Turkish newspaper in 2014, she was reading him one of his favorite books and said she was too tired to continue, so Alpöge picked up where she’d stopped. At first she thought he had memorized the page, but when she gave him another book, he kept reading. Somehow, he’d learned without instruction. On the advice of professionals, they enrolled him in a nearby gifted program.
paras.zh: 他的父母都是土耳其移民，在儿子三岁时就意识到他的智力非凡。 2014 年，他的母亲告诉一家土耳其报纸，她正在给他读一本他最喜欢的书，并说她太累了，无法继续读下去，所以阿尔波格从她停下来的地方继续读下去。起初她以为他已经记住了这一页，但当她给他另一本书时，他继续读下去。不知怎的，他在没有指导的情况下就学会了。根据专业人士的建议，他们为他报名了附近的一个天才项目。

paras.en: Levent Alpöge’s one sister, Elif, is a decade older, which made him practically an only child for much of the time. Alpöge was extremely athletic and especially into distance running and soccer—with his favorite soccer team being Istanbul’s Beşiktaş Gymnastics Club.
paras.zh: 莱文特·阿尔波格 (Levent Alpöge) 的一个姐姐埃利夫 (Elif) 比他大十岁，这使得他在大部分时间里几乎是独生子。阿尔波格非常擅长运动，尤其是长跑和足球——他最喜欢的足球队是伊斯坦布尔的贝西克塔斯体操俱乐部。

paras.en: He picked up coding early. In 2009, at age 17, he connected with bioinformatics professor Xenophon Papademetris of Yale University. Papademetris’s group assigned Alpöge a research problem the team had little time for. The idea was to use Nvidia graphical processing units (GPUs)—the technology now powering the AI revolution—to recognize vascular structures in medical images.
paras.zh: 他很早就开始编码。 2009年，17岁的他结识了耶鲁大学生物信息学教授Xenophon Papademetris。 Papademetris 的团队给 Alpöge 分配了一个研究问题，但该团队几乎没有时间进行研究。这个想法是使用 Nvidia 图形处理单元 (GPU)（目前正在推动人工智能革命的技术）来识别医学图像中的血管结构。

paras.en: “He helped do one of the first GPU implementations of an image analysis algorithm,” Papademetris says. “He was a 17-year-old kid who could say, ‘I will do it.’” The professor recalls what he wrote of Alpöge in his college recommendation letter, “His enthusiasm was contagious, his energy was boundless, and his confidence in his ability to overcome obstacles almost frightening.”
paras.zh: “他帮助完成了图像分析算法的第一个 GPU 实现，”Papademetris 说。 “他是一个 17 岁的孩子，可以说，‘我会做到的。’”教授回忆起他在大学推荐信中对阿尔波格的描述，“他的热情具有感染力，他的能量无穷无尽，他对自己克服障碍的能力的信心几乎令人恐惧。”

paras.en: Alpöge’s algorithm was enough to “punch your ticket to any university in the country,” Papademetris says. “My letter was irrelevant.” As a bonus for the achievement, a team at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology’s Lincoln Laboratory named an asteroid “Alpöge.”
paras.zh: 帕帕德梅特里斯说，阿尔波格的算法足以“帮你拿到国内任何大学的门票”。 “我的信无关紧要。”作为这项成就的奖励，麻省理工学院林肯实验室的一个团队将一颗小行星命名为“Alpöge”。

paras.en: The teenager ultimately chose Harvard University. He fell in love with math once he got there. “He distinguished himself even in that class of overachieving first-years,” says Noam Elkies of Harvard, who was his math professor that year, “finding more than half the corrections in class materials that I did not notice sooner.” Other instructors noted Alpöge’s fastidiousness could cause tensions: in a recent Bluesky post, physicist Matt Reece recalled how the young Alpöge joined Reece’s graduate physics course and so angered the students with his persistent mathematical questions that “I feared someone would actually punch him in class.”
paras.zh: 这位少年最终选择了哈佛大学。他一到那里就爱上了数学。 “即使在一年级成绩优异的班级中，他也表现出色，”当年担任他的数学教授、哈佛大学的诺姆·埃尔基斯 (Noam Elkies) 说，“他在课堂材料中找到了一半以上我没有注意到的更正。”其他老师指出阿尔波格的挑剔可能会引起紧张：在最近的一篇 Bluesky 帖子中，物理学家马特·里斯回忆起年轻的阿尔波格如何加入里斯的研究生物理课程，并因他顽固的数学问题激怒了学生，以至于“我担心有人会在课堂上打他。”

paras.en: By his junior year, Alpöge was under the tutelage of renowned mathematician Jacob Tsimerman. (A few months ago Tsimerman won a Fields Medal, math’s highest honor, and then announced he was leaving academia to work on AI safety.)
paras.zh: 到大三时，阿尔波格就师从著名数学家雅各布·齐默曼 (Jacob Tsimerman)。 （几个月前，齐默曼获得了菲尔兹奖，这是数学的最高荣誉，然后宣布他将离开学术界，从事人工智能安全方面的工作。）

paras.en: That year Alpöge participated in a well-known summer undergraduate research program at the University of Minnesota Duluth. The program’s longtime leader, Joe Gallian, recalls Alpöge as unusually buoyant and charismatic. After visiting the program, mathematician Rishi Nath said to Gallian, “Everybody wants to be like Levent.”
paras.zh: 那一年，Alpöge 参加了明尼苏达大学德卢斯分校著名的暑期本科生研究项目。该项目的长期领导者 Joe Gallian 回忆道，Alpöge 异常活跃且富有魅力。数学家 Rishi Nath 在参观完该项目后对 Gallian 说：“每个人都想成为 Levent 那样的人。”

paras.en: Alpöge did groundbreaking work that summer, publishing papers in top journals that were on par with those of established professionals. With two weeks left, Gallian gave Alpöge a particularly hard problem to occupy his remaining time. Gallan said, “Work on it until classes start, and then, if you don’t have anything, it’s fine.” But Alpöge told him, “I’ll work on it until I solve it.”
paras.zh: 那年夏天，阿尔波格做了开创性的工作，在顶级期刊上发表了与知名专业人士的论文相当的论文。还剩两周时间，加利安给阿尔波格出了一道特别难的题，以打发他剩余的时间。加兰说：“一直努力到开课，然后，如果你没有任何东西，也没关系。”但阿尔波格告诉他：“我会继续努力，直到解决为止。”

paras.en: He showed similar tenacity for everything in life, Gallian says. During the Duluth group’s yearly stop at a restaurant called Betty’s Pies along Minnesota State Highway 61, three students volunteered for the “pig’s trough” challenge: if they could eat a massive pie stuffed with ice cream in 15 minutes, they’d win a free T-shirt. Alpöge did it in three minutes and 43 seconds—a record at the time.* He also ran Duluth’s annual marathon, and Gallian snapped a photograph of him outracing everybody at an “alpine sliding” course. “You can see the competitiveness and the fierceness and the power of concentration,” Gallian says.
paras.zh: 加利安说，他对生活中的一切都表现出了类似的坚韧。德卢斯小组每年都会在明尼苏达州 61 号公路沿线的一家名为 Betty’s Pies 的餐厅停留期间，三名学生自愿参加“猪槽”挑战：如果他们能在 15 分钟内吃掉一个巨大的冰淇淋馅饼，他们将赢得一件免费 T 恤。阿尔波格用时 3 分 43 秒完成了这一任务，创下了当时的纪录。*他还参加了德卢斯的年度马拉松比赛，加利安拍了一张他在“高山滑行”路线上超越所有人的照片。 “你可以看到竞争力、激烈程度和专注的力量，”加利安说。

paras.en: The following year Alpöge’s undergraduate thesis, about famous equations called “elliptic curves,” won him the illustrious Morgan Prize. In a recommendation letter, the late Harvard professor Benedict Gross called it “a tremendous piece of research for an undergraduate, at the level of an outstanding PhD thesis.” Perhaps, Gross speculated in his letter, something like a Fields Medal was in Alpöge’s future, too. Tsimerman struck a similar note in a recommendation of his own: “Often it seemed as if there was no way to proceed, and I even suggested switching problems a few times when I thought there was a dead end,” he wrote. “But Levent enjoyed the challenge too much to stop.”
paras.zh: 第二年，阿尔波格的本科论文涉及著名的“椭圆曲线”方程，为他赢得了著名的摩根奖。已故哈佛大学教授本尼迪克特·格罗斯（Benedict Gross）在一封推荐信中称其为“对于本科生来说是一项伟大的研究，达到了杰出博士论文的水平”。格罗斯在信中推测，也许阿尔波格的未来也会获得菲尔兹奖之类的东西。齐默尔曼在自己的建议中也表达了类似的观点：“通常情况下，似乎没有办法继续下去，当我认为有一个死胡同时，我什至建议几次转换问题，”他写道。 “但莱文特太享受这个挑战了，无法停止。”

paras.en: Alpöge added to his illustrious CV with a Ph.D. from Princeton University and postdoctoral position back at Harvard. His doctoral advisor, the Fields Medalist Manjul Bhargava, cites the same exuberance and talent but adds that Alpöge “was slow to write up the new things he did, in part because he was always thinking about so many things.”
paras.zh: Alpöge 在他杰出的简历中增添了博士学位。从普林斯顿大学获得博士学位，并回到哈佛大学担任博士后职位。他的博士生导师、菲尔兹奖得主曼朱尔·巴尔加瓦 (Manjul Bhargava) 也提到了同样的热情和才华，但他补充道，阿尔波格“写下他所做的新事物的速度很慢，部分原因是他总是在思考太多事情。”

paras.en: Bhargava also recalls a time when a family member on Long Island was ill and Levent offered to take leave from his job to move home and help. “I’ve never forgotten that gesture,” Bhargava says, calling Alpöge “a very kind and caring person.”
paras.zh: 巴尔加瓦还回忆起，有一次，长岛的一名家庭成员生病了，莱文特提出请假搬回家帮忙。 “我永远不会忘记那个举动，”巴尔加瓦说，并称阿尔波格是“一个非常善良和有爱心的人”。

paras.en: Yet Alpöge’s frenzied approach sometimes ruffled feathers in academia. In a pithy February 2025 Facebook post, he wrote that he’d solved a “Hilbert problem,” one of math’s big trophies. But two other mathematicians had already solved the problem. As of today, Alpöge still proudly lists the accolade on his website and X bio.
paras.zh: 然而，阿尔波格的疯狂做法有时会激怒学术界。在 2025 年 2 月的 Facebook 简洁帖子中，他写道，他解决了“希尔伯特问题”，这是数学界的一大奖杯。但另外两位数学家已经解决了这个问题。直到今天，Alpöge 仍然自豪地在他的网站和 X bio 上列出了这一荣誉。

paras.en: Alpöge’s departure to Anthropic in the summer of 2024 didn’t surprise anyone close to him. He frequently expressed frustrations with academia and its antiquated journal system, they say, and had become obsessed with AI from the moment he interacted with OpenAI’s GPT-4 in mid-2023.
paras.zh: Alpöge 于 2024 年夏天离开到 Anthropic，并没有让任何与他关系密切的人感到惊讶。他们说，他经常对学术界及其过时的期刊系统表示失望，从 2023 年中期与 OpenAI 的 GPT-4 互动那一刻起，他就开始沉迷于人工智能。

paras.en: He joined the company under a vague title, “member of technical staff.” Anthropic declined a request to give further information about his official work. Everyone with second-hand knowledge of the arrangement, however, insists he was not hired to do math.
paras.zh: 他以一个模糊的头衔加入公司：“技术人员”。 Anthropic 拒绝提供有关其官方工作的进一步信息的请求。然而，每个对这一安排有二手了解的人都坚称，他不是被雇来做数学的。

paras.en: But Anthropic employees are allowed to experiment with unreleased versions of Claude in their off time. “Give a math person access to a powerful LLM [large language model] with access to a lot of compute,” says M.I.T. mathematician Andrew Sutherland, “and they will eventually start asking it math questions, whether you want them to or not.”
paras.zh: 但 Anthropic 的员工可以在休息时间尝试未发行的 Claude 版本。麻省理工学院表示：“让数学人员能够接触到强大的 LLM（大型语言模型）并进行大量计算。”数学家安德鲁·萨瑟兰（Andrew Sutherland）表示，“无论你是否愿意，他们最终都会开始问它数学问题。”

paras.en: Alpöge first gained wider recognition on July 19, 2026, with a curt X post at 10:19 P.M. EDT announcing he had solved the Jacobian conjecture, one of math’s most famous problems. Another mathematician, Akhil Mathew of the University of Chicago, had thought that the conjecture might be within reach of cutting-edge AI models and had mentioned it in passing to Alpöge, who took the idea and ran with it.
paras.zh: Alpöge 于 2026 年 7 月 19 日晚上 10:19 发布了一条简短的 X 帖子，首次获得更广泛的认可。 EDT 宣布他解决了雅可比猜想，这是数学最著名的问题之一。另一位数学家、芝加哥大学的阿基尔·马修 (Akhil Mathew) 认为这个猜想可能可以用尖端人工智能模型实现，并在向 Alpöge 提及这一点时，Alpöge 接受了这个想法并付诸实践。

paras.en: This achievement was a turning point, the first really famous math problem AI solved—the sort of thing most people would’ve revealed in a long, explanatory manuscript submitted to a top math journal. To critics, Alpöge’s nonchalant post almost seemed to say, with a callous shrug, “Yup, AI is better than you now.” (Friends say Alpöge now regrets the approach he took, for which a number of prominent mathematicians have castigated him publicly and privately.)
paras.zh: 这一成就是一个转折点，是人工智能解决的第一个真正著名的数学问题——大多数人会在提交给顶级数学期刊的长篇解释性手稿中透露这一点。对于批评者来说，阿尔波格冷漠的帖子几乎像是在冷酷地耸耸肩说：“是的，人工智能现在比你更好。” （朋友们说，阿尔波格现在对他所采取的做法感到后悔，为此，许多著名数学家公开和私下严厉批评了他。）

paras.en: Over the following months, Alpöge repeated this pattern again and again. He’d think of a problem, either because he knew it from his own area of number theory or because another mathematician suggested it. He’d throw his allowance of tokens and an internal version of Claude at it and then inform a few trusted outside experts of what he found. If necessary, he’d iterate based on their feedback.
paras.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，Alpöge 一次又一次重复这种模式。他会想到一个问题，要么是因为他从自己的数论领域知道了这个问题，要么是因为另一位数学家提出了这个问题。他会投入自己的代币和克劳德的内部版本，然后将他的发现告知一些值得信赖的外部专家。如有必要，他会根据他们的反馈进行迭代。

paras.en: These breakthroughs—too numerous and esoteric to concisely list here—spanned a breathtaking range of mathematical topics, more than any single mathematician can productively work in. Of course, Alpöge didn’t need to understand each topic completely. He would act as a kind of liaison between his legions of Claude agents and his human collaborators.
paras.zh: 这些突破数量众多，深奥难懂，无法在这里一一列举，涵盖了令人惊叹的数学主题，超出了任何一个数学家所能有效完成的范围。当然，Alpöge 并不需要完全理解每个主题。他将充当他的克劳德特工军团和他的人类合作者之间的联络人。

paras.en: He’d give his agentic army a direction, often based on the human experts’ guidance, and they’d churn out thousands of pages of calculations, mostly in a math-slop dialect unreadable to any human. But the slop corresponded, in some impenetrable way, to actual mathematical truth. Alpöge’s task was to translate this output, with the help of yet another LLM, into readable math. He’s become a kind of LLM whisperer through this unconventional, somewhat aggravating process, which he calls “AI psychosis,” according to Ethan Sussman, a mathematician at Northwestern University.
paras.zh: 他会给他的代理军队一个方向，通常是根据人类专家的指导，他们会写出数千页的计算结果，大部分是用任何人都无法理解的数学方言。但这个斜率以某种难以理解的方式与实际的数学真理相对应。 Alpöge 的任务是在另一位法学硕士的帮助下将这一输出转化为可读的数学。西北大学数学家伊森·苏斯曼 (Ethan Sussman) 表示，通过这种非传统的、有些令人恼火的过程，他已经成为了一名法学硕士窃窃私语者，他称之为“人工智能精神病”。

paras.en: Still, Alpöge’s correspondents all remark on his shocking ability to grasp subjects far from his expertise—and on his unflagging resolve. “I think he really does understand all this math,” Armstrong says. “He’s like some kind of genius.”
paras.zh: 尽管如此，阿尔波格的记者们都称赞他掌握远离他专业知识的主题的惊人能力，以及他坚定不移的决心。 “我认为他确实理解所有这些数学，”阿姆斯特朗说。 “他就像某种天才。”

paras.en: “He is exceptionally broad,” Sussman agrees. While Sussman is usually the most intense person in his collaborations, “Levent is an order of magnitude more intense than I am,” he says. Alpöge “sets his sights on the goal, and he’s like, ‘I’ll sleep when this is done.’”
paras.zh: “他非常宽广，”萨斯曼表示同意。虽然萨斯曼通常是他合作中最热情的人，但“莱文特的热情比我高一个数量级，”他说。 Alpöge“将目光瞄准了目标，他说，‘完成后我就睡觉了。’”

paras.en: In fact, the issue of Alpöge’s sleep—or lack thereof—is something many of his recent collaborators have noticed with concern. His messages and check-ins, arriving at all hours, seem untethered from any circadian routine. “I don’t know when he’s sleeping,” several of his collaborators told me.
paras.zh: 事实上，阿尔波格的睡眠问题（或者说缺乏睡眠）是他最近的许多合作者都关心的问题。他的信息和报到信息随时都会到达，似乎不受任何昼夜节律的束缚。 “我不知道他什么时候睡觉，”他的几位合作者告诉我。

paras.en: What happened next was a crash. Just as Alpöge was nearing one of math’s loftiest summits, hoping to solve a “million-dollar” problem from the Clay Mathematics Institute’s Millennium Prize list—the highest-value math targets out there—Anthropic’s archrival, OpenAI, swooped in. Rumors had spread that Alpöge and N.Y.U. mathematician Tristan Buckmaster were about to solve the Navier-Stokes problem. Looking for a win, OpenAI’s math team threw colossal amounts of computing power at the problem over several days to get there first.
paras.zh: 接下来发生的是一场车祸。正当 Alpöge 接近数学最高峰之一，希望解决克莱数学研究所千年奖名单上的“百万美元”问题（最高价值的数学目标）时，Anthropic 的主要竞争对手 OpenAI 突然介入。数学家特里斯坦·巴克马斯特即将解决纳维-斯托克斯问题。为了寻求胜利，OpenAI 的数学团队在几天内投入了大量的计算能力来解决这个问题，以便首先实现这一目标。

paras.en: The media painted the controversy as a David versus Goliath narrative. Alpöge did his best to stay out of it and mostly avoided the uproar, while Buckmaster was cast as the human struck down by an iron-fisted tech juggernaut.
paras.zh: 媒体将这场争议描述为大卫与歌利亚的故事。阿尔波格尽最大努力置身事外，基本上避免了骚动，而巴克马斯特则扮演被铁腕科技巨头击倒的人类。

paras.en: A month later OpenAI followed up the Navier-Stokes blockbuster with more than 700 additional results. The proof dump fell upon a mathematical community already in turmoil. It also scooped a number of mathematicians’ progress on important problems, including collaborations with Alpöge that were underway. Any paranoia he already felt was now magnified, and he became increasingly withdrawn, convinced that leaks between the two companies were stealing his progress.
paras.zh: 一个月后，OpenAI 继 Navier-Stokes 的重磅成果之后又推出了 700 多项额外结果。证明转储落在了已经陷入混乱的数学界身上。它还报道了许多数学家在重要问题上的进展，包括正在进行的与 Alpöge 的合作。他已经感觉到的偏执现在被放大了，他变得越来越孤僻，确信两家公司之间的泄密正在窃取他的进步。

paras.en: The most impressive result in OpenAI’s dump, maybe the most impressive AI-powered result up until then, was a proof that made significant progress toward the Riemann hypothesis. This was Alpöge’s favorite problem, the one he’d harbored unspoken dreams of someday besting. Publicly, he posted on X to commend OpenAI’s team for its work. But the very same day, he started poking harder around the edges of the hypothesis with his internal version of Claude.
paras.zh: OpenAI 转储中最令人印象深刻的结果，也许是迄今为止最令人印象深刻的人工智能驱动的结果，是在黎曼假设方面取得重大进展的证明。这是阿尔波格最喜欢的问题，他心中暗暗梦想有一天能打败这个问题。他公开在 X 上发帖赞扬 OpenAI 团队的工作。但就在同一天，他开始用他内心版本的克劳德更努力地探索这个假设的边缘。

paras.en: On October 14 Armstrong sat down on a bench in Alpöge’s hotel lobby in Aspen, Colo.
paras.zh: 10 月 14 日，阿姆斯特朗坐在科罗拉多州阿斯彭 Alpöge 酒店大堂的长凳上。

paras.en: He’d messaged Alpöge, whom he knew was in Aspen for the same secret “AIxMath” conference, because he hadn’t seen him at any of the events. Alpöge said he’d been hiding out in his hotel room and suggested they go for a walk.
paras.zh: 他给 Alpöge 发了消息，他知道 Alpöge 正在阿斯彭参加同一个秘密“AIxMath”会议，因为他在任何活动中都没有见过他。阿尔波格说，他一直躲在酒店房间里，建议他们去散步。

paras.en: The two had only spoken once before, at an N.Y.U. lunch in July. Armstrong was showing Alpöge’s Jacobian conjecture X post on his phone to colleagues around the table. He couldn’t figure out why they were giggling until the stranger with a bowl cut sitting next to him turned and said with a smile, “That was me.”
paras.zh: 两人之前只说过一次话，是在纽约大学。七月的午餐。阿姆斯特朗正在手机上向桌旁的同事展示 Alpöge 的雅可比猜想 X 帖子。他不明白他们为什么咯咯地笑，直到坐在他旁边的那个留着碗形头发的陌生人转过身来，笑着说道：“那是我。”

paras.en: When Alpöge finally emerged in the lobby in October, Armstrong barely recognized him. His hair was shaggier, his facial hair had grown out, and he was cloaked in a baggy hoodie. “He looked ‘like a hobo,’ in his own words,” Armstrong recalls. “He didn’t want to be seen by anyone.”
paras.zh: 当十月份阿尔波格最终出现在大厅时，阿姆斯特朗几乎认不出他了。他的头发更加蓬乱，面部毛发也长出来了，他穿着一件宽松的连帽衫。 “用他自己的话来说，他看起来‘像个流浪汉’，”阿姆斯特朗回忆道。 “他不想被任何人看见。”

paras.en: They strolled through Aspen’s quiet streets for two hours, talking about the Navier-Stokes drama and the powerful, AI-fueled forces that were forging their collective future. This time Alpöge offered no goofy quips, and his frustration was clear. “He’s a very intense person—he’s very moody,” Armstrong says. “He thinks that OpenAI is the evil empire, and he just wants to throw as much sand in their gears as he can.”
paras.zh: 他们在阿斯彭安静的街道上漫步了两个小时，谈论着纳维-斯托克斯的戏剧以及正在塑造他们共同未来的强大的、由人工智能驱动的力量。这次阿尔波格没有提出任何愚蠢的俏皮话，他的挫败感显而易见。 “他是一个非常热情的人——他非常喜怒无常，”阿姆斯特朗说。 “他认为 OpenAI 是邪恶帝国，他只是想尽可能多地往他们的齿轮里扔沙子。”

paras.en: Alpöge doesn’t seem to think Anthropic is perfect either, but he’s glad it exists. When Armstrong complained of math’s fate being in the hands of just two companies, Alpöge replied, “It could be worse. At least there’s not just one.”
paras.zh: Alpöge 似乎也不认为 Anthropic 是完美的，但他很高兴它的存在。当阿姆斯特朗抱怨数学的命运只掌握在两家公司手中时，阿尔波格回答道：“情况可能会更糟。至少不只有一家公司。”

paras.en: Alpöge hadn’t expressed such animosity toward his corporate rivals before this year’s headline-making events, according to everyone I spoke with. But OpenAI’s actions this year, rife with PR-heavy claims and rampant scooping of mathematicians (Alpöge most of all), seems to have made an enemy of him.
paras.zh: 据我采访过的每个人都说，在今年的头条新闻之前，阿尔波格从未对他的企业竞争对手表达过如此敌意。但 OpenAI 今年的行动充满了公关宣传和对数学家（尤其是 Alpöge）的猖獗挖角，似乎已经与他为敌了。

paras.en: Alpöge himself now has no shortage of enemies. In the aftermath of his Riemann proof, he wrote on X, he’s received death threats. And many mathematicians are frustrated with the official narrative, promoted by Alpöge and Anthropic alike, that his math work is merely a “hobby” entirely divorced from his day job—especially when he’s using internal models and resources.
paras.zh: 阿尔波格本人现在也不乏敌人。他在 X 上写道，黎曼证明完成后，他收到了死亡威胁。许多数学家对 Alpöge 和 Anthropic 等公司宣扬的官方说法感到沮丧，即他的数学工作只是一种“爱好”，完全脱离了他的日常工作——尤其是当他使用内部模型和资源时。

paras.en: Three mathematicians uploaded a preprint last week that provides a rare insight into those resources. Alpöge had shared with them the LLM output from one of his summer breakthroughs. They used it to estimate that the discovery—which was several times less ambitious than many of Alpöge’s other projects—cost up to $4 million worth of computing resources. An Anthropic representative declined to comment on the estimate. Whatever Anthropic’s “allowance” for Alpöge is, it’s not an especially cheap one. (Similarly, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman recently acknowledged that costs for his company’s math efforts reached more than $100 million.) For reference, in 2026 the National Science Foundation, the largest U.S. funder of math research, invested about $200 million in the field.
paras.zh: 三位数学家上周上传了一份预印本，提供了对这些资源的罕见见解。 Alpöge 与他们分享了他夏季突破之一的法学硕士成果。他们用它来估计这一发现（比 Alpöge 的许多其他项目要小几倍）花费了价值 400 万美元的计算资源。 Anthropic 的一位代表拒绝对这一估计发表评论。无论 Anthropic 对 Alpöge 的“补贴”是多少，它都不是特别便宜的。 （同样，OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 最近承认，其公司数学研究的成本超过 1 亿美元。）作为参考，2026 年，美国最大的数学研究资助者国家科学基金会在该领域投资了约 2 亿美元。

paras.en: “Anthropic should release how much this costs. How many tens of millions of dollars are in their budget to solve math problems?” says N.Y.U. mathematician Nestor Guillen. In mid-October, Guillen notes, Anthropic and OpenAI each committed $5 million in funding and resources to a joint initiative with the Simons Foundation to help mathematicians understand recent AI breakthroughs. “Would they agree to increase that money to match what they give an employee working on a ‘weekend hobby?’” he asks.
paras.zh: “Anthropic应该公布这需要多少钱。他们的预算中有多少数千万美元用于解决数学问题？”纽约大学说数学家内斯特·吉兰。 Guillen 指出，10 月中旬，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 各自承诺为与西蒙斯基金会的一项联合计划提供 500 万美元的资金和资源，以帮助数学家了解最近的人工智能突破。 “他们会同意增加这笔钱，以匹配他们给予从事‘周末爱好’的员工的钱吗？”他问道。

paras.en: After their afternoon walk in Aspen, Armstrong and Alpöge parted ways, heading back to their respective hotel rooms, where each had a number of agents churning on their current math problems. What Alpöge was working on, he did not disclose.
paras.zh: 下午在阿斯彭散步后，阿姆斯特朗和阿尔波格分道扬镳，回到各自的酒店房间，房间里都有一些特工在忙着解决当前的数学问题。 Alpöge 正在做什么，他没有透露。

paras.en: Alpöge and Claude’s successes on Riemann happened in spurts throughout October and November. In the early hours of November 16, they did the impossible. That was when Alpöge wrote to Anthropic’s CEO Dario Amodei, who asked him to save the announcement until after the company’s initial public offering (IPO) that Friday.
paras.zh: 阿尔波格和克劳德在黎曼问题上的成功在整个 10 月和 11 月期间都取得了突飞猛进的进展。 11 月 16 日凌晨，他们完成了不可能的任务。当时 Alpöge 写信给 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei)，后者要求他将这一公告保留到该公司周五首次公开募股 (IPO) 之后。

paras.en: That day Alpöge visited Princeton University, where he told Bhargava and mathematician Peter Sarnak what he’d accomplished, swearing them to secrecy and asking their advice. “It was surreal,” Sarnak says. “He was in a pretty excited state.” Alpöge spent the rest of the week holed up in Buckmaster’s N.Y.U. office, their old war room during the Navier-Stokes drama, where they now strategized the release of the Riemann proof.
paras.zh: 那天，阿尔波格访问了普林斯顿大学，在那里他告诉巴尔加瓦和数学家彼得·萨纳克他的成就，让他们发誓保密并征求他们的建议。 “这太超现实了，”萨纳克说。 “他当时的状态非常兴奋。”这周剩下的时间里，阿尔波格都躲在巴克马斯特的纽约大学里。办公室，他们在纳维-斯托克斯戏剧中的旧作战室，现在他们在那里制定了发布黎曼证明的策略。

paras.en: Drained but exhilarated, they wrapped up their work early on Friday morning and walked to the touristy Caffe Reggio on MacDougal Street, the only place nearby that was still serving decent coffee past 2 A.M.
paras.zh: 周五一早，他们就结束了工作，虽然筋疲力尽，但仍兴奋不已，步行前往位于麦克杜格尔街 (MacDougal Street) 的旅游胜地雷吉奥咖啡馆 (Caffe Reggio)，这是附近唯一一家在凌晨 2 点过后仍然提供优质咖啡的地方。

paras.en: Love him or hate him, Alpöge has given mathematicians a human face to represent the AI revolution, to project their feelings onto as their world is turned upside down. In his statement about the Riemann proof, Alpöge gave ample praise to Claude—“Claude flew, and danced, and sparkled near that finish line.” But he also highlighted his own agency. “It was my secret in my student days that my plans were for this problem,” he wrote. He used a machine to beat everyone, yes, but he remains a key ingredient. The story he has spun is one of triumphant partnership, portending a bright future for math—a modern retelling of the same “lone genius” story math has always been obsessed with, updated for the AI era.
paras.zh: 不管你爱他还是恨他，Alpöge 为数学家们提供了一张人性化的面孔来代表人工智能革命，让他们在世界发生翻天覆地的变化时投射出他们的感受。在关于黎曼证明的声明中，阿尔波格对克劳德给予了充分的赞扬——“克劳德在终点线附近飞翔、跳舞、闪闪发光。”但他也强调了自己的机构。 “在我学生时代，我的计划就是解决这个问题，这是我的秘密，”他写道。是的，他用机器打败了所有人，但他仍然是一个关键因素。他编造的故事是一个胜利的合作伙伴关系，预示着数学的光明未来——这是对数学一直痴迷的同一个“孤独天才”故事的现代重述，并为人工智能时代进行了更新。

paras.en: Whether he’s a visionary genius or a corporate face, his process and his foibles are a stark glimpse into math’s new, supercharged future—AI psychosis included. Riemann being solved won’t cure cancer or stop global warming. It probably won’t change your life in any noticeable way. But it marks a turning point nonetheless, one whose import will only be fully known to our future selves.
paras.zh: 无论他是一位有远见的天才还是一位企业界人士，他的过程和他的缺点都是数学新的、充满活力的未来的鲜明一瞥——包括人工智能精神病。解决黎曼问题并不能治愈癌症或阻止全球变暖。它可能不会以任何明显的方式改变你的生活。但这仍然标志着一个转折点，其重要性只有我们未来的自己才能完全了解。

paras.en: The upload finished shortly after 8 A.M. on November 20. Alpöge texted Buckmaster the link to his website and instructed him to pass it to Armstrong. “Levent and I always joked, ‘If we ever need anything leaked, we’ll just give it to Scott,’” Buckmaster says. Armstrong posted it to X immediately. It was done.
paras.zh: 上午 8 点刚过，上传就完成了。 11 月 20 日，阿尔波格向巴克马斯特发送了他网站的链接，并指示他将其传递给阿姆斯特朗。 “莱文特和我总是开玩笑说，‘如果我们需要泄露任何东西，我们就把它交给斯科特，’”巴克马斯特说。阿姆斯特朗立即将其发布到 X。事情完成了。

paras.en: But what if there was a bug? Alpöge realized he hadn’t had time to compile the code on his own machine before uploading it. Could something have gotten garbled in the process? People around the world would download his code, and it would crash, making them doubt his claim.
paras.zh: 但如果出现错误怎么办？ Alpöge 意识到他在上传代码之前没有时间在自己的机器上编译代码。在此过程中是否会出现乱码？世界各地的人们都会下载他的代码，但它会崩溃，让他们怀疑他的说法。

paras.en: It was done—the files were already online; the world already informed. But he had to know. Bleary-eyed, he started up his compiler. He could sleep once he knew he’d won.
paras.zh: 完成了——文件已经在线了；世界已经获悉。但他必须知道。他睡眼惺忪地启动了编译器。一旦他知道自己赢了，他就可以睡觉了。

paras.en: *Editor’s Note (11/25/26): This sentence was edited after posting to correct the description of Levent Alpöge’s record in the “pig’s trough” challenge.
paras.zh: *编者注（11/25/26）：这句话是在发帖后编辑的，以更正 Levent Alpöge 在“猪槽”挑战中的记录描述。

articles.title: Do you need to be worried about flying for Thanksgiving this year? We asked the experts

paras.en: The busiest travel days of the year are here, less than two weeks after a historic ground stop, numerous tech and airline outages and swirling questions over what could possibly go wrong now. Ahead of Thanksgiving, we asked experts the question at the top of our family group chats: Will it be safe to fly?
paras.zh: 一年中最繁忙的旅行日即将到来，距离历史性的地面停留不到两周，科技和航空公司出现大量中断，人们对现在可能出现问题的问题产生了疑问。感恩节前夕，我们在家庭群聊中向专家询问了这个问题：飞行安全吗？

paras.en: The short answer is yes, says Arnold Barnett, a statistician at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, who studies aviation. So far this year, roughly 800 million passengers have flown on commercial planes run by U.S. airlines, he says—and each one landed safely.
paras.zh: 麻省理工学院研究航空的统计学家阿诺德·巴尼特说，简短的答案是肯定的。他说，今年到目前为止，大约有 8 亿乘客乘坐美国航空公司运营的商用飞机出行，而且每一位乘客都安全着陆。

paras.en: That includes the recent ground stop on November 13, which the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) said was caused by a problem with equipment during repair works at a remote facility that led to widespread communications problems. No air traffic control centers fully lost contact, Barnett points out, and all planes that were in the air during the ground stop landed safely.
paras.zh: 其中包括最近 11 月 13 日的地面停飞，美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 表示，此次停飞是由于偏远设施维修期间出现设备问题，导致广泛的通信问题。巴尼特指出，没有空中交通管制中心完全失去联系，并且在地面停留期间在空中的所有飞机都安全着陆。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “Our air traffic controllers and safety professionals are working around the clock to keep Americans moving during what is expected to be the busiest Thanksgiving travel week in 16 years,” said FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford in a statement posted online.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空局局长布莱恩·贝德福德 (Bryan Bedford) 在网上发布的一份声明中表示：“我们的空中交通管制员和安全专业人员正在全天候工作，以确保美国人在预计将是 16 年来最繁忙的感恩节旅行周期间保持出行。”

paras.en: According to data from the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), which tracks air incidents, 2026 has seen fewer aviation accidents through October than any previous year at that point—1,216 compared with 1,267 in 2025 and more than 13,00 in each previous year, except 2020, which had fewer accidents in the same time frame. Of the accidents recorded through October this year, 244 accidents were fatal and 972 were nonfatal, compared with 240 and 1,027, respectively, in 2025.
paras.zh: 根据跟踪航空事故的美国国家运输安全委员会 (NTSB) 的数据，2026 年 10 月份的航空事故数量比以往任何一年都要少 — — 1,216 起，而 2025 年为 1,267 起，之前每年都超过 13,00 起，但 2020 年除外，2020 年同期事故数量较少。截至今年 10 月记录的事故中，死亡事故为 244 起，非致命事故为 972 起，而 2025 年分别为 240 起和 1,027 起。

paras.en: Indeed, January 2025 saw the first fatal U.S. commercial plane crash in 16 years, when an American Airlines flight collided with a military helicopter over Washington, D.C. The NTSB, which advises the FAA, currently has dozens of open recommendations to increase safety following such aviation incidents.
paras.zh: 事实上，2025 年 1 月，美国航空公司的一架飞机在华盛顿特区上空与一架军用直升机相撞，发生了 16 年来第一起致命的美国商用飞机失事事件。为 FAA 提供建议的 NTSB 目前已提出数十项公开建议，以在发生此类航空事故后提高安全性。

paras.en: David Woods, a U.S. safety systems researcher, says that he trusts commercial planes to carry his grandchildren safely this holiday season—but that this doesn’t mean our aviation systems don’t warrant a critical look moving forward. Woods says he is concerned about so-called reactive safety, or the practice of prioritizing technological innovation and then only adding safety measures once accidents have already happened. The country’s aviation infrastructure is aging, and as it’s updated, officials appear to be prioritizing technological advances such as artificial intelligence over safety needs, he says.
paras.zh: 美国安全系统研究员戴维·伍兹 (David Woods) 表示，他相信商用飞机能够在这个假期安全地载着他的孙子们，但这并不意味着我们的航空系统不值得对未来进行严格的审视。伍兹表示，他担心所谓的反应安全，即优先考虑技术创新，然后在事故发生后才添加安全措施的做法。他说，该国的航空基础设施正在老化，随着基础设施的更新，官员们似乎将人工智能等技术进步置于安全需求之上。

paras.en: “We’re worried on two fronts,” Woods says. “One is that we’re starting to backslide a little on the safety advances, and two is that the changing technology and scale of systems is creating new risks that we’re not seeing and anticipating.”
paras.zh: “我们担心两个方面，”伍兹说。 “一是我们在安全进步方面开始出现一些倒退，二是不断变化的技术和系统规模正在创造我们没有看到和预料到的新风险。”

paras.en: Najmedin Meshkati, an engineering professor at the University of Southern California, who served on an expert panel for the FAA following a fatal crash of a Boeing 737 MAX plane in Indonesia in 2018 and another in Ethiopia in 2019, points out that many aviation accidents happen on the runway—not in the sky. He says that issues with technology and human factors, such as understaffed air traffic control centers, can impact safety. Hundreds of FAA workers were laid off in “Department of Government Efficiency” (U.S. DOGE Service)–related cuts in 2025. The Department of Transportation has tried to bolster hiring for air traffic controllers since then; in response to a request for comment from Scientific American, the department said that no air traffic controllers were cut by DOGE.
paras.zh: 南加州大学工程学教授纳吉梅丁·梅斯卡蒂 (Najmedin Meshkati) 曾在 2018 年印度尼西亚一架波音 737 MAX 飞机和 2019 年埃塞俄比亚一架波音 737 MAX 飞机发生致命坠机事件后担任美国联邦航空局专家小组成员。他指出，许多航空事故都发生在跑道上，而不是天空中。他表示，技术和人为因素问题（例如空中交通管制中心人手不足）可能会影响安全。 2025 年，数百名 FAA 员工因“政府效率部”（美国 DOGE 服务）相关裁员而被解雇。此后，交通部一直试图加强空中交通管制员的招聘；在回应《科学美国人》的置评请求时，该部门表示，没有任何空中交通管制员被 DOGE 解雇。

paras.en: Still, “the recent accidents, close calls and equipment failures are not isolated events,” Meshkati says. “They are symptoms of how people, organizations and technology interact, and fail to interact, in an overstretched system.”
paras.zh: 尽管如此，“最近发生的事故、险情和设备故障并不是孤立事件，”梅斯卡蒂说。 “它们是人、组织和技术在过度拉伸的系统中如何交互以及无法交互的症状。”

articles.title: The hidden math behind this paradoxical Black Friday sale strategy

paras.en: “Found a lower price elsewhere? We’ll match it.” When big-box stores make these promises they sound like they’re on your side. Best Buy, Home Depot and Lowe’s will match prices from Amazon, Walmart and more than a dozen other retailers. Some go even further. Australian hardware giant Bunnings promises to beat any competitor’s lower price by a full 10 percent. In the U.S. Home Depot, Lowe’s and Sears once gave similar offers.
paras.zh: “在其他地方找到更低的价格？我们会匹配的。”当大型商店做出这些承诺时，他们听起来就像是站在你这边的。百思买、家得宝和劳氏将与亚马逊、沃尔玛和其他十几家零售商的价格相匹配。有些甚至更进一步。澳大利亚硬件巨头 Bunnings 承诺将比任何竞争对手的价格低整整 10%。在美国家得宝(Home Depot)，劳氏(Lowe's)和西尔斯(Sears)也曾给出过类似的优惠。

paras.en: But game theory suggests these guarantees are less generous than they appear. In fact, they can paradoxically keep prices high. One telling clue is that many retailers switch off their competitor price matching around Black Friday and Cyber Monday, the most competitive shopping stretch of the year.
paras.zh: 但博弈论表明，这些保证并不像看上去那么慷慨。事实上，他们可能会自相矛盾地保持高价格。一个明显的线索是，许多零售商在黑色星期五和网络星期一（一年中竞争最激烈的购物时段）前后停止了竞争对手的价格匹配。

paras.en: In 1883 French mathematician Joseph Bertrand published a scathing review of a book that offered one of the first mathematical models of economic competition. In that model, rival firms decide how much to produce, and the market settles on what the price is. Bertrand objected by saying that real sellers compete by setting and adapting prices, not production quantities. In just a few sentences, he sketched an argument that still informs how economists think about price competition.
paras.zh: 1883 年，法国数学家约瑟夫·贝特朗 (Joseph Bertrand) 对一本书发表了严厉的评论，该书提供了最早的经济竞争数学模型之一。在该模型中，竞争对手公司决定生产多少，而市场则决定价格。伯特兰反对说，真正的卖家通过设定和调整价格而不是产量来竞争。他仅用几句话就勾勒出一个论点，至今仍然影响着经济学家如何看待价格竞争。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Suppose a retailer called Store A sells a television that costs $500 to buy directly from the manufacturer. If it were the only store selling TVs, it would charge the price that earns it the most money, with no competition to incentivize a lower price." Perhaps $900 marks the store’s sweet spot: enough shoppers will pay that much, but if the cost were any higher, too many would decide the TV wasn’t worth it.
paras.zh: 假设一家名为 A 店的零售商出售一台直接从制造商处购买的电视机，售价为 500 美元。如果它是唯一一家销售电视的商店，它会收取最赚钱的价格，没有竞争来激励更低的价格。”也许 900 美元标志着商店的最佳定价：足够多的购物者愿意支付这么多钱，但如果成本更高，太多人会认为电视不值得。

paras.en: Now introduce a competitor, Store B, carrying the same TV, which also costs it $500. If both stores charge $900, customers might feel indifferent about where to purchase a TV, and the stores will roughly split the sales. But if Store A drops its price to $899, then every bargain hunter will go its way, and Store A will reap all of the profits. In the face of this, Store B drops its price to $898, and so on in a race to the bottom.
paras.zh: 现在介绍一下竞争对手，Store B，也有同样的电视，价格也为 500 美元。如果两家商店都收取 900 美元，顾客可能会觉得去哪里购买电视并不重要，商店就会大致平分销售额。但如果 A 店把价格降到 899 美元，那么每个逢低买进的人就会各走各的，A 店就会获得所有利润。面对这种情况，B 店将价格降至 898 美元，以此类推，竞相降价。

paras.en: Left unchecked, this undercutting would stop only at $500, with neither store earning a dime on the sale. Real prices rarely fall quite that far. Stores differ in location and brand loyalty, shoppers don’t check every ad, and stores eventually learn that if they cut prices once, they’ll have to do so again and again to stay competitive.
paras.zh: 如果不加以控制，这种降价只会止于 500 美元，而且两家商店都不会在促销中赚到一分钱。实际价格很少会下跌那么远。商店的位置和品牌忠诚度各不相同，购物者不会检查每条广告，商店最终会了解到，如果他们降价一次，他们就必须一次又一次地降价以保持竞争力。

paras.en: Yet Bertrand’s core insight still holds: sellers compete via price setting, and the threat of being undercut prevents stores from charging whatever they want. Both stores in the hypothetical scenario would be better off holding at $900, but they don’t. That’s because each worries the other will lower the price, and any agreement to hold the line would amount to price-fixing collusion, which is illegal. It’s a version of the prisoner’s dilemma that happens to benefit consumers. Both sellers fare better when they collude, but they can’t trust each other, so instead they compete. That’s why economists worry about monopolies. A store with no rivals to fear can charge the profit-maximizing $900 and make shoppers either pay above their comfort zone or skip the product altogether.
paras.zh: 然而，伯特兰的核心见解仍然成立：卖家通过定价进行竞争，而被压价的威胁会阻止商店随意收取费用。在假设的情况下，两家商店最好保持 900 美元的价格，但他们没有。这是因为双方都担心对方会降低价格，而任何保留底线的协议都将构成串通定价，这是非法的。这是囚徒困境的一个版本，但恰好对消费者有利。当两个卖家串通时，他们的表现会更好，但他们不能互相信任，所以他们会竞争。这就是经济学家担心垄断的原因。一家没有竞争对手的商店可以收取 900 美元的利润最大化费用，让购物者要么支付超出他们舒适范围的费用，要么完全跳过该产品。

paras.en: Now suppose Store A hangs a sign saying, “We’ll match any competitor’s price.” When Store B considers cutting to $899, the calculation changes. Without Store A’s price-matching offer, Store B’s cut would poach every bargain hunter. Now those shoppers can show Store B’s price at Store A and pay $899 there, so Store B wins no new customers and earns less on the ones it already had. If Store A goes further and promises to beat lower prices from rivals, as some stores do, then Store B’s price cut would actually backfire, sending Store B’s customers to Store A for a better deal. When these guarantees are in place, cutting prices no longer pays, so both stores stay at $900. Without any backroom dealings, the two stores have landed on the price that a monopoly would choose—and the ploy that secured this reads like generosity.
paras.zh: 现在假设 A 商店挂了一个牌子，上面写着：“我们将与任何竞争对手的价格相匹配。”当商店 B 考虑削减至 899 美元时，计算结果发生了变化。如果没有 A 店的价格匹配优惠，B 店的折扣就会挖走每一个讨价还价的人。现在，这些购物者可以在 A 店展示 B 店的价格，并在那里支付 899 美元，因此 B 店没有赢得新客户，并且在现有客户上赚取的收入也减少了。如果 A 店更进一步，承诺以更低的价格打败竞争对手，就像一些商店所做的那样，那么 B 店的降价实际上会适得其反，将 B 店的顾客带到 A 店以获得更优惠的价格。当这些保证到位后，降价就不再划算了，所以两家商店的价格都维持在 900 美元。在没有任何幕后交易的情况下，这两家商店已经确定了垄断者会选择的价格——而确保这一点的策略看起来像是慷慨的。

paras.en: Three things about price matching are worth noticing. First, only one store needs the guarantee—Store A’s promise to match competitors' prices protects Store B’s high price as much as its own. Second, a guarantee that functions as intended almost never gets used. In the idealized model nobody undercuts, so no shopper ever has a lower price to bring to the register. Third, the sign looks like it’s addressed to consumers, but it’s actually a message to rival stores.
paras.zh: 关于价格匹配的三件事值得注意。首先，只有一家商店需要保证——商店 A 承诺与竞争对手的价格保持一致，这既保护了商店 B 的高价格，也保护了商店 B 的高价格。其次，保证功能按预期运行几乎永远不会被使用。在理想化的模型中，没有人会降价，因此购物者不会以更低的价格进入收银台。第三，这个标牌看起来像是针对消费者的，但实际上是向竞争对手商店传达的信息。

paras.en: Shoppers rarely see it this way. A 2003 paper in the Journal of Consumer Psychology tellingly entitled “Failing to Suspect Collusion in Price-Matching Guarantees” concluded that people tend to interpret price-matching offers as a signal that prices are already low, not as a way of keeping them high.
paras.zh: 购物者很少这样看待。 2003 年，《消费者心理学杂志》上发表的一篇题​​为“未能怀疑价格匹配保证中的共谋”的论文引人注目，其结论是，人们倾向于将价格匹配优惠视为价格已经很低的信号，而不是保持价格较高的一种方式。

paras.en: Whether real stores behave in accordance with Bertrand’s model is an empirical question, and the evidence says they often do, under the right conditions. A 1991 study tracked supermarket prices before and after stores adopted price-matching guarantees and found that price matching caused higher prices overall. More recently economist Ran Zhuo examined what happened when big-box chains began promising to match Amazon. Theory predicted that Amazon would stop undercutting—and that’s exactly what Zhuo’s 2017 paper reports. Amazon’s prices rose by roughly six percentage points after the guarantees took effect, according to the paper.
paras.zh: 真实商店的行为是否符合伯特兰模型是一个经验问题，证据表明，在适当的条件下，它们经常这样做。 1991 年的一项研究跟踪了商店采用价格匹配保证前后的超市价格，发现价格匹配导致总体价格上涨。最近，经济学家卓然研究了当大型连锁店开始承诺与亚马逊竞争时会发生什么。 Theory 预测亚马逊将停止低价竞争——而这正是 Zhuo 在 2017 年的论文中所报道的。据该报报道，担保生效后，亚马逊的价格上涨了约六个百分点。

paras.en: Of course, real markets get messy and rarely play out exactly as described in economics textbooks. The effect is strongest under particular conditions: a few big rivals selling identical products where price matches are easy for customers to claim. Economists Morten Hviid and Greg Shaffer showed in 1999 that price-matching offers lose their power when shoppers have to jump through hoops to claim them. Rivals know that few customers will bother, so the threat meant to deter undercutting loses credibility.
paras.zh: 当然，真实的市场会变得混乱，很少会完全按照经济学教科书描述的那样发展。这种效应在特定条件下最为强烈：几个大竞争对手销售相同的产品，而客户很容易声称价格匹配。经济学家 Morten Hviid 和 Greg Shaffer 在 1999 年指出，当购物者必须克服重重困难才能获得价格匹配优惠时，价格匹配优惠就会失去效力。竞争对手知道很少有顾客会打扰，因此旨在阻止低价竞争的威胁失去了可信度。

paras.en: Retailers pitch price-matching guarantees as a promise to make sure you never overpay. But if that were their purpose, then the guarantees would matter most during sales events like Black Friday, when prices swing wildly. Instead that’s exactly when many retailers switch them off.
