articles.title: All Points Logistics Announces Partnership with Expeditors for Space Prep Logistics Center at Kennedy Space Center
articles.author: All Points Logistics

paras.en: MERRITT ISLAND, FL, November 18, 2026 — All Points Logistics has announced a partnership with Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. (NYSE: EXPD) to serve as the exclusive logistics provider for its planned Space Prep Spaceport Logistics Center at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州梅里特岛，2026 年 11 月 18 日 — All Points Logistics 宣布与华盛顿 Expeditors International, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：EXPD）建立合作伙伴关系，为其计划中的位于佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心的太空准备航天港物流中心提供独家物流服务。

paras.en: Through this partnership, Expeditors will establish an on-site presence at the Space Prep facility, providing end-to-end mission logistics for government agencies and commercial space operators. Services for spacecraft, ground support equipment, and related mission materials will include aerospace warehousing, inventory control, transportation management, project cargo services, customs brokerage, supply chain visibility, and launch campaign support. The operation will serve space system operators and manufacturers working at Kennedy Space Center, Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, and other launch locations.
paras.zh: 通过此次合作，Expeditors 将在太空准备设施建立现场服务，为政府机构和商业太空运营商提供端到端的任务后勤服务。航天器、地面支持设备和相关任务材料的服务将包括航空航天仓储、库存控制、运输管理、项目货运服务、报关、供应链可视性和发射活动支持。该行动将为在肯尼迪航天中心、卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站和其他发射地点工作的航天系统运营商和制造商提供服务。

paras.en: “Companies in the space industry manage highly specialized equipment and materials across global supply chains,” said Ed Rone, Expeditors’ Regional Vice President of the U.S. Southeast. “This partnership puts our people and services closer to their launch operations, transforming logistics from a transportation function into a mission-readiness capability that helps ensure critical flight hardware, launch equipment, and operational assets are available at the right time. We look forward to working with All Points and applying our experience to the unique demands of this industry.”
paras.zh: Expeditors 美国东南部区域副总裁 Ed Rone 表示：“航天工业公司管理着全球供应链中高度专业化的设备和材料。” “这种伙伴关系使我们的人员和服务更接近他们的发射操作，将物流从运输功能转变为任务准备能力，有助于确保关键的飞行硬件、发射设备和运营资产在正确的时间可用。我们期待与 All Points 合作，并将我们的经验应用于该行业的独特需求。”

paras.en: As part of its Space Prep initiative, All Points plans to build a 266,000-square-foot Spaceport Logistics Center on its 65-acre site at Kennedy Space Center. Located within five miles of the launch pads, the facility is scheduled to open by the end of 2027. The site will also include an adjacent 260,000-square-foot Spacecraft Processing Center, bringing together launch-site logistics and specialized spacecraft processing capabilities.
paras.zh: 作为其太空准备计划的一部分，All Points 计划在肯尼迪航天中心 65 英亩的场地上建造一个 266,000 平方英尺的太空港物流中心。该设施距离发射台不到 5 英里，计划于 2027 年底开放。该设施还将包括一个毗邻的 260,000 平方英尺的航天器处理中心，汇集发射场物流和专业航天器处理能力。

paras.en: “Expeditors is an ideal partner for our Space Prep business,” said Phil Monkress, CEO of All Points Logistics. “Their global logistics expertise and specialized transportation capabilities align directly with the needs of our space industry customers, helping them move, stage, and manage mission-critical flight hardware more efficiently at major launch sites.”
paras.zh: “Expeditors 是我们 Space Prep 业务的理想合作伙伴，”All Points Logistics 首席执行官 Phil Monkress 表示。 “他们的全球物流专业知识和专业运输能力直接满足我们航天工业客户的需求，帮助他们在主要发射场更有效地移动、部署和管理关键任务飞行硬件。”

paras.en: Through this collaboration, Space Prep customers will also benefit from access to Expeditors’ broader global logistics network, connecting suppliers and manufacturing locations with launch operations. The Kennedy Space Center location will also position Expeditors to support existing customers, including hyperscalers, as they explore opportunities in space-based data centers and advanced computing infrastructure.
paras.zh: 通过此次合作，Space Prep的客户还将受益于Expeditors更广泛的全球物流网络，将供应商和制造基地与发射业务连接起来。肯尼迪航天中心的选址还将使Expeditors能够为现有客户（包括超大规模企业）提供支持，帮助他们在探索太空数据中心和先进计算基础设施方面的机会。

paras.en: All Points developed Space Prep to help address the growing demand for spacecraft processing and launch-site logistics infrastructure. By combining specialized facilities, mission support services, and strategic partnerships, All Points is expanding its capabilities to support commercial and government space customers at America’s major launch sites.
paras.zh: All Points 开发了 Space Prep，以帮助满足对航天器处理和发射场物流基础设施不断增长的需求。通过结合专业设施、任务支持服务和战略合作伙伴关系，All Points 正在扩大其能力，为美国主要发射场的商业和政府太空客户提供支持。

paras.en: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. (NYSE: EXPD) is a leading S&P 500 global logistics company headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. Through a worldwide network of knowledgeable professionals across six continents and a globally connected technology platform, Expeditors tailors solutions to manage increasingly complex supply chains and international trade requirements. The asset-light company offers air, customs, ocean, order management, road, warehousing and distribution, and cargo insurance services to key industries worldwide. Guided by a culture of exceptional customer service, Expeditors aspires to be the most trusted and valued logistics company in the world. For more information, visit expeditors.com.
paras.zh: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：EXPD）是一家领先的标准普尔 500 强全球物流公司，总部位于华盛顿州贝尔维尤。通过遍布六大洲的知识丰富的专业人士的全球网络和全球互联的技术平台，Expeditors 定制解决方案来管理日益复杂的供应链和国际贸易要求。这家轻资产公司为全球主要行业提供空运、海关、海运、订单管理、公路、仓储和配送以及货物保险服务。在卓越客户服务文化的指导下，Expeditors 立志成为全球最值得信赖和最有价值的物流公司。欲了解更多信息，请访问 expeditors.com。

Learn more at SpacePrep.com.

articles.title: Simera Sense, Spacemanic, Zaitra and World from Space Join Forces on an End-to-End Dual-Use Mission Solution
articles.author: Spacemanic

paras.en: Bremen, 18 November 2026 – Simera Sense, Spacemanic, Zaitra and World from Space have signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Bremen to cooperate on a complete mission solution built around a dual-use camera. The agreement builds on the Memorandum of Understanding signed by Simera Sense and Spacemanic in Prague on 3 November 2026 and extends the cooperation with onboard data processing and imagery analytics.
paras.zh: 不来梅，2026 年 11 月 18 日 – Simera Sense、Spacemanic、Zaitra 和 World from Space 在不来梅签署了一份谅解备忘录，围绕两用相机构建完整的任务解决方案进行合作。该协议以 Simera Sense 和 Spacemanic 于 2026 年 11 月 3 日在布拉格签署的谅解备忘录为基础，扩展了与机载数据处理和图像分析方面的合作。

paras.en: The partners intend to offer customers a solution covering the whole chain:
paras.zh: 合作伙伴旨在为客户提供覆盖全链条的解决方案：

paras.en: - Simera Sense provides the xScape200 Dual-Use,a dual-use imaging payload delivering 1.5m resolution for defence and commercial applications.
paras.zh: - Simera Sense 提供 xScape200 Dual-Use，这是一种双用成像有效负载，可为国防和商业应用提供 1.5m 分辨率。

paras.en: - Spacemanic provides the satellite platform. Its CORVUS platform, developed under the ESA ARTES Pioneer programme and now deployed commercially in multiple missions, is tailored around the camera. The in-house SPACECANNON deployer attaches the satellite to the launch vehicle and releases it into its target orbit.
paras.zh: - Spacemanic 提供卫星平台。其 CORVUS 平台是根据 ESA ARTES Pioneer 计划开发的，现已在多个任务中进行商业部署，该平台是围绕相机量身定制的。内部的 SPACECANNON 部署者将卫星连接到运载火箭上，并将其释放到目标轨道。

paras.en: - Zaitra provides the SKAIDOCK onboard computer running SKAISEN onboard AI and SKAIPACK image compression. Imagery is analysed directly on board the satellite, so customers receive the information that matters with low latency, while the downlink data budget stays low.
paras.zh: - Zaitra 提供运行 SKAISEN 机载 AI 和 SKAIPACK 图像压缩的 SKAIDOCK 机载计算机。图像直接在卫星上进行分析，因此客户可以低延迟地接收重要信息，同时下行链路数据预算保持较低水平。

paras.en: - World from Space turns the imagery into insights for customers, including raw data calibration and quality assessment of the downlinked data. ORBIS platform deals with tasking, data consolidation and distribution.
paras.zh: - 太空世界将图像转化为客户的见解，包括原始数据校准和下行数据的质量评估。 ORBIS 平台负责任务分配、数据整合和分发。

paras.en: For customers, this means one coordinated offer from image acquisition to usable insight.
paras.zh: 对于客户而言，这意味着从图像采集到可用洞察的协调一致的服务。

paras.en: “Combining the xScape 200 Dual Use camera with a satellite tailored around it, onboard processing and analytics makes dual-use imaging easier for customers to adopt. We are glad to build on our cooperation with Spacemanic and to welcome Zaitra and World from Space.” – Emile Van Riel, Business Development Manager, Simera Sense.
paras.zh: “将 xScape 200 两用相机与围绕其量身定制的卫星相结合，机载处理和分析使客户更容易采用两用成像。我们很高兴与 Spacemanic 继续合作，并欢迎 Zaitra 和 World from Space。” – Simera Sense 业务开发经理 Emile Van Riel。

paras.en: “With CORVUS and our in-house SPACECANNON deployer, we can shape the whole satellite around the customer’s payload. With Zaitra’s onboard processing and World from Space’s insights, customers get a complete path from image to insight from one consortium.” – Juraj Dudáš, CEO, Spacemanic.
paras.zh: “借助 CORVUS 和我们内部的 SPACECANNON 部署器，我们可以围绕客户的有效载荷塑造整个卫星。借助 Zaitra 的机载处理和 World from Space 的见解，客户可以从一个联盟获得从图像到见解的完整路径。” – Juraj Dudáš，Spacemanic 首席执行官。

paras.en: “Zaitra was founded on a simple idea: a satellite should send down answers, not just pixels. This partnership puts that idea at the heart of a mission built around what customers actually need.” – Marek Marušin, CEO and co-founder, Zaitra.
paras.zh: “Zaitra 的成立基于一个简单的想法：卫星应该发送答案，而不仅仅是像素。这种合作伙伴关系将这一想法置于围绕客户实际需求而构建的任务的核心。” – Marek Marušin，Zaitra 首席执行官兼联合创始人。

paras.en: “Imagery creates value once it becomes insight. And Earth observation data doesn’t come ready. Together with Simera Sense, Spacemanic and Zaitra, we connect the satellite with users and deliver insights to customers.” – Roman Bohovic, CTO, World from Space.
paras.zh: “图像一旦成为洞察力，就会创造价值。而地球观测数据还没有准备好。我们与 Simera Sense、Spacemanic 和 Zaitra 一起，将卫星与用户连接起来，并向客户提供洞察力。” – Roman Bohovic，太空世界首席技术官。

paras.en: - Simera Sense is a leading European provider of optical payloads and image processing tools for space-based imaging. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Belgium, with offices in South Africa, France, and the United Kingdom.
paras.zh: - Simera Sense 是欧洲领先的天基成像光学有效载荷和图像处理工具供应商。成立于2018年，总部位于比利时，在南非、法国和英国设有办事处。

paras.en: - Spacemanic is a Czech vertical integrator of satellite missions, since 2019. It designs, manufactures, integrates and operates satellites with in-house subsystems, platforms and deployers, and also handles launch management and frequency licensing.
paras.zh: - Spacemanic 自 2019 年起是一家捷克卫星任务垂直集成商。它设计、制造、集成和运营带有内部子系统、平台和部署器的卫星，还负责发射管理和频率许可。

paras.en: - Zaitra, based in Brno, Czech Republic, develops onboard data processing for Earth observation satellites. Its SKAIDOCK onboard computer runs SKAISEN, AI inference software already operating in orbit, and SKAIPACK, onboard image compression, turning raw imagery into actionable information on board and reducing the volume of data that has to be downlinked.
paras.zh: - Zaitra 总部位于捷克共和国布尔诺，开发地球观测卫星的机载数据处理技术。其 SKAIDOCK 机载计算机运行 SKAISEN（已在轨道上运行的人工智能推理软件）和 SKAIPACK（机载图像压缩），将原始图像转化为机上可操作的信息，并减少必须下行传输的数据量。

paras.en: - World from Space, also based in Brno, Czech Republic, provides customers with insights derived from satellite imagery, including tasking and distribution. Company is expert in Earth observation data and deals with cal/val, quality assessment and interpretation.
paras.zh: - 同样位于捷克共和国布尔诺的 World from Space 为客户提供来自卫星图像的见解，包括任务分配和分配。公司是地球观测数据方面的专家，负责校准/验证、质量评估和解释。

paras.en: Media contact: Ota Michalek, Chief Strategy Officer at Spacemanic, ota.michalek@spacemanic.com
paras.zh: 媒体联系人：Ota Michalek，Spacemanic 首席战略官，ota.michalek@spacemanic.com

articles.title: The ‘bare-knuckled’ future of life in space with Tim Marshall
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, Mike Gruss speaks with journalist and best-selling author Tim Marshall. They discuss how the war in Ukraine represented a wakeup call for how Europe and the United States treat threats around the world, and what it means that space will always represent a major element of warfare in the future. They also talk about the role space will play in national contests among superpowers vying for leadership and control over orbit, and how new rules are needed to guide humanity’s space exploration and colonization.

articles.title: NASA’s Hubble Views Ocean of Stars in Groundwork for Roman

paras.en: An expanse of stars gleams in a rainbow of colors in these NASA Hubble Space Telescope images of the Milky Way. The images focus on an area of sky toward the galactic bulge, a densely packed, spherical region of stars that surrounds the center of a galaxy’s disk. These Hubble observations are part of a survey that will help researchers better interpret upcoming Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope observations as they seek to characterize the stars and search for exoplanets in this busy region of our galaxy.
paras.zh: 在美国宇航局哈勃太空望远镜拍摄的银河系图像中，广阔的恒星闪烁着彩虹般的色彩。这些图像聚焦于银河核球附近的天空区域，这是一个围绕着星系盘中心的密集的球形恒星区域。这些哈勃观测结果是一项调查的一部分，该调查将帮助研究人员更好地解释即将到来的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜的观测结果，因为他们试图描述恒星的特征并在我们银河系这个繁忙的区域寻找系外行星。

paras.en: Astronomers study the Milky Way’s galactic bulge because it holds nearly a quarter of the galaxy’s stellar mass, and its proximity allows them to examine the region in greater detail. Although we can see the glow from these crowded spheres of stars in other galaxies, they are too jam-packed and far away to resolve individual stars. By studying the Milky Way’s galactic bulge, researchers hope to find new planets and better understand how galaxies form, evolve, and interact over billions of years.
paras.zh: 天文学家研究银河系的核球，因为它拥有银河系近四分之一的恒星质量，而且它的邻近性使他们能够更详细地研究该区域。尽管我们可以看到其他星系中这些拥挤的恒星球体发出的光芒，但它们太拥挤且距离太远，无法分辨单个恒星。通过研究银河系的核球，研究人员希望找到新的行星，并更好地了解星系在数十亿年来如何形成、演化和相互作用。

paras.en: Hubble views the universe primarily in ultraviolet, visible, and near-infrared light, while Roman collects data in near-infrared light and some visible light. Because researchers wish to compare Hubble’s observations to future Roman observations, Hubble looked at the region in wavelengths that overlap with Roman’s areas of sensitivity, the red end of the visible spectrum and near-infrared wavelengths.
paras.zh: 哈勃主要通过紫外线、可见光和近红外光观察宇宙，而罗曼则通过近红外光和一些可见光收集数据。由于研究人员希望将哈勃的观测结果与罗马未来的观测结果进行比较，哈勃研究了与罗马的敏感区域重叠的波长区域、可见光谱的红端和近红外波长。

paras.en: Hubble’s high resolution allows its instruments to collect data on the brightness, ages, composition, and motion of stars over time. With this knowledge, astronomers can search for potential exoplanets, determine the location of black holes or dark matter, and better understand our galaxy’s environment and evolution.
paras.zh: 哈勃望远镜的高分辨率使其仪器能够收集有关恒星随时间变化的亮度、年龄、成分和运动的数据。有了这些知识，天文学家就可以寻找潜在的系外行星，确定黑洞或暗物质的位置，并更好地了解银河系的环境和演化。

paras.en: A key component of Roman’s future observations is the search for exoplanets by capturing microlensing events, a type of gravitational lensing that occurs when light from a more distant object is magnified and distorted by the mass of a closer object along the line of sight. The way light from the distant star is distorted and magnified can reveal clues to the nature of the foreground star and any planets it may have. Hubble's observations will help characterize stars in the region before they undergo a lensing event. Months or years in the future, when Roman captures a microlensing event, researchers can compare Hubble data to Roman data of the event, making it easer to interpret. These microlensing events are on a much smaller scale, that of stars and planets, than larger gravitational lenses that occur around galaxies and galaxy clusters.
paras.zh: 罗曼未来观测的一个关键组成部分是通过捕捉微透镜事件来寻找系外行星，微透镜事件是一种引力透镜，当来自较远物体的光被视线上较近物体的质量放大和扭曲时，就会发生这种情况。来自遥远恒星的光被扭曲和放大的方式可以揭示前景恒星及其可能拥有的任何行星的性质的线索。哈勃的观测将有助于在该地区的恒星经历透镜事件之前对其进行表征。未来数月或数年，当罗曼捕捉到微透镜事件时，研究人员可以将哈勃数据与该事件的罗曼数据进行比较，从而更容易解释。与星系和星系团周围发生的较大引力透镜相比，这些微透镜事件的规模（恒星和行星）要小得多。

paras.en: Over Hubble’s lifetime, it has observed our galaxy’s central bulge many times. These legacy surveys include the WFC3 Galactic Bulge Treasury Program that used Hubble’s Wide Field Camera 3 to study the brightness, precise positions, and motions of stars in this congested part of our galaxy. It also includes the Sagittarius Window Eclipsing Extrasolar Planet Search (SWEEPS) that used Hubble’s Advanced Camera for Surveys to look at 180,000 stars in the bulge of our galaxy. These new observations come from an observing program (#17776: S. Terry) designed to aid Roman in its search for exoplanets, black holes, neutron stars, and more. The data also adds to Hubble’s continuing legacy of high-precision observations of stars in the galactic bulge.
paras.zh: 在哈勃的一生中，它多次观测到我们银河系的中央核核。这些遗留调查包括 WFC3 银河核球金库计划，该计划使用哈勃的广角相机 3 来研究银河系这个拥挤部分中恒星的亮度、精确位置和运动。它还包括人马座窗食系外行星搜索 (SWEEPS)，该搜索使用哈勃的高级巡天相机来观察银河系核球中的 180,000 颗恒星。这些新的观测结果来自一个观测计划（#17776：S. Terry），旨在帮助 Roman 寻找系外行星、黑洞、中子星等。这些数据还丰富了哈勃对银河核球恒星进行高精度观测的持续遗产。

articles.title: Seeking Refuge on Resolution Island

paras.en: In the late 1800s, wildlife conservationists in New Zealand were recognizing how predators such as stoats, brought to the country to control other nonnative animal populations, were becoming a threat to native birds. Naturalists at the time surmised that some of the nation’s islands could serve as sanctuaries where endemic species could persist, free from the voracious newcomers.
paras.zh: 1800 年代末，新西兰的野生动物保护主义者认识到白鼬等捕食者被带到新西兰来控制其他非本地动物种群，却对本地鸟类构成了威胁。当时的博物学家推测，该国的一些岛屿可以作为特有物种可以持续存在的庇护所，而不受贪婪的新来者的影响。

paras.en: Resolution Island, located in the Fiordland region along the rugged southwest edge of New Zealand’s South Island, was one of the first eyed for this purpose. Conservationist Thomas Henry Potts proposed in 1872 that the island could be a place where “wingless species, and birds of feeble powers of flight, might there find a refuge for some of their representatives.”
paras.zh: 决议岛位于新西兰南岛崎岖的西南边缘峡湾地区，是最早关注这一目的的岛屿之一。环境保护主义者托马斯·亨利·波茨 (Thomas Henry Potts) 于 1872 年提出，该岛可能是“无翅物种和飞行能力较弱的鸟类可以为它们的一些代表找到庇护所的地方”。

paras.en: So began an early systematic effort to protect kiwi, kākāpō, and other native birds on Resolution Island, the largest of the approximately 90 islands in Fiordland National Park. This image, acquired with the OLI (Operational Land Imager) on Landsat 9 on December 12, 2025, shows the island’s setting amid a landscape of steep-sided valleys carved by glaciers and now inundated by the ocean.
paras.zh: 因此，我们开始了早期系统性的努力，以保护雷索卢索岛（Fiordland National Park 约 90 个岛屿中最大的岛屿）上的几维鸟、鸮鹦鹉和其他本土鸟类。这张图像是 2025 年 12 月 12 日使用 Landsat 9 上的 OLI（操作陆地成像仪）拍摄的，显示了该岛的环境，周围是由冰川雕刻而成的陡峭山谷，现已被海洋淹没。

paras.en: The uninhabited island rises from sea level to the summit of Mount Clerke at 1,069 meters (3,507 feet). Its diverse habitats and vegetation communities range from bogs and wetlands near the coast to widespread podocarp forests at middle elevations to tussock grasslands in the subalpine and alpine areas. Offshore, the Taumoana (Five Fingers Peninsula) Marine Reserve protects estuarine and wave-exposed rocky reef habitats at the entrance to Dusky Sound, east of Five Fingers Peninsula.
paras.zh: 这座无人岛从海平面上升至海拔 1,069 米（3,507 英尺）的克勒克山山顶。它的栖息地和植被群落多种多样，从海岸附近的沼泽和湿地到中海拔广泛的罗汉松森林，再到亚高山和高山地区的草丛草原。近海的陶莫阿纳（五指半岛）海洋保护区保护五指半岛以东达斯基海峡入口处的河口和暴露在海浪中的岩礁栖息地。

paras.en: Farther into the sound, Pigeon Island was the onetime home of Richard Henry, who was named caretaker of Resolution Island after it was designated a reserve in 1891. In what some have called a “landmark effort,” Henry spent years transporting more than 700 birds, mostly kiwi and kākāpō, by rowboat to Resolution and other would-be island sanctuaries nearby.
paras.zh: 再往深处，鸽子岛是理查德·亨利 (Richard Henry) 的故乡，1891 年雷索申岛被指定为保护区后，理查德·亨利 (Richard Henry) 被任命为雷索申岛的看护人。亨利花了数年时间，用划艇将 700 多只鸟类（其中大部分是几维鸟和鸮鹦鹉）运送到雷索申岛和附近其他可能成为岛屿保护区的鸟类，这是一些人称之为“里程碑式的努力”。

paras.en: In 1900, however, people began spotting mustelids on Resolution. It turns out the island is within swimming distance for animals such as stoats. Henry was intent on trapping the interlopers but eventually abandoned the project and moved on to caretaking work on another island. The spirit of his efforts lives on, though. A Department of Conservation program started in 2008 aims to control stoat populations and bolster native species on Resolution.
paras.zh: 然而，1900 年，人们开始在决议号上发现鼬科动物。事实证明，该岛对于白鼬等动物来说是在游泳距离之内的。亨利一心想要诱捕闯入者，但最终放弃了这个项目，转而去另一个岛上从事看护工作。不过，他努力的精神依然存在。环境保护部于 2008 年启动的一项计划旨在控制白鼬种群并促进本土物种的发展。

articles.title: APOD: 2026 November 26 – Eye in the Sky: The Milky Way over Lençóis

paras.en: Discover the cosmos! Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer.
paras.zh: 探索宇宙！每天都会展示我们迷人的宇宙的不同图像或照片，以及由专业天文学家撰写的简短说明。

paras.en: Eye in the Sky: The Milky Way over Lençóis
paras.zh: 天空之眼：伦索伊斯上空的银河系

paras.en: Explanation: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder. And there is much to behold in today's featured image. The Milky Way shines bright in the sky of Brazil, over the white sand dunes and dark lagoons of Lençóis Maranhenses National Park. We can see different parts of the Milky Way as it apparently rotates in the sky every night and throughout the year. This composite image was taken later in the night in July from a latitude of approximately 2º south. It shows some prominent Milky Way features, such as dark dust lanes and colorful nebulas. But does the Galaxy really appear arched like a rainbow in the sky? No, this is an artifact of a picture taken with a wide-angle lens. As the Galaxy was artfully framed by the photographer, it matches the contour of the dark lagoon creating the illusion of a cosmic eye, half in space and half on the ground. Is this eye in the sky looking back at you? Tomorrow's picture: what's next?
paras.zh: 说明：情人眼里出西施。今天的特色图片中有很多值得一看的地方。银河在巴西的天空中闪耀，在伦索伊斯马拉赫塞斯国家公园的白色沙丘和黑暗泻湖上空。我们可以看到银河系的不同部分，因为它显然每天晚上和全年都在天空中旋转。这张合成图像是 7 月晚些时候在南纬约 2 度处拍摄的。它显示了一些显着的银河系特征，例如黑暗的尘埃带和色彩缤纷的星云。但银河系真的像天空中的彩虹一样呈拱形吗？不，这是用广角镜头拍摄的照片的伪影。由于银河系被摄影师巧妙地构图，它与黑暗泻湖的轮廓相匹配，创造出宇宙之眼的错觉，一半在太空，一半在地面。天上的这只眼睛正在回望你吗？明天的图片：接下来是什么？

articles.title: 'Losing respect for him' - Pundits react to stunning Rodgers claims

paras.en: Aaron Rodgers: Quarterback 'losing respect' as NFL reacts to stunning Mike McCarthy claims
paras.zh: 亚伦·罗杰斯：四分卫“失去尊重”，因为NFL对迈克·麦卡锡的惊人言论做出反应

paras.en: Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers claims that head coach Mike McCarthy was 'snoring' in a quarterback meeting in an explosive interview; Steelers president Art Rooney II comes out in "100 per cent" support of McCarthy after team releases Rodgers in light of comments
paras.zh: 匹兹堡钢人队四分卫亚伦·罗杰斯在一次爆炸性采访中声称主教练迈克·麦卡锡在四分卫会议上“打鼾”；钢人队主席阿特·鲁尼二世在球队根据评论释放罗杰斯后表示“100%”支持麦卡锡

paras.en: Has Aaron Rodgers played his final game in the NFL? Was he wrong to publicly criticise Mike McCarthy? The four-time MVP quarterback is 'losing respect' following his explosive claims about the Pittsburgh Steelers head coach, according to Sky Sports NFL's Jason Bell.
paras.zh: 亚伦·罗杰斯 (Aaron Rodgers) 打完了他在 NFL 的最后一场比赛吗？他公开批评迈克·麦卡锡有错吗？据美国国家橄榄球联盟天空体育频道的贾森·贝尔报道，这位四届 MVP 四分卫在对匹兹堡钢人队主教练发表爆炸性言论后，正在“失去尊重”。

paras.en: Rodgers sent shockwaves through the NFL on Thanksgiving Eve as he used an interview on The Pat McAfee Show to claim McCarthy had been "falling asleep in meetings" while suggesting his entire team believed a change was required on the sideline.
paras.zh: 感恩节前夕，罗杰斯在帕特·麦卡菲秀上接受采访时声称麦卡锡“在会议上睡着了”，同时暗示他的整个团队认为需要在场外做出改变，这在整个 NFL 引起了震动。

paras.en: It came after Rodgers was benched for Friday's matchup with the Denver Broncos following two straight defeats, with Mason Rudolph due to start under center.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯在周五与丹佛野马队的比赛中连续两场失利后被坐在替补席上，而梅森·鲁道夫将在中锋位置上首发。

paras.en: The Steelers later released Rodgers 11 weeks into what is set to be the final season of the 42-year-old's career.
paras.zh: 钢人队随后在 11 周后裁掉了罗杰斯，这将是这位 42 岁球员职业生涯的最后一个赛季。

paras.en: - How to watch NFL Thanksgiving week live on Sky Sports
paras.zh: - 如何在Sky Sports上观看NFL感恩节周的直播

paras.en: - Jay-Z picks himself to headline Super Bowl half-time show
paras.zh: - Jay-Z选择自己担任超级碗中场秀的头牌明星

paras.en: - Latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract on NOW
paras.zh: - NOW 最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: "First of all, I don't want to be on Aaron Rodgers' bad side. Let's start there. We all make mistakes, right? We all do things that aren't necessarily right in the moment," said Sky Sports NFL's Bell.
paras.zh: “首先，我不想站在亚伦·罗杰斯的不利一边。让我们从这里开始吧。我们都会犯错误，对吗？我们都会做一些不一定是正确的事情，”天空体育 NFL 的贝尔说道。

paras.en: "But when I look at him as a player, he wasn't playing well. He wasn't helping his team.
paras.zh: “但是当我把他视为一名球员时，他打得不好。他没有帮助他的球队。

paras.en: "And you could could see him and his head coach arguing on the sideline with with each other. They weren't getting along.
paras.zh: “你可以看到他和他的主教练在场边互相争吵。他们相处得不好。

paras.en: "Whatever happens behind closed doors, that goes down, but the response to it is where I'm losing a little respect.
paras.zh: “无论幕后发生什么，事情都会减少，但人们对此的反应却让我失去了一点尊重。

paras.en: "In that locker room is a sanctuary. Some things we just don't let out. We don't have those conversations in public - it's a respect thing.
paras.zh: “更衣室是一个避难所。有些事情我们只是不会泄露。我们不会在公共场合进行这些对话——这是一种尊重。”

paras.en: "If Rodgers was playing MVP football like he did before, he could say all these things and get away with it, but you have to know where you are in your career."
paras.zh: “如果罗杰斯像以前那样打 MVP 橄榄球，他可以说出所有这些话并侥幸逃脱，但你必须知道自己处于职业生涯的哪个阶段。”

paras.en: Rodgers suggested in his appearance on The Pat McAfee Show that the prospect of being benched had never been mentioned during recent conversations with McCarthy.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯在帕特·麦卡菲秀上露面时表示，在最近与麦卡锡的谈话中从未提到过被坐冷板凳的可能性。

paras.en: He accused McCarthy of snoring during meetings and rebuffing Rodgers' suggestions that he needed to make more of an effort of connecting with the Steelers' defensive players.
paras.zh: 他指责麦卡锡在会议期间打鼾，并拒绝了罗杰斯的建议，即他需要付出更多努力与钢人队的防守球员建立联系。

paras.en: Rodgers added that the "final straw" came during half-time of a game when McCarthy closed a team talk by shouting 'one, two, three, Packers!'.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯补充说，“最后一根稻草”出现在比赛中场休息时，麦卡锡在结束球队讲话时大喊“一、二、三，包装工！”。

paras.en: Rodgers and McCarthy spent 13 seasons together with the Packers from 2006-2018, reaching the playoffs nine times and winning one Super Bowl. They were reunited this past offseason when the Steelers hired McCarthy following the departure of Mike Tomlin.
paras.zh: 从2006年到2018年，罗杰斯和麦卡锡与包装工队一起度过了13个赛季，九次进入季后赛并赢得了一次超级碗。他们在上个休赛期重聚，钢人队在迈克·汤姆林离开后聘请了麦卡锡。

paras.en: "I'm not sure what's next for Aaron Rodgers. I think he will figure out that for himself over the next handful of months, or whatever his particular process is," said Super Bowl champion and Sky Sports NFL expert Ndamukong Suh.
paras.zh: “我不确定亚伦·罗杰斯接下来会做什么。我认为他会在接下来的几个月里自己弄清楚这一点，或者无论他的具体过程是什么，”超级碗冠军、天空体育 NFL 专家 Ndamukong Suh 说。

paras.en: "But I want to go back to what Jason [Bell] said in the way that you handle your business, especially from the perspective of a star. There's a way you go about handling things.
paras.zh: “但我想回到贾森[贝尔]所说的处理业务的方式，特别是从明星的角度来看。处理事情是有方法的。

paras.en: "Those things should be handled behind closed doors before trying to get ahead of the story - on either side. Have a conversation, have an understanding, and then go from there and address it.
paras.zh: “在试图深入报道之前，无论是哪一方，这些事情都应该闭门处理。进行对话，达成理解，然后从那里开始解决问题。

paras.en: "Going out to the media and doing all of these different things, The Pat McAfee Show, it's great for them and great for ESPN, but it's not the proper way I would want to handle that particular scenario."
paras.zh: “走向媒体并做所有这些不同的事情，帕特·迈克菲秀，这对他们来说很棒，对 ESPN 来说也很棒，但这不是我想要处理特定情况的正确方式。”

paras.en: Responding to Rodgers' comments, McCarthy admitted to his "embarrassing" moment when mentioning the Packers during half-time of their defeat to the Philadelphia Eagles in Week 11.
paras.zh: 在回应罗杰斯的评论时，麦卡锡承认在第十一周包装工队输给费城老鹰队的中场休息时提到包装工队时他感到“尴尬”的时刻。

paras.en: Steelers president gives McCarthy his "100 per cent" backing
paras.zh: 钢人队主席给予麦卡锡“100%”的支持

paras.en: Steelers president Art Rooney II defended McCarthy on Thursday in an interview with the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette, insisting he supports him "100 per cent".
paras.zh: 钢人队主席阿特·鲁尼二世周四在接受《匹兹堡邮报》采访时为麦卡锡辩护，坚称他“百分百”支持他。

paras.en: "I just want to say that I have 100 per cent confidence in Mike McCarthy and I expect he'll be our coach this season, next season and beyond," Mr Rooney II told the Post-Gazette.
paras.zh: “我只想说，我对迈克·麦卡锡有百分百的信心，我希望他本赛季、下赛季以及以后都能成为我们的教练，”鲁尼二世告诉《邮报》。

paras.en: "The big thing, what happened this week, is insubordination can't be tolerated in any organization. When you start getting ultimatums, you can't live with that. There's maybe a time and place after the season if he wanted to kind of unload.
paras.zh: “本周发生的最重要的事情是，任何组织都不能容忍不服从命令。当你开始收到最后通牒时，你就无法忍受。赛季结束后，如果他想摆脱困境，也许会有某个时间和地点。”

paras.en: "He talks about wanting to be a good teammate, but you don't do that to your teammates a couple days before the game, that's for sure."
paras.zh: “他谈到想要成为一名好队友，但你不会在比赛前几天对你的队友这样做，这是肯定的。”

paras.en: Rooney II underlined his belief that events in the locker room should be kept within the locker room, and downplayed Rodgers' comments regarding concerns for McCarthy's health.
paras.zh: 鲁尼二世强调了他的信念，即更衣室里的活动应该在更衣室内进行，并淡化了罗杰斯对麦卡锡健康担忧的评论。

paras.en: The Steelers are 6-4 as they prepare to face the Denver Broncos (8-2) on Black Friday.
paras.zh: 钢人队目前战绩为 6 胜 4 负，他们准备在黑色星期五迎战丹佛野马队 (8 胜 2 负)。

paras.zh: 塞尔塔维戈 1-2 伯恩茅斯：拉扬获胜，樱桃队成为第一支在欧洲主要赛事中赢得前五场比赛的英格兰球队

paras.en: Report from the Europa League game between Celta Vigo and Bournemouth at Estadio Abanca-Balaidos; Iago Aspas put home side in front before Alvaro Rodriguez and Rayan struck to earn the Cherries a historic victory as Bournemouth extended their winning run to 10 matches in all competitions
paras.zh: 塞尔塔维戈队与伯恩茅斯队在阿班卡-巴莱多斯球场举行的欧罗巴联赛报道；伊阿古·阿斯帕斯 (Iago Aspas) 在阿尔瓦罗·罗德里格斯 (Alvaro Rodriguez) 和拉扬 (Rayan) 的进球之前帮助球队取得领先，为樱桃队赢得了一场历史性的胜利，伯恩茅斯将他们在所有比赛中的连胜场数扩大到了 10 场

paras.en: Bournemouth continued their magnificent run of form with a 2-1 victory against Celta Vigo, creating two bits of history in the process.
paras.zh: 伯恩茅斯以2-1战胜维戈塞尔塔，延续了他们的辉煌表现，创造了两项历史。

paras.en: It was a club-record-extending 10th successive win for Bournemouth in all competitions, with the victory also marking the first time an English club have won their first five matches in major European competition.
paras.zh: 这是伯恩茅斯在各项赛事中连续第十次获胜，刷新了俱乐部纪录，这场胜利也标志着英格兰俱乐部首次在欧洲主要赛事中取得前五场比赛的胜利。

paras.en: - Teams | Stats | Europa League fixtures and results
paras.zh: - 团队|统计 |欧洲联赛赛程和结果

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream Premier League games with no contract📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播英超联赛📺

paras.en: Veteran former Liverpool striker Iago Aspas put the home side in front in style in the first half, before Bournemouth were reduced to 10 men when Bafode Diakite was sent off for a late challenge.
paras.zh: 老将前利物浦前锋伊阿古·阿斯帕斯在上半场带领主队取得领先，随后巴福德·迪亚基特在最后时刻犯规被红牌罚下，伯恩茅斯队的人数减少到了 10 人。

paras.en: But Alvaro Rodriguez equalised early in the second half, with substitute Rayan coming on to score a late winner to give Bournemouth an unlikely win.
paras.zh: 但阿尔瓦罗·罗德里格斯在下半场一开始就扳平了比分，替补出场的拉扬在最后时刻打入制胜球，为伯恩茅斯带来了一场不太可能的胜利。

paras.en: Bournemouth were fortunate not to go behind after 10 minutes, with an offside flag chalking off Pablo Duran's poke home from close-range.
paras.zh: 伯恩茅斯幸运地在10分钟后没有落后，巴勃罗·杜兰近距离射门破门，越位旗标。

paras.en: But the Cherries fell behind 10 minutes later when record Celta Vigo goalscorer Aspas scored a screamer.
paras.zh: 但10分钟后，塞尔塔维戈队创纪录的射手阿斯帕斯进球，樱桃队落后了。

paras.en: The 39-year-old had seen an overhead kick saved well by Michele Di Gregorio, but he picked up the ball on the right side of the area in the second phase of play, before cutting inside to curl past the goalkeeper and into the far corner off the post.
paras.zh: 这位39岁的球员曾看到米歇尔·迪·格雷戈里奥(Michele Di Gregorio)漂亮地扑出一记倒钩球，但他在比赛第二阶段在禁区右侧接球，然后切入内线，绕过门将，飞入远角。

paras.en: Things went from bad to worse for Bournemouth moment later when Diakite saw a yellow card upgraded to a red after a VAR check following a late challenge on Couhaib Driouech.
paras.zh: 不久之后，伯恩茅斯的情况变得越来越糟，迪亚基特在对库海布·德里奥埃奇(Couhaib Driouech)的最后一次挑战后，经VAR检查后看到黄牌升级为红牌。

paras.en: Tyler Adams replaced Justin Kluivert at half-time and the tactical switch drew an instant reward when Alvaro Rodriguez glanced home Amine Adli's cross to get Bournemouth back on level terms.
paras.zh: 泰勒·亚当斯在中场休息时替换了贾斯汀·克鲁伊维特，阿尔瓦罗·罗德里格斯接过阿明·阿德利的传中球帮助伯恩茅斯扳平比分，这一战术转变立刻得到了回报。

paras.en: James Hill then drew a fine save from Ionut Radu - who is the only player ever to play for both clubs - before Di Gregorio was called into action at the other end to divert a long-range Aspas strike away.
paras.zh: 随后，詹姆斯·希尔 (James Hill) 做出了伊奥努特·拉杜 (Ionut Radu) 的精彩扑救，拉杜是唯一一位为两家具乐部效力过的球员，随后迪·格雷戈里奥 (Di Gregorio) 在另一端出击，转移了阿斯帕斯的远射射门。

paras.en: But three Bournemouth substitutes combined for a late winner.
paras.zh: 但伯恩茅斯的三名替补球员联手创造了最后的制胜球。

paras.en: Adrien Truffert stole possession and broke before finding Marcus Tavernier the area. He laid the ball off for Rayan to sweep home and seal victory as Marco Rose's side made more history with a brilliant win at the Estadio Abanca-Balaidos.
paras.zh: 阿德里安·特鲁弗特 (Adrien Truffert) 抢断控球权并破门，然后找到马库斯·塔维尼尔 (Marcus Tavernier) 禁区。他传球让拉扬横扫主场并锁定胜利，马可·罗斯的球队在阿班卡-巴莱多斯球场取得了辉煌的胜利，创造了更多历史。

paras.en: Key moments from Estadio Abanca-Balaidos
paras.zh: 阿班卡-巴莱多斯球场的关键时刻

paras.en: 11: GOAL RULED OUT! Duran follows up on an initial shot from Driouech to bundle home but is ruled off-side.
paras.zh: 11：进球无效！杜兰在德里奥埃奇的第一次射门后跟进，但被判越位。

paras.en: 19: GOAL! Veteran striker and former Liverpool man Aspas scores a screamer to give Celta Vigo the lead!
paras.zh: 19：目标！经验丰富的前锋、前利物浦球员阿斯帕斯进球，帮助塞尔塔维戈取得领先！

paras.en: 25: RED CARD! Diakite is sent off after a VAR check for a late challenge on Driouech!
paras.zh: 25：红牌！迪亚基特因对德里奥埃奇的迟到挑战而在VAR检查后被罚下场！

paras.en: 30: GOAL RULED OUT! Celta have the ball in the back of the net again, but Duran is again denied by an off-side flag.
paras.zh: 30：目标被排除！塞尔塔队再次将球打入球门，但杜兰再次被越位旗挡出。

paras.en: 39: SAVE! Kluivert shoots from a very tight angle - but it is well saved by Radu in the Celta Vigo goal.
paras.zh: 39：保存！克鲁伊维特的射门角度非常小，但在塞尔塔维戈队的进球中被拉杜精彩扑出。

paras.en: 46: GOAL! Rodriguez scores with a glancing header from close-range after a beautiful cross from the right-hand side by Adli.
paras.zh: 46：目标！阿德利右侧漂亮传中后，罗德里格斯近距离头球破门。

paras.en: 60: SAVE! Scott goes for goal from a free kick from a tight angle but Radu has it covered.
paras.zh: 60：保存！斯科特以小角度任意球射门，但被拉杜挡出。

paras.en: 63: SAVE! Hill has a go from range but the goalkeeper tips over.
paras.zh: 63：保存！希尔远射，但门将倒地。

paras.en: 73: SAVE! Aspas shoots from the edge of the area and Di Gregorio gets down well to save.
paras.zh: 73：保存！阿斯帕斯禁区边缘射门，迪格雷戈里奥奋力扑救。

paras.en: 78: GOAL! What a turnaround! Rayan sweeps home to give Bournemouth the lead!
paras.zh: 78：目标！多么大的转变啊！拉扬横扫主场，伯恩茅斯取得领先！

articles.title: NZ skipper Latham laughs off Pant dominating local cricket under false name

paras.en: New Zealand vs India: Tom Latham laughs off Rishabh Pant dominating local Christchurch cricket match under false name
paras.zh: 新西兰 vs 印度：汤姆·莱瑟姆 (Tom Latham) 对 Rishabh Pant 以假名统治基督城当地板球比赛一笑置之

paras.en: Footage emerged this week of India's Rishabh Pant scoring 54 off 21 balls for local Christchurch cricket club Open House Swingers under false name 'Stan Stan'; Pant played one day before second New Zealand vs India Test begins; Black Caps captain Tom Latham laughs it off as 'brilliant'
paras.zh: 本周出现的视频显示，印度选手 Rishabh Pant 以化名“Stan Stan”为基督城当地板球俱乐部 Open House Swingers 打进 21 个球，打进 54 分；潘特在第二次新西兰对印度测试开始前一天参加了比赛；黑帽队队长汤姆·莱瑟姆笑称“太棒了”

paras.en: New Zealand captain Tom Latham has laughed off India's Rishabh Pant dominating a local Christchurch cricket match under a false name, a day before their second Test.
paras.zh: 新西兰队长汤姆·莱瑟姆 (Tom Latham) 在第二次测试前一天，对印度选手瑞沙布·潘特 (Rishabh Pant) 以假名在基督城当地板球比赛中占据主导地位一笑置之。

paras.en: On Monday, Daryl Mitchell and Glenn Phillips held firm for 43 overs to earn the Black Caps a hard-fought draw in Wellington after India posted a record score of 720-9d.
paras.zh: 周一，达里尔·米切尔 (Daryl Mitchell) 和格伦·菲利普斯 (Glenn Phillips) 坚守 43 球，为黑帽队在惠灵顿赢得一场艰苦的平局，此前印度队以 720 比 9 的创纪录比分。

paras.en: Pant scored 128 in that Test, with the second Test between the sides beginning on Thursday at Hagley Oval.
paras.zh: 潘特在那次测试中获得了 128 分，双方之间的第二次测试将于周四在哈格利椭圆形球场开始。

paras.en: Yet, footage has since emerged of Pant playing for club side Open House Swingers against The Chosen Ones on Wednesday, scoring 54 off 21 balls under the name 'Stan Stan' to seal a 16-run victory.
paras.zh: 然而，随后出现的视频显示，周三，潘特代表俱乐部球队开放日摇摆者队对阵天选者队，以“斯坦·斯坦”的名义打进21球，拿下54分，锁定了16连胜。

paras.en: In an interview with The New Zealand Herald, Open House player Mohammad Safi said he had seen Pant on an electric bike in the city and asked if he would play, due to his club team being a player short.
paras.zh: 在接受《新西兰先驱报》采访时，开放日球员穆罕默德·萨菲表示，他在城里看到潘特骑着电动自行车，并询问他是否愿意参加比赛，因为他的俱乐部队缺少球员。

paras.en: "Did he play?! How'd he go?" Latham said at his New Zealand press conference. "That's brilliant!
paras.zh: “他玩了吗？！他玩得怎么样？”莱瑟姆在新西兰新闻发布会上说道。 “太棒了！

paras.en: "It's great. He's obviously a real character of the game, is Rishabh.
paras.zh: “这太棒了。他显然是游戏中真正的角色，就是 Rishabh。

paras.en: "It's great for him to be giving his experience back to LMS (Last Man Standing) teams!"
paras.zh: “能够将自己的经验回馈给 LMS（Last Man Standing）团队，对他来说真是太棒了！”

paras.en: Pant has scored 3,853 runs in his 53 Tests for India, averaging just below of 45.
paras.zh: 潘特在代表印度参加的 53 场测试中取得了 3,853 分，平均分略低于 45 分。

paras.en: The 29-year-old also boasts a strike-rate of 74.43, which is bettered only by Virender Sehwag and Kapil Dev among players to have scored more than 2,000 Test runs for India.
paras.zh: 这位 29 岁的球员还拥有 74.43 的命中率，在为印度试跑得分超过 2,000 次的球员中，仅次于 Virender Sehwag 和 Kapil Dev。

articles.title: Crowd evacuated from American rapper Don Toliver’s concert after ‘unknown substance’ released
articles.author: Adela Suliman

paras.en: MANCHESTER, England — Thousands of people attending a concert of American rapper Don Toliver were evacuated from a major British arena Sunday evening, police said, after an “unknown substance” was released into the crowd.
paras.zh: 英国曼彻斯特——周日晚上，警方表示，在一种“不明物质”被释放到人群中后，数千名观看美国说唱歌手唐·托利弗 (Don Toliver) 演唱会的人从英国一个主要舞台撤离。

paras.en: About 12,000 concertgoers were evacuated by emergency workers just after 10 p.m. local time (5 p.m. ET) from Toliver’s show at the Co-op Live venue in the northern English city of Manchester.
paras.zh: 晚上 10 点刚过，大约 12,000 名音乐会观众被紧急救援人员疏散。当地时间（美国东部时间下午 5 点），托利弗 (Toliver) 在英国北部城市曼彻斯特的 Co-op Live 场地演出。

paras.en: The North West Ambulance Service declared a major incident and said the substance was “believed to be tear gas” and was understood to have been released toward the end of the show.
paras.zh: 西北救护车服务中心宣布发生重大事件，并表示该物质“据信是催泪瓦斯”，据了解是在节目结束时释放的。

paras.en: “We deployed several emergency crews, including our Hazardous Area Response Team, to support the safe assessment and treatment of people at the scene,” it said in a statement, adding that one person had been hospitalized.
paras.zh: 该公司在一份声明中表示：“我们部署了几名应急人员，包括我们的危险区域响应小组，以支持现场人员的安全评估和治疗。”并补充说，其中一人已住院。

paras.en: “More than 80 people were assessed by our clinicians, with some reporting eye and respiratory symptoms. Decontamination was carried out as a precaution,” the ambulance service said Monday.
paras.zh: “我们的临床医生对 80 多人进行了评估，其中一些人报告了眼睛和呼吸道症状。作为预防措施，进行了净化处理，”救护车服务部门周一表示。

paras.en: People in the crowd were suffering effects “from an unknown substance,” Greater Manchester police said in its latest statement Monday. “Enquiries are underway into what the substance is and what caused the incident,” police added.
paras.zh: 大曼彻斯特警方在周一的最新声明中表示，人群中的人们受到“一种未知物质”的影响。警方补充说：“正在调查该物质是什么以及导致事件发生的原因。”

paras.en: The venue, in the center of the busy city, was hosting Grammy Award-nominated R&B rapper-singer Toliver, whose real name is Caleb Zackery Toliver, as part of his Nitrous tour.
paras.zh: 该场地位于繁忙城市的中心，作为他的 Nitrous 巡演的一部分，格莱美奖提名的 R&B 说唱歌手托利弗 (Toliver，他的真名是 Caleb Zackery Toliver) 正在这里举办。

paras.en: The Houston-based rapper is best known for hits “No idea” and “After Party,” and features on the soundtrack to the new “Grand Theft Auto VI” blockbuster game.
paras.zh: 这位来自休斯顿的说唱歌手以歌曲《No idea》和《After Party》而闻名，并为新的大片游戏《侠盗猎车手 VI》配乐。

paras.en: In a statement posted to Instagram, Toliver said he was “very sad” to announce that he would have to cancel his London show on Monday “due to the incident in Manchester” and would instead perform on Dec. 15.
paras.zh: 托利弗在 Instagram 上发布的一份声明中表示，他“非常悲伤”地宣布，“由于曼彻斯特发生的事件”，他将不得不取消周一的伦敦演出，并将于 12 月 15 日演出。

paras.en: “I Just Wanna Make Sure Everyone is Safe and the next Show goes on properly. My Heart and prayers are with with everyone that was injured last night,” he added.
paras.zh: “我只是想确保每个人都安全，并且下一场演出正常进行。我的心和祈祷与昨晚受伤的每个人同在，”他补充道。

paras.en: Manchester was left shaken in 2017 after a bombing at a nearby venue during an Ariana Grande concert left 22 people dead and made global headlines.
paras.zh: 2017 年，阿丽亚娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande) 演唱会期间，附近一个场地发生爆炸事件，导致 22 人死亡，并成为全球头条新闻，曼彻斯特震动不已。

paras.en: “We understand the concern that this incident will have raised,” Assistant Chief Constable Steph Parker said Monday. “We will now begin to fully understand what this substance was and how this incident came about.”
paras.zh: “我们理解这起事件会引起的担忧，”助理警长斯蒂芬·帕克周一表示。 “我们现在将开始充分了解这种物质是什么以及这起事件是如何发生的。”

paras.en: “Several people were treated on site, and one has been taken to hospital at this time. Anyone who has left the event and since become unwell is advised to attend their local hospital,” Parker added.
paras.zh: 帕克补充说：“有几人在现场接受治疗，其中一人已被送往医院。任何离开活动并出现不适的人都应前往当地医院。”

paras.en: Concertgoer Joey Howe, 22, told BBC Radio Manchester the lights came on and Toliver appeared to have been “rushed off stage.”
paras.zh: 22 岁的音乐会常客乔伊·豪 (Joey Howe) 告诉 BBC 曼彻斯特广播电台，灯光亮了，托利弗似乎“被赶下了舞台”。

paras.en: “I saw a lot of people streaming out and you go into this panic mode and you see a lot of people running out of the venue,” Howe said. He said people were “choking” and there was a “horrible smell” in the arena.
paras.zh: 豪说：“我看到很多人涌出，你进入这种恐慌模式，你会看到很多人跑出会场。”他说人们“窒息”，竞技场里有“可怕的气味”。

paras.en: “It was just really distressing scenes and not something you want to see,” he added.
paras.zh: “这真是令人痛苦的场景，不是你想看到的，”他补充道。

paras.en: Another fan, Ben Stevenson, told the Manchester Evening News that he was in the standing section of the arena when he “started coughing and (my) eyes were kind of itchy.”
paras.zh: 另一位球迷本·史蒂文森告诉《曼彻斯特晚报》，他当时正在球场的站立区，“开始咳嗽，（我的）眼睛有点痒”。

paras.en: A spokesman for Prime Minister Andy Burnham, a former mayor of Manchester, called the incident “deeply worrying” and said the police would conduct a full investigation.
paras.zh: 曼彻斯特前市长、首相安迪·伯纳姆的发言人称这一事件“令人深感担忧”，并表示警方将进行全面调查。

paras.en: The venue, which opened in 2024, is due to host American singer Phoebe Bridgers on Thursday.
paras.zh: 该场馆于 2024 年开业，将于周四接待美国歌手菲比·布里杰斯 (Phoebe Bridgers)。

paras.en: It said in a statement on X that it was “working closely with Greater Manchester Police to identify the cause and action appropriately. Our priority remains the safety and security of all visitors to Co-op Live, and we will provide more information once we have an update.”
paras.zh: 该公司在 X 的一份声明中表示，“正在与大曼彻斯特警方密切合作，以查明原因并采取适当行动。我们的首要任务仍然是 Co-op Live 所有访客的安全，一旦有最新消息，我们将提供更多信息。”

articles.title: Ukraine sinks Russian warship off Libya in latest expansion of the war
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: Ukraine has taken its fight against Russia to the shores of North Africa, claiming to have sunk a warship off the coast of Libya in its latest expansion of the war.
paras.zh: 乌克兰已将与俄罗斯的战斗转移到北非海岸，声称在其最新的战争扩张中击沉了利比亚海岸附近的一艘军舰。

paras.en: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Monday that Ukrainian naval drones had been used in the attack in the Mediterranean a day earlier, which came after Moscow said another of its ships was struck by drones in the Baltic Sea.
paras.zh: 总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基周一表示，乌克兰海军无人机在一天前的地中海袭击中被使用，此前莫斯科称其另一艘船只在波罗的海被无人机击中。

paras.en: Zelenskyy shared footage of the attacks in a post on X, showing drones approaching several vessels followed by massive fireballs.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在 X 上的一篇帖子中分享了袭击的镜头，显示无人机接近几艘船只，随后出现了巨大的火球。

paras.en: He said his forces deployed seven Ukrainian-made naval drones to sink the Russian corvette, Merkury, and hit a transport ship, the Angara, in an “exemplary Ukrainian operation.”
paras.zh: 他说，他的部队部署了七架乌克兰制造的海军无人机击沉了俄罗斯护卫舰“水星号”，并击中了一艘运输船“安加拉号”，这是“乌克兰行动的典范”。

paras.en: Later, in a separate post on the social media site, he said Ukraine responded “to Russia’s strikes the way it should be done, the way that is effective,” adding: “It is also important that without these ships in those waters, it will be harder for Russia to fuel conflicts and instability in that region as well.”
paras.zh: 后来，他在社交媒体网站上的另一篇帖子中表示，乌克兰“以应该、有效的方式回应俄罗斯的袭击”，并补充道：“同样重要的是，如果这些船只没有进入这些水域，俄罗斯将更难助长该地区的冲突和不稳定。”

paras.en: Ukraine’s Security Service, SBU, said the attacks took place near the Libyan port of Benghazi, some 1,500 miles from the established front lines of the conflict.
paras.zh: 乌克兰安全局 (SBU) 表示，袭击发生在利比亚班加西港附近，距离冲突既定前线约 1,500 英里。

paras.en: It said the corvette “regularly escorted enemy naval convoys” and in particular guarded the Angara cargo ship that was used to move weapons. “Both vessels were legitimate military targets for Ukraine, as they worked directly for Russia’s military capabilities,” the SBU said in a statement on Telegram.
paras.zh: 声明称，这艘护卫舰“定期护送敌方海军船队”，特别是守卫用于运输武器的安加拉货船。 SBU 在 Telegram 上的一份声明中表示：“这两艘船都是乌克兰的合法军事目标，因为它们直接为俄罗斯的军事能力服务。”

paras.en: Ukrainian uncrewed boats were delivered to a designated location and launched into the water from a so-called “mother ship,” the SBU said, reaching their targets despite “enemy’s attempts to destroy the Ukrainian drones from the air.” It said the Ka-27 multi-purpose helicopter was on board the corvette and was also sunk.
paras.zh: SBU表示，乌克兰无人船被运送到指定地点，并从一艘所谓的“母船”下水，尽管“敌人试图从空中摧毁乌克兰无人机”，但仍到达了目标。据称，护卫舰上有一架Ka-27多用途直升机，也被击沉。

paras.en: “The Defence Forces of Ukraine have once again shown that the Russian navy and its logistics have no safe routes, even far beyond the Black Sea,” the SBU added.
paras.zh: SBU补充说：“乌克兰国防军再次表明，俄罗斯海军及其后勤保障没有安全路线，甚至远离黑海。”

paras.en: Ukraine noted that the ship was one of Russia’s newest, commissioned only in 2023.
paras.zh: 乌克兰指出，这艘船是俄罗斯最新的一艘，于 2023 年才投入使用。

paras.en: Moscow has noted Zelenskyy’s “statement on this matter,” Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters Monday when asked about the attacks. He deferred to the Russian Defense Ministry, which was yet to comment.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫周一在被问及袭击事件时告诉记者，莫斯科已经注意到泽连斯基“关于此事的声明”。他听取了俄罗斯国防部的意见，但俄罗斯国防部尚未发表评论。

paras.en: It’s the latest example of Kyiv launching surprise attacks to hit back against the Kremlin.
paras.zh: 这是基辅发动突然袭击反击克里姆林宫的最新例证。

paras.en: But the weekend attack caused fallout in Libya, where local authorities expressed outrage and the United Nations called for an independent probe.
paras.zh: 但周末的袭击事件在利比亚引起了轩然大波，当地政府表达了愤怒，联合国呼吁进行独立调查。

paras.en: The eastern Libya-based government said Sunday that an explosion took place aboard a Russian vessel docked at the Benghazi naval base. It said the vessel was en route back to Russia and had stopped at the port to refuel and take on supplies.
paras.zh: 利比亚东部政府周日表示，停靠在班加西海军基地的一艘俄罗斯船只发生爆炸。据称，这艘船正在返回俄罗斯的途中，并在港口停下来加油和接收补给。

paras.en: A comprehensive investigation into the attack will be launched, it said, in coordination with Russian authorities.
paras.zh: 声明称，将与俄罗斯当局协调，对此次袭击事件展开全面调查。

paras.en: “The Government views the targeting of a vessel within a Libyan port as a serious assault on national sovereignty and a blatant violation of port security and the safety of maritime navigation,” the statement added, without calling out Kyiv directly but adding that Libya was not a party to the war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“政府认为针对利比亚港口内的一艘船只的袭击是对国家主权的严重侵犯，是对港口安全和海上航行安全的公然侵犯。”声明没有直接点名基辅，但补充说利比亚不是乌克兰战争的一方。

paras.en: Libya has been divided since an uprising toppled longtime dictator Moammar Gadhafi in 2011. A U.N.-supported government is based in Tripoli and a rival administration with ties to Russia is located in the east of the oil-rich nation.
paras.zh: 自2011年起义推翻长期独裁者卡扎菲以来，利比亚一直处于分裂状态。联合国支持的政府设在的黎波里，而与俄罗斯有联系的敌对政府则位于这个石油资源丰富的国家的东部。

paras.en: The eastern Libya-based government has cooperation agreements and maritime facility arrangements with Russia, but Ukrainian forces also operate in the country’s west under a deal believed to be endorsed by Kyiv’s global allies.
paras.zh: 利比亚东部政府与俄罗斯签订了合作协议和海上设施安排，但乌克兰军队也在该国西部根据一项据信得到基辅全球盟友认可的协议开展行动。

paras.en: The U.N. Support Mission in Libya called for “an immediate, independent and transparent investigation” into the ship attack.
paras.zh: 联合国利比亚支持团呼吁对船只袭击事件进行“立即、独立和透明的调查”。

paras.en: The western Libya government expressed concerns about “dragging Libyan ports and civilian facilities into external conflicts,” in an apparent reference to Russia’s war in Ukraine. “The government reaffirms its categorical rejection of turning Libya into an arena for international conflicts or a theater for external powers to settle scores,” it said in a statement.
paras.zh: 利比亚西部政府对“将利比亚港口和民用设施拖入外部冲突”表示担忧，这显然是指俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争。 “政府重申坚决反对将利比亚变成国际冲突的竞技场或外部势力算账的舞台，”声明中表示。

paras.en: It’s not the first attack linked to the Ukraine war in the Mediterranean this year.
paras.zh: 这并不是今年第一次与乌克兰地中海战争有关的袭击。

paras.en: Ukrainian forces operating in western Libya struck a Russian tanker in a suspected sea drone attack near Maltese waters, Libyan officials said in March.
paras.zh: 利比亚官员三月份表示，在利比亚西部活动的乌克兰军队在马耳他水域附近疑似海上无人机袭击中击中了一艘俄罗斯油轮。

paras.en: The latest attack off the coast of North Africa come just a day after a Russian-owned cargo ship was struck by drones in the Baltic Sea.
paras.zh: 就在北非海岸发生的最新袭击事件发生前一天，一艘俄罗斯货船在波罗的海被无人机袭击。

paras.en: The Finnish military said the strike on the Sparta II on Saturday was likely carried out by Ukraine and that the vessel later drifted into Finnish waters, raising fears that the conflict is increasingly spilling over.
paras.zh: 芬兰军方表示，周六对斯巴达二号的袭击很可能是乌克兰所为，该船后来漂入芬兰水域，引发了人们对冲突日益蔓延的担忧。

paras.en: Kyiv has not claimed responsibility, and the Ukrainian Defense Ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment from NBC News.
paras.zh: 基辅尚未声称对此事负责，乌克兰国防部也没有立即回应 NBC 新闻的置评请求。

paras.en: Peskov called the attack on Sparta II “a very dangerous trend of expanding terrorist activity in the Baltic region” Monday.
paras.zh: 佩斯科夫周一称对斯巴达二号的袭击是“波罗的海地区恐怖活动扩大的非常危险的趋势”。

paras.en: The escalation in international waters comes just days after the three-way summit between the leaders of Russia, China and the U.S., during which President Donald Trump called Russian President Vladimir Putin his “friend” and said Putin wanted to end his war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 就在国际水域局势升级的几天前，俄罗斯、中国和美国领导人举行了三方峰会，峰会期间，唐纳德·特朗普总统称俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京为他的“朋友”，并表示普京希望结束乌克兰战争。

paras.en: Zelenskyy told NBC News ahead of the Shenzhen summit that he saw no signs Putin was ready for peace.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在深圳峰会前告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，他没有看到普京准备好和平的迹象。

articles.title: Two arrested over suspected burglary at royal family’s Sandringham estate
articles.author: Alexander Smith

paras.en: LONDON — Two men have been arrested over a suspected burglary at the royal family’s Sandringham estate, British police said Tuesday, after a reported break-in at the country home of Prince William and Princess Kate.
paras.zh: 伦敦——英国警方周二表示，在威廉王子和凯特王妃的乡村住宅发生入室盗窃事件后，英国警方周二表示，两名男子因涉嫌入室盗窃而被捕。

paras.en: Police responded to reports of “suspicious activity” at the address Monday evening, dispatching searches by police dogs, drones a helicopter. That resulted in two men being arrested on suspicion of burglary and trespassing, according to a statement from the Norfolk Constabulary, the local police authority. The property was unoccupied at the time of the incident, it added.
paras.zh: 周一晚间，警方对该地址发生“可疑活动”的报告作出回应，派出警犬、无人机和直升机进行搜查。据当地警察当局诺福克警察局的一份声明称，两名男子因涉嫌入室盗窃和非法侵入而被捕。声明补充说，事发时该房产无人居住。

paras.en: The Sun newspaper first reported that police were investigating a break-in at Anmer Hall, one of the residences used by the heir to the British throne and his wife, nestled in the heart of the royals’ sprawling estate.
paras.zh: 《太阳报》首先报道称，警方正在调查安默厅 (Anmer Hall) 的一起入室盗窃案，该厅是英国王位继承人及其妻子使用的住宅之一，坐落在王室庞大庄园的中心地带。

paras.en: Kensington Palace, which handles communications for William and Kate, said it would not comment publicly on security matters. A royal source told NBC News that the couple and their three children, George, Charlotte and Louis, were not there at the time.
paras.zh: 负责处理威廉和凯特通讯的肯辛顿宫表示，不会就安全问题公开发表评论。一位王室消息人士告诉 NBC 新闻，这对夫妇和他们的三个孩子乔治、夏洛特和路易斯当时并不在场。

paras.en: The Waleses’ main home is Forest Lodge in Windsor, where they moved for a “fresh start” in 2025 after the death of Queen Elizabeth II and Kate’s cancer diagnosis.
paras.zh: 威尔士一家的主要住所是温莎的森林小屋，在伊丽莎白二世女王去世和凯特被诊断出癌症后，他们于 2025 年搬到了这里，开始了“新的开始”。

paras.en: Anmer Hall, a 10-bedroom country house built in the early 1800s, entered the royals’ extensive property portfolio when it was bought in 1898 by Queen Victoria’s son, who would later become King Edward VII.
paras.zh: 安默厅 (Anmer Hall) 是一座建于 1800 年代初、拥有 10 间卧室的乡间别墅，于 1898 年被维多利亚女王的儿子（后来成为国王爱德华七世）买下，进入了王室的广泛财产组合。

paras.en: It has been used by various royals over the years. And William and Kate often enjoy the residence for weekend breaks and holidays.
paras.zh: 多年来，它已被多位皇室成员使用。威廉和凯特经常在这里度过周末和假期。

paras.en: The incident will sharpen an ongoing debate about royal security.
paras.zh: 这一事件将加剧有关王室安全的持续争论。

paras.en: William, as a “working royal,” receives 24-hour armed security. But his brother, Prince Harry, does not, having moved to California in 2020 and relinquished his regal duties.
paras.zh: 威廉作为一名“工作王室成员”，受到 24 小时武装保安的保护。但他的弟弟哈里王子却没有，他已于 2020 年搬到加利福尼亚州并放弃了王室职责。

paras.en: Harry is in a protracted battle with authorities in a bid to reinstate this arrangement, which he argues is necessary due to his high-profile position and history of serving in the armed forces in Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 哈里正在与当局进行一场旷日持久的斗争，以期恢复这一安排，他认为，由于他的高调地位和在阿富汗武装部队服役的历史，这是必要的。

paras.en: This summer, Harry and his wife, Meghan, and their two children, Archie, 7, and Lilibet, 5, moved back to Britain.
paras.zh: 今年夏天，哈里和他的妻子梅根以及他们的两个孩子，7 岁的阿奇和 5 岁的莉莉贝特搬回了英国。

paras.en: In October 2024, burglars broke into the Windsor Castle estate west of London and stole a pickup truck and a quad bike from a farm building. King Charles and Queen Camilla weren’t at Windsor Castle at the time.
paras.zh: 2024 年 10 月，窃贼闯入伦敦西部温莎城堡庄园，从一座农场建筑中偷走了一辆皮卡车和一辆四轮摩托车。查尔斯国王和卡米拉王后当时并不在温莎城堡。

paras.en: Three years earlier, a man armed with a crossbow was detained on the castle grounds. Jaswant Singh Chail was later sentenced to nine years in prison after admitting he had been encouraged by a chatbot to kill Elizabeth.
paras.zh: 三年前，一名手持十字弓的男子在城堡内被拘留。贾斯万特·辛格·柴尔 (Jaswant Singh Chail) 承认自己受到聊天机器人的怂恿杀死伊丽莎白，后来被判处九年监禁。

paras.en: In 1982, intruder Michael Fagan managed to sneak into the queen’s private chambers while she was in bed. The queen spent 10 minutes chatting with the burglar before raising the alarm when he asked for a cigarette.
paras.zh: 1982 年，入侵者迈克尔·费根 (Michael Fagan) 趁女王睡觉时潜入她的私人卧室。女王花了10分钟与窃贼聊天，然后当窃贼向他要香烟时才发出警报。

paras.en: Hours after the break-in, William was meeting with British Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Tuesday on the doorstep of No. 10 Downing St., where they are expected to discuss issues such as homelessness.
paras.zh: 闯入事件发生数小时后，威廉周二在唐宁街 10 号门口会见英国首相安迪·伯纳姆，预计他们将在那里讨论无家可归等问题。

paras.en: Meanwhile Kate is set to feature in a 30-minute documentary, “Heal,” about her cancer diagnosis and remission. It will air on NBC on Nov. 30 at 8 p.m. ET/PT before streaming on Peacock from Dec. 1.
paras.zh: 与此同时，凯特将出演一部 30 分钟的纪录片《治愈》，讲述她的癌症诊断和缓解情况。该节目将于 11 月 30 日晚上 8 点在 NBC 播出。 ET/PT 将于 12 月 1 日起在 Peacock 上播出。

articles.title: 'Significant concern' as summer bushfire risk grows
articles.author: Romy Stephens

paras.en: Fire risk is elevated in Tasmania, parts of WA and SA, large parts of the NT and Victoria, and some regions within NSW.
paras.zh: 塔斯马尼亚州、西澳州和南澳州的部分地区、北领地和维多利亚州的大部分地区以及新南威尔士州的一些地区的火灾风险较高。

paras.en: Conditions are expected to dry up across northern and south-eastern states over the coming months.
paras.zh: 预计未来几个月，北部和东南部各州的情况将变得干燥。

paras.en: The BOM's summer forecast shows temperatures will be unusually high for most of the country, in particular at night.
paras.zh: 气象局的夏季预报显示，该国大部分地区的气温将异常高，特别是在夜间。

paras.en: Authorities are warning conditions will be ripe for bushfires across large parts of Australia this summer, particularly as hotter temperatures dry out landscapes that have seen prolific vegetation growth in recent months.
paras.zh: 当局警告称，今年夏天澳大利亚大部分地区发生丛林大火的条件已经成熟，特别是气温升高导致近几个月植被生长茂盛的景观变得干燥。

paras.en: The seasonal outlook, developed by the Australian and New Zealand Council for fire and emergency services (AFAC), shows an increased risk of fires across all states and territories except Queensland and the ACT.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚和新西兰消防和紧急服务委员会 (AFAC) 制定的季节性展望显示，除昆士兰州和首都地区外，所有州和地区的火灾风险都在增加。

paras.en: While 2026 is on track to become Australia's wettest El Niño year on record, forecasts suggest drier conditions could start to take hold across northern and south-eastern states over the coming months.
paras.zh: 虽然 2026 年有望成为澳大利亚有记录以来最潮湿的厄尔尼诺年，但预测显示，未来几个月，北部和东南部各州可能会开始出现干燥天气。

paras.en: The Bureau of Meteorology's summer outlook also points to above-average temperatures across most of the continent.
paras.zh: 气象局的夏季展望也表明，非洲大陆大部分地区的气温高于平均水平。

paras.en: AFAC CEO Rob Webb said some regions faced a higher threat due to prolonged drying, but even areas that saw higher spring rainfall were at risk.
paras.zh: AFAC 首席执行官罗布·韦伯 (Rob Webb) 表示，由于长期干旱，一些地区面临着更大的威胁，但即使是春季降雨量较多的地区也面临风险。

paras.en: "The recent rainfall has been a blessing in some ways in that the chances of early starts in some places are reduced," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“最近的降雨在某些方面是一件好事，因为某些地方提早启动的机会减少了。”

paras.en: "But wherever you are, you see the impact of two, three, or four 40-degree days, and we see in our own gardens the impact of that.
paras.zh: “但无论你身在何处，你都会看到两三天或四天 40 度的天气带来的影响，我们在自己的花园里也能看到这种影响。

paras.en: "Imagine those conditions over several weeks — it's not hard to imagine how quickly fire conditions can develop."
paras.zh: “想象一下几周内的情况——不难想象火灾的发展速度有多快。”

paras.en: Climate change and El Niño have driven global temperatures to record highs this year, while unusually warm temperatures helped drive a particularly bad wildfire season across Europe, the United States and Canada during the Northern Hemisphere summer.
paras.zh: 气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象导致今年全球气温创下历史新高，而北半球夏季异常温暖的气温导致欧洲、美国和加拿大遭遇了特别严重的野火季节。

paras.en: Almost all of Victoria is facing a heightened fire risk over the next few months, with East Gippsland and western regions the main areas of concern.
paras.zh: 未来几个月，维多利亚州几乎所有地区都面临着更高的火灾风险，其中东吉普斯兰和西部地区是主要关注地区。

paras.en: The warning comes months after the state was devastated by bushfires during the 2025-26 season, during which about 440,000 hectares of land were burnt.
paras.zh: 几个月前，该州在 2025-26 季节遭受丛林大火破坏，约 44 万公顷土地被烧毁。

paras.en: The AFAC outlook said there was "significant concern" around extreme grass and crop growth in northern and western parts of Victoria due to high rainfall in October.
paras.zh: AFAC展望表示，由于10月份的高降雨量，维多利亚州北部和西部地区的草和作物极端生长引起了“严重担忧”。

paras.en: Spring rainfall will likely limit forest fire activity in December, but the risk will increase in woodland areas towards the state's south-west and far east early next year.
paras.zh: 春季降雨可能会限制 12 月份的森林火灾活动，但明年初该州西南部和远东地区的林地风险将会增加。

paras.en: "It is likely that a hotter pattern will lead to a rapid switch in forest flammability with significant bushfires a real possibility in January and February," the outlook said.
paras.zh: 展望报告称：“更热的模式可能会导致森林易燃性迅速转变，一月和二月确实有可能发生严重的丛林火灾。”

paras.en: There could be more intense fire behaviour in eastern Tasmania due to low rainfall and drier soils.
paras.zh: 由于降雨量少和土壤干燥，塔斯马尼亚东部可能会发生更严重的火灾。

paras.en: While the top end fire season is winding down, large parts of Central Australia are expected to see an elevated fire risk from January.
paras.zh: 虽然高端火灾季节即将结束，但预计从一月份开始，澳大利亚中部大部分地区的火灾风险将会上升。

paras.en: There are warnings that dryness combined with above-average temperatures could drive fast-moving fires that are difficult to control across parts of southern New South Wales and the state's Hunter region.
paras.zh: 有警告称，干燥加上高于平均气温可能会导致新南威尔士州南部部分地区和该州亨特地区的大火迅速蔓延，难以控制。

paras.en: The outlook highlights that regions with elevated fire risk in Western Australia and South Australia are more scattered, compared to other states.
paras.zh: 展望强调，与其他州相比，西澳大利亚州和南澳大利亚州火灾风险较高的地区更加分散。

paras.en: Despite Queensland and the ACT facing a normal fire risk this season, authorities have warned that fires can still occur in those regions.
paras.zh: 尽管昆士兰州和首都地区本季度面临正常的火灾风险，但当局警告说，这些地区仍然可能发生火灾。

paras.en: "Wherever you are in Australia at the moment, we're coming into the warm season, and wherever you are, it's about knowing where your fire risks are, understanding whether it's normal or above normal or below normal," Mr Webb said.
paras.zh: 韦伯先生说：“无论你现在在澳大利亚的哪个地方，我们都将进入温暖的季节，无论你在哪里，重要的是要了解火灾风险在哪里，了解火灾是正常的、高于正常的还是低于正常的。”

paras.en: "Knowing whether your area is affected by bushfire and just take the precautions no matter what, do it ahead of time when the skies are blue."
paras.zh: “了解你所在的地区是否受到丛林大火的影响，无论如何都要采取预防措施，在天空晴朗的时候提前采取措施。”

paras.en: Firefighters have raised concerns about the long-range forecast showing both daytime and overnight temperatures will likely be higher than usual across most of the continent over summer.
paras.zh: 消防队员对长期预报表示担忧，该预报显示夏季非洲大陆大部分地区的白天和夜间气温可能会高于平常。

paras.en: Typically, evaporation is higher during hotter daytime temperatures, before landscapes have a chance to take in some water when it cools overnight. This means fires need to use more energy to evaporate water in soils and vegetation and do not burn as intensely.
paras.zh: 通常，在白天温度较高时，蒸发量较高，然后景观才有机会在夜间冷却时吸收一些水。这意味着火灾需要使用更多的能量来蒸发土壤和植被中的水分，并且燃烧不会那么强烈。

paras.en: But Mr Webb warned hotter temperatures not only ramped up evaporation but also meant there would be less relief at night.
paras.zh: 但韦伯先生警告说，气温升高不仅会加剧蒸发，还意味着夜间的缓解效果会减弱。

paras.en: "Vegetation not only will be under more stress but will be under stress more quickly," he said.
paras.zh: “植被不仅会承受更大的压力，而且会更快地承受压力，”他说。

paras.en: "The rate at which things dry, how long things will burn into the night and be dangerous into the night, will change.
paras.zh: “物体干燥的速度、物体在夜间燃烧的时间以及夜间危险的时间都会发生变化。

paras.en: "I remember teaching fire weather 25 years ago, and the anatomy of bad fire days were the ones that stayed warm and windy overnight."
paras.zh: “我记得 25 年前教授火灾天气，而恶劣的火灾天气就是那些整夜保持温暖和多风的天气。”

articles.title: Wind-monitoring mast removed as local pilots raise safety concerns
articles.author: Grace Nakamura

paras.en: Danish renewables company Vestas has removed one of its two wind-monitoring towers at a proposed wind farm in the Western Downs.
paras.zh: 丹麦可再生能源公司维斯塔斯拆除了位于西部唐斯拟建风电场的两座风力监测塔之一。

paras.en: Federal member for Maranoa David Littleproud accused the company of putting lives at risk after local agricultural pilots complained about visibility.
paras.zh: 马拉诺阿联邦议员戴维·利特尔普劳德 (David Littleproud) 指责该公司在当地农业飞行员抱怨能见度不佳后将生命置于危险之中。

paras.en: The Australian Transport Safety Bureau is investigating and will return a report in the coming weeks.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚运输安全局正在调查并将在未来几周内返回报告。

paras.en: A Danish renewables company has taken down one of two wind-monitoring masts at a proposed wind farm site in Queensland, which local agricultural pilots said was "nearly impossible to see".
paras.zh: 一家丹麦可再生能源公司拆除了昆士兰州拟建风电场的两个风力监测桅杆之一，当地农业飞行员表示“几乎不可能看到”。

paras.en: Grain grower Kieran Cook, who lives near the site south of Tara in the Western Downs, said he had experienced several "frightening near misses" with the 120-metre masts while flying his aircraft for crop spraying and fertilising.
paras.zh: 住在西部丘陵塔拉以南附近的粮食种植者基兰·库克 (Kieran Cook) 表示，他在驾驶飞机为农作物喷洒和施肥时，曾多次与 120 米长的桅杆“可怕地擦肩而过”。

paras.en: Mr Cook said a collision with a tower could be fatal.
paras.zh: 库克先生表示，与塔楼相撞可能致命。

paras.en: "If you hold a bit of fishing line up, whirl around in a room and try to see it against different backgrounds, that's what the pilot's got to look at," Mr Cook said.
paras.zh: 库克先生说：“如果你拿着一根钓鱼线，在房间里旋转并尝试在不同的背景下观察它，这就是飞行员必须观察的。”

paras.en: The Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB) confirmed it had received multiple reports of safety concerns about the Tara wind-monitoring towers.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚运输安全局（ATSB）证实已收到多份有关塔拉风力监测塔安全问题的报告。

paras.en: The ATSB said it was in the final stages of consulting with the regulator and would publish a report in the coming weeks.
paras.zh: ATSB 表示，其与监管机构的磋商已进入最后阶段，并将在未来几周内发布报告。

paras.en: Renewables company Vestas installed the two wind-monitoring towers in December 2023.
paras.zh: 可再生能源公司维斯塔斯于 2023 年 12 月安装了两座风力监测塔。

paras.en: Wind-monitoring masts are temporary structures that measure weather and atmospheric conditions at proposed wind farm sites.
paras.zh: 风力监测桅杆是测量拟建风电场地点天气和大气条件的临时结构。

paras.en: While it is standard industry practice, landholders said they were not consulted about the towers' locations.
paras.zh: 虽然这是标准的行业惯例，但土地所有者表示，他们没有就塔楼的位置进行咨询。

paras.en: There are strict rules about tall structures near airports, but it is looser around the small airstrips that farmers and firefighters use on rural properties.
paras.zh: 对于机场附近的高层建筑有严格的规定，但在农民和消防员在农村地区使用的小型飞机跑道周围，规定比较宽松。

paras.en: Mr Cook said when they first went up, the towers were not lit or marked properly.
paras.zh: 库克先生说，当他们第一次登上塔楼时，塔楼没有照明或正确标记。

paras.en: "They were actually in conflict with a couple of our firebombing strips and ag strips," he said.
paras.zh: “他们实际上与我们的几条燃烧弹带和农业带发生了冲突，”他说。

paras.en: In a previous statement, a Vestas spokesperson said the company had addressed visibility issues of the masts more than 12 months ago.
paras.zh: 维斯塔斯发言人在之前的一份声明中表示，该公司在 12 个多月前就已经解决了桅杆的能见度问题。

paras.en: It repainted the masts, marked the foundation, added marker balls on the guy ropes and installed 24-hour flashing lighting.
paras.zh: 它重新粉刷了桅杆，标记了地基，在拉绳上添加了标记球，并安装了 24 小时闪烁照明。

paras.en: "Vestas is confident that the monitoring masts are lit and marked to industry best practice and comply with the relevant approvals," the spokesperson had said.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示：“维斯塔斯有信心监控桅杆会按照行业最佳实践进行照明和标记，并符合相关批准。”

paras.en: But Mr Cook said the changes were "too small to make a difference".
paras.zh: 但库克先生表示，这些变化“太小，无法产生影响”。

paras.en: "A Telstra tower you can see a few miles away, you scan the horizon, and you pick it up straight away," he said.
paras.zh: “你可以在几英里外看到一座 Telstra 塔，你扫视地平线，然后立即发现它，”他说。

paras.en: "But you can't see the wind-monitoring tower."
paras.zh: “但是你看不到测风塔。”

paras.en: Last Friday, Vestas workers removed one of the two masts.
paras.zh: 上周五，维斯塔斯工人拆除了两根桅杆中的一根。

paras.en: A spokesperson said its wind specialist advised enough data had been gathered and that one wind-monitoring tower would be sufficient going forward.
paras.zh: 一位发言人表示，风能专家表示已经收集了足够的数据，未来一个风监测塔就足够了。

paras.en: The federal member for Maranoa, David Littleproud, said Vestas removing the tower was an "admission of guilt" that it was unsafe.
paras.zh: 马拉诺阿联邦议员戴维·利特尔普劳德 (David Littleproud) 表示，维斯塔斯拆除这座塔是“承认有罪”，因为它不安全。

paras.en: "Someone should have to pay a penalty for it because otherwise we would have heard about this through the coroner," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“应该有人为此支付罚款，否则我们会通过验尸官听到这件事。”

paras.en: Mr Littleproud said there was a legislative "grey area" around regulating agricultural aviation.
paras.zh: 利特尔普劳德表示，农业航空监管存在立法“灰色地带”。

paras.en: The local planning authority, the Western Downs Regional Council, approved the Vestas application for the towers in 2023.
paras.zh: 当地规划机构西部唐斯地区委员会于 2023 年批准了维斯塔斯建造这些塔楼的申请。

paras.en: The Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA) was notified because the towers were more than 100 metres tall, but a spokesperson said the body had no authority over enforcing compliance.
paras.zh: 由于这些塔楼高超过 100 米，民航安全局 (CASA) 收到了通知，但发言人表示，该机构无权强制执行。

paras.en: CASA updated its guidelines in October and noted that wind-monitoring masts were a "recognised hazard" that needed mitigating.
paras.zh: CASA 于 10 月更新了其指南，并指出风力监测桅杆是一种“公认的危险”，需要缓解。

paras.en: "They are narrow, are frequently guyed, are often unlit and unmarked … and in several jurisdictions are exempt from planning approval because of their height or their temporary nature," the report read.
paras.zh: 报告中写道：“它们很窄，经常被拉紧，通常没有照明和标记……并且在一些司法管辖区，由于它们的高度或临时性，它们可以免于获得规划批准。”

paras.en: Mr Littleproud said there were constitutional issues around whether it was the state or federal government that could take action against non-compliant companies.
paras.zh: 利特普劳德表示，州政府或联邦政府是否可以对不合规的公司采取行动，这存在宪法问题。

paras.en: He said there had been a failure at all levels to protect agricultural aviators.
paras.zh: 他说，各级都未能保护农业飞行员。

paras.en: "The onus of responsibility should go to the wind companies to actually do the on-ground consultation, identify all the aircraft-landing areas and have them registered with CASA," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“风电公司有责任实际进行地面咨询、确定所有飞机着陆区域并向 CASA 注册。”

articles.title: Live: Victorian Coalition's election eve kinder cut announcement slammed

paras.en: Victorian election live: Coalition's election eve kinder cut announcement slammed by union
paras.zh: 维多利亚州选举直播：联盟选举前夕金德削减公告遭到工会猛烈抨击

paras.en: The Victorian election is one day away, with the Coalition hoping to unseat a Labor government that has enjoyed three consecutive terms in power.
paras.zh: 距离维多利亚州大选还有一天，联盟党希望推翻已经连续三届执政的工党政府。

paras.en: Yesterday, Liberal leader Jess Wilson revealed the Coalition would partly privatise the sewerage network, cull and delay various level crossing removals, and cancel the current government's plans to expand free kinder.
paras.zh: 昨天，自由党领袖杰西·威尔逊透露，联盟党将部分将污水处理网络私有化，剔除和推迟各种平交道口的拆除，并取消现任政府扩大免费幼儿园的计划。

paras.en: Coalition to make cuts to free kinder expansion
paras.zh: 联盟将削减免费幼儿园的扩张

paras.en: A plan to build new kindergartens in so-called "childcare deserts" would be scrapped by a Coalition government as part of its plan to cut spending.
paras.zh: 作为削减开支计划的一部分，联合政府将取消在所谓的“儿童保育沙漠”中建造新幼儿园的计划。

paras.en: The kinder deserts are areas identified in Victoria with a lack of kinder spots for families so the state was going to build and operate some centres.
paras.zh: 善良沙漠是维多利亚州确定缺乏适合家庭的善良地点的地区，因此该州将建造和运营一些中心。

paras.en: But hidden in Liberal leader Jess Wilson's election costing is a half a billion dollar cut to capital works for early childhood centres.
paras.zh: 但自由党领袖杰西·威尔逊(Jess Wilson)的选举成本中隐藏着对幼儿中心基本建设工程的削减5亿美元。

paras.en: The Coalition is also saving another $400 million by not expanding access to free kinder to 30 hours a week. Families currently receive 15 hours a week of state-funded kinder.
paras.zh: 通过不将免费幼儿园的使用时间扩大到每周 30 小时，联盟党还节省了 4 亿美元。目前，家庭每周接受 15 个小时的国家资助的幼儿园教育。

paras.en: The Coalition is set to undertake an Early Learning Structural Review to help identify gaps in the sector and assess infrastructure capacity.
paras.zh: 该联盟将进行早期学习结构审查，以帮助确定该行业的差距并评估基础设施能力。

paras.en: It says it will ensure future early childhood facilities are built where there is genuine local need.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，将确保未来的幼儿设施建在当地真正需要的地方。

paras.en: The Coalition is not convinced Labor's plans do that.
paras.zh: 联盟党并不相信工党的计划能做到这一点。

paras.en: The ABC understands that Labor’s establishment of an early learning centre at Sunbury Secondary College (not Sunbury Primary School or by using existing places at existing non-governments early learning centres) was a key reason for the opposition to include this area in its review.
paras.zh: ABC 了解到，工党在森伯里中学（不是森伯里小学或利用现有非政府早期学习中心的现有位置）建立早期学习中心是反对党将该领域纳入其审查的一个关键原因。

paras.en: Key policies missing when Wilson outlined Coalition's plan
paras.zh: 威尔逊概述联盟计划时缺少关键政策

paras.en: Victoria's opposition unveiled major policies on kinder and the partial privatisation of public assets yesterday, just two days out from the election.
paras.zh: 维州反对党昨天公布了有关慈善和公共资产部分私有化的主要政策，距选举仅两天。

paras.en: At the time, roughly 2 million Victorians had already cast their ballots.
paras.zh: 当时，大约有 200 万维多利亚人已经投票。

paras.en: Opposition Leader Jess Wilson has defended her decision to drop the detailed policies and costings which you can read about below.
paras.zh: 反对党领袖杰西·威尔逊（Jess Wilson）为她放弃详细政策和成本计算的决定进行了辩护，您可以在下面阅读。

paras.en: Good morning and welcome to our coverage of the Victorian state election campaign.
paras.zh: 早上好，欢迎收看我们对维多利亚州竞选活动的报道。

paras.en: It's the final day of campaigning before election day.
paras.zh: 这是选举日前夕竞选活动的最后一天。

paras.en: Voting will officially close at 6pm tomorrow, Saturday November 28.
paras.zh: 投票将于明天（11 月 28 日星期六）下午 6 点正式结束。

paras.en: We'll bring you all the latest coverage of the day's events as they happen.
paras.zh: 我们将为您带来当天活动的所有最新报道。

articles.title: Iranian journalist, Oscar-nominated screenwriter Mehdi Mahmoudian arrested in Tehran
articles.author: Sara Jabakhanji

paras.en: Iranian journalist, Oscar-nominated screenwriter Mehdi Mahmoudian arrested in Tehran
paras.zh: 伊朗记者、奥斯卡提名编剧迈赫迪·马哈茂迪安在德黑兰被捕

paras.en: Mahmoudian reported on 2 jailed protesters at risk of execution day before arrest
paras.zh: 马哈茂迪安报道了两名被监禁的抗议者在被捕前一天面临被处决的风险

paras.en: Rights groups are calling for the release of freelance journalist and Oscar-nominated screenwriter Mehdi Mahmoudian after Iranian authorities arrested him at his Tehran home on Wednesday, a day after he reported on an execution notice of two jailed protesters in Iran.
paras.zh: 周三，伊朗当局在德黑兰的家中逮捕了自由记者兼奥斯卡提名编剧迈赫迪·马哈茂迪安，此前一天，他报道了伊朗两名被监禁抗议者的处决通知，人权组织呼吁释放他。

paras.en: Hosein Razzagh, a friend of Mahmoudian's and an Iranian activist based in Europe, told The Associated Press on Thursday that Mahmoudian was taken by security forces from his home.
paras.zh: 马哈茂迪安的朋友、驻欧洲的伊朗活动人士侯赛因·拉扎周四告诉美联社，马哈茂迪安被安全部队从家中带走。

paras.en: The Committee to Protect Journalists (CPJ) said in a statement on Thursday that a source close to the journalist told the organization that Mahmoudian's home was searched and his electronic devices were confiscated before he was detained. The source spoke to CPJ on condition of anonymity for fear of reprisal, it said.
paras.zh: 保护记者委员会（CPJ）在周四的一份声明中表示，一位与该记者关系密切的消息人士告诉该组织，马哈茂迪安的家遭到搜查，他的电子设备在被拘留之前被没收。报道称，由于担心遭到报复，该消息人士要求匿名。

paras.en: A message posted on Mahmoudian's Telegram channel later on Thursday said he had been charged with anti-government "propaganda against the regime" and "spreading false information." His detention was also reported on Wednesday by reformist news outlet Emtedad.
paras.zh: 周四晚些时候，马哈茂迪安的 Telegram 频道上发布的一条消息称，他被指控反政府“宣传反对政权”和“传播虚假信息”。改革派新闻媒体 Emtedad 周三也报道了他被拘留的消息。

paras.en: A day before his arrest, Mahmoudian published an execution notice on his channel that two protesters jailed after the 2022 nationwide "Woman, Life, Freedom" protests were at risk of execution within 24 hours.
paras.zh: 被捕前一天，马哈茂迪安在自己的频道上发布了一份处决通知，称两名在2022年全国“妇女、生命、自由”抗议活动后被监禁的抗议者将在24小时内面临被处决的危险。

paras.en: Mahmoudian posted later that day that according to a lawyer and family, the sentences had not been carried out.
paras.zh: 马哈茂迪安当天晚些时候发帖称，据律师和家人称，判决尚未执行。

paras.en: The 2022 protests were sparked by the death of 22-year-old Mahsa Amini after she was arrested by Iran's morality police over allegedly not wearing her headscarf correctly. Amnesty International said in a September report that authorities committed crimes against humanity in the monthslong crackdown on the protests that left hundreds of people dead and thousands detained.
paras.zh: 22 岁的 Mahsa Amini 因涉嫌未正确佩戴头巾而被伊朗道德警察逮捕，随后死亡，引发了 2022 年的抗议活动。国际特赦组织在 9 月份的一份报告中表示，当局在长达数月的镇压抗议活动中犯下了反人类罪，导致数百人死亡、数千人被拘留。

paras.en: Mahmoudian, who co-wrote the 2025 Iranian film It Was Just an Accident, which won the Palme d’Or at Cannes, has campaigned openly on behalf of jailed protesters and those at risk of execution in Iran, Razzagh said, adding that Iranian authorities "are extremely sensitive about execution cases."
paras.zh: 拉扎格表示，马哈茂迪安是 2025 年伊朗电影《这只是一次意外》的联合编剧，该片赢得了戛纳金棕榈奖，他公开代表伊朗被监禁的抗议者和那些面临被处决风险的人开展活动，并补充说伊朗当局“对处决案件极为敏感”。

paras.en: There has been no official statement or public comment from Iranian authorities on his arrest.
paras.zh: 伊朗当局尚未就他的被捕发表正式声明或公开评论。

paras.en: The Oslo-based Iran Human Rights group has said at least 15 protesters have been executed in connection with the protests over Amini, with two of the executions being carried out in 2026.
paras.zh: 总部位于奥斯陆的伊朗人权组织表示，至少 15 名抗议者因阿米尼抗议活动而被处决，其中两人于 2026 年执行。

paras.en: During a brief telephone call with his family on Thursday, Mahmoudian said he had been transferred to Greater Tehran Prison, just outside of Iran's capital. He said that security forces had severely beaten him during his arrest, leaving visible injuries, the source told CPJ.
paras.zh: 马哈茂迪安周四在与家人的简短电话中表示，他已被转移到伊朗首都郊外的大德黑兰监狱。消息人士告诉保护记者委员会，他说，在他被捕期间，安全部队对他进行了严厉殴打，造成明显的伤痕。

paras.en: Reporters Without Borders (RSF) said Mahmoudian was also reportedly subjected to severe torture in detention, to the point of losing consciousness, according to confirmed reports it received.
paras.zh: 无国界记者组织 (RSF) 收到的证实报告称，据报道，马哈茂迪安在拘留期间也遭受了严重酷刑，甚至失去了知觉。

paras.en: "Journalism saves lives, and Mehdi Mahmoudian’s courage deserves to be celebrated. Instead, the journalist has been arrested, imprisoned and reportedly tortured by the very authorities he exposed," said Jonathan Dagher, head of RSF Middle East, in a statement on Thursday.
paras.zh: 无国界记者组织中东地区负责人乔纳森·达格尔 (Jonathan Dagher) 在周四的一份声明中表示：“新闻工作拯救生命，迈赫迪·马哈茂迪安的勇气值得赞扬。相反，这位记者被逮捕、监禁，据报道还受到他所揭露的当局的酷刑。”

paras.en: "RSF stands in full solidarity with the renowned journalist and filmmaker and calls for his immediate release. Publishing information in the public interest must never be treated as a crime.”
paras.zh: “无国界记者组织完全声援这位著名记者和电影制片人，并呼吁立即释放他。为了公共利益发布信息绝不能被视为犯罪。”

paras.en: In recent months, the Iranian regime has resumed its wave of arrests targeting media professionals, RSF said.
paras.zh: 无国界记者组织称，近几个月来，伊朗政权恢复了针对媒体专业人士的逮捕浪潮。

paras.en: - Oscar-nominated director Jafar Panahi says he will return to Iran despite looming arrest
paras.zh: - 奥斯卡提名导演贾法尔·帕纳西表示，尽管被捕迫在眉睫，他仍将返回伊朗

paras.en: - Iranian singer subjected to 74 lashes for performing without her hijab
paras.zh: - 伊朗歌手因未戴头巾表演而被鞭打 74 下

paras.en: - Amnesty report says Iranian authorities committed crimes against humanity in bloody 2022 protest crackdown
paras.zh: - 国际特赦组织报告称伊朗当局在 2022 年血腥镇压抗议活动中犯下了反人类罪

paras.en: Razzagh told The Associated Press he last spoke with Mahmoudian by phone roughly between 2 to 3 a.m. on Wednesday about a death penalty case linked to the 2022 protests.
paras.zh: 拉扎格告诉美联社，他最后一次与马哈茂迪安通电话大约是在周三凌晨 2 点至 3 点之间，讨论了与 2022 年抗议活动有关的死刑案件。

paras.en: He said that Mahmoudian later didn't answer his phone, and that witnesses reported seeing more than a dozen armed agents raid his home.
paras.zh: 他说，马哈茂迪安后来没有接听他的电话，目击者称看到十多名武装特工袭击了他的家。

paras.en: The screenwriter and journalist has been repeatedly imprisoned for his work.
paras.zh: 这位编剧兼记者曾多次因其作品而入狱。

paras.en: Mahmoudian was arrested earlier this year on Jan. 31 and subsequently released on Feb. 17, shortly before the Academy Awards, according to the CPJ.
paras.zh: 据保护记者委员会称，马哈茂迪安于今年早些时候于 1 月 31 日被捕，随后于 2 月 17 日，即奥斯卡颁奖典礼前不久获释。

paras.en: His detention comes on the heels of Tehran's sentencing on Oct. 26 of his colleague and acclaimed director Jafar Panahi to five years and one month in prison. The Tehran court also ordered the confiscation of Panahi’s “movable and immovable assets."
paras.zh: 在他被拘留之前，德黑兰于 10 月 26 日判处他的同事、著名导演贾法尔·帕纳西 (Jafar Panahi) 五年零一个月监禁。德黑兰法院还下令没收帕纳西的“动产和不动产”。

paras.en: Director Jafar Panahi poses on the red carpet at the Academy Awards in Hollywood on March 15. (Daniel Cole/Reuters)
paras.zh: 3 月 15 日，导演贾法尔·帕纳西 (Jafar Panahi) 在好莱坞奥斯卡颁奖典礼红地毯上摆出姿势。（丹尼尔·科尔/路透社）

paras.en: Panahi, who directed and co-wrote It Was Just an Accident with Mahmoudian, returned to Iran in March after he had been previously convicted of “propaganda activities against the system.” Panahi has not been detained at this time, but his current whereabouts are unclear.
paras.zh: 帕纳西与马哈茂迪安执导并共同编剧了《这只是一次意外》，他在此前被判犯有“反体制宣传活动”罪后，于三月返回伊朗。帕纳西目前尚未被拘留，但目前下落不明。

paras.en: Panahi is among the most celebrated of contemporary Iranian directors and has continued making movies despite repeatedly being imprisoned, banned from travelling and put under house arrest by Iranian authorities over the past 20 years.
