paras.zh: 帕纳西是当代伊朗最著名的导演之一，尽管过去 20 年来屡次被伊朗当局监禁、禁止旅行和软禁，但他仍继续拍电影。

paras.en: Mahmoudian and Panahi were among 17 Iranian activists, filmmakers and lawyers who signed a public statement issued on Jan. 28 condemning Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and the violent crackdown on protesters following mass anti-government protests in January.
paras.zh: 马哈茂迪安和帕纳西等 17 名伊朗活动家、电影制片人和律师签署了 1 月 28 日发表的公开声明，谴责阿亚图拉阿里·哈梅内伊以及 1 月份大规模反政府抗议活动后对抗议者的暴力镇压。

articles.title: Anita DeFrantz, whose trailblazing advocacy gave women an Olympic voice, dead at 74
articles.author: Eddie Pells

paras.en: Anita DeFrantz, whose trailblazing advocacy gave women an Olympic voice, dead at 74
paras.zh: 安妮塔·德弗朗茨 (Anita DeFrantz) 去世，享年 74 岁，她的开创性倡导让女性拥有了奥林匹克的声音

paras.en: 'She showed me what courageous leadership looked like,' says IOC president Kirsty Coventry
paras.zh: 国际奥委会主席科斯蒂·考文垂表示：“她向我展示了什么是勇敢的领导力”

paras.en: Anita DeFrantz, the bronze-medal rower who became best known for breaking barriers to give women a long-lasting voice at the highest reaches of male-dominated Olympic policymaking, has died. She was 74.
paras.zh: 铜牌赛艇运动员安妮塔·德弗朗茨 (Anita DeFrantz) 去世，她因打破障碍、让女性在男性主导的奥林匹克决策最高层拥有持久的发言权而闻名。她74岁了。

paras.en: No cause of death was given in the announcements of DeFrantz's death Thursday from the international and U.S. Olympic committees. She had been in declining health over the past few years.
paras.zh: 国际奥委会和美国奥委会周四宣布德弗朗茨的死因时，没有给出死因。过去几年，她的健康状况每况愈下。

paras.en: DeFrantz, who in 1986 became the first American woman and first Black American named to the International Olympic Committee, also became the first woman to serve as an IOC vice president, in 1997. She also was vice president of the organizing committee for the LA Olympics in 1984 and served as chair of the IOC's Women in Sport Commission for 20 years.
paras.zh: 德弗兰茨于 1986 年成为第一位进入国际奥委会的美国女性和第一位黑人，并于 1997 年成为第一位担任国际奥委会副主席的女性。她还曾担任 1984 年洛杉矶奥运会组委会副主席，并担任国际奥委会女性体育委员会主席长达 20 年。

paras.en: IOC president Kirsty Coventry, an Olympic swimmer who has credited DeFrantz for helping her ascend to the most powerful spot in the Olympic hierarchy, called DeFrantz "a mentor, a friend and a true inspiration to me, and to so many others around the world.
paras.zh: 国际奥委会主席科斯蒂·考文垂（Kirsty Coventry）是一名奥运会游泳运动员，她称赞德弗兰茨帮助她登上了奥运级别中最有权势的位置，称德弗兰茨“对我和世界各地的许多人来说是一位导师、一位朋友和真正的灵感”。

paras.en: "From my earliest days in the Olympic Movement, she showed me what courageous leadership looked like, and what was possible for women in sport," Coventry said.
paras.zh: “从我参与奥林匹克运动的最初几天起，她就向我展示了勇敢的领导力是什么样子，以及女性在体育运动中的可能性，”考文垂说。

paras.en: Edwin Moses, the record-setting hurdler who was a contemporary of DeFrantz's, said "every woman who has a high-level position in sports today, they can thank Anita DeFrantz."
paras.zh: 与德弗兰茨同时代的跨栏纪录创造者埃德温·摩西表示，“当今每一位在体育界担任高级职务的女性，都应该感谢安妮塔·德弗兰茨。”

paras.en: Bronze medal and a boycott led to a life of Olympic advocacy
paras.zh: 铜牌和抵制导致了奥林匹克倡导的一生

paras.en: DeFrantz won bronze in the 1976 Olympics as captain of the women's eight team in Montreal. She trained for an Olympic return and, in 1980, gained a sense of the disconnect between athletes and the boardrooms that made decisions on their behalf.
paras.zh: 德弗朗茨在 1976 年蒙特利尔奥运会上作为女子八人队队长获得铜牌。她为重返奥运会进行训练，并在 1980 年意识到运动员与代表他们做出决定的董事会之间的脱节。

paras.en: She was part of the U.S. team that never made the trip to the boycotted Moscow Olympics. As spokeswoman for the U.S. athletes' advisory council, she led a lawsuit against the U.S. Olympic Committee, which, pressed by the Carter administration, had authorized the boycott.
paras.zh: 她是从未参加过被抵制的莫斯科奥运会的美国队的一员。作为美国运动员咨询委员会的发言人，她对美国奥委会提起诉讼，美国奥委会在卡特政府的压力下批准了抵制活动。

paras.en: That was the first part of her push to be at the table where those decisions were made.
paras.zh: 这是她努力参与做出这些决定的第一步。

paras.en: In an interview last year with The Associated Press before being inducted into the Team USA Hall of Fame, DeFrantz recalled the feeling of realizing how much work there was to be done when she attended her first IOC meeting in 1986.
paras.zh: 去年，德弗兰茨在入选美国队名人堂之前接受美联社采访时，回忆起 1986 年第一次参加国际奥委会会议时的感受，当时她意识到有多少工作要做。

paras.en: "I walked in and I thought, 'This is odd,"' she said. "It was this cavernous room" and of the 90 or so committee members, she was one of only five women.
paras.zh: “我走进去，我想，‘这很奇怪，’”她说。 “这就是这个巨大的房间”，在 90 名左右的委员会成员中，她是仅有的五名女性之一。

paras.en: "We had to help people open their minds a little," she said.
paras.zh: “我们必须帮助人们敞开心扉，”她说。

paras.en: Change came slowly. It took until 2024 for the Olympics to reach gender parity, with women making up half of the 10,500 athletes at the Paris Games. Today, 46 of the IOC's 106 members are women.
paras.zh: 改变是慢慢来的。直到 2024 年，奥运会才实现性别平等，参加巴黎奥运会的 10,500 名运动员中女性占了一半。如今，国际奥委会 106 名委员中有 46 名是女性。

paras.en: "She often stood for things and wasn't supported but plowed ahead anyway," said Donna de Varona, the gold-medal Olympic swimmer who served with DeFrantz on the IOC women's commission. "In every sense of the word, she was a warrior as an athlete, and as someone who always fought for the right thing, even when the politics might not have been in her favour."
paras.zh: “她经常坚持自己的观点，虽然没有得到支持，但还是奋力前行，”与德弗朗茨一起在国际奥委会妇女委员会任职的奥运会游泳金牌运动员唐娜·德瓦罗纳 (Donna de Varona) 说。 “从任何意义上来说，她都是一名战士，作为一名运动员，作为一个总是为正确的事情而奋斗的人，即使政治可能不利于她。”

paras.en: - Football Canada launches Road to LA28 with first camps for Olympic-bound men's, women's flag teams
paras.zh: - 加拿大足球协会推出“通往 LA28 之路”，为奥运男子、女子旗队开设首个训练营

paras.en: - Canada's Humana-Paredes, Wilkerson clinch 2028 Olympic berth in beach volleyball
paras.zh: - 加拿大选手胡马纳-帕雷德斯和威尔克森获得 2028 年沙滩排球奥运会参赛资格

paras.en: DeFrantz's roles with the IOC also gave her a spot on the U.S. Olympic and Paralympic Committee's board of directors for decades. In a statement, CEO Sarah Hirshland and chairman Gene Sykes called DeFrantz "one of the most consequential Olympians our nation has ever known."
paras.zh: 德弗朗茨在国际奥委会的角色也让她在美国奥林匹克和残奥委员会的董事会中占有一席之地数十年。首席执行官莎拉·赫什兰（Sarah Hirshland）和董事长吉恩·赛克斯（Gene Sykes）在一份声明中称德弗兰茨是“我们国家有史以来最有影响力的奥运选手之一”。

paras.en: Intrigued by a group of rowing shells placed in front of an administration building to spur interest in the sport, DeFrantz took up rowing at Connecticut College, though she was never a star there.
paras.zh: 出于对行政大楼前放置的一组赛艇贝壳的兴趣，德弗朗茨在康涅狄格学院开始了赛艇运动，尽管她从来都不是那里的明星。

paras.en: It wasn't until she attended law school at Penn that she began training on the Schuylkill River in Philadelphia — a venue teeming with Olympic-caliber rowers — and got a sense of what was possible.
paras.zh: 直到她在宾夕法尼亚大学法学院就读时，她才开始在费城的斯库尔基尔河上进行训练——那里挤满了奥运会级别的赛艇运动员——并意识到了一切的可能性。

paras.en: "And she lit on fire," Bart Gullong, her coach at Connecticut College, said in a 1997 interview with the Hartford Courant. "She lost 45 to 50 pounds and really trained hard. She made the national team the following year. And the following year she made the Olympic team."
paras.zh: “她整个人都着火了，”她在康涅狄格学院的教练巴特·古隆 (Bart Gullong) 在 1997 年接受《哈特福德新闻报》采访时说道。 “她减掉了 45 到 50 磅，而且训练非常刻苦。第二年，她进入了国家队。第二年，她又进入了奥运会代表队。”

paras.en: That set the stage for the bronze medal, then a life of Olympic advocacy.
paras.zh: 这为铜牌奠定了基础，随后他一生都在为奥林匹克做宣传。

paras.en: Moses said DeFrantz's depth of knowledge about the Ted Stevens Amateur Sports Act, which passed in 1978 and has governed the Olympics in the U.S. ever since, made hers the perfect lead voice for athletes who took a risk in fighting the 1980 boycott.
paras.zh: 摩西说，德弗朗茨对 1978 年通过的《特德·史蒂文斯业余体育法案》（Ted Stevens Amateur Sports Act）有着深入的了解，该法案自此以来一直管辖着美国的奥运会，这使她成为那些冒着风险与 1980 年抵制运动作斗争的运动员的完美带头人。

paras.en: - 2028 Olympic torch relay to start in Atlanta, travel through all 50 states before arriving in L.A.
paras.zh: - 2028 年奥运会火炬传递将从亚特兰大开始，途经所有 50 个州，然后抵达洛杉矶。

paras.en: "She got in the ring and squared up with everyone," Moses said. "And because of her legal background and her temperament and ability to be a great moderator and negotiator, she was able to get a tremendous amount done. Not just for women, but for the athletes, Paralympics, all of the things that people were not thinking about at that time."
paras.zh: “她登上了擂台，与所有人摆好架势，”摩西说。 “由于她的法律背景、她的气质以及成为出色的调解人和谈判者的能力，她能够完成大量工作。不仅是为了女性，也为了运动员、残奥会，以及所有当时人们没有考虑到的事情。”

paras.en: Gold-medal sprinter Allyson Felix, who was inducted alongside DeFrantz in the U.S. Hall last year, said her advocacy work and her own position on the IOC wouldn't have been possible were it not for DeFrantz's work over decades.
paras.zh: 去年与德弗兰茨一起入选美国馆的短跑金牌运动员艾莉森·菲利克斯表示，如果没有德弗兰茨几十年来的工作，她的宣传工作和她自己在国际奥委会的地位就不可能实现。

paras.en: Sitting at a quiet corner in a restaurant for the AP interview in Colorado Springs, Colorado, last year, DeFrantz — her voice barely above a whisper — said she was flattered by all the attention she was receiving. But, always pushing, she insisted there was still much work to be done.
paras.zh: 去年，德弗兰茨坐在科罗拉多州科罗拉多斯普林斯一家餐厅的一个安静角落接受美联社采访，她的声音几乎低于耳语，她说她对自己受到的关注感到受宠若惊。但她始终坚持认为还有很多工作要做。

paras.en: "It's all about letting people have opportunities," she said. "You can't make an Olympian. But you can open the door to possibilities
paras.zh: “这一切都是为了让人们有机会，”她说。 “你无法成为奥运会选手。但你可以打开通往可能性的大门

articles.title: A Boston man won $1M US in the lottery. Days later, ICE arrested him
articles.author: Natalie Stechyson

paras.en: A Boston man won $1M US in the lottery. Days later, ICE arrested him
paras.zh: 一名波士顿男子在彩票中赢得了 100 万美元。几天后，ICE 逮捕了他

paras.en: The ticket 'ultimately led to his arrest,' ICE said, without elaborating how
paras.zh: ICE 表示，这张罚单“最终导致他被捕”，但没有详细说明如何

paras.en: Ariel Antonio Velasquez-Morales held an oversized cheque for $1 million US and smiled in the photo posted Saturday by the Massachusetts State Lottery.
paras.zh: 马萨诸塞州彩票周六发布的照片​​中，阿里尔·安东尼奥·贝拉斯克斯·莫拉莱斯 (Ariel Antonio Velasquez-Morales) 手持一张 100 万美元的超大支票，微笑着。

paras.en: Local media described the Boston man as "all smiles," reporting that he planned to save and invest his winnings after matching 11 words on a $10 US scratch ticket. Lottery officials said it was the first puzzle he'd ever scratched.
paras.zh: 当地媒体形容这位波士顿男子“笑容满面”，报道称，他在匹配了一张 10 美元的刮刮彩票上的 11 个单词后，计划将奖金保存起来并进行投资。彩票官员说这是他刮开的第一个谜题。

paras.en: A few days later, his photo was posted online again — but this time, by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), which said it had arrested the "illegal alien from El Salvador" on Tuesday. Now, Velasquez-Morales will remain in ICE custody until he's removed from the U.S., the agency said in a news release.
paras.zh: 几天后，他的照片再次被发布到网上，但这一次是由美国移民和海关执法局（ICE）发布的，该部门表示已于周二逮捕了这名“来自萨尔瓦多的非法外国人”。该机构在一份新闻稿中表示，现在，维拉斯奎兹-莫拉莱斯将继续被 ICE 拘留，直到他被驱逐出美国。

paras.en: The ticket "ultimately led to his arrest," ICE said, without elaborating how. CBC News has reached out to ICE and not yet heard back. Velasquez-Morales does not yet appear on ICE's Online Detainee Locator System, where members of the public can search for people held in the agency's custody.
paras.zh: ICE 表示，这张罚单“最终导致他被捕”，但没有详细说明具体原因。 CBC News 已联系 ICE，但尚未收到回复。委拉斯开兹-莫拉莱斯尚未出现在 ICE 的在线被拘留者定位系统中，公众可以在该系统中搜索被该机构拘留的人。

paras.en: “Looks like his luck ran out,” said ICE public affairs assistant director Micah Bock in the news release.
paras.zh: ICE 公共事务助理主任米卡·博克 (Micah Bock) 在新闻稿中表示：“看来他的运气已经耗尽了。”

paras.en: "Welcome to the ERO [enforcement and removal operations] Boston lottery! Where illegal aliens and sanctuary politicians are out of luck, and the law-abiding citizens of New England are always the winners!" ICE Boston posted on X.
paras.zh: “欢迎来到 ERO（执法和清除行动）波士顿彩票！非法移民和庇护所政客们运气不佳，而守法的新英格兰公民永远是赢家！” ICE 波士顿在 X 上发布。

paras.en: It's unclear if Velasquez-Morales has legal representation. CBC News has reached out to several Boston-area immigration lawyers and not yet heard back.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚委拉斯开兹-莫拉莱斯是否有法律代表。 CBC News 联系了几位波士顿地区的移民律师，但尚未收到回复。

paras.en: A woman identifying herself as Velasquez-Morales's sister-in-law wrote on Facebook Wednesday asking for respect and empathy for him, his wife and children.
paras.zh: 周三，一名自称委拉斯开兹-莫拉莱斯嫂子的女子在脸书上写道，请求尊重和同情他、他的妻子和孩子。

paras.en: "There is a family waiting for him," she wrote in Spanish.
paras.zh: “有一个家庭在等他，”她用西班牙语写道。

paras.en: Another woman identifying herself as Velasquez-Morales's older sister commented on the same post, writing her wishes that he would soon be back home with his family.
paras.zh: 另一位自称委拉斯开兹-莫拉莱斯姐姐的女士在同一篇帖子下发表了评论，并写道她希望他能尽快回家与家人团聚。

paras.en: CBC News has reached out to both women for comment and not yet heard back.
paras.zh: CBC新闻已联系这两名女性征求意见，但尚未得到回复。

paras.en: A photo of Ariel Velasquez-Morales posted by ICE in a new release on Nov. 25, announcing that ICE Boston had arrested the man a day prior. (U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement)
paras.zh: ICE 在 11 月 25 日发布的新版本中发布了 Ariel Velasquez-Morales 的照片，宣布 ICE 波士顿办事处已于前一天逮捕了该男子。 （美国移民和海关执法局）

paras.en: Can you win the lottery if you're not a citizen?
paras.zh: 如果你不是公民你能中彩票吗？

paras.en: Velasquez-Morales illegally entered the U.S. in 2013 through the Texas border, according to ICE. An immigration judge ordered him removed in 2014, the press release noted, but "he illegally remained in the country."
paras.zh: 据 ICE 称，维拉斯奎兹-莫拉莱斯于 2013 年通过德克萨斯州边境非法进入美国。新闻稿指出，一名移民法官于 2014 年下令将他驱逐出境，但“他非法留在该国”。

paras.en: While ICE posted on social media that "the rights and privileges reserved for American citizens are for American citizens," state lotteries typically do not require citizenship or residency — if you meet the age requirement and are physically present in a participating jurisdiction when buying the ticket, you can play.
paras.zh: 虽然 ICE 在社交媒体上发帖称“为美国公民保留的权利和特权也属于美国公民”，但州彩票通常不需要公民身份或居住权——如果您符合年龄要求并且在购买彩票时身在参与管辖区，您就可以参加彩票。

paras.en: - What happened at the Seattle airport? Outrage as ICE arrests man and daughter boarding flight
paras.zh: - 西雅图机场发生了什么？ ICE 逮捕登机的男子和女儿引发愤怒

paras.en: - Kilmar Ábrego García, who faced U.S. deportation efforts and 'vindictive prosecution,' arrives in Spain
paras.zh: - 面临美国驱逐和“报复性起诉”的基尔马·阿夫雷戈·加西亚抵达西班牙

paras.en: CBC News has reached out to the Massachusetts State Lottery and has not yet heard back. But its website help desk notes that anyone age 18 and up who is physically present in the state can buy lottery tickets at retail locations and win prizes. The Boston Globe reports that the lottery also doesn't require winners to have social security numbers, but that non-resident winners often face higher federal taxes on their winnings.
paras.zh: CBC News 已联系马萨诸塞州彩票公司，但尚未收到回复。但其网站服务台指出，任何年满 18 岁且身在该州的人都可以在零售点购买彩票并赢得奖品。据《波士顿环球报》报道，彩票也不要求中奖者有社会安全号码，但非居民中奖者往往要为其奖金缴纳更高的联邦税。

paras.en: Some U.S. states allow lottery winners to remain anonymous no matter the amount, others depend on how much a person win, but many — including Massachusetts — do not let winners claim prizes anonymously.
paras.zh: 美国一些州允许彩票中奖者保持匿名，无论金额多少，其他州则取决于一个人中奖的金额，但包括马萨诸塞州在内的许多州不允许中奖者匿名领取奖金。

paras.en: "The Massachusetts State Lottery treats a winner’s name, town and prize as public information and releases them," explains the Massachusetts Legal Resources website.
paras.zh: 马萨诸塞州法律资源网站解释说：“马萨诸塞州彩票将中奖者的姓名、城镇和奖金视为公共信息并予以发布。”

paras.en: "The lottery’s position, and the state’s, is that publicity is part of the game: It demonstrates that real people win, and it deters fraud in the claiming process."
paras.zh: “彩票和国家的立场是，宣传是游戏的一部分：它表明真正的人获胜，并阻止申领过程中的欺诈行为。”

paras.en: Michael Baker, a Massachusetts attorney who works with lottery winners, told the Boston Globe that immigrants may not realize how much exposure winning the lottery can bring them.
paras.zh: 与彩票中奖者打交道的马萨诸塞州律师迈克尔·贝克告诉《波士顿环球报》，移民可能没有意识到中彩票能给他们带来多少曝光度。

paras.en: "I’m sure people, when they play, they’re not expecting being at risk of being arrested," he told the media outlet.
paras.zh: 他对媒体表示：“我确信人们在比赛时并没有想到会面临被捕的风险。”

articles.title: Protests in Iraqi Kurdistan at plans for government in Baghdad to take over oil, border crossings

paras.en: Protesters took to the streets of Irbil, also often written Erbil, in Iraqi Kurdistan early on Thursday in large numbers, waving massive flags of the semiautonomous region in northern Iraq.
paras.zh: 周四早些时候，大批抗议者走上伊拉克库尔德斯坦埃尔比勒（也常写作埃尔比勒）街头，挥舞着伊拉克北部半自治区的巨大旗帜。

paras.en: They were responding to federal government plans announced earlier in the week for Baghdad to take control of oil operations and border crossings previously run by Kurdish authorities.
paras.zh: 他们是对本周早些时候宣布的联邦政府计划做出的回应，计划要求巴格达控制以前由库尔德当局管理的石油作业和边境口岸。

paras.en: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi had said the measures were part of a bid to stop oil smuggling when announcing the changes.
paras.zh: 伊拉克总理阿里·扎伊迪在宣布这些变化时表示，这些措施是阻止石油走私的一部分。

paras.en: Rival Kurdish factions unite to protest plans
paras.zh: 库尔德敌对派系联合抗议计划

paras.en: The plans marked an escalation in the long-running power struggle between the central government and Kurdish authorities that have largely governed themselves since 1991, albeit with varying levels of recognition and authority.
paras.zh: 这些计划标志着中央政府和库尔德当局之间长期权力斗争的升级，库尔德当局自1991年以来基本上实行自治，尽管认可度和权威程度各不相同。

paras.en: Rival Kurdish parties joined forces for the large protests in the regional capital.
paras.zh: 库尔德敌对政党联合起来，在地区首府举行大规模抗议活动。

paras.en: Protests were also reported to have spread to several other towns and cities beyond the capital.
paras.zh: 据报道，抗议活动还蔓延到首都以外的其他几个城镇。

paras.en: Iraq's 2005 constitution, written following the US-led invasion that toppled Saddam Hussein, formally recognized the Kurdish region and its government. But authorities in Erbil and Baghdad have remained in a tug of war over the control of land, oil and money ever since.
paras.zh: 伊拉克2005年宪法是在美国领导的入侵推翻萨达姆·侯赛因之后制定的，正式承认库尔德地区及其政府。但自那以后，埃尔比勒和巴格达当局一直在围绕土地、石油和金钱的控制权展开拉锯战。

paras.en: Tuesday's decision, which received backing from Iraq's Federal Supreme Court a day later, brings border crossing in the Kurdish region under federal government management. It places approval for oil exports from the region under the authority of the federal oil ministry and transfers the management of oil fields in four contested provinces — Kirkuk, Diyala, Salahuddin and Nineveh.
paras.zh: 周二的决定一天后得到了伊拉克联邦最高法院的支持，将库尔德地区的过境点置于联邦政府管理之下。该协议将该地区的石油出口审批权归联邦石油部管辖，并将基尔库克、迪亚拉、萨拉赫丁和尼尼微四个有争议省份的油田管理权移交。

paras.en: The Kurdish regional government's Cabinet said on Wednesday that the decision from Baghdad "violates both the Constitution and the constitutional rights of the Kurdistan region," saying it represented "an attempt to return Iraq to a centralized regime."
paras.zh: 库尔德地区政府内阁周三表示，巴格达的决定“违反了宪法和库尔德斯坦地区的宪法权利”，并称这代表“伊拉克回归中央集权政权的企图”。

paras.en: Prime Minister al-Zaidi, who took office earlier this year with the backing of US President Donald Trump, also dismissed Kirkuk's operations commander and police chief and the head of the Border Ports Commission. He said the measures reflected Iraq's "independent national will."
paras.zh: 今年早些时候在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的支持下上任的总理扎伊迪还解雇了基尔库克行动指挥官、警察局长以及边境口岸委员会主席。他说，这些措施反映了伊拉克“独立的国家意志”。

paras.en: Regional Prime Minister Masrour Barzani said his government was "surprised" by al-Zaidi's decisions and called them "completely unacceptable."
paras.zh: 地区总理马斯鲁尔·巴尔扎尼表示，他的政府对扎伊迪的决定感到“惊讶”，并称这些决定“完全不可接受”。

paras.en: Contested region even since 2005 reformation
paras.zh: 自2005年改革以来，该地区一直存在争议

paras.en: Iraq's Supreme Court ruled on Wednesday that the authority of the Kurdish Regional Government (KRG) only covered the land it administered on March 19, 2003, the day before the US-led invasion that unseated Saddam Hussein.
paras.zh: 伊拉克最高法院周三裁定，库尔德地区政府（KRG）的权力仅涵盖其2003年3月19日管理的土地，即美国领导的入侵推翻萨达姆·侯赛因的前一天。

paras.en: Kurdish peshmerga forces moved into many disputed areas after 2003, including the oil fields covered by this week's orders.
paras.zh: 2003 年之后，库尔德佩什梅加部队进入了许多有争议的地区，其中包括本周命令所涵盖的油田。

paras.en: The 2005 constitution tried to solve the fate of some of the disputed territories in the lands between the borders to Syria and Iran that are home to a host of ethnicities and communities but with Kurds generally the majority group.
paras.zh: 2005年宪法试图解决叙利亚和伊朗边境之间一些有争议领土的命运，这些领土是许多民族和社区的家园，但库尔德人总体上是多数群体。

paras.en: Article 140 called for reversing Saddam-era policies of expelling Kurds and moving Arabs in, and called for a census and a referendum on whether the disputed regions should join the Kurdistan region. Neither was held.
paras.zh: 第140条呼吁扭转萨达姆时代驱逐库尔德人、迁入阿拉伯人的政策，并呼吁对有争议的地区是否应加入库尔德斯坦地区进行人口普查和全民公投。两者都没有举行。

paras.en: Kurdish forces then gained more of the disputed territory after Iraqi forces were forced out by the so-called "Islamic State," with Kurdish pershmerga for subsequently reclaiming some of the land with some international assistance.
paras.zh: 在伊拉克军队被所谓的“伊斯兰国”驱逐后，库尔德军队获得了更多有争议的领土，库尔德武装随后在一些国际援助下收复了部分土地。

paras.en: The oil-rich region is highly important to both administrations, in a country that relies on oil revenues for the vast majority of its public sector budget.
paras.zh: 对于一个绝大多数公共部门预算都依赖石油收入的国家来说，石油资源丰富的地区对于两国政府都非常重要。

paras.en: Internal political tensions within Iraqi Kurdistan have further complicated the issue in recent months, with the Federal Supreme Court hearing an ongoing challenge against the current government's legitimacy after a party withdrew from the coalition cabinet. But rival Kurdish political factions seem to have found common ground on this issue at least.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，伊拉克库尔德斯坦内部的政治紧张局势使问题进一步复杂化，在一个政党退出联合内阁后，联邦最高法院审理了对现任政府合法性的持续挑战。但库尔德敌对政治派别似乎至少在这个问题上找到了共同点。

articles.title: Saudi pop music is thriving — but for the right reasons?

paras.en: Today, rapper Asayel Bishi is one of Saudi Arabia's rising hip-hop stars, signed to the country's biggest record label for new music, MDLBEAST. But not so long ago, she was making international headlines for a totally different reason.
paras.zh: 如今，说唱歌手 Asayel Bishi 是沙特阿拉伯冉冉升起的嘻哈新星之一，与该国最大的新音乐唱片公司 MDLBEAST 签约。但不久前，她因完全不同的原因而成为国际头条新闻。

paras.en: In 2020, after Bishi released a music video for a song, "Bint Mecca," or "girl from Mecca," featuring people dancing in a local cafe, Mecca's governor called for the arrest of Bishi's whole production team. He said the video violated the holy city's local customs and traditions. In the end, the situation was resolved with a discussion about filming permits.
paras.zh: 2020 年，Bishi 发布了歌曲《Bint Mecca》或《来自麦加的女孩》的音乐视频，其中人们在当地一家咖啡馆跳舞，麦加州长要求逮捕 Bishi 的整个制作团队。他说该视频违反了圣城当地的习俗和传统。最终，双方就拍摄许可事宜进行了讨论，解决了此事。

paras.en: And by early 2023, Bishi was signed to MDLBEAST and has since racked up hundreds of thousands of streams on music platforms like Spotify.
paras.zh: 到 2023 年初，Bishi 与 MDLBEAST 签约，此后在 Spotify 等音乐平台上获得了数十万次流媒体播放量。

paras.en: In the past, other Saudi rappers have ended up in prison for similar, alleged transgressions. The fact that Bishi's story went a different way is probably partially because the 31-year-old's career path is on a similar trajectory to the Saudi pop music industry as a whole.
paras.zh: 过去，其他沙特说唱歌手也曾因类似的涉嫌违法行为而入狱。 Bishi 的故事走向了不同的方向，部分原因可能是这位 31 岁的人的职业道路与整个沙特流行音乐产业的轨迹相似。

paras.en: As part of Saudi ruler Mohammed bin Salman's Vision 2030 plan, announced in 2016 and which aims to move the country away from economic dependence on oil, the country has poured billions into the local music industry.
paras.zh: 作为沙特统治者穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼 2030 年愿景计划的一部分，该计划于 2016 年宣布，旨在使该国摆脱对石油的经济依赖，该国已向当地音乐产业投入数十亿美元。

paras.en: The pace of development increased in 2019 after the country held its first major festival, Soundstorm, an annual event that now draws major international acts and over 400,000 guests. MDLBEAST was created then, primarily as the festival organizer. Since then, it has also become a record label, radio station, distributor, promoter and talent incubator.
paras.zh: 2019 年，该国举办了首个大型音乐节 Soundstorm，之后发展步伐加快，这一年度盛事现已吸引了众多国际知名艺人和超过 40 万名宾客。 MDLBEAST 当时成立，主要作为节日组织者。此后，它也成为唱片公司、广播电台、发行商、推广商和人才孵化器。

paras.en: A recent report for the Saudi Music Commission suggests the music sector could be worth $500 million (€455 million) by 2034. But it's difficult to figure out how well Saudi pop is really doing now because independent monitoring of the sector only began relatively recently.
paras.zh: 沙特音乐委员会最近的一份报告显示，到 2034 年，音乐行业的价值可能达到 5 亿美元（4.55 亿欧元）。但很难弄清楚沙特流行音乐现在的实际表现如何，因为对该行业的独立监控最近才开始。

paras.en: Streaming platform Spotify reports that people listening to Saudi-made music inside Saudi Arabia increased by 195% between 2020 and 2024. However, the most-streamed artists inside the country are still international.
paras.zh: 流媒体平台 Spotify 报告称，2020 年至 2024 年间，沙特阿拉伯境内收听沙特制作音乐的人数增加了 195%。然而，该国国内流媒体播放量最多的艺术家仍然是国际艺术家。

paras.en: Although there was a mostly-hidden Saudi music scene before this recent boom, observers say the growth of the Saudi music sector is not organic.
paras.zh: 尽管在最近的繁荣之前，沙特音乐界几乎处于隐藏状态，但观察人士表示，沙特音乐行业的增长并不是有机的。

paras.en: It's all about building an industry from the top down, Amr Abdelrahim, a researcher at Sciences Po in Paris, reported in a 2024 study. "After 2016, young middle-class musicians and creative professionals, who had been careful to avoid drawing official attention to their countercultural activities suddenly became central to the ambitions of the state," he wrote.
paras.zh: 巴黎政治学院的研究员 Amr Abdelrahim 在 2024 年的一项研究中报告说，这一切都是为了自上而下地建立一个行业。他写道：“2016年后，年轻的中产阶级音乐家和创意专业人士一直小心翼翼地避免引起官方对其反文化活动的关注，突然成为国家野心的核心。”

paras.en: The careers of young Saudi acts — like Bishi, for example — "became tied to the destiny of the crown prince," the researcher explained.
paras.zh: 研究人员解释说，年轻的沙特艺人——比如比什——的职业生涯“与王储的命运息息相关”。

paras.en: The Saudi royal family has long dispersed money from Saudi oil sales to their subjects, in order to ensure economic dependence and loyalty. But, Abdelrahim argued, "what is new about Saudi investments in culture under MBS is an unprecedented degree of centralization and the emergence of new clientelist networks around the country's de-facto ruler," using a common abbreviation for Crown Prince Mohammed.
paras.zh: 沙特王室长期以来一直将沙特石油销售所得的资金分散给其臣民，以确保经济依赖和忠诚度。但是，阿卜杜勒拉希姆认为，“穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼领导下的沙特文化投资的新特点是前所未有的集权化程度，以及围绕该国事实上的统治者出现的新的依附主义网络”（穆罕默德王储的常用缩写）。

paras.en: Those involved "are inadvertently participating in the consolidation of the Saudi regime," he argued.
paras.zh: 他认为，那些参与其中的人“无意中参与了沙特政权的巩固”。

paras.en: Observers say a lot of the new music businesses are vague about their ties to the state. But it's clear they couldn't work without the state's financial support and approval.
paras.zh: 观察人士表示，许多新音乐企业对于它们与国家的关系含糊其辞。但很明显，如果没有国家的财政支持和批准，他们就无法开展工作。

paras.en: "Almost all major events are organized by the state or funded by closely linked entities," a spokesperson from Saudi-focused organization, ALQST for Human Rights, told DW. "This affects the type of music produced, as musicians have to be mindful of what is acceptable. This is not just about the music they produce, but also how they act and what they say to their fans."
paras.zh: “几乎所有重大活动都是由国家组织或由密切相关实体资助，”专注于沙特的组织 ALQST for Human Rights 的发言人告诉德国之声。 “这会影响制作的音乐类型，因为音乐家必须注意什么是可以接受的。这不仅关系到他们制作的音乐，还关系到他们的行为方式以及他们对粉丝说的话。”

paras.en: ALQST believes Saudi musicians have even less artistic freedom under the new musical system than before, when they would have played or performed privately. They can lose their contracts and livelihoods, be prevented from performing or even arrested, ALQST's spokesperson said.
paras.zh: ALQST 认为，在新的音乐体系下，沙特音乐家的艺术自由度比以前更小，因为他们本来可以私下演奏或表演。 ALQST 发言人表示，他们可能会失去合同和生计、无法表演甚至被捕。

paras.en: "In the past, the music scene was not regulated," explained the guitarist and bassist for Saudi black metal band, Al-Namrood. But now that it is, the state can more closely monitor musicians who once stayed hidden and only played privately, the musician, who goes by the name of Mephisto, told DW.
paras.zh: “过去，音乐界不受监管，”沙特黑金属乐队 Al-Namrood 的吉他手和贝斯手解释道。但现在，国家可以更密切地监视那些曾经隐藏起来、只在私下演奏的音乐家，这位名叫梅菲斯托的音乐家告诉德国之声。

paras.en: Al-Namrood are one of the rare examples of a Saudi act that isn't working with state support. The group first formed in 2008 but have never played at home and have kept their identities secret for almost two decades.
paras.zh: 纳姆鲁德是沙特行为不受国家支持的罕见例子之一。该乐队于 2008 年首次成立，但从未在国内比赛过，并且近二十年来一直对自己的身份保密。

paras.en: "The exchange is clear: You want to perform, it has to be under our rules," Mephisto continued. "And I totally understand the perspective [of some musicians]. But typically the artist must refrain from any criticism of the religious or authoritarian. [The state] doesn't necessarily buy an artist's loyalty, it just creates incentives that make criticism increasingly costly."
paras.zh: “交换很明确：你想要表演，就必须遵守我们的规则，”梅菲斯托继续说道。 “我完全理解（一些音乐家）的观点。但通常艺术家必须避免对宗教或独裁者的任何批评。（国家）不一定会购买艺术家的忠诚，它只是创造激励措施，使批评的成本越来越高。”

paras.en: For Al-Namrood, who have often condemned Saudi conservatism, religion and politics in their music, that's not an option. "We don't want anything to do with them," Mephisto said.
paras.zh: 对于经常在音乐中谴责沙特保守主义、宗教和政治的 Al-Namrood 来说，这不是一个选择。 “我们不想和他们有任何关系，”墨菲斯托说。

paras.en: In her 2020 paper for the journal, Arabian Humanities, Nora Derbal, a professor at the University of Hamburg, said Saudi artists told her that if they got a call from authorities asking them to participate in a government project, it would be an offer they couldn't turn down.
paras.zh: 汉堡大学教授诺拉·德巴尔 (Nora Derbal) 在 2020 年为《阿拉伯人文》杂志发表的论文中表示，沙特艺术家告诉她，如果他们接到当局要求他们参与政府项目的电话，他们将无法拒绝这个提议。

paras.en: The artists she spoke with were debating "their cooptation and loss of autonomy, and about the consequences for not joining in state projects," she wrote.
paras.zh: 她写道，与她交谈的艺术家正在讨论“他们的合作和自主权的丧失，以及不加入国家项目的后果”。

paras.en: On the other hand, in various interviews, Saudi acts who have partaken in their country's pop music renaissance have also been positive: They don't have to hide anymore, they can play for larger audiences and they are paid. In an interview, one Saudi DJ described the first Soundstorm festival as like "Berlin after the fall of the wall" while others said they felt they were making history.
paras.zh: 另一方面，在各种采访中，参与本国流行音乐复兴的沙特艺人也表现出了积极的态度：他们不必再隐藏，他们可以为更多的观众演奏，而且他们可以得到报酬。在接受采访时，一位沙特 DJ 将首届 Soundstorm 音乐节描述为“柏林墙倒塌后的柏林”，而其他人则表示他们觉得自己正在创造历史。

paras.en: "So that's the interesting paradox," said Fannie Agerschou-Madsen, a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Roskilde in Denmark, who's written several papers on the topic. "We have all these social liberalizations and challenges to conservative norms but at the same time that's not being followed by political liberalization."
paras.zh: “这就是一个有趣的悖论，”丹麦罗斯基勒大学博士后研究员范妮·阿格舒-马德森说，她就此主题撰写了几篇论文。 “我们面临着所有这些社会自由化和对保守规范的挑战，但与此同时，政治自由化却没有随之而来。”

paras.en: But that doesn't mean that some room isn't being created for meaningful change, Agerschou-Madsen told DW. Locals told her they enjoyed the newfound freedom of going to a dance party although, she noted, the subversiveness seemed to be more directed at the social conservatism than Saudi authorities.
paras.zh: 阿格舒-马德森告诉德国之声，但这并不意味着没有为有意义的变革创造一些空间。当地人告诉她，他们很享受参加舞会的新自由，尽管她指出，颠覆性似乎更多地针对社会保守主义，而不是沙特当局。

paras.en: Young Saudis are well aware of the red lines and state control of the music scene and are continually negotiating boundaries, the researcher argued. In that way, "their everyday practices create space for political and social change, little by little, although perhaps not in what you'd consider a typically revolutionary way."
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，年轻的沙特人很清楚音乐界的红线和国家控制，并不断协商边界。这样，“他们的日常实践一点一点地为政治和社会变革创造了空间，尽管可能不是以你认为典型的革命性方式。”

paras.en: So is the Saudi state co-opting local musicians, including those who might have said something controversial before they ever get a chance to?
paras.zh: 那么，沙特政府是否正在拉拢当地音乐家，包括那些可能在有机会之前就说过一些有争议的话的人？

paras.en: A DW enquiry to MDLBEAST was not answered. And the answer likely lies somewhere in the middle.
paras.zh: 德国之声向 MDLBEAST 询问未得到答复。答案可能就在中间的某个地方。

paras.en: For some young Saudis, the new music scene has been about fun, self-expression, belonging and creativity, Agerschou-Madsen wrote in a new, as-yet-unpublished paper shared with DW. "Others, however, view it as a top-down project that commodifies fun while sidestepping deeper issues of political freedom and social equity."
paras.zh: 阿格舒-马德森在与德国之声分享的一篇尚未发表的新论文中写道，对于一些年轻的沙特人来说，新的音乐场景意味着乐趣、自我表达、归属感和创造力。 “然而，其他人则认为这是一个自上而下的项目，将乐趣商品化，同时回避了更深层次的政治自由和社会公平问题。”

articles.title: Albania's youth are protesting in Flamingo Revolution, not leaving the country anymore

paras.en: In mid-October, students in the Albanian capital Tirana set a suitcase on fire and threw it into the courtyard of the Education Ministry. Everyone in the country understood the symbolism: According to the 2023 census, the population of this Western Balkan country shrunk by about 420,000 between 2011 and 2023 — by nearly 15% — primarily because of emigration.
paras.zh: 10月中旬，阿尔巴尼亚首都地拉那的学生点燃了一个手提箱，并将其扔进了教育部的庭院。这个国家的每个人都明白其中的象征意义：根据 2023 年人口普查，这个西巴尔干国家的人口在 2011 年至 2023 年间减少了约 42 万，即近 15%，主要是因为移民。

paras.en: For a generation of young Albanians, this was the response to a system that gave them little voice. But now young people want to stay, and the protesters are saying that the system has to change.
paras.zh: 对于一代年轻的阿尔巴尼亚人来说，这是对他们几乎没有发言权的制度的反应。但现在年轻人想留下来，抗议者说这个制度必须改变。

paras.en: Known as the "Flamingo Revolution," the social movement began in May with demonstrations against a luxury resort in a coastal reserve that US President Donald Trump's daughter Ivanka Trump and her husband Jared Kushner were involved in.
paras.zh: 这场被称为“火烈鸟革命”的社会运动始于五月，抗议美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的女儿伊万卡·特朗普和她的丈夫贾里德·库什纳参与的沿海保护区豪华度假村的示威活动。

paras.en: It quickly evolved into broader criticism against corruption, Prime Minister Edi Rama's government and his ruling Socialist Party and the country's entire political class.
paras.zh: 它很快演变成对腐败、总理埃迪·拉玛政府及其执政的社会党以及该国整个政治阶层的更广泛的批评。

paras.en: Thousands marched almost every evening for four months in protests that were largely peaceful. But on October 13, a student protest escalated and there were clashes with police. Since then, the unrest has continued, with police using tear gas, water cannons and rubber bullets against demonstrators. There have been hundreds of arrests and many injuries, amid damage to public and private property.
paras.zh: 在四个月的时间里，数千人几乎每天晚上都举行游行，抗议活动基本上是和平的。但10月13日，学生抗议升级，并与警方发生冲突。此后，骚乱仍在继续，警方对示威者使用催泪瓦斯、高压水枪和橡皮子弹。公共和私人财产遭到破坏，数百人被捕，多人受伤。

paras.en: The protesters have called for Rama's resignation, a transitional government, electoral reform and fresh elections. The movement, which has no leader, has support from people across the political spectrum. And while the prime minister has blamed "foreign hands" for the movement, there seems to be little evidence that external actors are orchestrating the protests, though they may have attempted to exploit the unrest online.
paras.zh: 抗议者呼吁拉玛辞职、组建过渡政府、进行选举改革和重新举行选举。该运动没有领导人，但得到了各个政治派别人士的支持。尽管总理将这场运动归咎于“外国人”，但似乎没有证据表明外部行为者正在策划抗议活动，尽管他们可能试图利用网上的骚乱。

paras.en: The protesters, who do not feel represented by Albania's democracy, are driven by domestic issues: corruption, the high cost of living and low wages. This is nothing new, but many factors have converged recently: a series of high-level corruption charges, including against ministers and two of Rama's former deputies, rising prices and the fact that Albania is being measured against EU standards by a new generation.
paras.zh: 抗议者感觉自己没有代表阿尔巴尼亚的民主，他们受到国内问题的驱使：腐败、高生活成本和低工资。这并不是什么新鲜事，但最近许多因素都集中在一起：一系列高层腐败指控，包括针对部长和拉马的两名前副手的指控、物价上涨以及阿尔巴尼亚新一代人正在根据欧盟标准来衡量这一事实。

paras.en: In certain areas, Rama has transformed Albania since taking office in 2013: the economy has grown significantly, as the government likes to point out, and tourism is booming. But the prosperity remains unevenly distributed. Critics accuse the government of channeling too much taxpayer money into a small number of well-connected companies through prestigious projects and public-private partnerships, and in some cases through corrupt business deals, at the expense of healthcare, education and better economic prospects for the wider population.
paras.zh: 自2013年上任以来，拉马在某些领域改变了阿尔巴尼亚：正如政府喜欢指出的那样，经济显着增长，旅游业蓬勃发展。但繁荣的分布仍然不均匀。批评者指责政府通过著名的项目和公私合作伙伴关系，在某些情况下通过腐败的商业交易，将过多的纳税人资金投入到少数人脉广泛的公司中，而牺牲了医疗保健、教育和更广泛人口的更好的经济前景。

paras.en: Rama has rejected the calls for his resignation and has invited protesters to engage in dialogue, which they have so far refused.
paras.zh: 拉玛拒绝了辞职的呼吁，并邀请抗议者进行对话，但他们迄今拒绝了。

paras.en: Alternating between Socialist and Democratic Party
paras.zh: 社会党和民主党之间交替

paras.en: In 2008, Rama and Sali Berisha, the long-time chairman of the opposition Democratic Party, worked on a reform to Albania's constitution and electoral law, which was approved by parliament. Since then, it is party leaders who have determined who enters Parliament, which weakens ties between lawmakers and their constituents.
paras.zh: 2008年，拉马和长期担任反对党民主党主席的萨利·贝里沙致力于对阿尔巴尼亚宪法和选举法进行改革，并获得议会批准。从那时起，由政党领导人决定谁进入议会，这削弱了立法者与其选民之间的联系。

paras.en: In addition, it has become significantly more difficult for new parties to win seats. In 2025, a new party received about 64,000 votes, but only one seat. The Socialists, by contrast, won about one seat for every 10,000 votes.
paras.zh: 此外，新政党赢得席位变得更加困难。 2025年，一个新政党获得约64,000张选票，但只有一个席位。相比之下，社会党每 10,000 票就赢得大约一个席位。

paras.en: Rama has been the leader of the Socialists since 2005, while Berisha first became the chairman of the Democratic Party in 1991. For 21 years, Albania's prime minister has either been Rama or Berisha. Freedom House, a US nongovernmental organization that promotes democracy worldwide, classifies Albania as "partly free" and describes the country's political parties as being "often organized around leading personalities."
paras.zh: 拉马自2005年起一直担任社会党领袖，贝里沙则于1991年首次担任民主党主席。21年来，阿尔巴尼亚总理要么是拉马，要么是贝里沙。自由之家是一个在全球范围内促进民主的美国非政府组织，将阿尔巴尼亚归类为“部分自由”，并将该国的政党描述为“通常围绕领导人人物组织起来”。

paras.en: Protesters on the streets have said that they want both men to be jailed. Rama has argued that governments should be replaced at the ballot box, not on the streets.
paras.zh: 街头抗议者表示，他们希望这两个人都被监禁。拉玛认为，政府应该在投票箱中更换，而不是在街头。

paras.en: Though the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE) acknowledged that parliamentary elections in 2025 were "competitive and professionally managed" it said that they had taken place "in a highly polarized environment and contestants did not enjoy a level playing field."
paras.zh: 尽管欧洲安全与合作组织 (OSCE) 承认 2025 年议会选举是“竞争性的、专业管理的”，但表示选举是在“高度两极分化的环境中进行的，参赛者没有享受公平的竞争环境”。

paras.en: It added that there were "reports of intimidation, misuse of public resources and pressure on public employees, which undermined equal opportunities."
paras.zh: 它补充说，有“关于恐吓、滥用公共资源和对公职人员施加压力的报告，这破坏了平等机会。”

paras.en: The Democratic Party also spoke of election fraud and intimidation. Turnout was below 45%.
paras.zh: 民主党还谈到了选举舞弊和恐吓。投票率低于 45%。

paras.en: Protesters call out corruption, face high cost of living
paras.zh: 抗议者呼吁腐败，面临高昂的生活成本

paras.en: Many protesters also allege that when it comes to business, what matters is the proximity to people in power. They criticize the public procurement, public auctions and concessions system, which has led to state-owned land, including coastal and protected areas, being sold to private investors.
paras.zh: 许多抗议者还声称，在商业方面，重要的是与当权者的接近。他们批评公共采购、公开拍卖和特许制度，该制度导致包括沿海和保护区在内的国有土地被出售给私人投资者。

paras.en: Ordinary Albanians are feeling the financial brunt. According to the Albanian Institute of Statistics (INSTAT), half of all employees earn less than 60,000 lek (roughly €620 or $680) per month after taxes. But according to Eurostat, food prices are slightly above the EU average and real estate prices in Tirana have nearly doubled since 2018, with rents rising just as quickly.
paras.zh: 普通阿尔巴尼亚人正感受到经济上的冲击。根据阿尔巴尼亚统计研究所 (INSTAT) 的数据，一半员工的税后月收入低于 60,000 列克（约合 620 欧元或 680 美元）。但根据欧盟统计局的数据，食品价格略高于欧盟平均水平，地拉那的房地产价格自 2018 年以来几乎翻了一番，租金上涨同样迅速。

paras.en: For many years, young Albanians who were dissatisfied with the system opted to leave the country. The number of Albanian citizens in Germany more than doubled between 2018 and 2024, reaching almost 120,000.
paras.zh: 多年来，对制度不满的阿尔巴尼亚年轻人选择离开这个国家。 2018 年至 2024 年间，在德国的阿尔巴尼亚公民人数增加了一倍多，达到近 12 万人。

paras.en: Though it is still too early to say whether there are fewer Albanians leaving today, for many protesters staying has become a political statement.
paras.zh: 尽管现在判断今天离开的阿尔巴尼亚人是否减少还为时过早，但对许多抗议者来说，留下来已经成为一种政治声明。

paras.en: Rama has argued that his resignation would jeopardize Albania's bid to join the European Union by 2030, but the vast majority of Albanians are pro-European, including those on the streets and in the opposition. From the protesters' perspective, it is the government headed by Rama that is the real obstacle on the path to the EU.
paras.zh: 拉马辩称，他的辞职将危及阿尔巴尼亚在2030年加入欧盟的努力，但绝大多数阿尔巴尼亚人都是亲欧洲的，包括街头和反对派的人。从抗议者的角度来看，以拉玛为首的政府才是通向欧盟道路上的真正障碍。

paras.en: Though there is currently a wave of protests across Europe, the only obvious comparison is with Serbia, where a student-led movement recently forced a long-time ruler from office. Whether Albania will follow this example depends on whether young people, who have traditionally not been deeply engaged in politics, can turn their protests into votes.
paras.zh: 尽管目前欧洲各地掀起了一波抗议浪潮，但唯一明显的比较是塞尔维亚，那里的学生领导的运动最近迫使一位长期统治者下台。阿尔巴尼亚是否会效仿这一做法，取决于传统上不深入参与政治的年轻人能否将抗议转化为选票。

paras.en: What is certain is that for three decades, Albania's leaders have relied on their citizens' suitcases. Now, the country's students have burned that very luggage.
paras.zh: 可以肯定的是，三十年来，阿尔巴尼亚领导人一直依赖其公民的手提箱。现在，该国的学生已经烧毁了这些行李。

paras.en: Andi Balla is a doctoral candidate at the Leibniz Institute for East and Southeast European Studies (IOS) in Regensburg, where he is conducting research on demographic debates in Albania. He has written numerous articles on Albania for an international audience.
paras.zh: 安迪·巴拉 (Andi Balla) 是雷根斯堡莱布尼茨东欧和东南欧研究所 (IOS) 的博士生，他正在该研究所进行阿尔巴尼亚人口辩论的研究。他为国际读者撰写了大量有关阿尔巴尼亚的文章。

paras.en: This article was translated from German.
paras.zh: 这篇文章是从德文翻译过来的。

articles.title: Mexico seeks US talks about suspected SpaceX debris

paras.en: The Mexican government is seeking talks with aviation authorities in the United States about falling rocket debris following SpaceX launches in Texas.
paras.zh: 墨西哥政府正在寻求与美国航空当局就 SpaceX 在德克萨斯州发射后掉落的火箭碎片问题进行谈判。

paras.en: It is the latest sign of growing tensions between Mexico City and Elon Musk’s trillion-dollar company.
paras.zh: 这是墨西哥城和埃隆·马斯克的万亿美元公司之间紧张关系日益加剧的最新迹象。

paras.en: “What we are seeking, through the embassy, is a meeting between US and Mexican airspace authorities so that permission for the use of Mexican airspace can be established, how often it would be used, and, if necessary, the relocation of the launch site,” Mexico’s President Claudia Sheinbaum said on Thursday at a news conference in the capital.
paras.zh: 墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·谢因鲍姆周四在首都举行的新闻发布会上表示：“我们正在通过大使馆寻求美国和墨西哥空域当局之间的会议，以便获得使用墨西哥空域的许可，确定使用频率，并在必要时重新安置发射场。”

paras.en: “And then there’s the issue of the debris,” she added.
paras.zh: “还有碎片问题，”她补充道。

paras.en: Earlier this month, Mexican authorities said they had to recover debris after a launch of a SpaceX Starship from its Starbase,Texas, facility near the Gulf of Mexico and nature reserves on both sides of the shared border.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，墨西哥当局表示，SpaceX 星际飞船从其位于德克萨斯州的 Starbase、墨西哥湾附近的设施以及共同边界两侧的自然保护区发射升空后，他们必须回收碎片。

paras.en: Debris that officials said came from the launch washed ashore along Playa Bagdad in Matamoros in the Mexican state of Tamaulipas, according to PROFEPA, Mexico’s Federal Attorney for Environmental Protection.
paras.zh: 据墨西哥联邦环境保护检察官 PROFEPA 称，官员称，发射产生的碎片被冲上墨西哥塔毛利帕斯州马塔莫罗斯的巴格达海滩沿岸。

paras.en: It said it had collected material several days after part of the Starship was destroyed and fell into the sea. The debris was taken by the Mexican navy to be stored and PROFEPA said it would ask SpaceX to take possession of it.
paras.zh: 它表示，在星舰的一部分被摧毁并落入海中几天后，他们已经收集了材料。这些残骸已被墨西哥海军带走存放，PROFEPA 表示将要求 SpaceX 接管它。

paras.en: SpaceX said it was working with Mexican authorities and disputed the claim that what was found was from its failed Starship launch.
paras.zh: SpaceX 表示正在与墨西哥当局合作，并对所发现的东西来自其失败的星舰发射的说法提出异议。

paras.en: “We continue to stay in contact with the Mexican government and are on standby to send support if authorities in Mexico tell us it is actually needed,” the company posted on X. “Partners on the ground relayed that they have found very little debris in their sweeps of the beach and the small amount they have found is not clearly from SpaceX operations.”
paras.zh: 该公司在 X 上发帖称：“我们将继续与墨西哥政府保持联系，并随时待命，如果墨西哥当局告诉我们确实需要的话，我们将提供支持。”“地面合作伙伴表示，他们在海滩上发现的碎片很少，而且他们发现的少量碎片显然不是 SpaceX 运营造成的。”

paras.en: Musk’s SpaceX is seeking permission from the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to dramatically increase activity at the Starbase facility. Previously, the company was allowed 25 launches and 50 landings a year, but now it is seeking permission for 456 launches and 912 landings annually.
paras.zh: 马斯克的 SpaceX 正在寻求美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 的许可，以大幅增加 Starbase 设施的活动。此前，该公司每年获准进行 25 次发射和 50 次着陆，但现在正在寻求每年 456 次发射和 912 次着陆的许可。

paras.en: Earlier this week, the US Federal Communications Commission granted SpaceX permission to send up to one million satellites into space as part of Musk’s plans to develop data centres in orbit.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，美国联邦通信委员会批准 SpaceX 向太空发射多达 100 万颗卫星，作为马斯克在轨道上开发数据中心计划的一部分。

articles.title: Attack on Saudi’s Jazan refinery kills one person, disrupts operations

paras.en: An aerial projectile has hit an oil refinery in Saudi Arabia’s city of Jazan, killing one worker and injuring several other people, according to the country’s Ministry of Energy.
paras.zh: 据沙特阿拉伯能源部称，一枚空中射弹击中了沙特阿拉伯吉赞市的一家炼油厂，造成一名工人死亡，多人受伤。

paras.en: Thursday’s attack on the facility on the kingdom’s Red Sea coast caused a fire and temporarily halted some operations, the ministry said.
paras.zh: 该部表示，周四对该国红海沿岸设施的袭击引发火灾，并暂时停止了部分业务。

paras.en: The statement did not identify who carried out the strike, but earlier the Saudi-led military coalition fighting Yemen’s Houthis said that the Iranian-backed group had attacked the refinery. It came after Saudi Arabia’s civil defence agency had issued an alert about potential danger in Jazan province.
paras.zh: 声明没有透露是谁实施了这次袭击，但早些时候，沙特领导的打击也门胡塞武装的军事联盟表示，伊朗支持的组织袭击了炼油厂。此前，沙特阿拉伯民防机构就吉赞省的潜在危险发出了警报。

paras.en: The strike was the Houthis‘ latest blow against key Saudi facilities, a day after the group claimed attacks on Ras Tanura, the kingdom’s largest refinery and a major crude export hub, and the Red Sea ports of Jeddah and Jazan, amid escalating hostilities between the two sides.
paras.zh: 这次袭击是胡塞武装对沙特主要设施的最新打击，此前一天，该组织声称袭击了沙特最大的炼油厂和主要原油出口中心拉斯坦努拉以及红海港口吉达和吉赞，双方之间的敌对行动不断升级。

paras.en: The Saudi Ministry of Energy said the worker who died was Nepali, while the injured were of various nationalities.
paras.zh: 沙特能源部表示，死亡工人是尼泊尔人，受伤者来自不同国籍。

paras.en: The injured received medical care, while emergency personnel and specialised technical teams arrived at the site to assess the damage and verify the safety of the facilities following the attack, the ministry added.
paras.zh: 该部补充说，伤者接受了医疗救治，紧急救援人员和专业技术小组抵达现场评估损失情况并核实袭击后设施的安全性。

paras.en: The refinery in southwestern Saudi Arabia, near the Yemeni border, is designed to process up to 400,000 barrels of crude oil per day.
paras.zh: 该炼油厂位于沙特阿拉伯西南部，靠近也门边境，设计产能为每天 40 万桶原油。

paras.en: The Saudi-led coalition, which is backing Yemen’s internationally recognised government in its fight with the Houthis, condemned the strike and threatened a counterattack.
paras.zh: 沙特领导的联盟支持国际公认的也门政府与胡塞武装的战斗，该联盟谴责这次袭击并威胁进行反击。

paras.en: “Targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure would be met with a firm military ‌‌response,” coalition spokesman Turki al-Maliki posted on X.
paras.zh: 联军发言人图尔基·马利基 (Turki al-Maliki) 在 X 上发帖称：“针对平民和民用基础设施的攻击将得到坚决的军事反应。”

paras.en: Later on Thursday, the coalition claimed its forces had destroyed a Houthi ballistic missile launch platform in Yemen’s Hodeidah governorate used by the armed group to stage the attack on the Jazan refinery, according to al-Maliki. There was no immediate statement from the Houthis regarding the strike.
paras.zh: 据马利基称，周四晚些时候，联军声称其部队摧毁了也门荷台达省的胡塞弹道导弹发射平台，胡塞武装利用该平台袭击吉赞炼油厂。胡塞武装没有立即就这次袭击发表声明。

paras.en: On the ground in Yemen, meanwhile, Saudi-backed government forces claimed they had carried out 767 strikes on Houthi positions on Thursday.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在也门，沙特支持的政府军声称周四对胡塞武装阵地进行了 767 次袭击。

paras.en: In a post on X, the forces’ spokesman Majed Abdullah al-Nuzaili said the strikes had “neutralised” 117 Houthi fighters and destroyed 87 vehicles and combat assets.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装发言人马吉德·阿卜杜拉·努扎利 (Majed Abdullah al-Nuzaili) 在 X 上发帖称，袭击“消灭”了 117 名胡塞武装人员，摧毁了 87 辆车辆和战斗资产。

paras.en: Al-Nuzaili added that government forces continued to confront Houthi formations on the front lines in northern and western Marib governorate, as well as in the governorates of al-Jawf, Taiz, Lahj, Shabwah and Hajjah.
paras.zh: 努扎利补充说，政府军继续在马里布省北部和西部前线以及焦夫、塔伊兹、拉赫季、沙布瓦和哈杰等省与胡塞武装对抗。

paras.en: Earlier on Thursday, a series of air strikes targeted Yemen’s Houthi-held capital, Sanaa, according to media affiliated with the armed group, which is also known as Ansar Allah – Arabic for Supporters of God.
paras.zh: 据隶属于胡塞武装组织的媒体报道，周四早些时候，一系列空袭针对也门胡塞武装控制的首都萨那。该武装组织也被称为安萨尔安拉（Ansar Allah，阿拉伯语，意为上帝的支持者）。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Houthi forces targeted Habib al-Sarm and al-Hujalla, as well as al-Aqroud in al-Masrakh district.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，胡塞武装的目标是 Habib al-Sarm 和 al-Hujalla，以及马斯拉赫地区的 al-Aqroud。

paras.en: The Houthis, who control the most populous areas of Yemen, have launched missiles and drones at Saudi airports, oil facilities and office buildings since the country’s civil war reignited in July, in a spillover from the US-Iran war.
paras.zh: 控制也门人口最多地区的胡塞武装自 7 月美伊战争蔓延以来，该国内战重新燃起，向沙特机场、石油设施和办公楼发射了导弹和无人机。

paras.en: The attacks have previously temporarily disrupted some of Aramco’s operations and caused the cancellation of most international flights to Riyadh. They also forced Saudi Arabia to postpone or cancel major international events, including football’s AFC Asian Cup and the flagship FII investment conference.
paras.zh: 这些袭击此前曾暂时扰乱阿美公司的部分业务，并导致大多数飞往利雅得的国际航班取消。他们还迫使沙特阿拉伯推迟或取消重大国际赛事，包括足球亚足联亚洲杯和旗舰国际足联投资会议。

paras.en: The fighting has also exacerbated dire humanitarian conditions for Yemeni civilians.
paras.zh: 战斗还加剧了也门平民严峻的人道主义状况。

paras.en: The World Health Organization (WHO) reported that as of Monday, 2,361 people had been killed and 10,982 injured since fighting in Yemen escalated in August. More than 360,000 people have also been forced to flee their homes in Yemen since the start of August, according to the UN.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织 (WHO) 报告称，自 8 月也门战斗升级以来，截至周一，已有 2,361 人死亡、10,982 人受伤。据联合国称，自 8 月初以来，也门也有超过 36 万人被迫逃离家园。

articles.title: Egypt detains driver over Cairo fuel tanker fire that killed 31

paras.en: Prosecutors in Egypt have ordered the detention of a 21-year-old driver suspected of causing a collision on Wednesday that overturned a fuel tanker on Cairo’s ring road, starting a fire that killed 31 people.
paras.zh: 埃及检方已下令拘留一名涉嫌于周三在开罗环路发生撞车事故的 21 岁司机，该司机在开罗环城公路上撞翻了一辆油罐车，引发火灾，造成 31 人死亡。

paras.en: The Public Prosecution announced on Thursday that it had ordered the man to be held pending an investigation, and sent him to the Forensic Medicine Authority for tests to determine whether he had taken drugs.
paras.zh: 检察机关周四宣布，已下令拘留该男子等待调查，并将他送往法医管理局进行检查，以确定他是否吸毒。

paras.en: The tanker burst into flames at about 6:30pm (16:30 GMT) on Wednesday, at the height of the evening rush hour, on an elevated stretch of the ring road in al-Waraq, a densely populated district of Giza on the western edge of the capital. The fire spread to passing traffic and destroyed 27 vehicles, including cars and motorcycles.
paras.zh: 周三下午 6:30 左右（格林威治标准时间 16:30），这辆油轮在晚高峰时段的阿尔瓦拉克环路高架上起火，瓦拉克是首都西部边缘吉萨人口稠密的地区。火势蔓延至过往车辆，烧毁了包括汽车和摩托车在内的 27 辆汽车。

paras.en: In an earlier statement, prosecutors said the driver told investigators he had been travelling from al-Marg towards al-Haram at 110km/h (68mph), with his father in the car, and was switching lanes to overtake other vehicles when the front left of his car struck the rear right of the tanker.
paras.zh: 检察官在早些时候的一份声明中表示，司机告诉调查人员，他当时正以 110 公里/小时（68 英里/小时）的速度从 al-Marg 前往 al-Haram，父亲在车里，当时他正在变换车道以超越其他车辆，这时他的车左前部撞到了油罐车的右后部。

paras.en: The man told prosecutors he then lost control and his car veered to the far right of the road. One of the tanker’s tyres burst, the statement said, before the vehicle hit a concrete barrier and overturned. Petrol leaking from the truck caught fire.
paras.zh: 该男子告诉检察官，他随后失去了控制，他的车转向了道路的最右侧。声明称，油罐车的一个轮胎爆裂，然后车辆撞上混凝土屏障并翻倒。卡车泄漏的汽油着火了。

paras.en: Prosecutors said they identified the driver after inspecting the scene and interviewing witnesses, and had since spoken to all the injured whose condition allowed them to be questioned. Forensic teams are taking DNA samples from victims’ relatives to identify some of the bodies. Relatives posted appeals on Facebook for men who had been on the road and had not been heard from since, the Reuters news agency reported.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，他们在检查现场并采访目击者后确认了司机的身份，并与所有伤者进行了交谈，伤者的情况允许他们接受讯问。法医小组正在从受害者亲属身上提取 DNA 样本，以鉴定部分尸体的身份。据路透社报道，亲属在脸书上为那些一直在路上但自那以后就杳无音讯的男子发出呼吁。

paras.en: The investigation will determine whether the driver bears criminal responsibility.
paras.zh: 调查将确定司机是否承担刑事责任。

paras.en: The Ministry of Health and Population on Thursday put the final toll at 31 dead and 26 injured, up from the 21 injured it had reported on Wednesday. Five of the injured have left hospital. The other 21 are still being treated, including eight transferred to other hospitals for further care. The bodies of the dead are in the custody of prosecutors, the ministry said.
paras.zh: 卫生和人口部周四公布的最终死亡人数为 31 人、26 人受伤，高于周三报告的 21 人受伤人数。五名伤者已出院。其余21人仍在接受治疗，其中8人已转往其他医院接受进一步治疗。内政部表示，死者尸体已由检察官保管。

paras.en: By Thursday morning, traffic was moving again after crews cleared most of the burned wreckage. Salah Ahmed, a microbus driver, told the AP news agency that he had been on the ring road when the tanker caught fire but was held back by traffic, which saved his life.
paras.zh: 到周四早上，在工作人员清理了大部分被烧毁的残骸后，交通再次恢复畅通。小型客车司机萨拉·艾哈迈德 (Salah Ahmed) 告诉美联社，油罐车着火时他正在环路上，但被交通堵塞，这才救了他的命。

paras.en: “It was God’s hellfire on the ring road,” he said. “Why is a truck like this on the ring road at a rush hour? Who gets penalised for this happening?”
paras.zh: “这是上帝在环路上的地狱之火，”他说。 “为什么这样的卡车在高峰时段出现在环城公路上？谁会因此受到处罚？”

paras.en: A 2018 cabinet decision barred trucks carrying more than four tonnes from the ring road between 6am and midnight, the AFP news agency reported. Prosecutors have not said why the tanker was on the road at the time.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，2018 年内阁的一项决定禁止卡车在早上 6 点至午夜期间从环路行驶超过 4 吨的卡车。检察官尚未说明油轮当时为何在路上。

paras.en: “The tanks were exploding, the tyres were exploding, and there was fire,” Zaghlol al-Me, a local resident who reached the scene shortly after the crash, told Reuters. “We just didn’t know what to do or how to save anyone.”
paras.zh: 事故发生后不久到达现场的当地居民扎格洛尔·阿尔·梅 (Zaghlol al-Me) 告诉路透社：“坦克爆炸，轮胎爆炸，并发生火灾。” “我们只是不知道该怎么做或如何拯救任何人。”

paras.en: The Public Prosecution’s statements are the first official account of how the crash happened. Early reports in local media suggested that a high-voltage cable had fallen in front of the tanker. On Wednesday night, the Ministry of Transport denied issuing any statement to that effect and said the cause was a matter for prosecutors.
paras.zh: 检方的声明是对坠机事件发生过程的第一份官方说明。当地媒体的早期报道显示，一根高压电缆掉落在油轮前面。周三晚间，交通运输部否认就此发表任何声明，并表示原因由检察官负责。

paras.en: The Ministry of Electricity and Renewable Energy said the overhead lines were taut when the fire began and that two circuits tripped only after it started. The ministry’s spokesman, Mansour Abdel Ghani, told the Egyptian Youm7 daily newspaper that the lines had no connection to the crash and melted in the heat. A high-voltage line lay twisted on the ground on Thursday, AP reported.
paras.zh: 电力和可再生能源部表示，火灾发生时，架空线路处于拉紧状态，直到火灾发生后，两条电路才跳闸。该部发言人曼苏尔·阿卜杜勒·加尼 (Mansour Abdel Ghani) 告诉埃及《Youm7》日报，这些管线与坠机事件无关，只是在高温下融化了。据美联社报道，周四，地面上有一条高压线扭曲。

paras.en: President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi ordered full medical care for the injured and support for the families of those killed. Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly visited the injured on Thursday with Health Minister Khaled Abdel Ghaffar and Social Solidarity Minister Maya Morsy. Madbouly said the government, civil society and businesspeople would provide bank investment certificates to give bereaved families a stable income, and replacement vehicles for people whose cars burned.
paras.zh: 总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西下令为伤者提供全面医疗护理，并为遇难者家属提供支持。周四，总理穆斯塔法·马德布利与卫生部长哈立德·阿卜杜勒·加法尔和社会团结部长玛雅·穆尔西一起探望了伤者。马德布利表示，政府、民间社会和商界人士将提供银行投资证书，为失去亲人的家庭提供稳定的收入，并为汽车烧毁的人提供更换车辆。

paras.en: “We realise that no compensation or money can make up for those we have lost,” Madbouly said.
paras.zh: “我们意识到没有任何补偿或金钱可以弥补我们所失去的，”马德布利说。

paras.en: Egypt’s Ministry of Social Solidarity said on Thursday that people could donate through the InstaPay app to help the injured and the families of those killed. It also opened an account at Nasser Social Bank for donations from businesses and civil society groups. The cabinet said the ministry had received 24 million Egyptian pounds (about $445,000) from seven charities.
paras.zh: 埃及社会团结部周四表示，人们可以通过 InstaPay 应用程序捐款，以帮助受伤者和遇难者家属。它还在纳赛尔社会银行开设了一个账户，用于接受企业和民间社会团体的捐款。内阁表示，该部已从七个慈善机构收到了 2400 万埃及镑（约合 445,000 美元）。

paras.en: The crash has renewed questions about road safety in Egypt. The Ministry of Transport says it spent about $37bn on transport between 2014 and 2024, yet 5,829 people were killed on the country’s roads in 2025, up 10.8 percent from the year before, and about 84,000 were injured, according to the state statistics agency, CAPMAS.
paras.zh: 此次事故再次引发人们对埃及道路安全的质疑。交通运输部表示，2014 年至 2024 年间，该国交通运输支出约为 370 亿美元，但根据国家统计机构 CAPMAS 的数据，2025 年该国道路上死亡人数为 5,829 人，比前一年增加 10.8%，约 84,000 人受伤。

paras.en: Egyptian legislators demanded accountability on Thursday. Mahmoud Samy, an MP, said the government needed to move from “building roads and expanding them to managing their safety professionally”. Abdel Moneim Imam, a politician who chairs the liberal Justice Party, said the cabinet bore full responsibility and should resign.
paras.zh: 埃及立法者周四要求追究责任。议员马哈茂德·萨米 (Mahmoud Samy) 表示，政府需要从“修建和扩建道路转向专业管理道路安全”。自由正义党主席、政治家阿卜杜勒·莫奈姆·伊玛目表示，内阁负有全部责任，应该辞职。

paras.en: Amr Moussa, Egypt’s former foreign minister and former secretary-general of the Arab League, also criticised what he described as a deterioration in government oversight.
paras.zh: 埃及前外交部长、阿拉伯联盟前秘书长阿姆鲁·穆萨也批评了他所说的政府监督恶化。

paras.en: “Trading accusations and evading responsibility leads to the next disaster,” Moussa said, according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，穆萨表示：“相互指责和逃避责任会导致下一场灾难。”

paras.en: Transport Minister Kamel al-Wazir was appointed in 2019 after a train crash at Cairo’s Ramses station triggered a fire that killed 25 people, according to Reuters. He has rejected calls to resign since then, including after a lorry crash in the Nile Delta that killed 19 people, almost all of them young women, last year. The ministry declined to comment further when contacted by Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，交通部长卡梅尔·瓦齐尔 (Kamel al-Wazir) 于 2019 年被任命，此前开罗拉美西斯火车站发生火车相撞事故并引发火灾，造成 25 人死亡。此后他一直拒绝辞职，包括去年尼罗河三角洲发生的卡车相撞事故，造成 19 人死亡，其中几乎全是年轻女性。当路透社联系该部时，该部拒绝进一步置评。

paras.en: Earlier this month, a train crash, also in Giza, killed at least seven people and injured more than 125, prompting calls from legislators for accountability over recurring transport accidents.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，同样在吉萨发生的火车相撞事故造成至少 7 人死亡、超过 125 人受伤，促使立法者呼吁对反复发生的交通事故追究责任。

articles.title: Storms disrupt Thanksgiving travel. And, FCC violated ABC's free speech, judge says
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Storms disrupt Thanksgiving travel. And, FCC violated ABC's free speech, judge says
paras.zh: 暴风雨扰乱了感恩节旅行。而且，法官称 FCC 侵犯了 ABC 的言论自由

paras.en: Severe storms sweeping across the nation threaten to cause widespread travel delays today, as millions of people gather with their loved ones. New York City officials announced that the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has been rescheduled to Saturday due to the threat of powerful wind gusts that could reach up to 60 mph. This year marked the 100th procession, and the first time the iconic event is being postponed.
paras.zh: 今天，席卷全国的强风暴可能会导致大范围的旅行延误，数百万人与亲人相聚。纽约市官员宣布，由于时速可能达到 60 英里的强阵风威胁，梅西百货感恩节大游行已改期至周六举行。今年是第 100 届游行，也是这一标志性活动首次被推迟。

paras.en: - 🎧 Something is happening across almost every part of the country right now, NPR's Kat Lonsdorf tells Up First. Extreme high tides are affecting the West Coast, snow is expected in parts of the Midwest, and in the South and Southeast, a major storm is advancing up the East Coast. Meteorologist Richard Bann with the National Weather Service Weather Prediction Center tells Lonsdorf the East Coast storm is the primary concern. Bann says the storm will become better organized throughout the day, bringing strong winds and heavy rain that could lead to coastal flooding. The good news: Forecasters expect the East Coast's major storm to move on, mostly wrapping up by Saturday, Lonsdorf says.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 Kat Lonsdorf 告诉 Up First，现在全国几乎每个地方都在发生一些事情。极端涨潮正在影响西海岸，中西部部分地区预计会下雪，而在南部和东南部，一场大风暴正在向东海岸推进。国家气象局天气预报中心的气象学家理查德·班恩告诉朗斯多夫，东海岸风暴是首要问题。班恩表示，风暴将在全天变得更加有组织，带来强风和大雨，可能导致沿海洪水。好消息：朗斯多夫说，预报员预计东海岸的大风暴将继续下去，大部分在周六结束。

paras.en: The Trump administration has proposed new tariffs targeting goods from 14 major U.S. trading partners, including China, Japan and the European Union. Administration officials argue the measures counter unfair foreign trade practices, though critics question their ultimate effectiveness. Proposed rates may reach 40% on Chinese imports, 35% on Vietnamese goods, and 20-25% on products from other targeted nations. Additional tariffs on Brazilian sugar and aircraft are also being suggested.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府提议对来自中国、日本和欧盟等美国 14 个主要贸易伙伴的商品征收新关税。政府官员认为这些措施旨在打击不公平的外贸行为，但批评者质疑其最终效果。拟议的对中国进口商品征收的关税可能达到 40%，对越南商品征收 35%，对来自其他目标国家的产品征收 20-25%。还建议对巴西糖和飞机征收额外关税。

paras.en: - 🎧 U.S. Trade Ambassador Jamieson Greer said that new tariffs could take effect within a couple of months. For each country, the White House has listed a "proposed" rate and a "deal" rate, NPR's Danielle Kurtzleben says. For example, if talks with China progress positively, they may receive a deal rate of 20%, which is different from its proposed rate of 40%. Although the Supreme Court overturned President Trump's previous tariffs, the new ones fall under Section 301, a law meant to counter unfair trade practices. The administration says these countries exhibit "structural excess capacity" in various manufactured goods, a situation caused by policies that lead to overproduction, which can distort the global market.
paras.zh: - 🎧 美国贸易大使杰米森·格里尔表示，新关税可能会在几个月内生效。 NPR 的丹妮尔·库茨莱本 (Danielle Kurtzleben) 表示，对于每个国家，白宫都列出了“提议”利率和“交易”利率。例如，如果与中国的谈判取得积极进展，他们可能会获得20%的交易率，这与提议的40%不同。尽管最高法院推翻了特朗普总统之前的关税，但新关税属于旨在打击不公平贸易行为的第 301 条法律的管辖范围。美国政府表示，这些国家在各种制成品方面表现出“结构性产能过剩”，这是由导致生产过剩的政策造成的，这可能会扭曲全球市场。

paras.en: Federal scientists are testing the air, soil and water in Eastern Iowa for lead contamination after the U.S. Army detonated thousands of pounds of unstable lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown yesterday. Officials said the controlled explosion was the only safe way to dispose of the bomb-making compound.
paras.zh: 美国陆军昨天在米德尔敦的爱荷华州陆军弹药厂引爆了数千磅不稳定的叠氮化铅后，联邦科学家正在测试爱荷华州东部的空气、土壤和水的铅污染情况。官员们表示，受控爆炸是处理炸弹制造化合物的唯一安全方法。

paras.en: - 🎧 Eliza Billingham of NPR network station Iowa Public Radio says the major concern is the potential release of lead into the air from the explosion. She adds that the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency has tested the area since the detonation and hasn't found lead in the air. The EPA has deployed around 300 people to sample the air, ground and nearby water. Lead is a neurotoxin that especially endangers children and pregnant people because it can impede childhood development. After a week and a half of delays and inconsistent communication from the Army, residents have grown hesitant about the Army and the EPA's initial findings, Billingham says. Residents want independent monitoring and the University of Iowa and the University of Illinois are conducting regional sampling. Results are expected in a few days and should show if their measurements align with the EPA's data, Billingham says.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 网络电台爱荷华州公共广播电台的 Eliza Billingham 表示，主要担心的是爆炸可能导致铅释放到空气中。她补充说，自爆炸以来，美国环境保护局已经对该地区进行了测试，没有在空气中发现铅。 EPA 已部署约 300 人对空气、地面和附近的水进行采样。铅是一种神经毒素，特别危害儿童和孕妇，因为它会阻碍儿童发育。比林厄姆说，经过一周半的延误和陆军的沟通不一致，居民对陆军和环保局的初步调查结果越来越犹豫。居民希望进行独立监测，爱荷华大学和伊利诺伊大学正在进行区域抽样。比林厄姆说，预计几天后就会得出结果，并且应该显示他们的测量结果是否与美国环保局的数据相符。

paras.en: A federal judge has blocked Trump from challenging the ABC television network's broadcast licenses. U.S. District Court Judge Loren AliKhan ruled that the president retaliating against satire and commentary he dislikes is unconstitutional. AliKhan issued the preliminary injunction yesterday and dismissed the administration's request to throw out ABC and Disney's lawsuit challenging the review of the local license. Licenses typically last eight years and are rarely revoked. AliKhan's decision drew heavily on Trump's public statements and social media posts against ABC and Disney, as well as comments from Brendan Carr, the president's pick for chair of the Federal Communications Commission.
paras.zh: 一名联邦法官阻止特朗普质疑美国广播公司电视网络的广播许可证。美国地方法院法官洛伦·阿里汗裁定，总统对他不喜欢的讽刺和评论进行报复是违宪的。阿里汗昨天发布了初步禁令，并驳回了政府的要求，即驳回美国广播公司和迪士尼对当地许可证审查提出质疑的诉讼。许可证的有效期通常为八年，很少被撤销。阿里汗的决定在很大程度上参考了特朗普针对美国广播公司和迪士尼的公开声明和社交媒体帖子，以及总统提名的联邦通信委员会主席布伦丹·卡尔的评论。

paras.en: Holiday shopping season is in full swing. Before you spend, consider if you actually need what's in your cart. Sales are exciting because our brains are wired to seek newness. Retailers capitalize on that urge. To escape the cycle of constantly wanting more, shop intentionally and appreciate what you already own, says Eric Athas, author of Saying No to New. He shares his insights on breaking this cycle and finding joy in your current possessions with Life Kit.
paras.zh: 假日购物季正如火如荼地进行。在消费之前，请考虑您是否确实需要购物车中的商品。销售令人兴奋，因为我们的大脑天生就喜欢寻求新鲜事物。零售商利用了这种冲动。 《对新事物说不》一书的作者埃里克·阿萨斯说，为了摆脱不断想要更多的循环，有意识地购物并欣赏你已经拥有的东西。他通过 Life Kit 分享了他关于打破这个循环并在你当前拥有的东西中找到快乐的见解。

paras.en: - 🛒 Delete the app or remove your credit card info if you have one-click checkout with a company.
paras.zh: - 🛒 如果您与公司进行一键结帐，请删除应用程序或删除您的信用卡信息。

paras.en: - 🛒 Add an item to your online shopping cart and leave it for 24 hours. Research shows that delaying a purchase decreases your interest in it.
paras.zh: - 🛒 将商品添加到您的在线购物车并保留 24 小时。研究表明，延迟购买会降低您的兴趣。

paras.en: - 🛒 Make intentional choices. Don't reject all new things. After you understand this, you can learn to say no to the wrong items and yes to the right ones.
paras.zh: - 🛒 做出有意的选择。不要拒绝一切新事物。了解这一点后，您可以学会对错误的项目说“不”，对正确的项目说“是”。

paras.en: - 🛒 Revisiting old things can provide you with untapped enjoyment in them, research has found. You can apply this by rereading a book or by traveling to a city you have visited before.
paras.zh: - 🛒 研究发现，重温旧事物可以给你带来前所未有的乐趣。您可以通过重读一本书或前往您以前访问过的城市来应用此方法。

paras.en: - The Pittsburgh Steelers have cut quarterback Aaron Rodgers after he claimed in an interview that the team's head coach sleeps in meetings.
paras.zh: - 匹兹堡钢人队裁掉了四分卫亚伦·罗杰斯，因为他在接受采访时声称球队主教练在会议中睡觉。

paras.en: - The Ariston Cafe opened in 1924 along Illinois's Route 66, serving classic American diner fare. The National Register landmark attracts international travelers and hosts local milestones, from wedding proposals to 65th anniversaries.
paras.zh: - Ariston 咖啡馆于 1924 年在伊利诺伊州 66 号公路旁开业，供应经典的美式晚餐。这个国家名录地标吸引了国际游客，并举办了当地的里程碑活动，从求婚到 65 周年纪念日。

paras.en: - In this week's Far-Flung Postcards, NPR's Emily Feng brings readers views of the peak of Mount Kilimanjaro. She was able to see it during a camping trip at altitude.
paras.zh: - 在本周的《遥远明信片》中，NPR 的 Emily Feng 为读者带来了乞力马扎罗山峰顶的景色。她在一次高海拔露营旅行中看到了它。

articles.title: North Korea's Kim vows to build more nuclear weapons after ignoring Trump's overture
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: North Korea's Kim vows to build more nuclear weapons after ignoring Trump's overture
paras.zh: 朝鲜金正恩无视特朗普的提议后誓言要制造更多核武器

paras.en: SEOUL, South Korea — North Korean leader Kim Jong Un visited facilities that produce nuclear ingredients and called for building more nuclear weapons, days after ignoring U.S. President Donald Trump's offer to meet during his recent visit to Asia.
paras.zh: 韩国首尔——朝鲜领导人金正恩视察了生产核原料的设施，并呼吁制造更多核武器，几天前，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在最近访问亚洲期间提出了会面的提议。

paras.en: Experts say Kim likely wants to show off his evolving nuclear arsenal, the backbone of his authoritarian rule, and reaffirm his rejection of any future talks on dismantling his nuclear program.
paras.zh: 专家表示，金正恩可能想炫耀他不断发展的核武库，这是他独裁统治的支柱，并重申他拒绝未来任何有关废除核计划的谈判。

paras.en: The North's official Korean Central News Agency said Thursday that Kim inspected two nuclear materials production factories, one newly inaugurated and the other being expanded. KCNA photos showed Kim and senior military officials walking between dense rows of what appeared to be centrifuges used to produce weapons-grade uranium and touring halls displaying what were believed to be warheads. Some of the images were blurred.
paras.zh: 朝鲜官方通讯社朝中社周四称，金正恩视察了两家核材料生产工厂，一家是新落成的，另一家正在扩建。朝中社的照片显示，金正恩和高级军事官员在密集的一排似乎是用于生产武器级铀的离心机和展示据信是弹头的参观大厅之间行走。一些图像变得模糊。

paras.en: KCNA said Kim visited a nuclear-powered equipment production base and a nuclear research institute as well on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 朝中社称，金正恩周三还参观了核动力设备生产基地和核研究所。

paras.en: North Korea has disclosed a uranium enrichment site a few times since it showed one at its main Yongbyon nuclear complex to visiting American scholars in 2010. North Korea didn't say where the nuclear materials production factories that Kim visited this week are located. In June, when North Korea disclosed parts of a uranium enrichment site while reporting on Kim's visit there, outside experts assessed it was likely an additional uranium enrichment facility at Yongbyon.
paras.zh: 自2010年向来访的美国学者展示其主要宁边核设施的铀浓缩设施以来，朝鲜已多次披露了铀浓缩设施。朝鲜没有透露金正恩本周访问的核材料生产工厂位于何处。 6月，当朝鲜在报道金正恩访问那里时披露了铀浓缩设施的部分内容时，外部专家评估这可能是宁边的另一个铀浓缩设施。

paras.en: Kim justifies nuke program by citing threats from US, South KoreaKim said his latest inspection visit was part of efforts to strengthen North Korea's defense capabilities in response to "variable nuclear threats approaching the Korean Peninsula moment by moment." He accused the U.S. of inciting its regional allies to possess nuclear-powered submarines and committing to sharing its nuclear weapons with them, KCNA said.
paras.zh: 金正恩以来自美国的威胁为核计划辩护 金正恩表示，他最近的视察是加强朝鲜防御能力的努力的一部分，以应对“时时刻刻逼近朝鲜半岛的各种核威胁”。朝中社称，他指责美国煽动其地区盟友拥有核动力潜艇，并承诺与它们分享核武器。

paras.en: "The validity and substantiality of our possession of nuclear weapons and the trend of bolstering up its nuclear capability in quality and quantity are an irreversible reality," Kim said, according to KCNA.
paras.zh: 据朝中社报道，金正恩表示：“我们拥有核武器的有效性和实质性以及在质量和数量上增强核能力的趋势是不可逆转的现实。”

paras.en: Kim also said the deployment of low-yield battlefield nuclear weapons across multiple domains for various missions is crucial and urgent given North Korea's "inevitable reality facing the border with the most dangerous enemy state," a reference to South Korea. North Korea has in recent years focused on developing such tactical nuclear weapons amid heightened animosity with South Korea.
paras.zh: 金正恩还表示，鉴于朝鲜“不可避免地面临与最危险敌国边境的现实”（指的是韩国），在多个领域部署低当量战场核武器以执行各种任务至关重要且紧迫。近年来，在与韩国的敌意加剧的情况下，朝鲜一直致力于发展此类战术核武器。

paras.en: "Trump has talked about a willingness to meet Kim Jong Un, but the basic U.S. position that North Korea must denuclearize remains unchanged. So Kim Jong Un wants to say 'Look at how powerful we are. Don't talk about denuclearization if you want to meet us,'" said Moon Seong Mook, an analyst for the Seoul-based Korea Research Institute for National Strategy.
paras.zh: “特朗普已经谈到愿意与金正恩会面，但美国关于朝鲜必须无核化的基本立场没有改变。所以金正恩想说，‘看看我们有多强大。如果你想见我们，就不要谈论无核化，’”首尔韩国国家战略研究院分析师文成穆(Moon Seong Mook)表示。

paras.en: Moon said Kim's visit to the nuclear facilities was also likely meant to check on how state objectives on the nuclear program have progressed this year and what future goals must be set ahead of a year-end Workers' Party conference.
paras.zh: 文在寅表示，金正恩访问核设施也可能是为了检查今年国家核计划目标的进展情况，以及在年底劳动党会议之前必须制定哪些未来目标。

paras.en: South Korea's Defense Ministry said it takes Kim's comments on battlefield nuclear weapons seriously and added that Seoul maintains a firm military readiness against Pyongyang's nuclear threats under an alliance with the U.S. South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff declined to share an analysis of the North Korean nuclear facilities reported by KCNA, calling it confidential information for South Korea and the U.S.
paras.zh: 韩国国防部表示，认真对待金正恩关于战场核武器的评论，并补充说，首尔在与美国结盟的情况下，对平壤的核威胁保持坚定的军事准备状态。韩国参谋长联席会议拒绝分享朝中社报道的朝鲜核设施的分析，称其为韩国和美国的机密信息。

paras.en: Trump still hopes to meet KimTrump reiterated his eagerness to restore diplomacy with Kim as he visited China last week for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. But a Trump-Kim meeting didn't happen, with Pyongyang not publicly responding to Trump's overture.
paras.zh: 特朗普仍希望与金正恩会面 特朗普上周访问中国参加亚太经合组织峰会时重申了他与金正恩恢复外交的渴望。但特金会并没有发生，平壤也没有公开回应特朗普的提议。

paras.en: In an interview with the New York Post this week, Trump dismissed the suggestion that Kim had rebuffed his outreach, saying, "No, he didn't ignore it. You know, we had many leaders there … There'll be a time when we meet … It was just not really the right time. It was a very busy two-day period."
paras.zh: 在本周接受《纽约邮报》采访时，特朗普驳斥了有关金正恩拒绝与他接触的说法，他说：“不，他并没有忽视这一点。你知道，我们那里有很多领导人……我们会有一个会面的时间……只是时机不太合适。那是非常忙碌的两天。”

paras.en: Trump also claimed he could revive diplomacy with Kim at any time by restarting the exchange of letters they maintained during his first term, although he acknowledged that the two leaders had not corresponded "recently."
paras.zh: 特朗普还声称，他可以随时恢复与金正恩的外交关系，恢复他们在第一个任期内保持的信函往来，尽管他承认两位领导人“最近”没有进行过通信。

paras.en: Kim has previously said he could return to talks if the U.S. drops its "hostile policy" against his country and respects what he calls the North's status as a nuclear state. Experts say Kim aims to win international recognition as a nuclear state so that he could demand the lifting of international sanctions.
paras.zh: 金正恩此前曾表示，如果美国放弃对朝鲜的“敌对政策”并尊重他所说的朝鲜核国家地位，他可能会重返会谈。专家表示，金正恩的目标是赢得国际社会对核国家的承认，以便他可以要求取消国际制裁。

paras.en: Last week, International Atomic Energy Agency Director General Rafael Grossi assessed North Korea has been expanding its original uranium enrichment facility at Yongbyon, calling the move "a cause for serious concern."
paras.zh: 上周，国际原子能机构总干事拉斐尔·格罗西评估朝鲜一直在扩建其位于宁边的原始铀浓缩设施，称此举“引起严重关切”。

paras.en: Nuclear weapons can be built using either highly enriched uranium or weapons-grade plutonium, and North Korea has facilities to produce both at Yongbyon. Last year, South Korea's Unification Minister Chung Dong-young said that North Korea was operating four uranium enrichment facilities and that they were running every day.
paras.zh: 核武器可以使用高浓缩铀或武器级钚来制造，朝鲜在宁边拥有生产这两种材料的设施。去年，韩国统一部长官郑东泳表示，朝鲜正在运营四个铀浓缩设施，而且它们每天都在运行。

articles.title: Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 12,000 cases as some responders evacuate
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 12,000 cases as some responders evacuate
paras.zh: 刚果埃博拉疫情已达 12,000 例，部分急救人员撤离

paras.en: BUNIA, Congo — The fast-moving Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has topped 12,000 confirmed cases, government data showed Thursday, as fighting between rebels and the army disrupts efforts to contain the spread of the disease.
paras.zh: 刚果布尼亚——政府数据周四显示，刚果东部埃博拉疫情快速蔓延，确诊病例已突破 12,000 例，叛乱分子与军队之间的战斗扰乱了遏制埃博拉疫情蔓延的努力。

paras.en: It is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history and nearly half the 12,021 people confirmed to have the virus have died, according to data from Congo's Ministry of Health. It is also the deadliest of Congo's 17 outbreaks and is on track to surpass the death toll from the West African outbreak that killed 11,000 people between 2014 and 2016.
paras.zh: 刚果卫生部的数据显示，这是历史上增长最快的埃博拉疫情，确诊感染该病毒的 12,021 人中近一半已经死亡。这也是刚果 17 次疫情中最致命的一次，并且有望超过 2014 年至 2016 年间西非疫情造成 11,000 人死亡的死亡人数。

paras.en: The outbreak declared in May is caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Response teams are battling armed conflict, poor roads and violence from residents fueled by mistrust and misinformation.
paras.zh: 五月份宣布的疫情是由罕见的本迪布焦病毒引起的，目前尚无批准的疫苗或治疗方法。响应小组正在与武装冲突、道路状况不佳以及因不信任和错误信息而引发的居民暴力作斗争。

paras.en: Ebola spreads through direct contact with the blood or other bodily fluids of people who are sick or have died from the disease. Containing the disease requires quickly identifying and treating patients in isolation, monitoring people who may have been exposed and safely burying the dead.
paras.zh: 埃博拉病毒通过直接接触患病或死亡者的血液或其他体液进行传播。遏制这种疾病需要快速识别和隔离患者、监测可能接触过病毒的人并安全埋葬死者。

paras.en: Fighting between the army and the Convention pour la révolution populaire rebels resumed Thursday morning in Iga-Barrière, a mining town about 25 kilometers (15 miles) north of Bunia in eastern Congo, sending new waves of displaced people toward the city. Bunia is the capital of northeastern Ituri province and a major hub for the Ebola response.
paras.zh: 周四上午，军队与人民革命大会叛乱分子之间的战斗在刚果东部布尼亚以北约 25 公里（15 英里）的采矿小镇伊加巴里尔重新爆发，新一波流离失所者涌入该市。布尼亚是东北部伊图里省的首府，也是应对埃博拉病毒的主要中心。

paras.en: CRP is one of more than 100 armed groups in eastern Congo, where conflict has created one of the world's most severe humanitarian crises. The group was founded last year by former warlord Thomas Lubanga, who was convicted by the International Criminal Court in 2012 of recruiting children under 15 and using them in fighting.
paras.zh: CRP 是刚果东部 100 多个武装团体之一，那里的冲突造成了世界上最严重的人道主义危机之一。该组织由前军阀托马斯·卢班加 (Thomas Lubanga) 去年创立，他于 2012 年因招募 15 岁以下儿童并利用他们参加战斗而被国际刑事法院定罪。

paras.en: Fighting between the army and the rebels earlier this week had already prevented teams from reaching some communities, disrupted monitoring of people exposed to the virus and left some treatment centers with fewer staff, Dr. Catherine Smallwood, the World Health Organization's Ebola incident manager, said Wednesday.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织埃博拉事件负责人凯瑟琳·斯莫尔伍德博士周三表示，本周早些时候，军队和叛军之间的战斗已经导致医疗队无法到达一些社区，扰乱了对病毒感染者的监测，并导致一些治疗中心的人员减少。

paras.en: Smallwood said that about a dozen people, including two WHO personnel and Congolese health officials, were evacuated to Bunia on Tuesday after three full days trapped in a hospital in Akwe, northeast of the provincial capital, amid intense crossfire.
paras.zh: 斯莫尔伍德说，在激烈的交火中，包括两名世卫组织人员和刚果卫生官员在内的大约十几人被困在省会东北部阿克维的一家医院三天后，于周二被疏散到布尼亚。

articles.title: Kevin Durant dishes on Steelers coach Mike McCarthy’s alleged ice cream snack habits after making NBA history

paras.en: Aaron Rodgers’ time with the Pittsburgh Steelers ended abruptly just one day before Thanksgiving. The team cut ties with the veteran quarterback shortly after benching him and following his disparaging comments about coach Mike McCarthy during an appearance on "The Pat McAfee Show" on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 亚伦·罗杰斯在匹兹堡钢人队的时光在感恩节前一天突然结束。在这位经验丰富的四分卫周三出现在“帕特·麦卡菲秀”上并对教练迈克·麦卡锡发表贬低言论后不久，球队就与这位经验丰富的四分卫断绝了关系。

paras.en: Rodgers, who was in his second season with the Steelers, made a series of allegations questioning McCarthy’s focus and work ethic. He claimed the coach had been caught "snoring" during team meetings and recently inadvertently ended a speech with "one, two, three, Packers."
paras.zh: 罗杰斯在钢人队的第二个赛季提出了一系列质疑麦卡锡的专注和职业道德的指控。他声称教练在球队会议期间被发现“打鼾”，最近无意中结束了与“一、二、三，包装工队”的演讲。

paras.en: Another allegation came from former Steelers defensive lineman Breiden Fehoko, who claimed that a Steelers player sent him a message reading: "McCarthy has a personal assistant who brings him ice cream sandwiches on demand."
paras.zh: 另一项指控来自前钢人队防守锋线球员布雷登·费霍科，他声称一名钢人队球员给他发了一条消息，上面写着：“麦卡锡有一名私人助理，可以根据需要为他送冰淇淋三明治。”

paras.en: Several sports figures have weighed in on Rodgers’ abrupt departure, with NBA star Kevin Durant among the latest to comment.
paras.zh: 几位体育界人士对罗杰斯的突然离开发表了看法，NBA球星凯文·杜兰特是最新发表评论的人之一。

paras.en: "Happy Thanksgiving, hiring a ice cream sandwich assistant for the day, great idea Mike," the Houston Rockets forward wrote on X on Thanksgiving morning.
paras.zh: “感恩节快乐，今天雇用一名冰淇淋三明治助理，好主意迈克，”这位休斯顿火箭队前锋在感恩节早上在 X 上写道。

paras.en: Durant's post surfaced hours after a 3-pointer in the first half of the Rockets game against the Phoenix Suns on Wednesday, made him the fifth NBA player to score 33,000 career points. Houston went to defeat Durant's former team 116-104, with Durant ending the game with 20 points.
