articles.title: YANG Launches 2027 Mentorship Program
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Young Auto Care Network Group (YANG), a community of the Auto Care Association, recently launched its 2027 YANG Mentorship Program. Now in its fifth year, the program averages 125 mentees and 24 volunteer mentors annually. Anyone under age 40 who joins the YANG community can participate for free.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会旗下社区青年汽车护理网络集团 (YANG) 最近启动了 2027 年 YANG 指导计划。该计划现已进入第五个年头，平均每年有 125 名学员和 24 名志愿者导师。任何 40 岁以下加入 YANG 社区的人都可以免费参与。

paras.en: “One of the most valuable aspects of my involvement with YANG has been the relationships I’ve built with individuals who genuinely challenge me to grow, both personally and professionally,” said Brandon Crenshaw, chair, YANG. “The Mentorship Program creates an opportunity to go beyond networking, by building meaningful connections, challenging your own perspectives, and developing the confidence and perspective to lead in new ways. It’s an experience I encourage every young professional in our industry to embrace.”
paras.zh: YANG 主席布兰登·克伦肖 (Brandon Crenshaw) 表示：“我参与 YANG 的最有价值的方面之一是我与那些真正挑战我成长的人建立了关系，无论是个人还是职业。” “导师计划通过建立有意义的联系、挑战自己的观点以及培养以新方式领导的信心和视角，创造了一个超越网络的机会。我鼓励我们行业的每一位年轻专业人士接受这种经历。”

paras.en: Each YANG mentee will rank industry-specific topics by preference to form mentorship circles. Examples of topics include:
paras.zh: 每个 YANG 学员都会根据偏好对特定行业主题进行排序，形成导师圈。主题示例包括：

paras.en: - Navigating change, building influence and earning your seat at the table
paras.zh: - 驾驭变革、建立影响力并赢得席位

paras.en: - Standing out and the importance of networking
paras.zh: - 脱颖而出和网络的重要性

paras.en: Each mentorship circle consists of approximately five mentees and one mentor focused on a unique topic.
paras.zh: 每个导师圈由大约五名学员和一名专注于某个独特主题的导师组成。

paras.en: Organizers will assign groups after registration closes Nov. 30. Participants will then join the YANG Mentorship Program kickoff meeting in January 2027. Each mentorship circle will meet once per quarter throughout 2027. The program runs from January through December 2027.
paras.zh: 组织者将在 11 月 30 日报名截止后分配小组。参与者随后将参加 2027 年 1 月举行的 YANG 导师计划启动会议。每个导师圈将在 2027 年每季度举行一次会议。该计划从 2027 年 1 月持续到 2027 年 12 月。

paras.en: The YANG Mentorship Program aims to help mentees experience all three YANG pillars: networking, professional development and giving back. Through this small-group mentorship program, mentees will benefit from the experience of automotive aftermarket veterans.
paras.zh: YANG 导师计划旨在帮助受训者体验 YANG 的所有三个支柱：网络、专业发展和回馈。通过这个小组辅导计划，学员将受益于汽车售后市场资深人士的经验。

paras.en: The program targets young automotive aftermarket professionals who want to advance their careers. It provides opportunities for members to focus on individual professional goals while developing the skills to become future leaders.
paras.zh: 该计划针对希望提升职业生涯的年轻汽车售后专业人士。它为会员提供了专注于个人职业目标的机会，同时培养成为未来领导者的技能。

articles.title: Up, Up and Awayyyy! Upselling and Cross-Selling at the Counter
articles.author: Thomas Dayton

paras.en: One of the ugliest stereotypes in our industry is that those of us behind the counter are simply a bunch of order-takers. There is a world of difference between a salesperson and an order-taker, and if you’re taking the time to read Counterman, I’m willing to bet that you aren’t just another order-taker. If you care enough to consider this a career, you’re already familiar with the value of upselling and the importance of add-on sales at the checkout counter.
paras.zh: 我们行业中最丑陋的刻板印象之一是，我们这些柜台后面的人只是一群接订单的人。销售人员和订单接受者之间存在天壤之别，如果您花时间阅读《Counterman》，我敢打赌您不仅仅是另一个订单接受者。如果您足够重视将其视为职业，那么您已经熟悉追加销售的价值以及收银台附加销售的重要性。

paras.en: For some retailers, those “add-on” sales take the form of impulse items at the counter or small items related to the repair, while others take a more holistic approach to the concept of increasing revenue per transaction. Make no mistake, revenue is the driving force behind the quotas and spiffs attached to these additional sales, but when applied correctly (and with a little finesse), upselling and/or cross-selling becomes both an effective sales tool and a time-saver for the customer.
paras.zh: 对于一些零售商来说，这些“附加”销售采取柜台冲动商品或与维修相关的小商品的形式，而其他零售商则采取更全面的方法来实现增加每笔交易收入的概念。毫无疑问，收入是这些额外销售所附带的配额和利润背后的驱动力，但如果应用得当（并且有一点技巧），追加销售和/或交叉销售既可以成为有效的销售工具，又可以为客户节省时间。

paras.en: It starts with understanding the complex association between the various systems of today’s automobile. I’ve often been guilty of thinking about parts as individual components rather than part of a larger ecosystem. I’m old, and “back in my day,” a lot of the parts we sold were a lot easier to get to without the need to disassemble half of the vehicle just to access them. Today’s crowded underhood environment means that replacing an alternator might require the technician to drain coolant or remove a CV axle just to access a few bolts. Increasingly, it also requires a special tool or three to extract the parts in need of replacement. Scenarios like that not only add unexpected labor to an otherwise straightforward repair, but may also lead to additional sales. The best time to suggest those supplemental parts and supplies is during the initial quote and sale, not after their vehicle is already scattered across the driveway outside of business hours. This version of a customer is in a considerably better mood, and more receptive to your suggestions than the one who just spent the afternoon struggling through a repair that still isn’t complete and is about to cost them more money than they anticipated!
paras.zh: 首先要了解当今汽车各个系统之间的复杂关联。我经常错误地将各个部分视为单独的组件，而不是更大生态系统的一部分。我老了，“回到我那个时代”，我们出售的许多零件都更容易获得，而不需要拆卸一半的车辆来获取它们。当今拥挤的引擎盖下环境意味着更换交流发电机可能需要技术人员排出冷却液或拆下CV轴才能检修几个螺栓。越来越多地，它还需要一个或三个特殊工具来提取需要更换的零件。类似的情况不仅给原本简单的维修增加了意想不到的劳动力，而且还可能带来额外的销售。建议这些补充零件和用品的最佳时间是在最初的报价和销售期间，而不是在工作时间之外他们的车辆已经散落在车道上之后。这个版本的客户心情要好得多，也比刚刚花了一个下午努力完成尚未完成的维修并且将花费比他们预期更多的钱的客户更容易接受您的建议！

paras.en: Labor-intensive repairs are an excellent time to upsell to a premium product. If a product saves time, has a longer service life, or includes associated components that might otherwise be overlooked, then those benefits help overcome many objections to price. Critical components, especially safety-related items, are another prime category for upselling. If the failure of a part is likely to cause catastrophic damage or compromise someone’s safety, it just isn’t worth skimping on quality. We don’t need to resort to scare tactics in order to sell our premium lines, but safety and security are important considerations for many buyers, so they become effective talking points when guiding a customer toward a particular product.
paras.zh: 劳动密集型维修是追加销售优质产品的绝佳时机。如果产品可以节省时间，具有更长的使用寿命，或者包含可能被忽视的相关组件，那么这些好处有助于克服对价格的许多反对意见。关键部件，尤其是与安全相关的部件，是追加销售的另一个主要类别。如果某个零件的故障可能会造成灾难性的损害或危及某人的安全，那么就不值得在质量上马虎。我们不需要采取恐吓策略来销售我们的优质产品，但安全和保障对于许多买家来说是重要的考虑因素，因此它们在引导客户购买特定产品时成为有效的话题。

paras.en: It is important to remember that potential up-sales and cross-sales should always benefit the customer first. Our customers’ continued confidence and trust will produce much more long-term profitability for our store than a series of one-off sales to customers who are put off by a pushy salesperson. You may be able to talk them into the current purchase, but they might think twice about making their next purchase with you, especially if their inflated expectations aren’t realized after the sale. Recommend only those items that will enhance the owner’s repair and ownership experience. Focus on adding value to the current purchase, not just adding zeroes to the invoice!
paras.zh: 重要的是要记住，潜在的追加销售和交叉销售应始终首先使客户受益。与那些被咄咄逼人的销售人员推迟的一系列一次性销售相比，客户持续的信心和信任将为我们的商店带来更多的长期盈利能力。您也许可以说服他们进行当前的购买，但他们可能会在下次与您一起购买时三思而后行，特别是如果他们夸大的期望在销售后没有实现的话。仅推荐那些能够增强车主的维修和拥有体验的物品。专注于为当前购买增值，而不仅仅是在发票上添加零！

articles.title: ‘Tis the Season: Forecasting for Demand
articles.author: Thomas Dayton

paras.en: Seasonal items present a unique challenge for purchasing and inventory specialists. While many of the products on our store shelves move at a steady and predictable rate throughout the year, seasonal items are confined to a narrower “window of opportunity” and are characterized by frequent or increased sales numbers within that window. An item with a steady demand throughout the year is a prime candidate for continuous restocking to maintain a ready supply on a daily basis. Seasonal items, on the other hand, will require an increased on-hand inventory level for only a brief period of time in order to maximize sales and profitability. Responding effectively to this temporary spike in demand requires a bit of planning and more than a bit of gambling.
paras.zh: 季节性商品对采购和库存专家提出了独特的挑战。虽然我们商店货架上的许多产品全年都以稳定且可预测的速度移动，但季节性商品仅限于较窄的“机会之窗”，其特点是该窗口内的销售数量频繁或增加。全年需求稳定的商品是持续补充库存以维持日常供应的主要候选商品。另一方面，季节性商品只需要在短时间内增加现有库存水平，即可最大限度地提高销售额和盈利能力。有效应对这种暂时的需求激增需要一些计划和一些赌博。

paras.en: Calculating demand for an individual SKU seems relatively simple, identifying the number of sales of that item within a set time period. Past performance helps us establish a base level for our immediate future needs. Extended out over time, that demand reveals sales patterns that indicate if sales of that SKU are growing, remaining steady, or falling off. We can use these patterns to adjust inventory levels, filling those needs as necessary to prevent out-of-stock situations as well as keeping overstock from chipping away at our profitability.
paras.zh: 计算单个 SKU 的需求似乎相对简单，只需确定该商品在设定时间段内的销售数量即可。过去的表现帮助我们为未来的需求奠定基础。随着时间的推移，这种需求揭示了销售模式，表明该 SKU 的销售额是增长、保持稳定还是下降。我们可以使用这些模式来调整库存水平，根据需要满足这些需求，以防止缺货情况，并防止库存过多削弱我们的盈利能力。

paras.en: Seasonal sales patterns will also reveal themselves, indicating the need for increased inventory volume for various products at certain times of the year. Forecasting the need for a particular item involves a number of factors. Lead time, availability, pricing and even weather predictions can have an effect on when to place these seasonal orders and how many of any particular SKU you expect to sell during that season. Unfortunately, political and economic factors can also influence the pricing and availability of our products. Many of us have seen the debilitating effects of the First Brands bankruptcy firsthand, as well as the widespread supply constraints throughout the petroleum industry. This has created shortages of product at the store level, and higher prices for most consumer goods through increased fuel costs. It not only affects our ability as vendors to plan ahead, but also the willingness of consumers to make purchases.
paras.zh: 季节性销售模式也会显现出来，表明在一年中的某些时间需要增加各种产品的库存量。预测特定物品的需求涉及许多因素。交货时间、供货情况、定价甚至天气预报都会影响何时下这些季节性订单以及您预计在该季节销售的任何特定 SKU 的数量。不幸的是，政治和经济因素也会影响我们产品的定价和可用性。我们中的许多人都亲眼目睹了第一品牌破产的破坏性影响，以及整个石油行业普遍存在的供应限制。这导致商店一级的产品短缺，并且由于燃料成本增加，大多数消费品的价格上涨。它不仅影响我们作为供应商提前计划的能力，也影响消费者的购买意愿。

paras.en: Forecasting remains our best defense against empty shelves when demand is at its peak, or a back room filled with overstock at the tail end of the rush. Recognizing seasonality on individual SKUs, even those we don’t normally consider “seasonal goods” allows us to anticipate increased demand before an item is needed, and to stock those additional items only when that demand justifies the extra expense. It should be proactive, rather than reactive. We’ve all seen the news reports of “panic buying” in the days leading up to a blizzard, hurricane, or other crisis, and we’re unlikely to forget the misery of trying to find N95 masks, toilet paper, and hand sanitizer during a pandemic. The time to build an ark is before the flood.
paras.zh: 预测仍然是我们应对需求高峰时货架空空，或高峰期末期库存积压的最佳防御措施。认识到单个 SKU 的季节性，即使是那些我们通常不认为是“季节性商品”的商品，也能让我们在需要某件商品之前预测需求的增加，并仅在该需求足以证明额外费用合理时才储存这些额外商品。它应该是主动的，而不是被动的。我们都看过暴风雪、飓风或其他危机前几天“抢购”的新闻报道，我们不太可能忘记在大流行期间试图找到 N95 口罩、卫生纸和洗手液的痛苦。建造方舟的时间是在洪水之前。

paras.en: Many tend to think of seasonal items in terms of winter, spring, summer, or fall goods, but there are a wide range of other “seasons” that can boost sales across product lines or even individual SKUs. The local racing season, planting and harvest times in rural markets, snowmobiling, boating, and RV travel seasons all represent opportunities to present those niche products others have overlooked. Those obvious categories like snowplow parts, lawn and garden or air conditioning parts have well-established seasonality, but determining the timing and duration of those seasons is becoming more of a moving target. Retailers can count on fixed “selling seasons” leading up to holidays like Halloween and Christmas, or the triple-threat of Black Friday, Small Business Saturday, and Cyber Monday. We can’t plan sales around “the first major snowfall” or “hottest week of the year” in quite the same way, but keeping tabs on recurring sales trends certainly allows us to maximize the effectiveness of our inventories throughout the year.
paras.zh: 许多人倾向于将季节性商品视为冬季、春季、夏季或秋季商品，但还有许多其他“季节”可以促进整个产品线甚至单个 SKU 的销售。当地的赛车季节、农村市场的种植和收获时间、雪地摩托、划船和房车旅行季节都代表了展示其他人忽视的利基产品的机会。那些明显的类别，如扫雪机零件、草坪和花园或空调零件，具有明确的季节性，但确定这些季节的时间和持续时间正变得越来越成为一个不断变化的目标。零售商可以依靠万圣节和圣诞节等假期之前的固定“销售季节”，或黑色星期五、小型企业星期六和网络星期一的三重威胁。我们无法以完全相同的方式围绕“第一场大雪”或“一年中最热的一周”计划销售，但密切关注经常性的销售趋势无疑使我们能够最大限度地提高全年库存的效率。

articles.title: Scientists may have discovered new branch on the human family tree, 100,000-year-old tooth in China suggests
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: In a cave in southern China, archaeologists have discovered an unusual 100,000-year-old tooth that may add a brand-new branch to the human family tree. A genetic analysis of the enamel revealed that the tooth is distinct from all other examples discovered in the area and may have come from an individual who belonged to a previously unknown ancient human lineage.
paras.zh: 在中国南方的一个洞穴中，考古学家发现了一颗不寻常的 10 万年前的牙齿，它可能会为人类谱系增添一个全新的分支。对牙釉质的基因分析表明，这颗牙齿与该地区发现的所有其他牙齿不同，可能来自属于先前未知的古人类血统的个体。

paras.en: In a study published Wednesday (Nov. 25) in the journal Nature, researchers described four isolated teeth recovered from two cave sites in southern China that date to around 100,000 years ago, when our extinct cousins the Denisovans roamed Asia. Teeth from one cave site are similar to Denisovans', but a tooth from the second site has a unique shape and genetic variants in the tooth enamel, suggesting it is from an "unresolved archaic Homo" group, the researchers wrote.
paras.zh: 在周三（11 月 25 日）《自然》杂志上发表的一项研究中，研究人员描述了从中国南部的两个洞穴遗址中发现的四颗孤立的牙齿，其历史可以追溯到大约 10 万年前，当时我们已灭绝的表亲丹尼索瓦人在亚洲漫游。研究人员写道，一个洞穴遗址的牙齿与丹尼索瓦人的牙齿相似，但第二个洞穴遗址的牙齿具有独特的形状和牙釉质的遗传变异，表明它来自一个“未解决的古代人”群体。

paras.en: The teeth were recovered from archaeological cave sites named Longchuandong and Chuanshandong in the Guangxi region. Based on uranium-series dating, the two teeth from Longchuandong — a molar and a bicuspid (the teeth between the canines and molars) — date to about 104,500 to 42,600 years ago, while the two teeth from Chuanshandong — which are both bicuspids — are at least 100,800 years old.
paras.zh: 这些牙齿是从广西地区龙川洞和川山东考古洞穴遗址中发现的。根据铀系测年，龙川洞的两颗牙齿——一颗臼齿和一颗二尖牙（犬齿和臼齿之间的牙齿）——可以追溯到大约 104,500 至 42,600 年前，而来自船山东的两颗牙齿——均为二尖牙——至少有 100,800 年前。

paras.en: To try to figure out which ancient human group these teeth belonged to, the researchers studied the shape and characteristics of the teeth and extracted proteins from the tooth enamel. The heritable traits of the two Longchuandong teeth lined up well with Denisovan teeth that had previously been identified, revealing that a Denisovan-related group was living in southern China in the Late Pleistocene (129,000 to 11,700 years ago), according to the study. But the Chuanshandong teeth — which the team thinks may be from the same individual — were very different.
paras.zh: 为了弄清楚这些牙齿属于哪个古代人类群体，研究人员研究了牙齿的形状和特征，并从牙釉质中提取了蛋白质。研究表明，龙川洞的两颗牙齿的遗传特征与之前发现的丹尼索瓦人牙齿非常吻合，表明晚更新世（距今129,000至11,700年前）中国南方生活着一个与丹尼索瓦人相关的群体。但船山东牙齿——研究小组认为这可能来自同一个人——却非常不同。

paras.en: The shape of the Chuanshandong bicuspids "did not align well with any established East Asian Homo member," the researchers wrote. For example, the Chuanshandong teeth had a complex tooth root system typically seen in Homo erectus, but they also had traits more aligned with Homo sapiens, including a more symmetrically shaped tooth crown.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道，船山东二尖牙的形状“与任何已确定的东亚人属成员都不太相符”。例如，船山东牙齿具有直立人常见的复杂牙根系统，但它们也具有更符合智人的特征，包括形状更对称的牙冠。

paras.en: The researchers extracted proteins from the Longchuandong teeth and one of the Chuanshandong bicuspids and discovered they were all from chromosomally male individuals. But while the Longchuandong proteins matched those from Denisovan remains that were unearthed elsewhere in China, several of the Chuanshandong protein variants have only been identified in H. erectus and Homo antecessor, an ancient human distantly related to Neanderthals and modern humans.
paras.zh: 研究人员从龙川洞牙齿和其中一颗川山东二尖牙中提取了蛋白质，发现它们都来自染色体男性个体。不过，虽然龙川洞蛋白与中国其他地方出土的丹尼索瓦人遗骸中的蛋白相匹配，但川山东蛋白的几种变体仅在直立人和始祖人（一种与尼安德特人和现代人类有远亲关系的古人类）中被发现。

paras.en: The protein analysis "showed that Chuanshandong formed a sister group to the common ancestors of Neanderthals, Denisovans and H. sapiens," the researchers wrote in the study. This means that "at least two non-sapiens Homo populations may have existed in southern China's subtropics during the Middle and Late Pleistocene," they wrote.
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究中写道，蛋白质分析“表明川山东人与尼安德特人、丹尼索瓦人和智人的共同祖先形成了一个姐妹群”。他们写道，这意味着“在中更新世和晚更新世期间，中国南部亚热带地区可能存在至少两个非智人种群”。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Given the small number of 100,000-year-old fossils from China that have been analyzed to date, it is unclear what the morphology and genetics of the Chuanshandong teeth mean for our understanding of human evolution, researchers say.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，鉴于迄今为止分析的中国 10 万年前化石数量很少，目前还不清楚船山东牙齿的形态和遗传学对于我们理解人类进化意味着什么。

paras.en: Denisovans were first identified in 2010, when DNA analysis of a tiny pinkie finger bone found in a Siberian cave revealed that the group was distinct from Neanderthals and modern humans. Since then, paleoanthropologists have discovered fossils all across Asia from our extinct cousins and learned that Denisovans, Neanderthals and modern humans all interbred when they had the chance. But Denisovans' and Neanderthals' genetics are known from full genomes — the complete set of their genetic material — while due to preservation issues, most of the fossils from China have only produced proteomes, a more limited set of genetic data that provides information on the body's proteins.
paras.zh: 丹尼索瓦人于 2010 年首次被识别，当时对西伯利亚洞穴中发现的一小块小指骨的 DNA 分析显示，该群体与尼安德特人和现代人类不同。从那时起，古人类学家在亚洲各地发现了我们已灭绝的近亲的化石，并了解到丹尼索瓦人、尼安德特人和现代人类只要有机会就会进行杂交。但丹尼索瓦人和尼安德特人的遗传学是通过完整的基因组（其遗传物质的完整集合）得知的，而由于保存问题，大多数来自中国的化石只产生了蛋白质组，这是一组更为有限的遗传数据，提供了有关人体蛋白质的信息。

paras.en: The Chuanshandong proteome included an ancestral genetic variant linking them to H. erectus and H. antecessor, two groups that lived before H. sapiens arrived on the scene. The presence of these variants suggests that the Chuanshandong teeth were from someone who belonged to a primitive Homo lineage, the researchers wrote. Their unique ancient proteins could also be explained by interbreeding with H. erectus.
paras.zh: 船山东蛋白质组包括一个祖先遗传变异，将它们与直立人和祖先这两个群体联系起来，这两个群体生活在智人到达现场之前。研究人员写道，这些变异的存在表明川山东牙齿来自原始人属谱系。它们独特的古老蛋白质也可以通过与直立人的杂交来解释。

paras.en: It's too early, though, to call this a new human group, study co-author Qiaomei Fu, director of the Ancient DNA Laboratory at the Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology, part of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 不过，该研究的共同作者、中国科学院古脊椎动物与古人类研究所古代DNA实验室主任付巧梅在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，现在将其称为新人类群体还为时过早。

paras.en: "We could call it the Chuanshandong group temporarily, but we need more fossil and molecular evidence to determine its affinity with other archaic Homo," Fu said. "It's not clear whether they are our cousins."
paras.zh: “我们可以暂时将其称为船山东群，但我们需要更多的化石和分子证据来确定它与其他古老人属的亲缘关系，”傅说。 “目前还不清楚他们是否是我们的表兄弟。”

paras.en: The new Chuanshandong proteome is extremely interesting, said John Hawks, an anthropologist at the University of Wisconsin-Madison who was not involved in the study. But "the paper characterizes this as an 'unknown Homo'. I wouldn't put it that way. The question is which group has variation of the proteome," he told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校人类学家约翰·霍克斯（John Hawks）没有参与这项研究，他说，新的穿山东蛋白质组非常有趣。但“这篇论文将其描述为‘未知的人’。我不会这么说。问题是哪个群体具有蛋白质组变异，”他在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: Hawks noted that it is currently unclear whether H. erectus or Denisovans had the specific variant identified in the Chuanshandong tooth, as paleoproteomic analysis is still a relatively new technique. If the genetic variant existed in H. erectus, then the Chuanshandong teeth, which are more similar to H. erectus in shape than they are to Neanderthals, may actually be from an H. erectus individual rather than a brand-new human group. But the comparison is further complicated by the fact that no one has yet found other Denisovan bicuspids — the type of tooth found in the Chuanshandong cave.
paras.zh: 霍克斯指出，目前尚不清楚直立人或丹尼索瓦人是否具有在穿山东牙齿中发现的特定变异，因为古蛋白质组分析仍然是一项相对较新的技术。如果直立人身上存在这种遗传变异，那么形状与直立人比尼安德特人更相似的川山东牙齿实际上可能来自直立人个体，而不是一个全新的人类群体。但由于目前还没有人发现其他丹尼索瓦人的二尖牙（即在船山东洞发现的牙齿类型），这一事实使比较变得更加复杂。

paras.en: "I have a feeling that a comprehensive analysis with all the teeth together would be stronger than these separate papers" that Fu's research team has published recently, Hawks said. "I think there is more to learn from compiling more complete analyses."
paras.zh: 霍克斯说，“我有一种感觉，将所有牙齿放在一起进行综合分析会比这些单独的论文更有力”，傅的研究小组最近发表了这一论文。 “我认为通过编制更完整的分析可以学到更多东西。”

paras.en: The researchers noted in the study that excavations have been ongoing in Guangxi caves for a decade, revealing a rich variety of Pleistocene mammal fossils, including ancient human relatives. This may mean that the pace of discoveries about our species' past will soon accelerate.
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究中指出，广西洞穴的发掘工作已经进行了十年，揭示了种类丰富的更新世哺乳动物化石，其中包括古代人类亲戚。这可能意味着关于我们物种过去的发现步伐将很快加快。

paras.en: "We have some new findings from this region, and we are conducting analyses on them," Fu said.
paras.zh: “我们从这个地区得到了一些新的发现，我们正在对其进行分析，”傅说。

paras.en: Xing, S., Rao, H., Xie, G., Bai, F., Ge, J., Bennett, E.A., Wu, Z., Shao, Q., Li, X., Viola, B., Sun, Q., Zhou, K., Li, Z., Jiangzuo, Q., Zhao, Y., Liu, F., Liu, Y., Feng, X., Lin, Q., Fu, Q. (2026). Middle-Late Pleistocene Denisovans and unresolved Homo in southern China. Nature. https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-11341-6
paras.zh: 邢S.、饶华、谢G.、白F.、葛J.、Bennett、E.A.、吴Z.、邵Q.、李X.、中提琴B.、孙Q.、周K.、李Z.、江作Q.、赵Y.、刘F.、刘Y.、冯X.、林Q.、付Q.(2026)。中国南方中更新世中晚期丹尼索瓦人和未解决的人属。自然。 https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-11341-6

paras.en: Human evolution quiz: What do you know about Homo sapiens?
paras.zh: 人类进化测验：你对智人了解多少？

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: California braces for triple flooding threat as 'king tides' overlap with 'super' El Niño
articles.author: Sascha Pare

paras.en: Major flooding of up to 2.7 feet (0.8 meters) is expected in parts of California today (Nov. 25) as record-breaking tides, El Niño-fueled conditions and warmer-than-average ocean water converge along the state's coast.
paras.zh: 由于破纪录的潮汐、厄尔尼诺现象和高于平均水平的海水沿着该州海岸汇聚，今天（11 月 25 日）加州部分地区预计将出现高达 2.7 英尺（0.8 米）的严重洪水。

paras.en: The triple flooding threat is expected to hit the San Francisco Bay Area especially hard, with San Francisco International Airport and other low-lying areas of the city bracing for deluges, while officials warned of dangerous breaking waves measuring 20 to 30 feet (6 to 9 m) tall along San Francisco's coast, the San Francisco Chronicle reported.
paras.zh: 据《旧金山纪事报》报道，三重洪水威胁预计将对旧金山湾区造成特别严重的影响，旧金山国际机场和该市其他低洼地区将面临洪水，同时官员警告称，旧金山海岸将出现 20 至 30 英尺（6 至 9 m）高的危险破浪。

paras.en: Meanwhile, in Southern California, coastal communities should expect potentially record-breaking "king tides" and breaking waves up to 15 feet (4.6 m) high, the National Weather Service warned on its website. King tides are exceptionally high tides that occur every year due to seasonal factors and the alignment of Earth, the sun and the moon — but this year's "super" El Niño has amplified the risk by pushing a massive "Kelvin wave" up California's coast.
paras.zh: 与此同时，美国国家气象局在其网站上警告说，在南加州，沿海社区可能会出现破纪录的“大潮”，巨浪高达 15 英尺（4.6 m）。王潮是每年由于季节性因素以及地球、太阳和月亮的排列而发生的异常高潮，但今年的“超级”厄尔尼诺现象通过将巨大的“开尔文波”推向加利福尼亚海岸，放大了风险。

paras.en: Citing the forecast, several cities on California's central coast have closed beaches to shield people from hazards, including sudden waves that could wash beachgoers out to sea. Local authorities have also urged residents to limit unnecessary travel during the Thanksgiving holiday.
paras.zh: 加州中部海岸的几个城市援引这一预测，关闭了海滩，以保护人们免受危险，包括可能将海滩游客冲到海里的突然海浪。地方当局还敦促居民在感恩节假期期间限制不必要的出行。

paras.en: The flooding comes as a perfect storm of adverse conditions has gathered on California's coastline. Scientists expected the king tides and the coastal flooding associated with them to emerge this time of the year. However, these powerful tides are now arriving on top of blistering sea temperatures due to accelerating climate change and the current El Niño event — the warm phase of a multiyear natural climate pattern that's in full swing and set to intensify through the end of the year.
paras.zh: 这场洪水发生之际，加州海岸线正遭遇一场恶劣条件下的完美风暴。科学家预计每年的这个时候会出现大潮和与之相关的沿海洪水。然而，由于气候变化加速和当前的厄尔尼诺事件，这些强大的潮汐现在正在汹涌的海水温度之上到来。厄尔尼诺事件是多年自然气候模式的温暖阶段，该现象正在全面展开，并将在年底加剧。

paras.en: Ocean water expands as it warms, swelling tides and raising the risk of strong surf and big waves. As a result, this year's tides are predicted to be at their highest levels since January 1983, when tides also coincided with El Niño-fueled storms, AFP reported.
paras.zh: 海水随着变暖而膨胀，导致潮汐膨胀，增加出现强烈海浪和巨浪的风险。据法新社报道，今年的潮汐预计将达到 1983 年 1 月以来的最高水平，当时的潮汐也与厄尔尼诺引发的风暴同时发生。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: - 'This is such a clear story': Climate change is supercharging El Niño to unprecedented strengths, study finds
paras.zh: - “这是一个如此清晰的故事”：研究发现，气候变化正在使厄尔尼诺现象变得前所未有的强大

paras.en: - The super El Niño could cause torrential rainstorms. Americans may need to stock up on food to prepare, experts say.
paras.zh: - 超级厄尔尼诺现象可能引发暴雨。专家表示，美国人可能需要储备食物以备不时之需。

paras.en: - Super El Niño may push an already stressed climate ecosystem across a critical threshold, climate change researcher says
paras.zh: - 气候变化研究人员表示，超级厄尔尼诺现象可能会将本已紧张的气候生态系统推向一个关键阈值

paras.en: In January 1983, "all hell broke loose," Reinhard Flick, a researcher at the Scripps Institution of Oceanography at the University of California, San Diego, told AFP. "We had 13-foot (4-meter) waves offshore, the highest tides of the year, and hundreds of millions of dollars in damage. It hit Northern California, Southern California, everybody."
paras.zh: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校斯克里普斯海洋学研究所研究员莱因哈德·弗里克告诉法新社，1983 年 1 月，“一切都乱了套”。 “我们近海遭遇了 13 英尺（4 米）高的海浪，这是今年最高的潮汐，造成了数亿美元的损失。北加州、南加州的所有人都受到了影响。”

paras.en: Forecasts suggest this week's conditions won't be quite that bad. But there are risks to be aware of going into winter, especially as El Niño has yet to peak and more king tides are expected in December and January.
paras.zh: 预测表明本周的情况不会那么糟糕。但进入冬季也存在风险，尤其是厄尔尼诺现象尚未达到顶峰，预计 12 月和 1 月将出现更多大潮。

paras.en: "It could potentially be quite bad if we also have rainfall and high waves at the same time during any one of these big events, especially December and January, when rainfall generally increases on our coast," Flick said.
paras.zh: 弗里克说：“如果在任何一次重大事件期间，特别是 12 月和 1 月，我们海岸的降雨量普遍增加，如果我们同时出现降雨和巨浪，情况可能会非常糟糕。”

paras.en: Sascha is a U.K.-based staff writer at Live Science. She holds a bachelor’s degree in biology from the University of Southampton in England and a master’s degree in science communication from Imperial College London. Her work has appeared in The Guardian and the health website Zoe. Besides writing, she enjoys playing tennis, bread-making and browsing second-hand shops for hidden gems.
paras.zh: Sascha 是 Live Science 驻英国的特约撰稿人。她拥有英国南安普顿大学生物学学士学位和伦敦帝国理工学院科学传播硕士学位。她的作品曾出现在《卫报》和健康网站 Zoe 上。除了写作之外，她还喜欢打网球、制作面包和逛二手店寻找隐藏的宝石。

articles.title: 'Like designing a new key to open a defective lock': AI-designed protein tricks defective insulin receptors into working
articles.author: Anirban Mukhopadhyay

paras.en: A protein designed with the help of artificial intelligence (AI) has successfully switched on faulty insulin receptors in lab mice even when insulin itself couldn't.
paras.zh: 一种在人工智能 (AI) 帮助下设计的蛋白质已成功开启实验室小鼠体内有缺陷的胰岛素受体，而胰岛素本身却无法开启。

paras.en: The findings hint at a new way to treat certain rare, life-threatening genetic disorders that cause insulin resistance, in which the body's cells don't respond well to the blood-sugar-controlling hormone.
paras.zh: 这些发现暗示了一种治疗某些罕见的、危及生命的遗传性疾病的新方法，这些遗传性疾病会导致胰岛素抵抗，即人体细胞对血糖控制激素的反应不佳。

paras.en: In a study published Wednesday (Nov. 25) in the journal Science Translational Medicine, researchers found that the AI-designed protein, called RF-409, lowered blood sugar and reduced damage to the pancreas in mice with a genetic form of severe insulin resistance. This, in turn, prevented dangerous weight loss that typically comes with the condition.
paras.zh: 在周三（11 月 25 日）《科学转化医学》杂志上发表的一项研究中，研究人员发现，人工智能设计的蛋白质 RF-409 可以降低患有遗传性严重胰岛素抵抗的小鼠的血糖，并减少对胰腺的损害。这反过来又防止了通常伴随这种情况而来的危险的体重减轻。

paras.en: When blood sugar rises, the pancreas releases insulin, a hormone that binds to proteins called insulin receptors on the surface of cells. This changes the receptors' shape, triggering a series of chemical signals that ultimately help bring blood sugar levels back down.
paras.zh: 当血糖升高时，胰腺会释放胰岛素，这是一种与细胞表面称为胰岛素受体的蛋白质结合的激素。这会改变受体的形状，触发一系列化学信号，最终帮助血糖水平回落。

paras.en: But mutations in the gene that encodes the insulin receptor can disrupt this process. More than 150 such mutations have been linked to inherited forms of insulin resistance. In one of the most severe forms, called Donohue syndrome, children can experience dangerously high blood sugar after eating, and unusually low blood sugar between meals, as well as poor growth. Most children with the condition die before their first birthday.
paras.zh: 但编码胰岛素受体的基因突变可能会破坏这一过程。超过 150 种此类突变与遗传性胰岛素抵抗有关。其中一种最严重的形式称为多诺霍综合症，儿童在进食后可能会出现危险的高血糖，两餐之间的血糖会异常低，并且生长缓慢。大多数患有这种疾病的儿童在一岁生日前死亡。

paras.en: "Some [of these] patients produce extremely high levels of insulin, but their receptors cannot respond properly," study co-author Eunhee Choi, a cell biologist at Columbia University, told Live Science. "Simply giving more insulin may not solve the problem."
paras.zh: 研究合著者、哥伦比亚大学细胞生物学家 Eunhee Choi 告诉《Live Science》：“其中一些患者会产生极高水平的胰岛素，但他们的受体无法正常反应。” “仅仅给予更多胰岛素可能无法解决问题。”

paras.en: That's why Choi and her colleagues explored whether they could activate the receptor in another way.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么 Choi 和她的同事探索是否可以通过另一种方式激活受体。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: In 2025, the researchers used computational tools, including AlphaFold2, an AI program that predicts protein structures and how they fit together, to develop proteins that activate insulin receptors in a different way than insulin does. In that previous study, one of those proteins, RF-409, lowered blood sugar in both healthy mice and mice with obesity. In the new research, the team wanted to see whether RF-409 could also activate defective insulin receptors.
paras.zh: 2025 年，研究人员使用计算工具，包括 AlphaFold2（一种预测蛋白质结构及其如何组合的人工智能程序）来开发以与胰岛素不同的方式激活胰岛素受体的蛋白质。在之前的研究中，其中一种蛋白质 RF-409 可以降低健康小鼠和肥胖小鼠的血糖。在这项新研究中，研究小组希望了解 RF-409 是否也能激活有缺陷的胰岛素受体。

paras.en: First, they ran experiments with laboratory-grown mouse and rat cells and with healthy mice, both with working insulin receptors. This confirmed that RF-409 largely mimicked insulin's effects on cellular signaling and metabolism. In the mice, RF-409 had a nearly 60-fold longer half-life in the bloodstream than insulin, meaning the protein stays in circulation much longer before breaking down.
paras.zh: 首先，他们对实验室培养的小鼠和大鼠细胞以及健康小鼠进行了实验，两者都具有工作胰岛素受体。这证实 RF-409 在很大程度上模仿了胰岛素对细胞信号传导和代谢的影响。在小鼠体内，RF-409 在血液中的半衰期比胰岛素长近 60 倍，这意味着该蛋白质在分解之前在循环中停留的时间要长得多。

paras.en: "Both these features make [the finding] more than just an elegant trick," said Dr. Rajiv Agarwal, a nephrologist at Indiana University School of Medicine who was not involved in the study. Unlike a protein that mimics only some of insulin's effects, RF-409 reproduces most of its normal signaling, "which matters in children who need growth as well as glucose control," he added.
paras.zh: “这两个特征使得[这一发现]不仅仅是一个优雅的技巧，”印第安纳大学医学院的肾病学家拉吉夫·阿加瓦尔博士说，他没有参与这项研究。与仅模仿胰岛素部分作用的蛋白质不同，RF-409 复制了大部分正常信号，“这对于需要生长和血糖控制的儿童很重要，”他补充道。

paras.en: To test how RF-409 works with defective receptors, the researchers focused on a mutation previously identified in patients with Donohue syndrome; this genetic mutation alters a key part of the receptor's structure, preventing insulin from binding to it. Computer models suggested that RF-409 could bypass the affected region and hold the receptor in the shape needed to transmit signals inside cells.
paras.zh: 为了测试 RF-409 如何与有缺陷的受体发挥作用，研究人员重点关注了先前在多诺霍综合征患者中发现的突变。这种基因突变改变了受体结构的关键部分，阻止胰岛素与其结合。计算机模型表明，RF-409 可以绕过受影响的区域，并将受体保持在细胞内传输信号所需的形状。

paras.en: The researchers genetically engineered mice to carry this mutation. Compared with mice that retained a functioning copy of the insulin receptor gene, these mice had, on average, roughly 2.5 times higher blood sugar and 10 times higher fasting insulin levels (the amount of insulin in blood after a period without food).
paras.zh: 研究人员对小鼠进行基因改造使其携带这种突变。与保留胰岛素受体基因功能性拷贝的小鼠相比，这些小鼠的血糖平均高出约 2.5 倍，空腹胰岛素水平（一段时间没有进食后血液中的胰岛素含量）高出 10 倍。

paras.en: When injected with insulin, mice with defective receptors showed no substantial drop in blood sugar. Treatment with RF-409, however, lowered mice's blood sugar by roughly 60% within two hours.
paras.zh: 当注射胰岛素时，受体缺陷的小鼠的血糖没有显着下降。然而，使用 RF-409 治疗后，小鼠的血糖在两小时内降低了约 60%。

paras.en: "It is like designing a new key to open a defective lock," said Kalaiarasan Ponnusamy, a computational biologist at SRM Institute of Science and Technology in India who was not involved in the study. "From a computational protein-design perspective, this is a major advance because it demonstrates that entirely new proteins can be engineered to restore receptor function without correcting the underlying genetic mutation."
paras.zh: “这就像设计一把新钥匙来打开一把有缺陷的锁，”印度 SRM 科学技术研究所的计算生物学家 Kalaiarasan Ponnusamy 说，他没有参与这项研究。 “从计算蛋白质设计的角度来看，这是一个重大进步，因为它表明可以设计全新的蛋白质来恢复受体功能，而无需纠正潜在的基因突变。”

paras.en: After 14 days of continuous treatment, five mice given RF-409 had lower blood sugar, maintained their body weight and retained more abdominal fat than five mice given a saline solution, for comparison. The treated mice also showed less pancreatic damage.
paras.zh: 经过 14 天的连续治疗后，与 5 只服用生理盐水的小鼠相比，5 只服用 RF-409 的小鼠血糖更低，体重保持不变，并且保留了更多的腹部脂肪。接受治疗的小鼠的胰腺损伤也较少。

paras.en: "Extending this approach to other disease-causing receptor mutations is a realistic possibility, provided the receptor retains its ability to transmit signals," Ponnusamy said. Some mutations, for instance, prevent insulin receptors from reaching the cell surface or transmitting signals inside cells at all. That means the technique demonstrated in the study is unlikely to work against such mutations.
paras.zh: Ponnusamy 说：“只要受体保留其传输信号的能力，将这种方法扩展到其他引起疾病的受体突变是一种现实的可能性。”例如，一些突变会阻止胰岛素受体到达细胞表面或根本无法在细胞内传递信号。这意味着研究中展示的技术不太可能对抗此类突变。

paras.en: Identifying which mutations can be treated in this way is now a priority for Choi. The team also plans to investigate how RF-409 affects different tissues in the body and whether it remains safe and effective over longer periods of treatment, she said.
paras.zh: 确定哪些突变可以通过这种方式治疗是 Choi 现在的首要任务。她说，该团队还计划研究 RF-409 如何影响体内不同组织，以及它在较长时间内是否仍然安全有效。

paras.en: Although Agarwal foresees several hurdles in bringing RF-409 into clinical use; for instance, the immune system's reaction to the protein will have to be carefully studied, and in general, it's challenging to run trials with infants with rare disorders. That said, he remains hopeful that it could help patients whose diseases have no treatments to treat the underlying cause.
paras.zh: 尽管 Agarwal 预见到将 RF-409 投入临床使用会遇到一些障碍；例如，必须仔细研究免疫系统对蛋白质的反应，而且一般来说，对患有罕见疾病的婴儿进行试验具有挑战性。尽管如此，他仍然希望它能够帮助那些无法治疗疾病的患者从根本上治疗疾病。

paras.en: "This is the first approach I have seen that addresses the actual defect rather than working around it," he said.
paras.zh: “这是我见过的第一个解决实际缺陷而不是解决它的方法，”他说。

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Hung, A., Wang, X., Gao, M., Ng, M., Oliinyk, D., Weaver, R., Zollbrecht, E., Cardoso, S., Ronel, G. S., Paolucci, C., Ye, J., Fan, Q. R., Rhea, E., Mann, M., Baker, D., Accili, D., & Choi, E. (2026). Reprogramming insulin receptor activation with a de novo agonist to overcome severe preclinical insulin resistance. Science Translational Medicine, 18, eaei0487. https://dx.doi.org/10.1126/scitranslmed.aei0487
paras.zh: Hung, A.、Wang, X.、Gao, M.、Ng, M.、Oliinyk, D.、Weaver, R.、Zollbrecht, E.、Cardoso, S.、Ronel, G. S.、Paolucci, C.、Ye, J.、Fan, Q. R.、Rhea, E.、Mann, M.、Baker, D.、Accili, D. 和 Choi, E. (2026)。用从头激动剂重新编程胰岛素受体激活，以克服严重的临床前胰岛素抵抗。科学转化医学，18，eaei0487。 https://dx.doi.org/10.1126/scitranslmed.aei0487

paras.en: Anirban Mukhopadhyay is an independent science journalist. He holds a PhD in genetics and a master’s in computational biology and drug design. He regularly writes for The Hindu and has contributed to The Wire Science, where he conveys complex biomedical research to the public in accessible language. Beyond science writing, he enjoys creating and reading fiction that blends myth, memory, and melancholy into surreal tales exploring grief, identity, and the quiet magic of self-discovery. In his free time, he loves long walks with his dog and motorcycling across The Himalayas.
paras.zh: Anirban Mukhopadhyay 是一位独立科学记者。他拥有遗传学博士学位以及计算生物学和药物设计硕士学位。他定期为《印度教徒报》撰稿，并为《The Wire Science》撰稿，以通俗易懂的语言向公众传达复杂的生物医学研究成果。除了科学写作之外，他还喜欢创作和阅读小说，将神话、记忆和忧郁融入超现实故事中，探索悲伤、身份和自我发现的安静魔力。在空闲时间，他喜欢与他的狗一起长途散步和骑摩托车穿越喜马拉雅山。

articles.title: Indigenous Hunters Drove Bison Off This Tall Cliff for 3,000 Years. It's Only the Second Buffalo Jump Ever Discovered in Texas

paras.en: For thousands of years, Indigenous communities in what is now Texas hunted bison by herding them toward the edge of a high cliff, sending the large animals plunging to their deaths below.
paras.zh: 数千年来，现在德克萨斯州的原住民社区通过将野牛赶到高高的悬崖边缘来猎杀野牛，然后将大型动物扔到下面死亡。

paras.en: That’s the conclusion archaeologists have reached after discovering bison bones, chipped stone tools and arrowheads beneath a 65-foot-tall cliff. Some of the bones bear cut marks suggesting prehistoric butchery, while many others have compression fractures indicating they fell from a great height. Together, the evidence pointed to the discovery of a “bison jump,” researchers report in a paper published earlier this month in the journal American Antiquity.
paras.zh: 这是考古学家在 65 英尺高的悬崖下发现野牛骨头、碎石工具和箭头后得出的结论。一些骨头上有切割痕迹，表明是史前屠杀，而其他许多骨头上有压缩性骨折，表明它们是从高处坠落的。研究人员在本月早些时候发表在《美国古代》杂志上的一篇论文中报告说，所有证据都表明发现了“野牛跳跃”。

paras.en: Archaeologists have found numerous bison jumps across the northern Great Plains, a vast region that stretches from Nebraska to Alberta. But, until now, only one such site had been found in the southern Great Plains, which includes Texas. The newly discovered bison jump, called Nighthawk, suggests the Indigenous practice of herding bison off cliffs may have been more widespread than previously thought.
paras.zh: 考古学家在北部大平原上发现了许多野牛跳跃，这是一个从内布拉斯加州延伸到阿尔伯塔省的广阔地区。但到目前为止，在包括德克萨斯州在内的大平原南部只发现了一处这样的遗址。新发现的野牛跳跃现象被称为“夜鹰”，表明原住民将野牛赶下悬崖的做法可能比之前想象的更为普遍。

paras.en: “The fact that we found this site is pretty incredible,” Tamra Walter, an archaeologist at Texas Tech University, told Texas Parks & Wildlife Magazine’s Eva Frederick in 2023. “It’s a once-in-a-lifetime kind of site. It’s so incredibly rare.”
paras.zh: 德克萨斯理工大学的考古学家塔姆拉·沃尔特 (Tamra Walter) 在 2023 年对德克萨斯公园与野生动物杂志的伊娃·弗雷德里克 (Eva Frederick) 表示：“我们发现这个遗址的事实非常令人难以置信。这是一个千载难逢的遗址。非常罕见。”

paras.en: Nighthawk is located in Caprock Canyons State Park, a roughly 17,500-acre protected area in Briscoe County, situated between Amarillo and Lubbock in the Texas Panhandle. Today, the park is home to the Texas State Bison Herd, which officials say is made up of the descendants of the tens of millions of Southern Plains bison that used to roam the land.
paras.zh: 夜鹰位于卡普罗克峡谷州立公园内，这是布里斯科县的一个保护区，占地约 17,500 英亩，位于德克萨斯州狭长地带的阿马里洛和拉伯克之间。如今，该公园是德克萨斯州野牛群的家园，官员们称该野牛群是由曾经在这片土地上漫步的数千万头南部平原野牛的后代组成的。

paras.en: In November 2021, Rick and Susan Day—science teachers at nearby Lockney Junior High School—were out hiking in the park when they spotted hundreds of bones jutting out from a cliff side, Texas Parks & Wildlife Magazine reported.
paras.zh: 据《德克萨斯公园与野生动物》杂志报道，2021 年 11 月，附近洛克尼初中的科学老师里克和苏珊·戴在公园里徒步旅行时，发现数百块骨头从悬崖边伸出。

paras.en: Archaeologists spent months excavating the site, ultimately determining that it was the first bison jump discovered in Texas in more than six decades. The only other known bison jump in the state is called Bonfire Shelter. It’s located in Val Verde County, close to the Mexico border, and was discovered in the 1960s.
paras.zh: 考古学家花了几个月的时间挖掘该地点，最终确定这是六十多年来在德克萨斯州发现的第一次野牛跳跃。该州唯一已知的野牛跳跃点被称为篝火避难所。它位于 Val Verde 县，靠近墨西哥边境，于 20 世纪 60 年代被发现。

paras.en: Radiocarbon dating revealed that at least seven mass bison kills took place at Nighthawk over a roughly 3,000-year period, as far back as 3,500 years ago. The kill events took place every 500 years, on average.
paras.zh: 放射性碳测年显示，在大约 3,000 年间，早在 3,500 年前，夜鹰至少发生过 7 次大规模猎杀野牛的事件。平均每 500 年就会发生一次杀戮事件。

paras.en: “The simplest explanation for long-lived jump facilities is that these techniques were passed down over long time spans rather than revived again and again,” the researchers write in the paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在论文中写道：“对长寿跳跃设施的最简单解释是，这些技术是在很长一段时间内传承下来的，而不是一次又一次地复兴。”

paras.en: At other bison jump sites, researchers think Indigenous hunters likely herded bison into a stampede toward a surprise fall off the edge of a cliff. Nighthawk, however, probably operated “more like ‘walking the plank,’” the researchers write in the paper, with Indigenous hunters taking advantage of the cliff’s natural spur shape to guide the massive animals to their deaths.
paras.zh: 在其他野牛跳跃地点，研究人员认为，土著猎人可能会驱赶野牛，导致野牛突然从悬崖边缘跌落。然而，研究人员在论文中写道，夜鹰的运作方式可能“更像是‘在木板上行走’”，土著猎人利用悬崖的天然山刺形状来引导这种大型动物走向死亡。

paras.en: Scientists aren’t sure what Indigenous hunters did with all the bison meat they obtained from these mass kill events. In the northern Plains, bison jumps are thought to have been used primarily in the fall, to help Indigenous communities stock up on pemmican, a long-lasting concoction made of dried meat and rendered fat, for the impending winter. But Texas was probably too warm for pemmican, as the high temperatures would have caused the fat to melt and, eventually, go rancid.
paras.zh: 科学家们不确定土著猎人如何处理从这些大规模屠杀事件中获得的所有野牛肉。在北部平原，野牛跳跃被认为主要在秋季使用，以帮助原住民社区储备干肉饼，这是一种由干肉和提炼脂肪制成的持久混合物，以应对即将到来的冬季。但德克萨斯州对于肉饼来说可能太温暖了，因为高温会导致脂肪融化并最终腐臭。

paras.en: Dense in protein and calories, pemmican was also eaten by fur traders in the North American wilderness, as well as Antarctic explorers, who combined it with sledging biscuits and water to make a concoction known as “hoosh.”
paras.zh: 干肉饼富含蛋白质和热量，北美荒野的毛皮商人和南极探险家也吃干肉干饼，他们将干肉干饼与雪橇饼干和水混合，制成一种名为“hoosh”的混合物。

paras.en: This leads the archaeologists to posit that, in the south, bison jumps may have been less about food and more about “social or political ambitions,” as they write in the paper. The mass kill events may have brought communities together for ceremonies, trade, celebrations and other events that helped strengthen relationships.
paras.zh: 这使得考古学家推测，在南方，野牛的跳跃可能与食物无关，而更多地与“社会或政治野心”有关，正如他们在论文中所写的那样。大规模杀戮事件可能使社区聚集在一起举行仪式、贸易、庆祝活动和其他有助于加强关系的活动。

paras.en: Whatever the explanation, bison jumping was a large-scale operation that required extensive planning and cooperation among multiple groups of people. “It’s a community activity,” lead author August “Gus” Costa, an anthropologist at Rice University, says in a statement. “They require a large group of people working together to be successful.”
paras.zh: 无论解释如何，野牛跳跃都是一项大规模行动，需要多组人员进行广泛的规划和合作。 “这是一项社区活动，”莱斯大学人类学家、主要作者奥古斯特·“格斯”·科斯塔在一份声明中说。 “他们需要一大群人共同努力才能取得成功。”

paras.en: Moving forward, researchers hope to compare ancient DNA from the bison remains found at Nighthawk to the herd that is roaming around the park today.
paras.zh: 展望未来，研究人员希望将夜鹰发现的野牛遗骸中的古代 DNA 与今天在公园周围漫步的牛群进行比较。

paras.en: “The unique lineage of the Southern Plains bison that live in the park, how far back can we chase that?” Costa tells KFDA’s Canion Cavazos.
paras.zh: “公园里生活着的南部平原野牛的独特血统，我们能追溯到多久以前？” Costa 告诉 KFDA 的 Canion Cavazos。

articles.title: Meet Earth's New 'Mini-Moon' 2026 QQ8, a Six-Foot-Wide Asteroid That's Temporarily Circling Our Planet

paras.en: Earth has a new “mini-moon”—at least for another few weeks.
paras.zh: 地球有一个新的“迷你月亮”——至少还会持续几周。

paras.en: The temporary companion, dubbed 2026 QQ8, entered orbit around our planet in April. Though it was first observed back in August by Hungarian astronomer Krisztián Sárneczky, scientists needed time to confirm whether the object was human-made or celestial. People previously mistook the European Space Agency’s Gaia observatory for a mini-moon, after all, according to Asa Stahl at the Planetary Society.
paras.zh: 这个临时伴星被称为 2026 QQ8，于 4 月进入绕地球轨道。尽管匈牙利天文学家 Krisztián Sárneczky 在八月份首次观测到该物体，但科学家们仍需要时间来确认该物体是人造物体还是天体。毕竟，根据行星协会的阿萨·斯塔尔的说法，人们此前曾将欧洲航天局的盖亚天文台误认为是迷你月球。

paras.en: Finally, on October 29, the International Astronomical Union’s Minor Planet Center announced that the object is, indeed, a space rock. It’ll keep circling Earth until sometime in December or January, after which it will continue its regular orbit around the sun.
paras.zh: 最终，10 月 29 日，国际天文学联合会小行星中心宣布，该物体确实是一颗太空岩石。它将继续绕地球运行，直到十二月或一月的某个时候，之后它将继续绕太阳运行其常规轨道。

paras.en: According to the Minor Planet Center, the object is only about six feet in diameter. Astronomers doubt it poses any danger to Earth, but even if it did get too close, it’s so small that it would probably burn up in our planet’s atmosphere. It’s also orbiting us from fairly far away—roughly 1.5 times the average distance of the moon, Joanna Thompson reports for Live Science.
paras.zh: 据小行星中心称，该物体的直径仅为约六英尺。天文学家怀疑它会对地球构成任何危险，但即使它确实离地球太近，它也太小了，很可能会在我们星球的大气层中燃烧。乔安娜·汤普森 (Joanna Thompson) 在《Live Science》杂志上报道称，它还从相当远的地方围绕我们运行——大约是月球平均距离的 1.5 倍。

paras.en: This tiny traveler isn’t our first mini-moon, which is an informal term. When little objects pass by Earth, they occasionally get captured by our planet’s gravity. They spend less than a year, on average, orbiting us before being flung back into space. Many scientists speculate that we always have at least one mini-moon. A study published last year even suggests Earth hosts at least six of them at any given time. Despite those postulations, only four other mini-moons have previously been observed, since they’re so small and hard to detect, per the Planetary Society.
paras.zh: 这个小旅行者并不是我们的第一个迷你月亮，这是一个非正式术语。当小物体经过地球时，它们偶尔会被地球的引力捕获。它们在被抛回太空之前平均花费不到一年的时间绕我们运行。许多科学家推测我们总是至少有一个迷你月亮。去年发表的一项研究甚至表明，地球在任何特定时间都至少拥有六个这样的行星。尽管有这些假设，但根据行星协会的说法，之前只观察到了另外四个迷你卫星，因为它们太小而且很难被发现。

paras.en: Sárneczky, a research coordinator at the Konkoly Observatory in Hungary, says he spotted 2026 QQ8 while “searching for near-Earth asteroids, as I have done on every clear night since 2020.”
paras.zh: 匈牙利 Konkoly 天文台的研究协调员 Sárneczky 表示，他在“寻找近地小行星时发现了 2026 QQ8，就像我自 2020 年以来在每个晴朗的夜晚所做的那样。”

paras.en: “At the time of its discovery, it appeared just like the nearly 400 other near-Earth asteroids I had found,” he tells Jacopo Prisco at CNN. “Its unique nature only became apparent later, following the precise orbital calculations.”
paras.zh: “在发现它时，它看起来就像我发现的近 400 颗其他近地小行星一样，”他告诉 CNN 的雅科波·普里斯科 (Jacopo Prisco)。 “经过精确的轨道计算后，它的独特性质才变得明显。”

paras.en: That triggered a weeks-long study by astronomers trying to determine the object’s nature, per the outlet. With the help of the Lowell Discovery Telescope in Arizona and the University of Hawaii’s telescope on Mauna Kea, they confirmed it was born in space.
paras.zh: 据报道，这引发了天文学家为期数周的研究，试图确定该物体的性质。 With the help of the Lowell Discovery Telescope in Arizona and the University of Hawaii’s telescope on Mauna Kea, they confirmed it was born in space.

paras.en: These objects are asteroids that, from a certain point of view, appear to behave like a moon of Earth, according to the Planetary Society. However, they’re actually orbiting the sun—their orbital paths are just very similar to our planet’s.
paras.zh: 根据行星协会的说法，这些物体是小行星，从某种角度来看，它们的行为似乎像地球的卫星。然而，它们实际上是绕太阳运行——它们的轨道与我们星球的轨道非常相似。

paras.en: According to Live Science, the current mini-moon is classified as an Aten asteroid, a type of space rock whose orbit around the sun occasionally brings it close to Earth. 2026 QQ8 cozies up with our planet around once every ten years. Although this object’s exact origins are unclear, scientists believe most near-Earth asteroids originate in the main asteroid belt, between Mars and Jupiter.
paras.zh: 据《生活科学》报道，​​目前的迷你卫星被归类为阿顿小行星，这是一种太空岩石，其绕太阳运行的轨道偶尔会使其靠近地球。 2026 QQ8大约每十年与我们的星球亲密接触一次。尽管该物体的确切起源尚不清楚，但科学家认为大多数近地小行星起源于火星和木星之间的主要小行星带。

paras.en: With new telescopes scanning the heavens, scientists expect many more mini-moons to be discovered. For instance, the Vera C. Rubin Observatory in Chile started its decade-long Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) over the summer, and the telescope has already detected thousands of new asteroids as it watches the Southern Hemisphere sky.
paras.zh: 随着新望远镜扫描天空，科学家们预计会发现更多的迷你卫星。例如，智利的维拉·C·鲁宾天文台在夏季开始了长达十年的时空遗产勘测（LSST），该望远镜在观察南半球的天空时已经发现了数千颗新的小行星。

paras.en: “When the LSST survey starts operating fully, it’s expected to discover lots and lots of things,” says Matthew Payne, director of the Minor Planet Center and an astrophysicist at the Center for Astrophysics, Harvard & Smithsonian, to CNN. “The expectation is that we’ll go from knowing 1.5 million objects to knowing 5 million.”
paras.zh: “当 LSST 调查开始全面运行时，预计会发现很多很多东西，”小行星中心主任、哈佛和史密森天体物理中心的天体物理学家马修·佩恩 (Matthew Payne) 向 CNN 表示。 “我们的期望是从了解 150 万个物体增加到了解 500 万个。”

articles.title: Scientists Discover Signs of Explosive Volcanic Eruptions 20,000 Feet Underwater—the Deepest Ever Found—in the Mariana Trench

paras.en: Challenger Deep, located in the Mariana Trench in the western Pacific Ocean, is the deepest known point on Earth, plunging 35,876 feet—or nearly seven miles—below the water’s surface.
paras.zh: 挑战者深渊位于西太平洋的马里亚纳海沟，是地球上已知的最深点，深达水面以下 35,876 英尺（即近 7 英里）。

paras.en: Now, Challenger Deep can add another distinction to its list: the site of the deepest known explosive volcanic eruptions on Earth. Using a remotely operated underwater vehicle, scientists recovered pyroclastic rocks and “abundant” evidence of ultradeep explosive volcanism from the site. They described their findings in a study published November 22 in the journal Frontiers in Earth Science.
paras.zh: 现在，挑战者深渊可以在其名单中添加另一个特点：地球上已知最深的火山喷发地点。科学家们利用远程操作的水下航行器，从现场回收了火山碎屑岩和超深火山喷发的“大量”证据。他们在 11 月 22 日发表在《地球科学前沿》杂志上的一项研究中描述了他们的发现。

paras.en: The discovery is “surprising and unprecedented,” William Chadwick, a geologist at Oregon State University who was not involved with the work, tells Science News’ Carolyn Gramling. “Imagining this happening is … pretty mind-boggling.”
paras.zh: 未参与这项工作的俄勒冈州立大学地质学家威廉·查德威克 (William Chadwick) 告诉《科学新闻》的卡罗琳·格拉姆林 (Carolyn Gramling)，这一发现“令人惊讶且前所未有”。 “想象这种情况发生……真是令人难以置信。”

paras.en: Challenger Deep is a dangerous place for humans to visit, with roughly 1,000 times the pressure we experience at sea level. So, scientists often turn to robots to explore this mysterious submarine depression. In 2024, researchers deployed a Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution submersible called Jason/Medea to explore part of the Mariana Trench.
paras.zh: 挑战者深渊对于人类来说是一个危险的地方，其压力大约是海平面压力的 1000 倍。因此，科学家经常求助于机器人来探索这个神秘的海底凹陷。 2024 年，研究人员部署了伍兹霍尔海洋研究所的一艘名为 Jason/Medea 的潜水器来探索马里亚纳海沟的部分区域。

paras.en: Some people have made the daring journey to Challenger Deep. The first were U.S. Navy officer Don Walsh and Swiss oceanographer Jacques Piccard, who ventured there in a submarine in January 1960.
paras.zh: 有些人已经勇敢地前往挑战者深渊。第一批是美国海军军官唐·沃尔什 (Don Walsh) 和瑞士海洋学家雅克·皮卡德 (Jacques Piccard)，他们于 1960 年 1 月乘坐潜艇冒险前往那里。

paras.en: The underwater device couldn’t reach the very bottom of Challenger Deep without risking implosion, but it did descend to a maximum depth of about 21,300 feet. On three dives, the submersible’s camera spotted flat, lobe-shaped rocks at different spots, some located more than about 19,685 feet below the surface, along a 60-mile stretch. Scientists say this material, some of which was brought back to the surface, represents the remnants of a pyroclastic flow, a fast-moving mixture of hot gas, ash and volcanic rock produced by explosive eruptions.
paras.zh: 该水下装置无法到达挑战者深渊的最底部而不冒内爆的风险，但它确实下降到了约 21,300 英尺的最大深度。在三次潜水中，潜水器的相机在不同地点发现了平坦的叶状岩石，其中一些位于水面以下约 19,685 英尺以上，绵延 60 英里。科学家表示，这种物质（其中一些被带回地表）代表了火山碎屑流的残余物，火山碎屑流是爆炸性喷发产生的热气体、火山灰和火山岩的快速移动混合物。

paras.en: The team couldn’t find the exact location of the eruption, but they suspect it occurred somewhere nearby, along the trench wall. They also don’t know exactly when the eruption occurred, but they think it happened somewhat recently in geologic terms.
paras.zh: 研究小组无法找到喷发的确切位置，但他们怀疑喷发发生在附近的某个地方，沿着沟渠壁。他们也不知道火山喷发发生的确切时间，但他们认为从地质角度来看，火山喷发是最近发生的。

paras.en: “They’re not yesterday, but I don’t think they’re a million years old,” lead author Robert Stern, a geoscientist who retired from the University of Texas at Dallas, tells Live Science’s Stephanie Pappas.
paras.zh: 从德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校退休的地球科学家、主要作者罗伯特·斯特恩 (Robert Stern) 告诉《生活科学》杂志的斯蒂芬妮·帕帕斯 (Stephanie Pappas)：“它们不是昨天的事，但我认为它们还没有一百万年的历史。”

paras.en: Most of Earth’s volcanic activity occurs underwater, forming island chains and extensive networks of hydrothermal vents along mid-ocean ridges. But scientists never expected to find explosive eruptions at such extreme depths, thinking they were only possible in shallower waters.
paras.zh: 地球上的大部分火山活动发生在水下，沿着洋中脊形成岛链和广泛的热液喷口网络。但科学家们从未想到会在如此极端的深度发现爆炸性喷发，认为它们只可能在较浅的水域中发生。

paras.en: “It’s not something that, as a geoscientist, I would have said would be predicted,” Sune Nielsen, a geochemist at the University of Lorraine in France who was not involved in the study, tells Live Science. “Very far from it.”
paras.zh: “作为一名地球科学家，我认为这不是可以预测的，”未参与这项研究的法国洛林大学地球化学家苏尼·尼尔森 (Sune Nielsen) 告诉《生活科学》。 “离它很远。”

paras.en: In Challenger Deep, explosive eruptions were thought to be impossible, since the immense water pressure should prevent volcanic gases from expanding and triggering an explosion. Yet the evidence suggests some kind of volcanic explosion did occur there, raising new questions about what’s possible.
paras.zh: 在挑战者深渊，爆炸性喷发被认为是不可能的，因为巨大的水压应该可以防止火山气体膨胀并引发爆炸。然而，有证据表明那里确实发生了某种火山爆发，这引发了关于可能发生的新问题。

paras.en: “Submarine volcanism is something we’ve got quite big knowledge gaps in,” Peter Rowley, a volcanologist at the University of Bristol in England who was not involved with the study, tells New Scientist’s Matthew Sparkes. “It’s that famous thing that we know less about the seafloor than we do about the moon.”
paras.zh: 英国布里斯托大学火山学家彼得·罗利（Peter Rowley）没有参与这项研究，他告诉《新科学家》杂志的马修·斯帕克斯：“我们在海底火山活动方面存在很大的知识空白。” “众所周知，我们对海底的了解还不如对月球的了解。”

paras.en: Scientists still don’t fully understand how explosive volcanism works at such extreme depths. They suspect, however, that these eruptions function very differently than those that occur on land. As Robin George Andrews writes for National Geographic, perhaps an underwater eruption at this depth would look like “a convulsing, crumbling, splintering stream of toothpaste angrily escaping out of the seafloor.”
paras.zh: 科学家们仍然不完全了解爆炸性火山活动如何在如此极端的深度发挥作用。然而，他们怀疑这些喷发的作用与陆地上发生的喷发有很大不同。正如罗宾·乔治·安德鲁斯为《国家地理》杂志所写的那样，也许在这个深度的水下喷发看起来就像“一股痉挛、破碎、分裂的牙膏流愤怒地从海底逸出”。

paras.en: Another puzzle is the location of the volcanic deposits. Scientists say they sit unusually close to the trench, a subduction zone that began to form about 52 million years ago when the older, denser Pacific tectonic plate started sliding beneath the smaller Mariana microplate.
paras.zh: 另一个谜团是火山沉积物的位置。科学家表示，它们的位置异常靠近海沟，这是大约 5200 万年前开始形成的俯冲带，当时更古老、密度更大的太平洋构造板块开始在较小的马里亚纳微板块下方滑动。

paras.en: In subduction zones, the sinking plate heats up and starts to melt into magma as it dives beneath the overriding plate. Typically, that magma rises to the surface and erupts hundreds of miles from the place where the two plates meet.
paras.zh: 在俯冲带，下沉板块在潜入上覆板块下方时升温并开始融化成岩浆。通常情况下，岩浆会上升到地表并从两个板块相遇的地方喷发数百英里。

paras.en: But scientists found the Mariana Trench volcanic deposits much closer to the meeting point of the Pacific and Mariana plates than they would have expected. One possible explanation for this proximity is that the Pacific plate makes a sharp, steep bend as it sinks beneath the Mariana Plate. This hypothesis might also help explain how Challenger Deep got so far below the surface in the first place, reports Science News.
paras.zh: 但科学家发现马里亚纳海沟火山沉积物比他们预期的更接近太平洋板块和马里亚纳板块的交汇点。对于这种接近的一种可能的解释是，太平洋板块在沉入马里亚纳板块下方时发生了急剧的、陡峭的弯曲。据《科学新闻》报道，这一假设也可能有助于解释“挑战者深渊”最初是如何深入地表以下的。

paras.en: Many questions remain unanswered. But the scientists behind the new work hope their discovery inspires other researchers to explore these largely uncharted underwater environments.
paras.zh: 许多问题仍未得到解答。但这项新工作背后的科学家希望他们的发现能够激励其他研究人员探索这些基本上未知的水下环境。

paras.en: “The trenches are the last frontier,” Stern tells National Geographic. “We’ve opened a door.”
paras.zh: “战壕是最后的边疆，”斯特恩告诉国家地理杂志。 “我们已经打开了一扇门。”

articles.title: Office Depot Coupons: $20 Off November 2026
articles.author: Molly Higgins

paras.en: As someone who WFH for a minimum of forty hours a week and is constantly rotating between working from an office chair, couch, and bed, I can truly say that the office furniture you use matters. Not only can it make or break your body (literally), but it also helps to have office supplies and furniture to get you in the professional state of mind when at home.
paras.zh: 作为一个每周至少在家工作 40 个小时并且经常在办公椅、沙发和床上工作的人，我可以确实地说你使用的办公家具很重要。它不仅可以塑造或摧毁你的身体（字面意思），而且还有助于拥有办公用品和家具，让你在家时保持专业的心态。

paras.en: We love Office Depot’s wide selection of office chairs and standing desks to outfit our home offices. Plus, Office Depot has a great selection of home printers for every price point and need, with options from our favorite brands like Epson and HP. Outfitting a home office or providing office supplies no matter where you work can be overwhelming and costly. Luckily, Office Depot has everything a business needs, from staples to paper to shelving and scanners. These costs can add up quickly, and that’s why we have rounded up some of the best Office Depot coupons to help you save big.
paras.zh: 我们喜欢 Office Depot 为我们的家庭办公室配备的各种办公椅和站立式办公桌。此外，Office Depot 还提供适合各种价位和需求的多种家用打印机，其中包括 Epson 和 HP 等我们最喜欢的品牌的选项。无论您在哪里工作，配备家庭办公室或提供办公用品都可能是一项艰巨且昂贵的工作。幸运的是，Office Depot 拥有企业所需的一切，从订书钉到纸张，再到书架和扫描仪。这些成本可能会迅速增加，因此我们收集了一些最好的 Office Depot 优惠券来帮助您节省大笔费用。

paras.en: 40% Off All Custom Gifts at Office Depot
paras.zh: Office Depot 所有定制礼品 40% 折扣

paras.en: One of the best gifts you can give during the holidays is a personalized photo gift, such as wrapping paper, holiday cards, photos, canvas prints, and more. If you still need to order your holiday photo cards or postcards, take advantage of the gift sale at Office Depot, where you can get 40% off all photo products through November 21. Create a memorable, personalized gift that stands out for less this holiday season at Office Depot.
paras.zh: 节日期间可以赠送的最好礼物之一是个性化照片礼物，例如包装纸、节日贺卡、照片、画布照片等。如果您仍需要订购节日照片卡或明信片，请利用 Office Depot 的礼品促销活动，截至 11 月 21 日，所有照片产品均可享受 40% 的折扣。在 Office Depot 打造令人难忘的个性化礼物，在这个节日季中脱颖而出。

paras.en: These days, it’s easy to spend $100. Whether that’s for a budget printer or a whole bunch of pens and paper clips, you can save money on purchases you were already going to make with this Office Depot promo code. Right now, you can get $20 off a purchase of $100 or more. Once you’re done shopping and have all of the items in your cart, input the Office Depot coupon code YES20 in the box at the payment screen to get the Office Depot discount. Perhaps best of all, this Office Depot discount code applies to all regular-priced items across valuable home office categories like furniture, supplies, and tech.
paras.zh: 如今，花 100 美元很容易。无论是廉价打印机还是一大堆钢笔和回形针，您都可以使用此 Office Depot 促销代码在购买时节省金钱。现在，购买满 100 美元即可立减 20 美元。完成购物并将所有商品放入购物车后，请在付款屏幕的框中输入 Office Depot 优惠券代码 YES20，以获得 Office Depot 折扣。也许最重要的是，此 Office Depot 折扣代码适用于有价值的家庭办公类别（如家具、用品和技术）中的所有正价商品。

paras.en: $40 Off Instantly With an Office Depot Coupon Code
paras.zh: 使用 Office Depot 优惠券代码立即立减 40 美元

paras.en: If you need to upgrade your organizational system or get a new chair that doesn’t trigger back spasms, now’s a great time to invest in your home office setup for less. With this Office Depot promo code, you can get $40 off when you purchase $200 or more (an easy milestone to get to). To get this discount, input Office Depot promo code YES40 at checkout for massive savings on a myriad of regularly-priced items.
paras.zh: 如果您需要升级您的组织系统或购买一把不会引发背部痉挛的新椅子，那么现在是花更少的钱投资您的家庭办公室设置的好时机。使用此 Office Depot 促销代码，购买 200 美元或以上即可享受 40 美元折扣（这是一个轻松实现的里程碑）。要获得此折扣，请在结账时输入 Office Depot 促销代码 YES40，即可在购买各种正价商品时节省大量费用。

paras.en: If you’re wanting to upgrade your office furniture, like a luxe office chair, gaming chair, or standing desk, now’s a great time to make an investment in your home office. Get rewarded for the larger purchases you were already going to make. When you spend $500 at Office Depot right now, you’ll get a free $50 prepaid Visa Reward Card. This offer excludes products from HP, Samsung, Canon, Epson, Brother, Lexmark, Microsoft Surface, Google hardware, simplehuman, postage stamps, ink and toner. This offer isn’t valid in Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands, and there’s a limit of one per household or business. This $50 reward Office Depot coupon code will be automatically applied and will be reflected during checkout, with no Office Depot promo code needed.
paras.zh: 如果您想升级您的办公家具，例如豪华办公椅、游戏椅或站立式办公桌，现在是投资家庭办公室的好时机。为您已经打算进行的较大购买获得奖励。现在，当您在 Office Depot 消费满 500 美元时，您将获得一张免费的 50 美元预付 Visa 奖励卡。此优惠不包括 HP、Samsung、Canon、Epson、Brother、Lexmark、Microsoft Surface、Google 硬件、simple human、邮票、墨水和碳粉的产品。此优惠不适用于阿拉斯加、夏威夷、波多黎各或维尔京群岛，并且每个家庭或企业最多可享受一次优惠。此 50 美元奖励 Office Depot 优惠券代码将自动应用并在结帐时反映，无需 Office Depot 促销代码。

paras.en: Office Depot Printing Coupons: Professional Projects With Office Depot
paras.zh: Office Depot 打印优惠券：Office Depot 的专业项目

paras.en: If you’re a small business owner, you can get deep discounts on business cards, banners, marketing materials, and basically everything needed to promote and get your business off the ground. We have a myriad of rotating Office Depot printing coupons (primarily aimed at business cards) so you can level up your branding, with no Office Depot coupon code needed to get steep discounts on professional printing.
paras.zh: 如果您是小企业主，您可以获得名片、横幅、营销材料以及推广和开展业务所需的基本上所有物品的大幅折扣。我们有大量轮换的 Office Depot 打印优惠券（主要针对名片），因此您可以提升您的品牌，无需 Office Depot 优惠券代码即可获得专业打印的大幅折扣。

paras.en: Save on Printer Supplies With Office Depot Ink Coupons
paras.zh: 使用 Office Depot 墨水优惠券节省打印机耗材

paras.en: We can put a man on the moon; we can clone sheep. But somehow, home office printers have been stuck in the dark ages. Huge, clunky, and prone to error messages and hardware issues, printers have become a relic of the past, with many at a loss for where to get the best.
paras.zh: 我们可以把人送上月球；我们可以克隆羊。但不知何故，家庭办公室打印机一直陷入黑暗时代。打印机体积庞大、笨重、容易出现错误消息和硬件问题，已经成为过去的产物，许多人不知道从哪里可以获得最好的打印机。

articles.title: Chewy Promo Codes: 50% Off November 2026
articles.author: Molly Higgins

paras.en: Florida-based online retailer Chewy has been around for less than 15 years but has quickly become a popular source for everything pet-related. Chewy carries supplies for farm animals, reptiles, fish, and more, with over 3,500 brands, including food, medicine, and toys. My cat is constantly throwing up (same) and requires Hill’s Sensitive Skin and Stomach, which costs roughly as much as my car insurance every month. I use WIRED’s Chewy promo codes to save money so I can spring for the 50-cent instant ramen while she remains vomit-free. Browse our roundup of verified coupons to score 50% off pet food and toys, $20 off your first purchase, free shipping deals, and more 2026 promotions.
paras.zh: 总部位于佛罗里达州的在线零售商 Chewy 成立还不到 15 年，但很快就成为与宠物相关的所有商品的热门来源。 Chewy 提供农场动物、爬行动物、鱼类等用品，品牌超过 3,500 个，包括食品、药品和玩具。我的猫经常呕吐（同样），需要希尔的敏感皮肤和胃部护理，其费用大约相当于我每个月的汽车保险费用。我使用《连线》杂志的 Chewy 促销代码来省钱，这样我就可以在她不呕吐的情况下享用 50 美分的方便面。浏览我们经过验证的优惠券汇总，享受宠物食品和玩具 50% 折扣、首次购买 20 美元折扣、免费送货优惠以及更多 2026 年促销活动。

paras.en: If you’ve been wondering whether Chewy is right for you, now's the time to try. First-time users can get a $20 eGift card when they place a first order at Chewy over $49 and use code WELCOME. And if you’ve never placed an order with their pharmacy, use Chewy coupon code RX20 at checkout to save 20% on prescription essentials like Simparica Trio, NexGard Plus, Heartgard, and more pet medications.
paras.zh: 如果您一直想知道 Chewy 是否适合您，现在是时候尝试一下了。首次用户在 Chewy 首次订购超过 49 美元并使用代码 WELCOME 即可获得一张 20 美元的电子礼品卡。如果您从未在他们的药房下过订单，请在结帐时使用 Chewy 优惠券代码 RX20 购买 Simparica Trio、NexGard Plus、Heartgard 和更多宠物药物等处方必需品可节省 20%。

paras.en: If you’re a returning customer, don’t fret. Chewy has rotating deals on a myriad of pet essentials and supplies, like flea guard, treats, litter, toys, and more. With this Chewy promo code, you can get almost half off, with $20 off orders of $49 or more with Chewy coupon code GIFT20OFF. This is a rare coupon that is only for existing customers who are signed in with their account. Plus, you can get an extra $5 off the first order made through the Chewy app with a Chewy promo code. You’ll just need to download the app and enter the code in the box on the checkout screen for $5 off.
paras.zh: 如果您是回头客，请不要担心。 Chewy 轮换出售各种宠物必需品和用品，例如跳蚤防护剂、零食、垃圾、玩具等。使用 Chewy 促销代码，您可以享受几乎一半的折扣，使用 Chewy 优惠券代码 GIFT20OFF 订单满 49 美元或以上可享受 20 美元折扣。这是一张罕见的优惠券，仅适用于使用其帐户登录的现有客户。此外，您还可以使用 Chewy 促销代码通过 Chewy 应用程序下的第一笔订单额外获得 5 美元优惠。您只需下载该应用程序并在结账屏幕上的框中输入代码即可享受 5 美元的折扣。

paras.en: Unlock Chewy Black Friday Deals: 50% Off
paras.zh: 解锁耐嚼的黑色星期五优惠：50% 折扣

paras.en: Shopping Chewy Black Friday Deals is one of the best ways to save on essentials and toys for your furry friends. There will be major deals for all types of animals, including dogs, cats, horses, small pets, pet birds, wild birds, fish, reptiles, chickens, and more. Plus, there are flash deals like buy 2, get a third for free on select Chewy treats, 40% off prescriptions, and buy 2, get a third free on select toys.
paras.zh: 购物耐嚼黑色星期五优惠是为毛茸茸的朋友节省必需品和玩具的最佳方式之一。所有类型的动物都将有重大优惠，包括狗、猫、马、小宠物、宠物鸟、野鸟、鱼、爬行动物、鸡等。此外，还有一些限时优惠，例如特定 Chewy 零食买 2 送 1/3、处方药 40% 折扣，以及特定玩具买 2 送 1/3。

paras.en: New customers can also get free 1-3-day delivery (with real-time tracking) on first-time orders over $35, which seriously helps cut down the convenience cost of getting your 40-lb litter box to your third-floor apartment without having to lug it on the L train yourself (speaking from experience, don’t endure what I’ve had to). Get the convenience without paying for it with Chewy coupons for free delivery on all items.
paras.zh: 新客户还可以在首次订单超过 35 美元时享受 1-3 天的免费送货服务（实时跟踪），这极大地帮助降低了将 40 磅垃圾箱运送到三楼公寓的便利成本，而无需自己将其拖上 L 火车（根据经验，不要忍受我不得不忍受的事情）。使用 Chewy 优惠券免费送货，无需付费即可享受便利。

paras.en: Save 50% With Chewy Coupons and Pet Food Deals
paras.zh: 使用耐嚼优惠券和宠物食品优惠节省 50%

paras.en: Already a devoted pet parent/Chewy member? While the best Chewy promo codes are often reserved for first-time customers, existing customers can score daily deals like buy 3, get 1 free offers on toys. Make sure to stay tuned here. While our top Chewy promo codes unlock over 20% off, there’s more to look forward to. Expect discount codes still to come, like 50% off premium dog and cat food, up to 40% off flea and tick medications for fall, and free shipping on $35, an easy price to hit when you’re grabbing pet essentials (not to mention I’ll spend any amount to avoid lugging around boxes of concrete clay litter in the pits of hell, a.k.a. the subway).
paras.zh: 已经是忠实的宠物家长/Chewy 会员？虽然最好的 Chewy 促销代码通常是为首次购买的客户保留的，但现有客户可以获得每日优惠，例如玩具买 3 送 1 免费优惠。请务必关注这里。虽然我们的顶级 Chewy 促销代码可享受超过 20% 的折扣，但还有更多值得期待的内容。预计还会有折扣码，比如高级狗粮和猫粮 50% 折扣，秋季跳蚤和蜱虫药物最高 40% 折扣，35 美元免运费，当你购买宠物必需品时，这是一个很容易买到的价格（更不用说我会花很多钱来避免在地狱坑（又名地铁）里拖着一箱箱混凝土粘土垃圾）。

paras.en: Get 50% Off Your First Chewy Autoship Order
paras.zh: 首次订购 Chewy Autoship 即可享受 50% 折扣

paras.en: Are there any equestrians here tonight? If so, you’re in luck. You can enjoy 40% off horse joint health supplements with the Chewy promo code EQSUP. Interestingly, some deals are automatic and don’t require a code or effort. When you set up an autoship subscription for certain products, you’ll receive 35% off your first order and discounts of up to 50% on select pet food brands, plus an extra 5% off all future shipments. Chewy allows combining autoship with other deals or category discounts listed on the “Today’s Deals” page. It’s flexible: you can pause, skip, or cancel any autoship at any time without being locked into a subscription. You can also adjust the delivery frequency—from weekly to monthly or more. Additionally, autoship orders on pharmacy items, including prescription medications, come with extra discounts.
paras.zh: 今晚这里有马术爱好者吗？如果是这样，那么你很幸运。使用 Chewy 促销代码 EQSUP，您可以享受马关节健康补充剂 40% 的折扣。有趣的是，有些交易是自动进行的，不需要代码或努力。当您为某些产品设置自动发货订阅时，您的首笔订单将享受 35% 的折扣，特定宠物食品品牌的折扣高达 50%，未来所有发货还可享受 5% 的额外折扣。 Chewy 允许将自动发货与“今日优惠”页面上列出的其他优惠或类别折扣结合起来。它很灵活：您可以随时暂停、跳过或取消任何自动发货，而无需锁定订阅。您还可以调整交付频率——从每周到每月或更长时间。此外，药品（包括处方药）的自动发货订单还可享受额外折扣。

paras.en: Save on our Favorite Chewy Tech Products
paras.zh: 节省我们最喜欢的耐嚼科技产品

paras.en: I’m sort of the cat tech guru around here, and I’ve tested a myriad of the best pet tech, including automatic feeders and automatic litter boxes. I have some very strong opinions about which are worth the money (or not). I’m currently using—erm, my cats are using—the Litter-Robot 4 automatic litter box, and although it’s pricey, this box has changed my life. Gone are the days of foul smells, scooping, and pouring litter. This little machine does all the dirty work for you so you can spend more time on cuddles. I also own the LEVOIT Core Pet Care Air Purifier, which has been a game changer for me living in a cramped apartment with two giant cats—it really helps dissipate any smells, pet hair, or pesky dander. Overall, my house feels cleaner because of this small powerhouse machine. When I transition from WFH, I’m going to invest in this inexpensive camera, the INSTACHEW Purrsight 360 Degree Wi-Fi Security Pet Camera, to keep an eye on the goings-on and shenanigans while I’m at work.
paras.zh: 我是这里的猫技术专家，我测试了无数最好的宠物技术，包括自动喂食器和自动猫砂盆。对于哪些值得（或不值得），我有一些非常强烈的意见。我目前正在使用——呃，我的猫正在使用——Litter-Robot 4 自动猫砂盆，虽然价格昂贵，但这个盒子改变了我的生活。恶臭、铲起和倾倒垃圾的日子已经一去不复返了。这台小机器会为您完成所有脏活，这样您就可以花更多时间拥抱。我还拥有 LEVOIT Core 宠物护理空气净化器，对于我住在一间有两只大猫的狭窄公寓里来说，它改变了游戏规则——它确实有助于消除任何气味、宠物毛发或讨厌的皮屑。总的来说，因为有了这台小型动力机器，我的房子感觉更干净了。当我从 WFH 转型时，我将投资购买这款便宜的摄像机，即 INSTACHEW Purrsight 360 度 Wi-Fi 安全宠物摄像机，以便在我工作时密切关注发生的事情和恶作剧。

paras.en: If you haven’t ordered from Chewy before, now’s a great time to give it a try and see if it’s a good fit for you or your furry friend. Right now, when you place an order over $49, you’ll get a $25 eGift card. This means that when you buy anything over $49, from dog toys to cat litter to bird food, you’ll be rewarded with an eGift card to use on future purchases and cut down costs. (Some restrictions apply.)
paras.zh: 如果您以前没有从 Chewy 订购过，现在是尝试一下的好时机，看看它是否适合您或您毛茸茸的朋友。现在，当您下订单超过 49 美元时，您将获得一张 25 美元的电子礼品卡。这意味着，当您购买超过 49 美元的任何商品（从狗玩具到猫砂再到鸟食）时，您将获得一张电子礼品卡，可用于将来的购买并降低成本。 （有一些限制。）

paras.en: If you’re not a new Chewy customer, don’t worry. You can still snag great deals! Returning Chewy customers can still get rewards for their purchases. Right now, when you spend $100 at Chewy, you’ll get a $30 e-gift card. While browsing, be sure to check out Chewy’s autoship deals for even more stackable savings, including half off Purina Pro Plan Veterinary Diet supplements and chews. Be sure to check out the whole page of autoship savings and deals, with heavy discounts of up to half off Churu treats, oral care chews, brushes, and even more pet essentials.
paras.zh: 如果您不是 Chewy 的新客户，请不要担心。您仍然可以抢到超值优惠！ Chewy 的回头客仍然可以获得购买奖励。现在，当您在 Chewy 消费 100 美元时，您将获得一张 30 美元的电子礼品卡。浏览时，请务必查看 Chewy 的自动送货优惠，以获得更多可叠加的优惠，包括 Purina Pro Plan 兽医饮食补充剂和咀嚼物半价优惠。请务必查看整页的自动送货优惠和优惠，其中 Churu 零食、口腔护理咀嚼物、刷子以及更多宠物必需品可享受高达半价的大幅折扣。

paras.en: If you are like me and find yourself needing to restock on (heavy) essentials like kibble, canned food, and litter every few weeks, it’s a good idea to become a Chewy+ member, where you’ll get discounts on tons of items, autoship savings, rewards, and free delivery. With Chewy+, you not only get free, fast shipping with no minimums, but you’ll also get 5% back in rewards on purchases, exclusive offers, double rewards, discounts, free items, and more. Chewy also gives you a 30-day trial period so you can decide if Chewy+ is right for you. After that, it’ll be $79 per year. When you earn rewards, they will be added to your Chewy+ rewards balance, which shows in your member details and at checkout for redemption. Join Chewy+ today so you can make the most of your Chewy membership with newly added and changing offers like free access to Chewy services for your pet, extra rewards, or special pricing.

articles.title: U2 Wind Back the Years With Classics, Dolly Parton Tribute for Thanksgiving Eve NFL Halftime Show
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: The legendary Irish rock band, as they’ve done so often in the past, stepped into the cauldron, rocked out, and gave everyone what they were looking for.
paras.zh: 正如他们过去经常做的那样，传奇的爱尔兰摇滚乐队走进大锅，摇滚出来，给了每个人他们想要的东西。

paras.en: On this occasion, Bono, The Edge, Adam Clayton and Larry Mullen Jr. stepped into the colosseum that is the NFL‘s first-ever Thanksgiving Eve game at SoFi Stadium, pitting the Los Angeles Rams against the visiting Green Bay Packers.
paras.zh: 值此之际，Bono、The Edge、Adam Clayton 和 Larry Mullen Jr. 走进斗兽场，这是 NFL 在 SoFi 体育场举行的第一场感恩节前夕比赛，洛杉矶公羊队对阵来访的绿湾包装工队。

paras.en: The Rock Hall-inducted group headlined the halftime show, which streamed live late Wednesday, Nov. 25 on Netflix.
paras.zh: 这支摇滚音乐厅的乐队在中场表演中占据主导地位，该表演于 11 月 25 日星期三晚在 Netflix 上进行了现场直播。

paras.en: At the very top, the four bandmates took the long walk to the centerfield as a choir recited the lyrics of “I Still Haven’t Found What I’m Looking For.”
paras.zh: 在最高处，四位乐队成员长途跋涉到达中场，合唱团吟诵着“我仍然没有找到我正在寻找的东西”的歌词。

paras.en: “Thank you for having us,” Bono remarked over Mullen’s iconic, military-style drum pattern that launched the mini-set proper with “Sunday Bloody Sunday,” one of the band’s early political anthems. The production stepped up several gears as a marching band assembled and the song shapeshifted, interpolating The Supremes’ “Stop! In The Name of Love.”
paras.zh: “谢谢你邀请我们，”波诺对马伦标志性的军用风格的鼓声说道，该鼓声以乐队早期的政治歌曲之一“周日血腥星期日”启动了迷你套装。随着行进乐队的集结和歌曲的变形，制作加快了几个步伐，插入了至尊乐队的“停止！以爱之名”。

paras.en: Then, a change in mood as U2 paid tribute to Dolly Parton, the late queen of country’s smiling image splashed on three sails towering over the circular, center stage. Bono dueted with Dolly’s vocals for “Torn,” her very last recording which appears on the band’s 16th and latest studio album, Carnaval de Luz.
paras.zh: 然后，当 U2 向多莉·帕顿致敬时，气氛发生了变化，已故乡村女王的微笑形象溅落在圆形中央舞台上高耸的三张帆上。波诺与多莉的声音合唱了《Torn》，这是她最后一张录音，出现在乐队第 16 张也是最新的录音室专辑《Carnaval de Luz》中。

paras.en: And, in a moment that earned a roar from the audience, the band slotted seamlessly into another Joshua Tree number, “Where The Streets Have No Name.” The sails came down, and U2 got down to rockstar business — with some support from scores of backing singers.
paras.zh: 而且，在赢得观众欢呼的那一刻，乐队无缝地插入了约书亚树乐队的另一首歌曲“Where The Streets Have No Name”。风帆落下，U2 开始从事摇滚明星业务——并得到了数十位伴唱的支持。

paras.en: Without missing a beat, Bono and Co. reached into their glorybox with a rendition of “Pride (In The Name of Love)” a tribute to the assassinated civil rights leader Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., which appeared on their 1984 LP The Unforgettable Fire. And with that, U2 was done and it was game on.
paras.zh: 波诺和他的伙伴们毫不犹豫地走进他们的荣耀箱，演唱了一首向被暗杀的民权领袖马丁·路德·金博士致敬的《骄傲（以爱之名）》，这首歌曲出现在他们 1984 年的唱片《难忘的火焰》中。就这样，U2 就完成了，比赛开始了。

paras.en: Carnaval de Luz this month debuted at No. 1 on three Billboard charts, including No. 1 on Top Rock Albums, Vinyl Albums and Indie Store Album Sales, and became the band’s 14th top 10 on the Billboard 200 (opening at No. 4). It’s their 12th No. 1 on the Official U.K. Albums Chart and Australia’s ARIA Chart.
paras.zh: Carnaval de Luz 本月首次亮相就在三张 Billboard 排行榜上排名第一，其中包括顶级摇滚专辑、黑胶专辑和独立商店专辑销量第一，并成为乐队第 14 位进入 Billboard 200 排行榜前 10 名（开局排名第四）。这是他们在英国官方专辑排行榜和澳大利亚 ARIA 排行榜上第 12 个第一名。

paras.en: U2 this year chalks up its 50th anniversary, the celebrations for which will accelerate next year when the band returns to stadiums around the globe with Carnaval De Luz presents: The Greatest Show on Earth, its first stadium tour since 2019. Watch highlights from the Thanksgiving Eve halftime show and check out the setlist below. Stream the full performance here on Netflix.
paras.zh: U2 今年迎来了成立 50 周年，明年，乐队的庆祝活动将会加速，届时乐队将带着 Carnaval De Luz 的节目重返全球各地的体育场：地球上最伟大的表演，这是自 2019 年以来的首次体育场巡演。观看感恩节前夕中场表演的精彩片段，并查看下面的演出列表。在 Netflix 上观看完整演出。

paras.zh: U2 感恩节前夕中场表演曲目表：
