articles.title: Astronomers may have discovered a black hole born before the first stars

paras.en: Astronomers may have discovered a black hole born before the first stars
paras.zh: 天文学家可能发现了一个诞生于第一批恒星之前的黑洞

paras.en: A mysterious object named Phoebe, detected when it briefly magnified a distant star, could be a primordial black hole formed just after the Big Bang. With an estimated mass only three times that of the Moon, it may be a 13-billion-year-old cosmic relic that offers new clues to the mystery of dark matter.
paras.zh: 一个名为菲比的神秘物体，在短暂放大一颗遥远恒星时被发现，它可能是大爆炸后形成的原始黑洞。据估计，它的质量仅为月球的三倍，它可能是一个 130 亿年前的宇宙遗迹，为解开暗物质之谜提供了新的线索。

paras.en: On December 18, 2019, astronomers recorded something unusual happening to a star in the Large Magellanic Cloud, a satellite galaxy of the Milky Way. For approximately one hour, the star gradually grew brighter before fading back to its usual appearance. The change was smooth and symmetrical, with no sudden explosion or flare. It looked as though an invisible object had moved between Earth and the star, bending its light in our direction. Afterward, the star returned to normal and showed no further changes in brightness.
paras.zh: 2019 年 12 月 18 日，天文学家记录到银河系卫星星系大麦哲伦星云中的一颗恒星发生了一些不寻常的事情。在大约一个小时的时间里，这颗恒星逐渐变亮，然后又恢复到原来的样子。变化平稳、对称，没有突然爆发或耀斑。看起来好像有一个看不见的物体在地球和恒星之间移动，将其光线转向我们的方向。随后，恒星恢复正常，亮度不再发生变化。

paras.en: Researchers have named the mysterious object Phoebe, but its true identity remains unknown. The event appears to be an example of gravitational microlensing, a phenomenon predicted by Einstein's general theory of relativity. When a compact object with sufficient mass passes in front of a distant star, its gravity bends the star's light and temporarily magnifies its brightness. This produces a recognizable pattern that differs from the changes caused by variable stars, stellar flares, or passing asteroids.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这个神秘物体命名为菲比，但其真实身份仍然未知。该事件似乎是引力微透镜的一个例子，这是爱因斯坦广义相对论所预测的现象。当一个具有足够质量的致密天体经过一颗遥远恒星的前方时，它的引力会使恒星的光线弯曲并暂时放大其亮度。这会产生一种可识别的模式，与变星、恒星耀斑或经过的小行星引起的变化不同。

paras.en: Astronomers at Swinburne University in Melbourne identified the signal while examining observations from a survey that frequently monitored stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud. The distinctive pattern convinced the team that they had detected a genuine gravitational microlensing event. What remained uncertain was the nature of the invisible object responsible.
paras.zh: 墨尔本斯威本大学的天文学家在检查一项经常监测大麦哲伦星云中恒星的调查观测结果时发现了这一信号。这种独特的模式让团队相信他们已经检测到了真正的引力微透镜事件。仍然不确定的是负责的隐形物体的性质。

paras.en: Three Possible Explanations for the Mysterious Object
paras.zh: 对于这个神秘物体的三种可能的解释

paras.en: Researchers have identified three potential explanations for Phoebe. One possibility is a rogue planet that was expelled from its original solar system and now travels alone through the Milky Way. Another is a similar wandering planet located within the Large Magellanic Cloud. If the second explanation proves correct, Phoebe would become the first planet discovered through gravitational microlensing beyond our galaxy.
paras.zh: 研究人员为菲比找到了三种可能的解释。一种可能性是一颗流氓行星被逐出了原来的太阳系，现在独自穿过银河系。另一个是位于大麦哲伦星云内的类似流浪行星。如果第二种解释被证明是正确的，菲比将成为第一颗通过引力微透镜在我们银河系之外发现的行星。

paras.en: The third possibility is far more extraordinary. Phoebe could be a primordial black hole, an ancient object that formed in the earliest moments of the universe. Unlike ordinary black holes, which develop when massive stars collapse, primordial black holes could have emerged from extremely dense regions of space during the first fractions of a second after the Big Bang. Such objects would have formed long before the first stars appeared.
paras.zh: 第三种可能性要非同寻常得多。菲比可能是一个原始黑洞，一个在宇宙诞生之初形成的古老物体。与大质量恒星坍缩时形成的普通黑洞不同，太初黑洞可能是在大爆炸后的最初几分之一秒内从极其致密的空间区域中出现的。这些物体早在第一批恒星出现之前就已经形成了。

paras.en: A One-Hour Signal Reveals a Surprising Clue
paras.zh: 一小时信号揭示了令人惊讶的线索

paras.en: The unusually short duration of the brightening provides an important clue about Phoebe's mass. Gravitational microlensing events depend partly on how massive the intervening object is. Generally, lighter objects produce shorter events, although their speed and position also influence how long the magnification lasts.
paras.zh: 异常短暂的增亮持续时间提供了有关菲比质量的重要线索。引力微透镜事件部分取决于介入物体的质量。一般来说，较轻的物体产生的事件较短，尽管它们的速度和位置也会影响放大的持续时间。

paras.en: Phoebe's signal lasted approximately 60 minutes, placing it near the detection limit of current astronomical surveys. Using the observed duration and their models of the event, researchers estimated that the object has a mass roughly three times that of the Moon. That would make it considerably less massive than any planet in our solar system and far too small to be a conventional black hole formed by a collapsing star.
paras.zh: 菲比的信号持续了大约 60 分钟，接近当前天文观测的探测极限。利用观测到的持续时间和事件模型，研究人员估计该物体的质量大约是月球的三倍。这将使它比我们太阳系中的任何行星都要小得多，而且对于由坍缩恒星形成的传统黑洞来说也太小了。

paras.en: Black holes produced through stellar collapse typically have masses of at least about five times that of the Sun. Phoebe's estimated mass falls enormously below that threshold. If the mysterious object really is a black hole, its tiny mass would point toward a primordial origin rather than the death of a star.
paras.zh: 恒星塌缩产生的黑洞的质量通常至少约为太阳的五倍。菲比的估计质量大大低于该阈值。如果这个神秘物体确实是一个黑洞，那么它的微小质量将指向原始起源而不是恒星的死亡。

paras.en: Could Phoebe Be a Primordial Black Hole Linked to Dark Matter?
paras.zh: 菲比可能是与暗物质有关的原始黑洞吗？

paras.en: To investigate where Phoebe might belong, the researchers compared the likelihood that the object originated from different populations. These included stars in the Milky Way, stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud, and objects associated with the surrounding dark matter halo.
paras.zh: 为了调查菲比可能属于哪里，研究人员比较了该物体起源于不同人群的可能性。其中包括银河系中的恒星、大麦哲伦星云中的恒星以及与周围暗物质晕相关的物体。

paras.en: The results strongly favored the dark matter halo. According to the team's calculations, Phoebe is approximately 100,000 times more likely to belong to this population than to one associated with ordinary stellar matter. This enormous difference makes a potential connection to dark matter particularly intriguing, although it does not establish that Phoebe is a primordial black hole.
paras.zh: 结果强烈支持暗物质晕。根据该团队的计算，菲比属于这一族群的可能性比普通恒星物质族群的可能性高出大约 100,000 倍。这种巨大的差异使得与暗物质的潜在联系特别有趣，尽管它并不能证明菲比是一个原始黑洞。

paras.en: If the primordial black hole interpretation is correct, Phoebe could be among the oldest objects ever detected. It may have formed before the first atoms and stars existed, when the universe was still experiencing the extreme conditions that followed the Big Bang.
paras.zh: 如果原始黑洞的解释是正确的，菲比可能是迄今为止发现的最古老的天体之一。它可能是在第一个原子和恒星存在之前形成的，当时宇宙仍在经历大爆炸后的极端条件。

paras.en: For roughly 13 billion years, such an object could have traveled unseen through space, leaving almost no trace of its existence. Then, on a single night in December 2019, its gravity may have briefly magnified the light of a distant star, offering astronomers a remarkable glimpse of something born near the very beginning of the universe.
paras.zh: 在大约 130 亿年的时间里，这样的物体可能在太空中悄无声息地旅行，几乎没有留下任何存在的痕迹。然后，在 2019 年 12 月的一个晚上，它的引力可能短暂地放大了一颗遥远恒星的光，让天文学家得以一睹在宇宙诞生之初附近诞生的物体。

paras.en: Materials provided by Universe Today. Original written by Mark Thompson. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由今日宇宙提供。马克·汤普森原创。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Scientists discover mysterious lakes more than a mile beneath the Red Sea

paras.en: Scientists discover mysterious lakes more than a mile beneath the Red Sea
paras.zh: 科学家在红海下方一英里多处发现神秘湖泊

paras.en: University of Miami Rosenstiel School of Marine, Atmospheric, and Earth Science
paras.zh: 迈阿密大学罗森斯蒂尔海洋、大气和地球科学学院

paras.en: More than a mile beneath the surface of the Red Sea, scientists have discovered rare underwater lakes that could reveal secrets about Earth's ancient oceans and the possibility of alien life. Known as brine pools, these extremely salty, oxygen-free environments are surprisingly teeming with microbial life, challenging our understanding of where living organisms can survive.
paras.zh: 在红海表面一英里多的地方，科学家们发现了罕见的水下湖泊，这些湖泊可以揭示有关地球古代海洋的秘密以及外星生命的可能性。这些极咸、无氧的环境被称为盐水池，令人惊讶地充满了微生物，挑战了我们对生物体可以生存的理解。

paras.en: More than a mile below the surface of the Red Sea, researchers from the University of Miami (UM) Rosenstiel School of Marine and Atmospheric Science discovered rare deep-sea brine pools in the Gulf of Aqaba, a northern extension of the Red Sea. These unusually salty underwater lakes could provide clues to how Earth's oceans formed millions of years ago and help guide the search for life on other planets.
paras.zh: 迈阿密大学 (UM) 罗森斯蒂尔海洋与大气科学学院的研究人员在红海表面一英里多的地方，在红海北部延伸的亚喀巴湾发现了罕见的深海盐水池。这些异常咸的水下湖泊可以提供数百万年前地球海洋如何形成的线索，并有助于指导在其他行星上寻找生命。

paras.en: The discovery was made by Sam Purkis, professor and chair of the UM Department of Marine Geosciences, and his colleagues in collaboration with OceanX. The researchers located the pools at a depth of more than one mile (1,770 meters) using a remotely operated underwater vehicle (ROV) deployed from the OceanXplorer, an advanced research vessel equipped to investigate some of the least accessible environments on Earth.
paras.zh: 这一发现是由密歇根大学海洋地球科学系教授兼系主任 Sam Purkis 及其同事与 OceanX 合作完成的。研究人员使用 OceanXplorer 部署的远程操作水下航行器 (ROV) 将水池定位在超过一英里（1,770 米）的深度，OceanXplorer 是一艘先进的研究船，配备用于调查地球上一些最难以接近的环境。

paras.en: "Until we understand the limits of life on Earth, it will be difficult to determine if alien planets can host any living beings," said Purkis. "Our discovery of a rich community of microbes that survive in extreme environments can help trace the limits of life on Earth and can be applied to the search for life elsewhere in our solar system and beyond."
paras.zh: 普尔基斯说：“在我们了解地球上生命的极限之前，很难确定外星行星是否可以容纳任何生物。” “我们发现了在极端环境中生存的丰富微生物群落，可以帮助追踪地球上生命的极限，并可以应用于寻找太阳系其他地方及以外的生命。”

paras.en: Life thrives in extreme underwater lakes
paras.zh: 生命在极端水下湖泊中繁衍生息

paras.en: Brine pools rank among the harshest environments on our planet. Their waters contain exceptionally high concentrations of salt, feature unusual chemical conditions, and are completely devoid of oxygen. Despite these seemingly inhospitable conditions, the pools support abundant microbial life. Previous research on microbes inhabiting Red Sea brine pools has even identified biologically active molecules with potential anticancer properties.
paras.zh: 盐水池是地球上最恶劣的环境之一。他们的水域含有极高浓度的盐，具有不寻常的化学条件，并且完全缺乏氧气。尽管条件看似恶劣，但这些水池却维持着丰富的微生物生命。此前对红海盐水池中微生物的研究甚至发现了具有潜在抗癌特性的生物活性分子。

paras.en: The findings, published in Communications Earth & Environment, mark the first documented discovery of brine pools in the Gulf of Aqaba. Remarkably, the researchers nearly missed them.
paras.zh: 该发现发表在《通讯地球与环境》上，标志着亚喀巴湾首次有记录的盐水池发现。值得注意的是，研究人员几乎错过了他们。

paras.en: "We were very lucky," said Purkis. "The discovery came in the last five minutes of the ten-hour ROV dive that we could dedicate to this project."
paras.zh: “我们非常幸运，”普基斯说。 “这一发现是在我们可以致力于该项目的十小时 ROV 潜水的最后五分钟内得出的。”

paras.en: Hidden records of ancient tsunamis and earthquakes
paras.zh: 古代海啸和地震的隐藏记录

paras.en: Beyond their biological significance, the pools serve as natural archives of the region's geological history. Situated relatively close to the coastline, their extremely salty waters and absence of oxygen help preserve evidence of tsunamis, flash floods, and earthquakes that occurred in the Gulf of Aqaba thousands of years ago. Regional tectonic activity has produced numerous faults and fractures across the seabed in this part of the gulf.
paras.zh: 除了其生物学意义外，这些水池还是该地区地质历史的自然档案。由于位置相对靠近海岸线，其海水极其咸且缺乏氧气，有助于保存数千年前亚喀巴湾发生的海啸、山洪和地震的证据。区域构造活动在海湾这一部分的海底产生了许多断层和裂缝。

paras.en: Earlier in 2022, Purkis and his colleagues uncovered evidence of a 500-year-old underwater landslide that likely generated a substantial tsunami. Understanding the region's history of such events could have important implications for coastal development in Egypt and Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 2022 年初，Purkis 和他的同事发现了 500 年前的水下山体滑坡的证据，该山体滑坡可能引发了大规模海啸。了解该地区此类事件的历史可能会对埃及和沙特阿拉伯的沿海发展产生重要影响。

paras.en: The study, titled "Discovery of the deep-sea NEOM Brine Pools in the Gulf of Aqaba, Red Sea," was published on June 27, 2022, in Communications Earth & Environment.
paras.zh: 该研究题为“红海亚喀巴湾深海 NEOM 盐水池的发现”，于 2022 年 6 月 27 日发表在《通讯地球与环境》杂志上。

paras.en: The research team included Sam J. Purkis, Hannah Shernisky, Peter K. Swart, Arash Sharifi, Amanda Oehlert, Gaëlle Duchâtellier, James Klaus, Gregor P. Eberli, Larry Peterson, and Graham Kolodziej from the UM Rosenstiel School; Fabio Marchese and Francesca Benzoni from King Abdullah University of Science and Technology's Red Sea Research Center; Giovanni Chimienti from the University of Bari Aldo Moro in Italy; Andrew Craig and Mattie Rodrigue from OceanX; Jürgen Titschack from MARUM -- Center for Marine Environmental Sciences in Germany; and Ameer Abdulla from NEOM.
paras.zh: 研究团队包括来自 UM Rosenstiel 学院的 Sam J. Purkis、Hannah Shernisky、Peter K. Swart、Arash Sharifi、Amanda Oehlert、Gaëlle Duchâtellier、James Klaus、Gregor P. Eberli、Larry Peterson 和 Graham Kolodziej；来自阿卜杜拉国王科技大学红海研究中心的 Fabio Marchese 和 Francesca Benzoni； Giovanni Chimienti，来自意大利巴里阿尔多莫罗大学；来自 OceanX 的安德鲁·克雷格和玛蒂·罗德里格；来自德国海洋环境科学中心 MARUM 的 Jürgen Titschack；和来自 NEOM 的 Ameer Abdulla。

paras.en: NEOM, a company developing the Saudi Arabian coastline, provided funding for the four-week research expedition aboard the OceanXplorer.
paras.zh: NEOM 是一家开发沙特阿拉伯海岸线的公司，为 OceanXplorer 号为期四周的研究考察提供了资金。

paras.en: Watch the NEOM OceanX documentary about the discovery: https://youtu.be/bWNftnYDx9c
paras.zh: 观看有关这一发现的 NEOM OceanX 纪录片：https://youtu.be/bWNftnYDx9c

articles.title: ‘Blade Runner 2099’ cast praise the incredible set designs that brought the sci-fi universe to life: ‘it was all so well-realized’ (interview)
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: Prime Video’s "Blade Runner 2099" has arrived with an 8-episode limited series revealing what the "Blade Runner" world looks like 50 years after the events of director Denis Villeneuve’s "Blade Runner 2049."
paras.zh: Prime Video 的《银翼杀手 2099》推出了 8 集限量剧集，揭示了导演丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦的《银翼杀手 2049》事件 50 年后的《银翼杀手》世界是什么样子。

paras.en: The most obvious change in this depressing dystopia is that replicants are running the LA show after some unmentionable ecological disaster and humans are now the ones relegated to underclass citizens.
paras.zh: 在这个令人沮丧的反乌托邦中，最明显的变化是，在一些不可提及的生态灾难之后，复制人正在洛杉矶主持节目，而人类现在沦为下层公民。

paras.en: Starring Michelle Yeoh as a replicant cop named Olwen whose life clock is running out and Hunter Schafer as Cora, a desperate human posing as a replicant blade runner, "Blade Runner 2099" unties these two in a mystery revolving around a rogue blade runner and a deadly secret that might cause their city to implode.
paras.zh: 《银翼杀手 2099》由杨紫琼饰演一名生命周期即将耗尽的名叫奥尔文的复制人警察，亨特·谢弗饰演冒充复制人银翼杀手的绝望人类科拉，《银翼杀手 2099》解开了这两个人的谜团，围绕着一名流氓银翼杀手和一个可能导致他们的城市崩溃的致命秘密。

paras.en: We connected with three of the sci-fi show’s main co-stars, Matthew Needham ("House of the Dragon"), Lewis Gribben ("T2 Trainspotting") and Dimitri Abold ("Love Addicts") to hear more about working with creator/showrunner Silka Louisa, and immersing themselves in "Blade Runner 2099's" vivid futuristic worldbuilding.
paras.zh: 我们联系了这部科幻剧的三位主要联合主演马修·尼达姆（《龙之家》）、刘易斯·格里本（《T2 猜火车》）和迪米特里·阿伯德（《爱情成瘾者》），了解更多关于与创作者/剧集主管西尔卡·路易莎合作的信息，以及如何沉浸在《银翼杀手 2099》生动的未来主义世界构建中。

paras.en: "For me it's a lot simpler than egos because he's such a goal-oriented person and all of his stuff has such a police procedural quality to it," Needham tells SPACE regarding his role as Yahya, an emotionless replicant who despises all humans.
paras.zh: “对我来说，这比自我要简单得多，因为他是一个以目标为导向的人，他的所有东西都具有警察程序的品质，”尼达姆在谈到自己扮演的叶海亚这个角色时告诉《太空》，叶海亚是一个蔑视所有人类、没有感情的复制人。

paras.en: "It was really fun to just follow what Silka [Louisa] did. She wrote this great, really exciting mystery thriller, and I just got to play in that.”
paras.zh: “跟随 Silka [Louisa] 所做的事情真的很有趣。她写了这部伟大的、非常令人兴奋的悬疑惊悚片，我就必须参与其中。”

paras.en: Scottish actor Gribben portrays Cora's ailing younger brother Elias, who has compromised mobility and a rocky relationship with his overprotective sister.
paras.zh: 苏格兰演员格里本饰演科拉生病的弟弟埃利亚斯，他行动不便，与过度保护的妹妹关系不稳定。

paras.en: "I've played a few characters that were fairly vulnerable or insular," he notes. "Then seeing the journey of this character grow in strength and confidence and feel like becoming his own man was so compelling to me. It’s almost a relationship that falls apart between brother and sister, and that's fascinating to me because that’s such a cool dynamic you don’t always really see in television shows. That was quite interesting and made me want to try and be in it."
paras.zh: “我扮演过一些相当脆弱或孤立的角色，”他指出。 “然后看到这个角色的力量和信心不断增长，感觉自己成为了自己的男人，这对我来说是如此引人注目。这几乎是一种兄弟姐妹之间的关系，这对我来说很有趣，因为这是一种很酷的动态，你在电视节目中并不总是能看到。这很有趣，让我想尝试参与其中。”

paras.en: As Bebeto, a doctor, veteran of the replicants vs. humans war, and a black-market dealer helping his species procure IDs and passports off-world, Abold enjoyed exploring the many facets of his character.
paras.zh: 贝贝托是一名医生，是复制人与人类战争的老兵，也是一名帮助他的物种在外星世界获取身份证和护照的黑市商人，阿伯德喜欢探索自己角色的许多方面。

paras.en: "Much like Matthew and Lewis, for me it was the journey that Bebeto goes on," Abold adds. "Starting out as someone who’s so hopeful and has to try and scrape up the last dregs of hope as things start falling apart. Being subject to circumstances like that inherently make for an interesting story arc and story in general. Throwing myself into that, especially after how well Silka crafted the story and script, was something I was totally ready for."
paras.zh: “就像马修和刘易斯一样，对我来说，这是贝贝托继续的旅程，”阿博尔德补充道。 “作为一个充满希望的人，当事情开始分崩离析时，必须尝试并拾起最后一丝希望。受到这样的环境的影响，本质上会产生一个有趣的故事情节和故事。全身心投入其中，尤其是在西尔卡精心制作了故事和剧本之后，我已经做好了准备。”

paras.en: "Blade Runner 2099’s" sets and locations feature detailed production design that allowed the actors to experience a seamless transition into the complex shoot.
paras.zh: 《银翼杀手 2099》的场景和场景采用了详细的制作设计，让演员能够体验到复杂拍摄的无缝过渡。

paras.en: "For me and Dimitri, our first day was in Bebeto’s apartment, and it was all so well-realized,” Gribben recalls.
paras.zh: “对我和迪米特里来说，我们的第一天是在贝贝托的公寓里，这一切都是那么清晰，”格里本回忆道。

paras.en: "You saw all the gadgets because obviously Bebeto was a bit of a tinkerer of a character and had lots of machinery and works and stuff. It took up about 70% of the acting, and we just had to come with compelling conviction. It made it so easy. When you audition for these things, you feel like you have to act more because you’re in a blue screen vacuum. But then you’re there, and it’s so visually well created like that, it made it so easy to be immersed in it."
paras.zh: “你看到所有的小玩意是因为贝贝托显然是一个喜欢修补角色的人，有很多机械和作品之类的东西。它占据了大约 70% 的表演时间，我们只需要带着令人信服的信念来。它让一切变得如此简单。当你试镜这些东西时，你觉得你必须表演更多，因为你处于蓝屏真空中。但当你在那里时，它在视觉上创造得如此出色，它让你很容易沉浸在其中它。”

paras.en: "Blade Runner 2099" is currently airing all 8 episodes exclusively on Prime Video.
paras.zh: 《银翼杀手 2099》的全部 8 集目前正在 Prime Video 上独家播出。

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

articles.title: I think this might be the best smart telescope for nebula photography — I'm amazed it's $500 off
articles.author: Harry Bennett

paras.en: Take a look back at our main image again; see that in the background? That's the North America Nebula that I photographed with the Vaonis Vespera Pro 2 as part of my recent testing. I was massively impressed, both by its performance and the fact that this new smart telescope is currently on sale at its lowest-ever price for Black Friday 2026.
paras.zh: 再次回顾一下我们的主图；看到背景了吗？这是我最近测试时使用 Vaonis Vespera Pro 2 拍摄的北美星云。它的性能给我留下了深刻的印象，而且这款新型智能望远镜目前正在 2026 年黑色星期五以有史以来最低的价格出售。

paras.en: You can buy the Vaonis Vespera Pro 2, on sale right now for $500 cheaper on Amazon in this early Black Friday smart telescope deal — now at its lowest-ever price.
paras.zh: 您可以在亚马逊黑色星期五智能望远镜早期促销活动中以便宜 500 美元的价格购买 Vaonis Vespera Pro 2，目前价格为有史以来最低。

paras.en: I would expect this level of astrophotography from huge observatories and space telescopes, not from a consumer smart telescope. After setting up the Vespera Pro 2 for just an hour in my backyard, I was blown away by the resulting image.
paras.zh: 我希望大型天文台和太空望远镜能够实现这种水平的天文摄影，而不是消费类智能望远镜。在我的后院设置 Vespera Pro 2 仅一个小时后，我就被生成的图像震惊了。

paras.en: This is the second release of the Vaonis Vespera Pro. Just like the original, it has a 12.5MP sensor, 225GB internal storage, a built-in hygrometer and 11-hour battery life, but with some changes. The optical design has been upgraded to increase sharpness, direct USB-C file transfer and ships with an adjustable carbon fiber tripod.
paras.zh: 这是 Vaonis Vespera Pro 的第二个版本。就像原来的一样，它有 12.5MP 传感器、225GB 内部存储、内置湿度计和 11 小时电池寿命，但有一些变化。光学设计经过升级，可提高清晰度、直接 USB-C 文件传输，并配有可调节碳纤维三脚架。

paras.en: We gave the original 4.5/5 stars in our Vaonis Vespera Pro review.
paras.zh: 我们在 Vaonis Vespera Pro 评测中给了最初的 4.5/5 星评价。

paras.en: Ahead of Black Friday on Nov. 27, you can get $500 off possibly the best smart telescope for nebula and wide-field photography. We have just finished testing the Vespera Pro 2 and think it is at the top of its league, adding noticeable upgrades for professionals to the still amazing Vaonis Vespera Pro.
paras.zh: 在 11 月 27 日黑色星期五之前，您可以享受 500 美元优惠，购买可能是最好的星云和广域摄影智能望远镜。我们刚刚完成了 Vespera Pro 2 的测试，认为它处于同类产品中的佼佼者，为专业人士在仍然令人惊叹的 Vaonis Vespera Pro 上添加了显着的升级。

paras.en: - Check out our Black Friday page, where we bring you the best deals of Black Friday 2026, including early telescope deals.
paras.zh: - 查看我们的黑色星期五页面，我们为您带来 2026 年黑色星期五的最佳优惠，包括早期望远镜优惠。

paras.en: - We've also got you covered with reviews and rankings of the best telescopes, binoculars, star projectors, cameras, drones, Lego, streaming and more.
paras.zh: - 我们还为您提供了最佳望远镜、双筒望远镜、星光投影仪、相机、无人机、乐高、流媒体等的评论和排名。

paras.en: It's an impressive balance Vaonis have struck here between usability and premium astrophotography output. Prior to the pro-line of Vespera smart telescopes, I would have thought that this quality of astrophotography would require the highest levels of astronomy knowledge, alongside a pricey lineup of separate instruments. Don't get me wrong, the Vespera Pro 2 is not cheap but it really does have everything you need for capturing the wonders of the night sky with ease.
paras.zh: Vaonis 在可用性和优质天文摄影输出之间取得了令人印象深刻的平衡。在推出专业版 Vespera 智能望远镜之前，我本以为这种质量的天文摄影需要最高水平的天文学知识，以及一系列昂贵的独立仪器。不要误会我的意思，Vespera Pro 2 并不便宜，但它确实拥有轻松捕捉夜空奇观所需的一切。

paras.en: Operation is controlled from the Singularity app on a smart device and setup takes minutes. After connecting the telescope, simply click on your chosen target to start automatic location and imaging. The app is intuitive and helpful for beginners, suggesting a range of night sky targets that are observable from your location and customisable plans that allow you to set a range of targets for automatic imaging throughout the night, so you can get some rest.
paras.zh: 操作由智能设备上的 Singularity 应用程序控制，设置只需几分钟。连接望远镜后，只需点击您选择的目标即可开始自动定位和成像。该应用程序直观且对初学者很有帮助，它会建议一系列可从您所在位置观测到的夜空目标，并可自定义计划，让您设置一系列目标以在整个晚上自动成像，以便您得到一些休息。

paras.en: We wrote about an early Black Friday deal on the the Vaonis Vespera Pro last week when it dropped in price, but Vaonis has now made both models of their Vespera Pro the same price. If you were thinking of getting a pro smart telescope for highly detailed nebula photography, you may as well get the better version. It comes with a fully adjustable tripod, enhanced data transfer and an overhauled optical design for maximum performance.
paras.zh: 上周，我们曾报道过 Vaonis Vespera Pro 的黑色星期五促销活动，当时它的价格有所下降，但 Vaonis 现在已将两款 Vespera Pro 的价格定为相同价格。如果您正在考虑购买专业智能望远镜来进行高度详细的星云摄影，那么您不妨购买更好的版本。它配备了完全可调的三脚架、增强的数据传输和彻底改进的光学设计，以实现最佳性能。

paras.en: This is a great model for expanding your knowledge of different types of objects in the universe. Do you know what a dark nebula is? I didn't until I decided to try and image one with the Vespera Pro 2. My attempts are not the best, but you can make out the clouds of dark dust that block out starlight behind them in the Dark Shark Nebula and the Seahorse Nebula. I'm sure that if I set these targets for "multi-night observation" in the app, those images would keep getting stronger and more detailed.
paras.zh: 这是一个很好的模型，可以扩展您对宇宙中不同类型物体的了解。你知道什么是暗星云吗？直到我决定尝试使用 Vespera Pro 2 拍摄一张照片时，我才开始这样做。我的尝试并不是最好的，但您可以在暗鲨鱼星云和海马星云中辨认出遮挡其后面星光的暗尘埃云。我确信，如果我在应用程序中设置“多夜观察”的目标，这些图像将会变得更强大、更详细。

paras.en: On top of continuing observations from past sessions, the Vespera Pro 2 also offers mosaic mode for expanding your field of view on a certain target. This means that you can image vast expanses of the night sky without having to manually stitch together all the frames yourself. The Vespera Pro 2 does it for you. Here is my attempt at capturing the monumental supernova remnant, The Cygnus Loop. Again, it is fairly faint apart from the Eastern and Western Veil nebulas, but enabling multi-night observation will keep adding to this image whenever you get the chance to pick up where you left off.
paras.zh: 除了对过去的持续观察之外，Vespera Pro 2 还提供马赛克模式，用于扩展特定目标的视野。这意味着您可以拍摄广阔的夜空图像，而无需自己手动将所有帧拼接在一起。 Vespera Pro 2 可以为您做到这一点。这是我尝试捕捉巨大的超新星遗迹——天鹅座环。同样，与东部和西部面纱星云相比，它相当微弱，但是只要您有机会从上次停下的地方继续进行多夜观测，就会不断增加该图像的质量。

paras.en: Harry joined Space.com in December 2024 as an e-commerce staff writer covering cameras, optics, and skywatching content. Based in the UK, Harry graduated in 2019 with a Bachelor's degree in American Literature with Creative Writing from the University of East Anglia. A keen photographer, Harry has strong experience with astrophotography and has captured celestial objects with a range of cameras and smart telescopes. As a lifelong skywatcher, Harry remembers watching the Perseid meteor shower every summer in his hometown and being amazed by the wonders of the night sky.
paras.zh: Harry 于 2024 年 12 月加入 Space.com，担任电子商务特约撰稿人，涵盖相机、光学和观天内容。 Harry 居住在英国，于 2019 年毕业于东安格利亚大学，获得美国文学与创意写作学士学位。哈利是一位敏锐的摄影师，在天文摄影方面拥有丰富的经验，并使用一系列相机和智能望远镜捕捉到天体。作为一名终生的天文观察者，哈利记得每年夏天都会在家乡观看英仙座流星雨，并对夜空的奇观感到惊叹。

paras.en: Key features: 50mm aperture, quadruplet apochromatic optics, hard case, adjustable tripod, 12.5 MP Sony IMX676 sensor (up to 50 MP via CovalENS live mosaic), built-in hygrometer dew-control sensor, lens cap, anti-theft system, 225GB internal storage, 4000+ object database in Singularity app.
paras.zh: 主要特点：50mm 光圈、四重复消色差光学器件、硬盒、可调节三脚架、12.5 MP 索尼 IMX676 传感器（通过 CovalENS 实时马赛克最高可达 50 MP）、内置湿度计露水控制传感器、镜头盖、防盗系统、225GB 内部存储、Singularity 应用程序中的 4000 多个对象数据库。

paras.en: Price history: The Vaonis Vespera Pro 2 usually retails for $2,990, but this price brings it down to $2,490, which is its lowest ever price.
paras.zh: 价格历史：Vaonis Vespera Pro 2 通常零售价为 2,990 美元，但这一价格使其降至 2,490 美元，这是其有史以来的最低价格。

paras.en: Review consensus: We currently have this model in for testing and our early results are astonishing. We think it is one of the best smart telescopes for wide-field targets like the Andromeda galaxy (M31) and nebulas.
paras.zh: 审查共识：我们目前正在测试这个模型，我们的早期结果令人惊讶。我们认为它是针对仙女座星系（M31）和星云等宽视场目标的最佳智能望远镜之一。

articles.title: Green light for Starmind: SpaceX gets approval to deploy 1 million AI satellites
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: Earth orbit could get a lot more crowded in the coming years.
paras.zh: 未来几年，地球轨道可能会变得更加拥挤。

paras.en: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) just granted SpaceX approval to deploy one million of its Starmind AI data-center satellites in orbit.
paras.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会 (FCC) 刚刚批准 SpaceX 在轨道上部署 100 万颗 Starmind AI 数据中心卫星。

paras.en: "This action opens a bold new frontier for the computing infrastructure needed to power America's leadership and growth," FCC Chairman Brendan Carr said today (Nov. 25) in a statement announcing the approval.
paras.zh: FCC 主席布伦丹·卡尔 (Brendan Carr) 今天（11 月 25 日）在宣布批准的声明中表示：“这一行动为推动美国领导力和增长所需的计算基础设施开辟了大胆的新领域。”

paras.en: AI has become central to SpaceX's business plans and identity over the past year or so. For example, the company has said that it's eyeing a "total addressable market" of $28.5 trillion over the long haul — and nearly $23 trillion of that is in "enterprise AI applications."
paras.zh: 在过去一年左右的时间里，人工智能已经成为 SpaceX 商业计划和形象的核心。例如，该公司表示，其长期目标是实现 28.5 万亿美元的“总潜在市场”，其中近 23 万亿美元用于“企业人工智能应用”。

paras.en: Starmind is key to those lofty ambitions. SpaceX founder and CEO Elon Musk believes that the future of AI compute is in space, where energy (from the sun) is unlimited and there are no land-owning neighbors to lodge NIMBY complaints.
paras.zh: Starmind 是实现这些远大抱负的关键。 SpaceX 创始人兼首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 认为，人工智能计算的未来在于太空，那里的能源（来自太阳）是无限的，而且没有拥有土地的邻居提出邻避投诉。

paras.en: SpaceX aims to launch the first of its Starmind satellites in the third quarter of 2027. The spacecraft will fly on the company's fully reusable Starship megarocket, which has deployed 26 of SpaceX's next-gen Starlink satellites on its most recent two test flights.
paras.zh: SpaceX 的目标是在 2027 年第三季度发射第一颗 Starmind 卫星。该航天器将在该公司完全可重复使用的 Starship 巨型火箭上飞行，该火箭在最近的两次测试飞行中部署了 26 颗 SpaceX 的下一代 Starlink 卫星。

paras.en: Those 52 spacecraft are the vanguard of another enormous constellation: Musk has said that the next-gen Starlink network will eventually consists of about 100,000 satellites.
paras.zh: 这 52 艘航天器是另一个庞大星座的先锋：马斯克曾表示，下一代星链网络最终将由约 10 万颗卫星组成。

paras.en: The planned numbers for Starlink and Starmind are truly mind-boggling. To put them into perspective: Since the dawn of the space age in 1957, humanity has launched a total of just 28,000 satellites, give or take a few hundred. And the biggest constellation ever operated to date, the current iteration of Starlink, consists of about 11,000 spacecraft.
paras.zh: Starlink 和 Starmind 的计划数量确实令人难以置信。客观来看：自 1957 年太空时代到来以来，人类总共发射了 28,000 颗卫星，大约有几百颗。迄今为止运行的最大的星座，即当前的星链，由约 11,000 艘航天器组成。

paras.en: These coming buildouts will require an enormous number of launches. Starship can carry a maximum of 60 V3 Starlink satellites per launch, for instance, so it will take about 1,700 liftoffs just to assemble that network (and more to maintain it, as the operational life of each satellite is expected to be about five years).
paras.zh: 这些即将到来的扩建将需要大量的发射。例如，星舰每次发射最多可携带 60 颗 V3 星链卫星，因此仅组装该网络就需要大约 1,700 次升空（并且需要更多的时间来维护它，因为每颗卫星的使用寿命预计约为五年）。

paras.en: Putting so many satellites into orbit also raises the risks of collisions. SpaceX has proven to be extremely proficient in this regard with its current Starlink satellites, which can detect and avoid potential collisions autonomously. But more evasive maneuvers will be required as space gets more and more crowded.
paras.zh: 将如此多的卫星送入轨道也增加了碰撞的风险。事实证明，SpaceX 现有的 Starlink 卫星在这方面非常精通，这些卫星可以自主检测并避免潜在的碰撞。但随着空间变得越来越拥挤，将需要更多的规避机动。

paras.en: SpaceX isn't the only company that aims to operate data centers in space; Cowboy Space, Starcloud, Blue Origin and Google, among other companies, have voiced similar ambitions. Starcloud and Google, in fact, have already launched AI pathfinder satellites.
paras.zh: SpaceX 并不是唯一一家致力于在太空运营数据中心的公司； Cowboy Space、Starcloud、蓝色起源和谷歌等公司也表达了类似的雄心。事实上，星云和谷歌已经发射了人工智能探路卫星。

paras.en: "Compute campuses or data centers are essential to sustaining America's leadership in SI," Carr said in the same statement. ("SI" stands for super intelligence, the Trump administration's preferred term for AI.)
paras.zh: 卡尔在同一份声明中表示：“计算园区或数据中心对于维持美国在 SI 领域的领导地位至关重要。” （“SI”代表超级智能，这是特朗普政府对人工智能的首选术语。）

paras.en: "By moving compute capacity beyond Earth, SpaceX and the many competitors working on their own orbital data centers are meeting the moment," Carr added. "This is the kind of American ingenuity that can unite our strengths in space and advanced technology, reinforce our economic leadership, and expand prosperity here at home."
paras.zh: 卡尔补充道：“通过将计算能力转移到地球之外，SpaceX 和许多在自己的轨道数据中心工作的竞争对手正在迎接这一时刻。” “这种美国的独创性可以结合我们在太空和先进技术方面的优势，加强我们的经济领导地位，并扩大国内的繁荣。”

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: What role does industry play in Europe’s space sovereignty push?
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Jason Rainbow interviews Atle Woello, the CEO and senior vice president of the space systems and surveillance business unit at Kongsberg NanoAvionics. They discuss the role space plays for defense systems that are increasingly interconnected across domains, as well as the role that the European industrial base can play in the continent’s recent political and fundraising push to bolster sovereignty, independence and resilience in space.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Jason Rainbow 采访了 Kongsberg NanoAvionics 空间系统和监视业务部门的首席执行官兼高级副总裁 Atle Woello。他们讨论了太空对于跨领域互联日益紧密的防御系统的作用，以及欧洲工业基础在欧洲大陆最近为加强太空主权、独立和复原力而进行的政治和筹款活动中可以发挥的作用。

paras.en: This episode is sponsored by Xiphos Systems.
paras.zh: 本集由 Xiphos Systems 赞助。

paras.en: Xiphos Systems develops compact, high-performance embedded computing solutions for spacecraft and aerospace applications. Founded in 1996 and based in Montreal, the company specializes in commercial off-the-shelf processing platforms designed for space, combining processors, programmable logic, storage, networking, and RF capabilities in low size, weight, power, and cost designs. Its portfolio includes processor boards, onboard computers, RF payload systems, and AI-capable computing platforms for satellites, launch vehicles, lunar missions, and robotics. With more than two decades of experience and over 1,000 processor cards delivered, Xiphos supports customers from system integration through deployment, helping bring reliable computing closer to the mission.
paras.zh: Xiphos Systems 为航天器和航空航天应用开发紧凑、高性能的嵌入式计算解决方案。该公司成立于 1996 年，总部位于蒙特利尔，专注于为太空设计的商用现成处理平台，将处理器、可编程逻辑、存储、网络和射频功能与低尺寸、重量、功耗和成本设计相结合。其产品组合包括处理器板、机载计算机、射频有效载荷系统以及用于卫星、运载火箭、月球任务和机器人的人工智能计算平台。 Xiphos 拥有二十多年的经验和交付的 1,000 多个处理器卡，为客户提供从系统集成到部署的支持，帮助实现可靠的计算更接近使命。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

articles.title: UARX Space Marks a Milestone for Spain’s Space Industry with the Maiden Flight of OSSIE-D, Featuring a Complete Power Subsystem Supplied by DHV Technology
articles.author: UARX Space

paras.en: Nigrán, Spain | November 12 2026 – UARX Space has achieved a major milestone for Spain’s space industry with the deployment of OSSIE-D, an Orbital Transfer Vehicle (OTV) designed and manufactured entirely in Spain, with 75% of its components developed in-house by the company. Launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, OSSIE-D was deployed using SAU&RON 24, UARX Space’s proprietary separation system. The achievement marks a world first, bringing together an orbital transfer vehicle and a separation system developed by the same company in a single mission.
paras.zh: 西班牙尼格兰| 2026 年 11 月 12 日 – UARX Space 部署了 OSSIE-D，实现了西班牙航天工业的一个重要里程碑。OSSIE-D 是一种完全在西班牙设计和制造的轨道传输飞行器 (OTV)，其 75% 的组件由该公司内部开发。 OSSIE-D 由 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭发射，并使用 UARX Space 的专有分离系统 SAU&RON 24 进行部署。这一成就标志着世界首创，将同一家公司开发的轨道传输飞行器和分离系统结合在一次任务中。

paras.en: The mission represents a significant advance in Spain’s space technology capabilities, demonstrating the ability to develop and integrate key technologies for in-space transportation and orbital operations. By combining its OTV with its own SAU&RON 24 separation system, UARX Space reinforces its integrated approach to spacecraft development, spanning the vehicle itself and the technology required for its deployment into orbit.
paras.zh: 该任务代表了西班牙空间技术能力的重大进步，展示了开发和集成空间运输和轨道运行关键技术的能力。通过将其 OTV 与其自己的 SAU&RON 24 分离系统相结合，UARX Space 强化了其航天器开发的集成方法，涵盖航天器本身及其部署到轨道所需的技术。

paras.en: OSSIE-D also highlights the importance of collaboration between specialized companies across the European space industry. For this mission, DHV Technology designed, qualified and manufactured the vehicle’s complete electrical power subsystem, including the solar arrays, Power Conditioning and Distribution Unit (PCDU), main battery modules, SADA (Solar Array Drive Assembly) and additional supporting subsystems required to meet the mission’s power requirements.
paras.zh: OSSIE-D 还强调了欧洲航天工业专业公司之间合作的重要性。对于此次任务，DHV Technology 设计、鉴定和制造了车辆的完整电力子系统，包括太阳能电池阵列、功率调节和配电单元 (PCDU)、主电池模块、SADA（太阳能阵列驱动组件）以及满足任务电力要求所需的其他支持子系统。

paras.en: “OSSIE-D represents a milestone for the Spanish aerospace industry and shows how collaboration between companies with complementary capabilities can turn ambitious missions into reality. DHV Technology has been a key partner, with its expertise, highly reliable solutions and team commitment making a significant contribution to the mission’s energy capabilities. This partnership also highlights the potential of the Spanish space sector to innovate and compete at both European and global level,” said Dr. Andrés Villa, CTO and Co-Founder of UARX Space.
paras.zh: UARX Space 首席技术官兼联合创始人 Andrés Villa 博士表示：“OSSIE-D 代表了西班牙航空航天业的一个里程碑，展示了具有互补能力的公司之间的合作如何能够将雄心勃勃的任务变为现实。DHV Technology 一直是关键合作伙伴，其专业知识、高度可靠的解决方案和团队承诺为任务的能源能力做出了重大贡献。这种合作伙伴关系还凸显了西班牙航天部门在欧洲和全球层面的创新和竞争潜力。”

paras.en: Following launch, DHV Technology’s electrical power subsystem is operating nominally in orbit, starting from the generation of the power with the solar arrays, control and distribution with the PCDU and storage with the battery, including initial telemetry which confirms that the system is performing as expected. This represents an important milestone for DHV Technology’s engineering team and for the OSSIE-D mission as a whole.
paras.zh: 发射后，DHV Technology 的电力子系统名义上在轨道上运行，从太阳能电池阵列发电、PCDU 控制和分配以及电池存储开始，包括确认系统按预期运行的初始遥测。 This represents an important milestone for DHV Technology’s engineering team and for the OSSIE-D mission as a whole.

paras.en: “Seeing the full electrical power subsystem fully developed by DHV for OSSIE-D operating as expected in orbit is an important milestone for our team and for our collaboration with UARX Space,” said Dr. Vicente Díaz, Managing Director and Co-Founder of DHV Technology. “This achievement reflects the close cooperation between both engineering teams and the work invested throughout the design, manufacturing, testing and integration phases. We are proud to contribute to this mission and look forward to OSSIE-D continuing to deliver positive results for UARX Space and all the partners involved.”
paras.zh: DHV Technology 董事总经理兼联合创始人 Vicente Díaz 博士表示：“看到 DHV 完全开发的用于 OSSIE-D 的完整电力子系统在轨道上按预期运行，对于我们的团队以及我们与 UARX Space 的合作来说是一个重要的里程碑。” “这一成就反映了两个工程团队之间的密切合作以及在整个设计、制造、测试和集成阶段所投入的工作。我们很自豪能为这一任务做出贡献，并期待 OSSIE-D 继续为 UARX Space 和所有相关合作伙伴带来积极的成果。”

paras.en: Beyond supplying the electrical power subsystem, DHV Technology is using OSSIE-D as a platform to test innovative technological concepts in orbit. The results obtained during the mission will help increase the technological maturity of several of the company’s solutions, extending the value of the mission beyond its immediate operational objectives. These developments include novel electrical interconnection methods, improved solar panel deployment and hinge mechanisms, as well as advanced photovoltaic technologies.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The collaboration between UARX Space and DHV Technology underscores the importance of combining specialized engineering capabilities to deliver increasingly advanced space missions. While UARX Space leads the development of the OTV and its deployment architecture, DHV Technology’s electrical power subsystem provides a critical element for the vehicle’s operation while enabling the evaluation of new technologies under real space operating conditions.
paras.zh: UARX Space 和 DHV Technology 之间的合作强调了结合专业工程能力来交付日益先进的太空任务的重要性。虽然 UARX Space 引领 OTV 及其部署架构的开发，但 DHV Technology 的电力子系统为车辆的运行提供了关键要素，同时能够在真实的空间运行条件下评估新技术。

paras.en: OSSIE-D therefore represents progress on two fronts: it strengthens UARX Space’s capabilities and position in the in-space transportation sector, while providing an opportunity to validate technologies that could support future missions. The combination of an OTV developed in Spain, a proprietary separation system and a complete electrical power subsystem supplied by DHV Technology demonstrates the potential of Spain’s space industry to deliver increasingly complex technological projects.
paras.zh: 因此，OSSIE-D 代表了两个方面的进展：它增强了 UARX Space 在太空运输领域的能力和地位，同时提供了验证可支持未来任务的技术的机会。西班牙开发的 OTV、专有的分离系统和 DHV Technology 提供的完整电力子系统的结合展示了西班牙航天工业交付日益复杂的技术项目的潜力。

paras.zh: 关于DHV Technology https://dhvtechnology.com/

articles.title: Commercial Space Federation Welcomes CesiumAstro as a New Associate Member
articles.author: Commercial Space Federation

paras.en: November 13, 2026— Washington, D.C.—The Commercial Space Federation (CSF) is pleased to welcome CesiumAstro as its newest Associate Member. A global leader in advanced connectivity solutions for the space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. CesiumAstro’s addition further strengthens CSF’s diverse membership and the Federation’s work to advance a competitive, innovative, and sustainable U.S. commercial space economy.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月 13 日——华盛顿特区——商业航天联合会 (CSF) 很高兴欢迎 CesiumAstro 成为其最新准会员。 CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。 CesiumAstro 的加入进一步加强了 CSF 的多元化成员资格以及联合会推动竞争性、创新性和可持续的美国商业太空经济的工作。

paras.en: CesiumAstro is a lobal leader in advanced connectivity solutions for space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. Its full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads and advanced computing systems. CesiumAstro maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards. Headquartered near Austin, Texas, the company operates additional facilities in Colorado, California, Washington, D.C., Florida, the United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore, Taiwan, and Japan.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，CesiumAstro 提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。其全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。 CesiumAstro 保持与内部设计、制造和测试能力的完全垂直整合，并通过了 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证。该公司总部位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀附近，在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、华盛顿特区、佛罗里达州、英国、德国、新加坡、台湾和日本设有其他工厂。

paras.en: CesiumAstro recently announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion, and unveiled Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation. The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 最近宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元，并推出了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划中的 737 颗卫星、支持人工智能的星座。新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has expanded its capabilities through three strategic acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr, strengthening the company’s capabilities across semiconductor technology, mission software, and artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 在过去的 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项战略收购扩大了其能力：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr，增强了公司在半导体技术、任务软件和人工智能方面的能力。

paras.en: CesiumAstro’s full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads, and advanced compute systems. The company maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 的全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。该公司与通过 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证的内部设计、制造和测试能力保持完整的垂直整合。

paras.en: “A thriving commercial economy in low Earth orbit needs reliable communications and a clear path from development to operations. CesiumAstro is joining CSF’s Commercial LEO Council to bring our communications expertise to that effort. We look forward to advancing policies that encourage investment, expand government use of commercial services, and support companies building the next generation of space infrastructure.”
paras.zh: “近地轨道蓬勃发展的商业经济需要可靠的通信以及从开发到运营的清晰路径。CesiumAstro 正在加入 CSF 的商业 LEO 委员会，将我们的通信专业知识用于这一努力。我们期待推进鼓励投资、扩大政府对商业服务的使用以及支持企业建设下一代空间基础设施的政策。”

paras.en: – Josh Ingersoll, Director of Spectrum and Regulatory Affairs at CesiumAstro
paras.zh: – Josh Ingersoll，CesiumAstro 频谱和监管事务总监

paras.en: Founded in 2006, the Commercial Space Federation (CSF) and its members are laying the foundation for democratizing access to outer space for scientists, students, civilians, and businesses. All while working towards the goal of expanding the U.S. Commercial Space Economy. Through the promotion of technological innovation, CSF and its diverse membership are guiding the bolstering of U.S. leadership in aerospace and inspiring America’s next generation of engineers and explorers. CSF also serves as the commercial space industry’s primary advocate with the U.S. Congress and the Administration, helping inform the development and implementation of policy priorities. By engaging with congressional players, CSF is able to provide recommendations on commercial space issues that will impact the commercial space industry in the short and long term.
paras.zh: 商业太空联盟 (CSF) 及其成员成立于 2006 年，正在为科学家、学生、平民和企业进入外太空的民主化奠定基础。同时努力实现扩大美国商业太空经济的目标。通过促进技术创新，CSF 及其多元化成员正在指导巩固美国在航空航天领域的领导地位，并激励美国下一代工程师和探险家。 CSF 还担任美国国会和政府商业航天业的主要倡导者，帮助为政策优先事项的制定和实施提供信息。通过与国会参与者合作，CSF 能够就商业航天问题提供建议，这些问题将在短期和长期影响商业航天行业。

articles.title: Gaza’s widows raise their families alone: ‘We do our duties twice over, but where are our rights?’

paras.en: Gaza’s widows raise their families alone: ‘We do our duties twice over, but where are our rights?’
paras.zh: 加沙的寡妇独自养家糊口：“我们双重履行了我们的职责，但我们的权利在哪里？”

paras.en: For women in Gaza who lost their husbands in the war, providing for a family no longer means just putting food on the table. Now it also means finding shelter, hauling water and keeping children in school – all from a tent.
paras.zh: 对于在战争中失去丈夫的加沙妇女来说，养家糊口不再仅仅意味着温饱。现在，这还意味着寻找庇护所、运水以及让孩子们上学——所有这些都需要在帐篷里完成。

paras.en: At the Flowers of Palestine camp, set up for widows in western Gaza City, the day begins with a walk to the water tankers. Women and their children fill buckets and plastic containers and carry them back to their canvas dwellings.
paras.zh: 在加沙城西部为寡妇设立的巴勒斯坦之花营地，新的一天从步行到水罐车开始。妇女和她们的孩子把水桶和塑料容器装满，然后把它们带回她们的帆布住所。

paras.en: “We carry out our duties twice over – our own and the man’s as well – but where are our rights?” said Kholoud Farajallah, a mother of three, speaking to our UN News correspondent in Gaza.
paras.zh: “我们双重履行我们的义务——我们自己的和人的——但我们的权利在哪里？”三个孩子的母亲霍卢德·法拉贾拉 (Kholoud Farajallah) 在加沙接受我们的联合国新闻记者采访时说道。

paras.en: According to UN Women, more than 86,000 households in Gaza are now headed by women.
paras.zh: 据联合国妇女署称，加沙目前有超过 86,000 个家庭由女性担任户主。

paras.en: That is nearly one in four, compared with one in nine before the war. On the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women, marked on 25 November, their struggle shows how the war’s harm to women goes far beyond death and injury.
paras.zh: 这一比例接近四分之一，而战前为九分之一。 11 月 25 日是消除对妇女的暴力行为国际日，她们的斗争表明战争对妇女的伤害远远超出了死亡和伤害。

paras.en: Ms. Farajallah lost her husband early in the war. With no money coming in, she had to give up her master’s degree in mathematics and teaching methods.
paras.zh: 法拉贾拉女士在战争初期失去了丈夫。由于没有钱进来，她不得不放弃数学和教学方法的硕士学位。

paras.en: She started out by baking pastries and sending her son to sell them around the displacement camps. Later she built a small shop out of timber and plastic sheeting near the camp, which now covers her children’s basic needs.
paras.zh: 她一开始烘烤糕点，然后派儿子到流离失所者营地周围出售。后来，她在营地附近用木材和塑料布建了一家小商店，现在可以满足孩子们的基本需求。

paras.en: Her day doesn’t end at the counter. She also runs the household, looks after the children and keeps on top of their schooling.
paras.zh: 她的一天并没有在柜台结束。她还负责管理家庭、照顾孩子并负责他们的学业。

paras.en: In another tent in the camp, Umm Mohammed Abu Rayala is raising seven children. She alone has to feed them, look after them and see that they keep learning.
paras.zh: 在营地的另一个帐篷里，乌姆·穆罕默德·阿布·拉亚拉 (Umm Mohammed Abu Rayala) 正在抚养七个孩子。她必须独自喂养他们，照顾他们并确保他们不断学习。

paras.en: Losing their husbands has left women with burdens they never carried before the war, she told UN News. They now fill the roles of both father and mother, in a daily life with nothing stable in it.
paras.zh: 她告诉联合国新闻，失去丈夫给妇女带来了战前从未承受过的负担。他们现在扮演着父亲和母亲的角色，在日常生活中没有任何稳定的东西。

paras.en: UN Women says 68 per cent of households headed by women do not have adequate shelter, and 67 per cent urgently need cash assistance just to get through each day. On average, these families have been forced to move eight times since October 2023.
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署表示，68％的以女性为户主的家庭没有足够的住所，67％的家庭迫切需要现金援助才能度过每一天。自 2023 年 10 月以来，这些家庭平均被迫搬家八次。

paras.en: The Flowers of Palestine initiative is trying to meet some of those needs. Nidaa Matar, one of its organizers, said it began as a personal effort in response to the growing number of widows and orphans the war was leaving behind.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦之花倡议正试图满足其中一些需求。活动组织者之一尼达·马塔尔 (Nidaa Matar) 表示，这一活动最初是个人的努力，旨在应对战争留下的越来越多的寡妇和孤儿。

paras.en: “We reached out to different organizations and associations to make this idea a reality. Thank God, we managed to build this camp, which shelters 82 widowed families,” she said. “We were able to give a home to families who didn’t know where to live, because they had no breadwinner and no income.”
paras.zh: “我们联系了不同的组织和协会，让这个想法成为现实。感谢上帝，我们成功建造了这个营地，为 82 个丧偶家庭提供了庇护，”她说。 “我们能够为那些不知道住在哪里的家庭提供一个家，因为他们没有养家糊口，也没有收入。”

paras.en: UN Women has warned that conditions will get worse as winter rains and floods sweep through displacement camps. Households headed by women are at greater risk because their shelters are flimsy and they are displaced again and again.
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署警告说，随着冬季降雨和洪水席卷流离失所者营地，情况将变得更糟。以妇女为户主的家庭面临更大的风险，因为她们的住所很脆弱，并且一次又一次地流离失所。

paras.en: Nearly 50,000 women and girls in Gaza have been killed or seriously injured since the war began, according to UN Women. More than 38,000 of them were killed, and around 11,700 have been left with permanent disabilities.
paras.zh: 据联合国妇女署称，自战争开始以来，加沙已有近 5 万名妇女和女童被杀或重伤。其中超过 38,000 人死亡，约 11,700 人永久残疾。

paras.en: Between the tents, the water queues and the daily hunt for a living, women like Ms. Farajallah and Ms. Abu Rayala keep their families going. How much longer they can do it is another question.
paras.zh: 法拉贾拉 (Farajallah) 和阿布·拉亚拉 (Abu Rayala) 等妇女在帐篷、排队取水和日常谋生之间维持着家庭的生计。他们还能坚持多久是另一个问题。

paras.en: “As a woman, I have received none of my rights at all,” Ms. Farajallah said. “I gave up my education, I gave up my life, and I devote everything – all my time – to raising my children. But until when?”
paras.zh: “作为一名女性，我根本没有获得任何权利，”法拉贾拉女士说。 “我放弃了我的教育，我放弃了我的生活，我投入了一切——所有的时间——来抚养我的孩子。但要等到什么时候呢？”

articles.title: Governments and experts gather in Nairobi to tackle the global housing crisis

paras.en: Governments and experts gather in Nairobi to tackle the global housing crisis
paras.zh: 各国政府和专家齐聚内罗毕应对全球住房危机

paras.en: A home is a place where people can feel safe. Yet billions worldwide do not have a proper place to live. As the global housing crisis deepens, government representatives and housing experts are gathering at the United Nations in Nairobi from 26-27 November to discuss how to address it.
paras.zh: 家是一个让人感到安全的地方。然而，全世界有数十亿人没有合适的居住地。随着全球住房危机的加深，政府代表和住房专家将于 11 月 26 日至 27 日齐聚内罗毕联合国，讨论如何解决这一问题。

paras.en: For many people living in informal settlements, the housing crisis goes hand in hand with the climate crisis.
paras.zh: 对于许多生活在非正规住区的人来说，住房危机与气候危机齐头并进。

paras.en: “People don’t sleep at night because they don't know if their houses will be standing the next day,” said Anacláudia Rossbach, Executive Director of UN-Habitat, the agency working to make cities more sustainable, which is hosting the meeting.
paras.zh: 联合国人居署执行主任阿纳克拉乌迪亚·罗斯巴赫（Anacláudia Rossbach）表示：“人们晚上不睡觉，因为他们不知道自己的房子第二天是否还能屹立不倒。”联合国人居署致力于让城市变得更加可持续，也是这次会议的主办方。

paras.en: The objective is to better understand the scale and nature of homelessness, improve national housing policies, and ensure that housing can withstand growing environmental and climate pressures.
paras.zh: 目标是更好地了解无家可归的规模和性质，改善国家住房政策，并确保住房能够承受日益增长的环境和气候压力。

paras.en: This is the third session of the Open-ended Intergovernmental Expert Working Group on Adequate Housing for All (OEWG-H) which was established in 2023. It aims to advance a comprehensive set of recommendations for the UN-Habitat Assembly in 2029.
paras.zh: 这是2023年成立的人人享有适足住房问题不限成员名额政府间专家工作组（OEWG-H）的第三次会议，旨在为2029年联合国人居大会提出一套全面的建议。

paras.en: Speaking to UN News ahead of the meeting, Ms. Rossbach emphasized the importance of bringing the housing crisis to the attention of Member States and building consensus on how to address it.
paras.zh: 罗斯巴赫女士在会议前接受《联合国新闻》采访时强调了提请会员国关注住房危机并就如何解决这一问题达成共识的重要性。

paras.en: Adequate housing means having the right to live somewhere in security, peace and dignity. For example, people should not fear being evicted, or that their home is unsafe because it was built with the wrong materials. She also highlighted the need to put homelessness on the global housing agenda.
paras.zh: 充足的住房意味着有权在安全、和平和有尊严的地方居住。例如，人们不应该担心被驱逐，或者他们的家因为使用了错误的材料而不安全。她还强调有必要将无家可归问题纳入全球住房议程。

paras.en: “We estimate that we have about 300 million people living without a roof over their heads, but we don't have a global definition of homelessness,” she said.
paras.zh: “我们估计大约有 3 亿人无家可归，但我们对无家可归没有一个全球性的定义，”她说。

paras.en: Having this definition means that people who are experiencing homelessness can be more easily included in housing policies in line with internationally agreed targets.
paras.zh: 有了这个定义意味着无家可归的人可以更容易地纳入符合国际商定目标的住房政策。

paras.en: However, having a home does not necessarily mean that it is safe. The latest UN-Habitat World Cities Report estimates that up to 3.4 billion people lack adequate housing, with more than 1.1 billion living in informal settlements and slums. This usually entails a lack of secure tenure, sanitation or safe water.
paras.zh: 然而，拥有一个家并不一定意味着它是安全的。联合国人居署最新的《世界城市报告》估计，多达 34 亿人缺乏足够的住房，其中超过 11 亿人生活在非正规住区和贫民窟。这通常意味着缺乏有保障的保有权、卫生设施或安全用水。

paras.en: As governments face the challenge of improving existing housing and building new homes, they must also consider the environmental consequences of construction and where these homes are built. “Housing is the cornerstone for adaptation,” she stressed.
paras.zh: 当政府面临改善现有住房和建造新住宅的挑战时，他们还必须考虑建筑工程以及这些住宅的建造地点对环境的影响。 “住房是适应的基石，”她强调。

paras.en: To address the housing crisis, an essential component remains listening to those most affected. Ms. Rossbach underscored the importance of involving local authorities and communities in the development of housing policies, especially those in more vulnerable positions. Local governments, she explained, are closer to the communities they serve and are therefore better positioned to understand their needs.
paras.zh: 为了解决住房危机，一个重要的组成部分仍然是倾听受影响最严重的人的意见。罗斯巴赫女士强调了地方当局和社区参与制定住房政策的重要性，特别是那些处于弱势地位的社区。她解释说，地方政府更接近他们所服务的社区，因此更有能力了解他们的需求。

paras.en: From communities and local governments to researchers and the private sector, efforts to address housing challenges are already underway. “They are finding solutions. They are innovating, and they are moving the frontier,” she said.
paras.zh: 从社区和地方政府到研究人员和私营部门，解决住房挑战的努力已经在进行中。 “他们正在寻找解决方案。他们正在创新，他们正在突破前沿，”她说。

paras.en: At the meeting, UN-Habitat will launch the first version of its Housing Knowledge Platform, bringing together housing data, policy resources and examples of practices from around the world.
paras.zh: 会上，人居署将推出第一版住房知识平台，汇集世界各地的住房数据、政策资源和实践范例。

paras.en: Despite the magnitude of the global housing crisis, Ms. Rossbach finds hope in the solutions already emerging on the ground.
paras.zh: 尽管全球住房危机十分严重，罗斯巴赫女士还是从已经出现的解决方案中看到了希望。

paras.en: “The decisions here, they will have a direct impact on the lives of people,” she said. “So, let's keep people at the centre of our minds this week.”
paras.zh: “这里的决定将对人们的生活产生直接影响，”她说。 “所以，本周让我们以人为本。”

articles.title: Türk warns of widening risk of atrocity crimes against Palestinians

paras.en: Türk warns of widening risk of atrocity crimes against Palestinians
paras.zh: 蒂尔克警告巴勒斯坦人遭受暴行罪的风险不断扩大

paras.en: UN human rights chief Volker Türk on Wednesday warned of a widening risk of further atrocity crimes by Israel against Palestinians, saying violence in the occupied West Bank in recent months has heightened existential fears.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克周三警告称，以色列对巴勒斯坦人实施进一步暴行的风险不断加大，称近几个月来被占领的约旦河西岸发生的暴力事件加剧了人们的生存恐惧。

paras.en: “In Gaza, my office has repeatedly warned against the risk of Israeli actions posing a real threat to the continued existence of Palestinians as a group,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在加沙，我的办公室一再警告以色列的行动可能对巴勒斯坦人作为一个群体的继续存在构成真正的威胁。”

paras.en: “Events over the past months in the occupied West Bank exacerbate our fear of such risk across the entirety of the occupied Palestinian territory.”
paras.zh: “过去几个月在被占领的约旦河西岸发生的事件加剧了我们对整个被占领巴勒斯坦领土出现这种风险的担忧。”

paras.en: “Our warnings have not been heeded, and atrocity crimes continue to recur,” the High Commissioner said. “Civilians continue to be killed, and hundreds of thousands of Palestinians have been forcibly displaced, with senior Israeli officials indicating intent for such displacement to be permanent.”
paras.zh: 高级专员表示：“我们的警告没有得到重视，暴行犯罪仍在继续发生。” “平民继续被杀害，数十万巴勒斯坦人被迫流离失所，以色列高级官员表示有意让这种流离失所成为永久性的。”

paras.en: Since the 7 October 2023 Hamas-led attacks, 42,666 Palestinians have been forcibly displaced by Israeli forces and settlers in the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, according to the UN human rights office. In Gaza, nearly two million have been forcibly displaced, often multiple times.
paras.zh: 据联合国人权办公室称，自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击以来，包括东耶路撒冷在内的西岸地区有 42,666 名巴勒斯坦人被以色列军队和定居者强迫流离失所。在加沙，近两百万人被迫流离失所，而且往往是多次流离失所。

paras.en: “I am extremely worried about the increasingly widespread and systematic nature of the violations being perpetrated across both the West Bank and Gaza,” Mr. Türk said.
paras.zh: “我对约旦河西岸和加沙地带日益普遍和系统性的侵犯行为感到极其担忧，”蒂尔克先生说。

paras.en: “Civilian infrastructure is destroyed in Gaza, as illegal settlements advance in the West Bank,” he added. “Palestinians are persistently arbitrarily detained, subjected to torture and mistreatment, and exposed to a two-tier justice system. The list goes on and on.”
paras.zh: “随着非法定居点在西岸的推进，加沙的民用基础设施遭到破坏，”他补充道。 “巴勒斯坦人持续遭到任意拘留，遭受酷刑和虐待，并面临两级司法系统的制裁。这样的例子不胜枚举。”

paras.en: He expressed particular concern over continued unlawful killings in Gaza even after a ceasefire was announced last year.
paras.zh: 他对去年宣布停火后加沙持续发生的非法杀戮表示特别关注。

paras.en: Gaza’s population is confined to an ever-shrinking sliver of the territory, he said, while Israel’s continued blockade and closure deprive Palestinians of basic survival necessities, including food, medicine and shelter.
paras.zh: 他说，加沙的人口被限制在不断缩小的领土上，而以色列的持续封锁和封锁剥夺了巴勒斯坦人的基本生存必需品，包括食品、药品和住所。

paras.en: Mr. Türk also reminded Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups of their obligation to protect civilians and to respect the safety and independence of humanitarian personnel and operations, as well as the prohibitions of summary executions, arbitrary detention, torture and other ill-treatment.
paras.zh: 图尔克先生还提醒哈马斯和其他巴勒斯坦武装团体有义务保护平民、尊重人道主义人员和行动的安全和独立性，并禁止即决处决、任意拘留、酷刑和其他虐待行为。

paras.en: In the West Bank, he pointed to systematic, violent efforts to replace Palestinian communities with Israeli settlers and to fragment the territory in a way that undermines any prospect of a contiguous future Palestinian State.
paras.zh: 他指出，在西岸，以色列定居者以系统性的暴力行为取代巴勒斯坦社区，并分裂领土，从而破坏了未来巴勒斯坦国的任何前景。

paras.en: He also cited a system of racial segregation, oppression and domination, seen most clearly in a separate legal system for Palestinians and a discriminatory movement regime that prioritises settlers’ freedom of movement over Palestinians’ ability to exercise their basic rights in daily life.
paras.zh: 他还列举了种族隔离、压迫和统治的制度，最明显地体现在针对巴勒斯坦人的单独法律制度和歧视性运动制度中，该制度优先考虑定居者的行动自由，而不是巴勒斯坦人在日常生活中行使其基本权利的能力。

paras.en: “Israeli Government representatives at highest levels have time and again spelled out policies of annexation, ethnic cleansing, and collective punishment in the West Bank,” he said. “Across society, the incitement to hatred and to perpetration of violations amounting to atrocity crimes – war crimes, crimes against humanity and even genocide – has been appalling.”
paras.zh: “以色列政府最高层代表一再阐明在西岸的吞并、种族清洗和集体惩罚政策，”他说。 “在整个社会，煽动仇恨和实施相当于暴行罪——战争罪、反人类罪甚至种族灭绝罪——的行为令人震惊。”

paras.en: “All States have the obligation to act, now, to prevent further atrocity crimes against the Palestinians,” Mr. Türk said.
paras.zh: “所有国家现在都有义务采取行动，防止针对巴勒斯坦人的进一步暴行，”蒂尔克先生说。

paras.en: “There must be independent investigations, and those responsible must be held to account. The work of the international courts in this regard must be supported by all States.”
paras.zh: “必须进行独立调查，必须追究责任人的责任。国际法院在这方面的工作必须得到所有国家的支持。”

articles.title: 'Cyborg' LeBron breaks own NBA record as Durant reaches historic milestone

paras.en: LeBron James breaks NBA record with Philadelphia 76ers as Kevin Durant joins exclusive club by passing 33,000 points
paras.zh: 勒布朗·詹姆斯随费城 76 人队打破 NBA 纪录，凯文·杜兰特以 33,000 分以上的成绩加入独家俱乐部

paras.en: LeBron James recorded his first triple-double with the Philadelphia 76ers in their victory over Miami Heat, breaking his own NBA record as the oldest to do so; Kevin Durant also became just the fifth to pass 33,000 career points during Wednesday NBA Cup action
paras.zh: 勒布朗·詹姆斯在费城 76 人队战胜迈阿密热火队的比赛中取得了他的首个三双，打破了他自己保持的 NBA 最年长三双纪录；凯文·杜兰特也成为第五位在周三 NBA 杯比赛中职业生涯得分超过 33,000 分的人

paras.en: LeBron James broke his own record as the oldest player to record a triple-double in NBA history as the Philadelphia 76ers beat the Miami Heat 111-104 in an NBA Cup game on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 周三，费城 76 人队在 NBA 杯比赛中以 111-104 击败迈阿密热火队，勒布朗·詹姆斯打破了自己的纪录，成为 NBA 历史上获得三双的最年长球员。

paras.en: The 41-year-old finished with 25 points, 12 assists and 10 rebounds, scoring 14 consecutive points in the first half, including three three-pointers.
paras.zh: 这位41岁的球员全场得到25分、12次助攻和10个篮板，上半场连续得到14分，其中包括3个三分球。

paras.en: Tyrese Maxey added 30 points for Philadelphia, while Giannis Antetokounmpo had 32 points and 14 rebounds for Miami.
paras.zh: 泰瑞斯·马克西为费城队贡献了30分，扬尼斯·阿德托昆博为迈阿密队贡献了32分和14个篮板。

paras.en: Philadelphia were without Joel Embiid for a second consecutive game due to illness and lost Jaylen Brown to left hamstring tightness at the end of the second quarter, but snapped Heat's seven-game winning streak and moved to 15-4 on the season.
paras.zh: 费城队因乔尔·恩比德连续第二场因病缺席，并在第二节末因左腿筋拉伤而失去了杰伦·布朗，但热火队的七连胜被终结，赛季战绩达到15胜4负。

paras.en: "I don't think my job is to dominate the game every night for this ball club," James said. "If they need me to dust off the cape from time to time - I can still accomplish that. That's not my job. But if they need it, I can do it at any given moment."
paras.zh: “我不认为我的工作是每晚为这个球俱乐部主宰比赛，”詹姆斯说。 “如果他们需要我时不时地掸掉斗篷上的灰尘，我仍然可以做到。那不是我的工作。但如果他们需要，我可以在任何特定时刻做到。”

paras.en: On whether he was surprised at James continuing to deliver impressive performances, Barlow teammate Dominick said: "I mean, from a regular 40-year-old, probably, but I mean, he's a cyborg!
paras.zh: 当被问及是否对詹姆斯继续打出令人印象深刻的表现感到惊讶时，巴洛的队友多米尼克说道：“我的意思是，他可能是一个普通的 40 岁年轻人，但我的意思是，他是一个机器人！

paras.en: "He has been doing this for a long time now, so it don't surprise me at all. I mean, this is just who he is. I mean, it's going to be this till whenever he decides not to play. So, I mean we're going to keep flowing with him."
paras.zh: “他这样做已经很长时间了，所以我一点也不感到惊讶。我的意思是，这就是他。我的意思是，直到他决定不参加比赛之前都会如此。所以，我的意思是我们将继续与他一起流动。”

paras.en: Durant reaches historic 33,000 points milestone
paras.zh: 杜兰特达到历史性的 33,000 分里程碑

paras.en: Kevin Durant became just the fifth NBA player in history to pass 33,000 points, joining James, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Karl Malone and Kobe Bryant in an exclusive club.
paras.zh: 凯文·杜兰特成为历史上第五位得分超过 33,000 分的 NBA 球员，加入了詹姆斯、卡里姆·阿卜杜尔·贾巴尔、卡尔·马龙和科比·布莱恩特的专属俱乐部。

paras.en: The 38-year-old reached the milestone during the Houston Rockets' 116-104 victory against the Phoenix Suns, firing a three-pointer with 46.3 seconds left in the second quarter.
paras.zh: 这位38岁的球员在休斯顿火箭队以116-104战胜菲尼克斯太阳队的比赛中达到了这一里程碑，他在第二节还剩46.3秒时投进了一个三分球。

paras.en: Durant scored 20 points, shot seven of 15 from the field and grabbed 10 rebounds, with Houston's victory ending a four-game winning streak for the Suns (9-8) and eliminating them from NBA Cup contention.
paras.zh: 杜兰特15投7中得到20分并抢下10个篮板，休斯顿队的胜利结束了太阳队的四连胜（9胜8负），并将他们从NBA杯的争夺中淘汰。

paras.en: He became the second-quickest player to reach the milestone, taking four more games than James, while he is now just over 600 points behind Bryant in the career points standings.
paras.zh: 他成为第二快达到这一里程碑的球员，比詹姆斯多打了四场比赛，而他现在在职业生涯得分榜上仅落后科比 600 多分。

paras.en: There were nine NBA Cup matches on Wednesday, including Minnesota Timberwolves continuing their unbeaten start with a 113-106 win over the Oklahoma City Thunder and Portland Trail Blazers beating San Antonio Spurs 116-111.
paras.zh: 周三，NBA 杯共有 9 场比赛，其中明尼苏达森林狼队以 113-106 战胜俄克拉荷马城雷霆队，延续不败开局；波特兰开拓者队以 116-111 击败圣安东尼奥马刺队。

paras.en: Jaden McDaniels posted his fourth career 30+ point game and locked down Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (32 pts) down the stretch for the Timberwolves, who outlasted a Thunder side without Anthony Edwards.
paras.zh: 贾登·麦克丹尼尔斯打出了职业生涯第四场30分以上的比赛，并在最后时刻锁定了谢伊·吉尔吉斯·亚历山大（32分），森林狼队在没有安东尼·爱德华兹的情况下击败了雷霆队。

paras.en: Victor Wembanyama (44 points, 16 rebounds) failed to maintain San Antonio's impressive away record, as Deni Avdija banked in a clutch three-pointer in the final minute to give Portland victory in a thriller that saw 25 lead changes and 13 ties.
paras.zh: 维克多·文班亚马（44分、16个篮板）没能保持圣安东尼奥令人印象深刻的客场战绩，德尼·阿夫迪亚在最后一分钟投进关键三分球，帮助开拓者队在这场惊心动魄的比赛中取得胜利，这场比赛双方领先25次，战成13平。

articles.title: 2 men charged with burglary after break-in at Prince William and Princess Kate’s country home
articles.author: Henry Austin

paras.en: LONDON — Two men have been charged in connection with a burglary at the royal family’s Sandringham estate, British police said Wednesday, after a reported break-in at the country home of Prince William and Princess Kate.
paras.zh: 伦敦——英国警方周三表示，在威廉王子和凯特王妃的乡村住宅发生入室盗窃事件后，英国警方周三表示，两名男子因涉嫌入室盗窃而被指控。

paras.en: The pair were charged with entering a dwelling with intent to steal and trespassing on a protected site, the local police force said in a statement.
paras.zh: 当地警方在一份声明中称，两人被指控进入住宅意图盗窃和侵入受保护的地点。

paras.en: Officers were called just before 6 p.m. local time (1 p.m. ET) on Monday “to reports of suspicious activity at a property,” Norfolk Constabulary said. “Police and specialist resources attended and two men were arrested nearby on suspicion of burglary and trespass and taken into custody for questioning,” the statement added.
paras.zh: 下午 6 点左右，警方接到报警。诺福克警察局表示，当地时间周一（美国东部时间下午 1 点）“接到有关某处房产可疑活动的报告”。声明补充说：“警察和专家人员赶到现场，两名男子因涉嫌入室盗窃和非法侵入而在附近被捕，并被拘留接受审讯。”

paras.en: The two men, named by police as Mirgen Doku, 34, and Arilen Ndoci, 32, have now been charged.
paras.zh: 警方称这两名男子为 34 岁的米尔根·多库 (Mirgen Doku) 和 32 岁的阿里伦·恩多西 (Arilen Ndoci)，现已受到指控。

paras.en: The pair were remanded in custody after a brief court appearance in the eastern city of Norwich on Wednesday morning, according to Britain’s Press Association news agency. Describing the accused as Albanian nationals, the agency reported that they were accused of stealing six pairs of cuff links and a clock, value unknown.
paras.zh: 据英国新闻协会通讯社报道，周三上午，两人在东部城市诺维奇短暂出庭后被还押。该机构将被告描述为阿尔巴尼亚国民，称他们被指控盗窃六对袖扣和一个时钟，价值未知。

paras.en: David Harrison, the games and conservation manager at the Sandringham Estate, told the court he was conducting a patrol when he saw two males jump through a hedgerow and run into a wooded area using a thermal spotter, according to the PA. He said he followed in a utility motor vehicle but could not locate the men.
paras.zh: 据 PA 报道，桑德灵厄姆庄园的游戏和保护经理戴维·哈里森 (David Harrison) 告诉法庭，他当时正在巡逻，看到两只雄性使用热观测仪跳过树篱，跑进树林里。他说，他开着一辆多功能汽车跟踪，但找不到这些人。

paras.en: The property, gifted to the heir to the British throne and his wife by the late Queen Elizabeth II as a wedding present, is nestled in the heart of the royals’ sprawling estate.
paras.zh: 该房产是已故女王伊丽莎白二世作为结婚礼物赠送给英国王位继承人及其妻子的礼物，坐落在王室庞大庄园的中心。

paras.en: In an earlier statement, police said the property which has its own private swimming pool, a full-size, artificial grass tennis court and vast grounds, was unoccupied at the time of the incident.
paras.zh: 警方在早些时候的一份声明中表示，该房产拥有自己的私人游泳池、一个全尺寸的人造草地网球场和广阔的场地，但在事件发生时无人居住。

paras.en: Separately, a royal source told NBC News that the couple and their three children, George, Charlotte and Louis, were not there at the time.
paras.zh: 另外，一位王室消息人士告诉 NBC 新闻，这对夫妇和他们的三个孩子乔治、夏洛特和路易斯当时并不在场。

paras.en: The couple and their children have often enjoyed weekend breaks and holidays at the royal estate in eastern England.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇和他们的孩子经常在英格兰东部的皇家庄园享受周末和假期。

paras.en: While they weren’t present at the time of the burglary, the incident is a significant security breach for the royals.
paras.zh: 虽然入室盗窃发生时他们并不在场，但这起事件对王室来说是一个重大的安全漏洞。

paras.en: The break in “of course, raises huge concerns,” NBC News royal contributor Emily Nash said Wednesday. “This is the home of our future king and queen.”
paras.zh: NBC 新闻皇家撰稿人艾米丽·纳什周三表示，这次闯入“当然引起了巨大的担忧”。 “这是我们未来国王和王后的家。”

paras.en: “Nobody wants to feel as though their home, their private space is being violated,” she said. “They do have a great deal of security in place and so they’ll be looking at why that has lapsed.”
paras.zh: “没有人愿意感觉自己的家、私人空间受到侵犯，”她说。 “他们确实有很多安全措施，所以他们会研究为什么会失效。”

paras.en: Security arrangements “are naturally cloaked in secrecy because they don’t want to let people know too much about what’s happening,” she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，安全安排“自然是保密的，因为他们不想让人们过多了解正在发生的事情”。

paras.en: “Essentially, it’s a bit like an onion. They have multiple layers of security,” she said, adding that when they were on the estate “they also have their armed police protection officers who ensure that nobody can get close to them.”
paras.zh: “本质上，这有点像洋葱。他们有多层安全措施，”她说，并补充说，当他们进入庄园时，“他们还有武装警察保护人员，确保没有人可以接近他们。”

paras.en: Anmer Hall, a 10-bedroom country house built in the early 1800s, entered the royals’ extensive property portfolio when it was bought in 1898 by Queen Victoria’s son, who would later become King Edward VII.
paras.zh: 安默厅 (Anmer Hall) 是一座建于 1800 年代初、拥有 10 间卧室的乡间别墅，于 1898 年被维多利亚女王的儿子（后来成为国王爱德华七世）买下，进入了王室的广泛财产组合。

paras.en: The prince and princess of Wales’ main home is Forest Lodge in Windsor, a small town around 30 miles west of London. The couple said they moved there for a “fresh start” in 2025 after the death of the late queen and Kate’s cancer diagnosis.
paras.zh: 威尔士王子和王妃的主要住所是位于伦敦以西约 30 英里的小镇温莎的森林小屋。这对夫妇表示，在已故女王去世和凯特被诊断出癌症后，他们于 2025 年搬到了那里，希望有一个“新的开始”。

paras.en: There have been several previous high profile security breaches involving the royal family.
paras.zh: 此前曾发生过数起涉及王室的引人注目的安全漏洞事件。

paras.en: In October 2024, burglars broke into the Windsor Castle estate and stole a pickup truck and a quad bike from a farm building. King Charles and Queen Camilla weren’t at the property at the time.
paras.zh: 2024 年 10 月，窃贼闯入温莎城堡庄园，从一座农场建筑中偷走了一辆皮卡车和一辆四轮摩托车。查尔斯国王和卡米拉王后当时并不在庄园。

paras.en: But perhaps the most famous break in came in 1982, when a man called Michael Fagan managed to sneak into the queen’s private chambers while she was in bed. The queen spent 10 minutes talking with the intruder before raising the alarm when he asked for a cigarette.
paras.zh: 但最著名的闯入事件可能发生在 1982 年，当时一名名叫迈克尔·费根 (Michael Fagan) 的男子趁女王睡觉时潜入了她的私人卧室。女王花了10分钟与入侵者交谈，然后当他要香烟时才发出警报。

paras.en: The latest incursion came days before the release of a new documentary about Kate’s cancer diagnosis and remission, called “Heal.”
paras.zh: 最近一次入侵发生在一部关于凯特癌症诊断和缓解的新纪录片《治愈》发布前几天。

paras.en: Set to air on NBC on Nov. 30 at 8 p.m. ET/PT before streaming on Peacock from Dec. 1., the highly personal film will see her share her private thoughts on her illness and recovery.
paras.zh: 定于 11 月 30 日晚上 8 点在 NBC 播出这部高度个人化的电影将在美国东部时间/太平洋时间 12 月 1 日起在 Peacock 上播出之前，分享她对疾病和康复的私人想法。

paras.en: “It changes your body, it changes you physically, but there is a much, much deeper part to what a cancer diagnosis shifts in you,” Kate says in a clip released ahead of Sunday’s air date
paras.zh: 凯特在周日播出前发布的一段视频中说道：“它改变了你的身体，它改变了你的身体，但癌症诊断对你的改变还有更深层次的影响。”

paras.en: “It is often through pain that we realize there is a greater beauty that lies beyond that,” she adds.
paras.zh: “往往是通过痛苦，我们才意识到除此之外还有更伟大的美丽，”她补充道。

articles.title: Train services to be disrupted after Fair Work Commission delays decision
articles.author: Bridget Murphy and Ben Clifford

paras.en: NSW regional and interstate trains disrupted after Fair Work Commission delays decision
paras.zh: 公平工作委员会推迟决定后新南威尔士州地区和州际列车中断

paras.en: The unions representing NSW rail workers had planned a week-long strike as part of an ongoing enterprise bargaining dispute.
paras.zh: 代表新南威尔士州铁路工人的工会计划举行为期一周的罢工，作为正在进行的企业谈判纠纷的一部分。

paras.en: The Fair Work Commission has delayed its decision on whether the industrial action can legally go ahead.
paras.zh: 公平工作委员会推迟了关于罢工是否可以合法进行的决定。

paras.en: Many regional and interstate services scheduled for Friday will be replaced by coaches or cancelled.
paras.zh: 原定于周五举行的许多地区和州际航班将被长途汽车取代或取消。

articles.title: Sydney apartment buyers in limbo after $24m in deposits goes missing
articles.author: Emily Baker

paras.en: Developer Landmark is pursuing a Sydney law firm and solicitor over $24 million in missing unit deposits.
paras.zh: 开发商 Landmark 正在追捕一家悉尼律师事务所和律师，该律师事务所和律师失踪的单位押金超过 2400 万澳元。

paras.en: Hundreds of home buyers were hoping to move into newly-built complexes in Dee Why and Blacktown before their funds vanished.
paras.zh: 数百名购房者希望在资金耗尽之前搬进迪威和布莱克敦的新建综合楼。

paras.en: The matter is due to return to the Supreme Court on November 30.
paras.zh: 该案将于 11 月 30 日返回最高法院。

paras.en: More than $24 million in deposits from prospective apartment buyers has gone missing as a Sydney developer acknowledges "something has gone seriously wrong".
paras.zh: 悉尼开发商承认“出了严重问题”，潜在公寓买家的超过 2400 万澳元的定金消失了。

paras.en: Almost 300 home buyers were due to get the keys to their newly-built apartments in Dee Why and Blacktown between this week and early next year but have been left in limbo.
paras.zh: 本周到明年初，近 300 名购房者本应拿到位于 Dee Why 和 Blacktown 的新建公寓的钥匙，但目前仍处于悬而未决的状态。

paras.en: Developer Landmark has launched legal action against Branston Neville Lawyers and solicitor Ken Neville to recoup the missing funds, after alleging only part of the deposits held in trust were transferred to Hendrix Legal as directed after the company changed firms.
paras.zh: 开发商Landmark已对Branston Neville律师事务所和律师Ken Neville提起法律诉讼，要求追回丢失的资金，此前该公司声称，在该公司更换公司后，只有部分信托存款按照指示转移给了Hendrix Legal。

paras.en: The ABC has contacted Branston Neville Lawyers and Mr Neville.
paras.zh: ABC 已联系布兰斯顿·内维尔律师事务所和内维尔先生。

paras.en: Purchasers in the Dee Why Casa Delmar complex were expecting to settle as early as Wednesday afternoon before receiving an email from Hendrix Legal that same morning that said their deposit had not come through.
paras.zh: Dee Why Casa Delmar 综合楼的买家预计最早于周三下午完成结算，但当天早上收到了来自 Hendrix Legal 的电子邮件，称他们的押金尚未到账。

paras.en: In a statement, Landmark founder Arash Tavakoli said the situation was unprecedented.
paras.zh: Landmark 创始人 Arash Tavakoli 在一份声明中表示，这种情况是前所未有的。

paras.en: "In over 25 years and thousands of homes delivered, this has never happened to us or our buyers,"
paras.zh: “在超过 25 年的时间里，交付了数千套房屋，这种情况从未发生在我们或我们的买家身上，”

paras.en: The situation affects about 140 purchasers at the Casa Delmar development at Dee Why and about 145 purchasers at the Second Avenue development at Blacktown.
paras.zh: 这种情况影响了 Dee Why 的 Casa Delmar 开发项目的约 140 名买家，以及 Blacktown 的第二大道开发项目的约 145 名买家。

paras.en: Apartment buyers told the ABC they were devastated.
paras.zh: 公寓买家告诉澳大利亚广播公司，他们感到震惊。

paras.en: Wainwright Legal principal lawyer Clare Wainwright represents 42 affected Dee Why purchasers and said she was receiving "really limited information" about the "completely unprecedented" situation.
paras.zh: Wainwright Legal 的首席律师 Clare Wainwright 代表 42 名受影响的 Dee Why 购买者，并表示她收到的有关“完全前所未有”的情况的“信息非常有限”。

paras.en: "Our position is our purchasers have done all the right things and ultimately settlement should be called for," Ms Wright said.
paras.zh: “我们的立场是，我们的买家已经做了所有正确的事情，最终应该要求和解，”赖特女士说。

paras.en: "We are needing to know what is happening and what the vendor's intention is because we have clients who don't have anywhere to go."
paras.zh: “我们需要知道发生了什么以及供应商的意图是什么，因为我们的客户无处可去。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, the Law Society of NSW confirmed it had suspended the practising certificate of Mr Neville and appointed a manager to Branston Neville Lawyers to "take control of the practice with immediate effect".
paras.zh: 与此同时，新南威尔士州律师协会证实已吊销内维尔先生的执业证书，并为布兰斯顿内维尔律师事务所任命了一名经理，以“立即控制其执业”。

paras.en: Mr Tavakoli wrote directly to affected apartment buyers to acknowledge "something has gone seriously wrong" and affirm the company's commitment to completing their contracts.
paras.zh: 塔瓦科利先生直接写信给受影响的公寓买家，承认“出现了严重问题”，并确认公司履行合同的承诺。

paras.en: In the correspondence, he urged affected purchasers to write to NSW Premier Chris Minns and other MPs to encourage the Law Society of NSW to lift the cap on the compensation available through its Fidelity Fund.
paras.zh: 在信中，他敦促受影响的购买者写信给新南威尔士州州长克里斯明斯和其他议员，鼓励新南威尔士州律师协会取消通过其富达基金提供的赔偿上限。

paras.en: The fund is administered by the Law Society to compensate people who lose money due to law firms acting improperly in relation to trust funds or property.
paras.zh: 该基金由律师协会管理，用于补偿因律师事务所在信托基金或财产方面采取不当行为而遭受损失的人。

paras.en: It is capped at $1 million to a single law practice unless the Law Society authorises a greater payment.
paras.zh: 除非律师协会授权支付更高的金额，否则单个律师事务所的最高限额为 100 万美元。

paras.en: "We would welcome the Law Society Council using its discretion to lift that limit, and the government looking at whether that limit still protects buyers in today's market," Mr Tavakoli said in his media statement.
paras.zh: 塔瓦科利在媒体声明中表示：“我们欢迎律师协会理事会利用其自由裁量权取消这一限制，并欢迎政府研究该限制是否仍然可以保护当今市场上的买家。”

paras.en: The matter is due to return to the Supreme Court on November 30.
paras.zh: 该案将于 11 月 30 日返回最高法院。

articles.title: Councillor ordered to apologise over 'school short-skirt brigade' remarks
articles.author: Ellen-Maree Elliot

paras.en: Ipswich City Council voted to direct a councillor to make a public apology and undertake training and counselling.
paras.zh: 伊普斯威奇市议会投票决定指示一名议员公开道歉并进行培训和咨询。
