paras.zh: 与此同时，VIX 本身的期权交易量比平均水平高出 50%，看跌期权的倾向更为明显，这表明交易者认为股市走强，或者至少市场波动的规模正在缩小。 Cboe 数据显示，在 VIX 交易的 850,000 份期权中，超过 515,000 份是看跌期权，买家发起的看跌期权数量可能是看涨期权的两倍。

articles.title: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving Day Parade due to severe weather

paras.en: Macy's on Wednesday announced it's postponing the annual Thanksgiving Day Parade due to severe weather.
paras.zh: 梅西百货周三宣布，由于恶劣天气，推迟一年一度的感恩节游行。

paras.en: The parade, held each year on Thursday morning, will now take place on Saturday at 8:30 a.m. ET, according to the company. The New York City area is expected to have heavy rain and thunderstorms on Thanksgiving.
paras.zh: 据该公司称，每年在周四早上举行的游行现在将于美国东部时间周六上午 8:30 举行。预计感恩节纽约地区将出现大雨和雷暴天气。

paras.en: "The safety of our participants and spectators is our top priority, and after close consultation with our city and agency partners, we have made the decision to move this year's celebration," Macy's said in a statement.
paras.zh: 梅西百货在一份声明中表示：“参与者和观众的安全是我们的首要任务，在与我们的城市和机构合作伙伴密切协商后，我们决定推迟今年的庆祝活动。”

paras.en: This year's event marks the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade. The annual event has never been canceled due to weather, though it was suspended between 1942 and 1944 for World War II.
paras.zh: 今年的活动是梅西百货感恩节大游行的第 100 届。尽管 1942 年至 1944 年间因第二次世界大战而暂停，但这项一年一度的活动从未因天气原因而取消。

paras.en: The parade's viability this year had been in question after concerns arose over strong winds that could become dangerous for the massive balloons that the event is known for. Many of the balloons had already been inflated as of Wednesday afternoon.
paras.zh: 今年游行的可行性受到质疑，因为人们担心强风可能会对游行活动中的巨型气球造成危险。截至周三下午，许多气球已经充气。

paras.en: The postponement also means thousands of volunteers and artists slated to perform will have to adapt to Saturday's schedule.
paras.zh: 推迟还意味着数千名计划表演的志愿者和艺术家将不得不适应周六的时间表。

articles.title: Liesman: Why Greenspan could bet on productivity — and Warsh needs to hike

paras.en: In a discussion on CNBC's Halftime Report Wednesday, the question came up: Why can't Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh hold the line on interest rates the way his icon Alan Greenspan did at the beginning of the dot-com era?
paras.zh: 在周三 CNBC 半场报道的讨论中，出现了这样一个问题：为什么美联储主席凯文·沃什不能像他的偶像艾伦·格林斯潘在互联网时代初期那样坚守利率底线？

paras.en: Greenspan famously leaned against inflation hawks on his committee in 1995 and 1996, holding the line on interest rates amid strong growth, because he believed in the productivity promise of the internet revolution.
paras.zh: 1995年和1996年，格林斯潘在委员会中反对通胀鹰派，在强劲增长的情况下坚持利率不变，因为他相信互联网革命的生产力承诺。

paras.en: It would be nice if Warsh could follow the same playbook amid the artificial intelligence build-out and keep rates steady until the productivity arrives. Unfortunately, a quick look at the numbers shows just how different the situation is for Warsh when it comes to inflation, the magnitude of the capital-investment boom and the monetary and fiscal stimulus boosting the economy.
paras.zh: 如果沃什能够在人工智能的发展过程中遵循同样的策略，并在生产力达到之前保持稳定的利率，那就太好了。不幸的是，快速浏览一下这些数字就会发现，在通货膨胀、资本投资热潮的规模以及提振经济的货币和财政刺激方面，沃什的情况有多么不同。

paras.en: Bottom line: the Fed looks like it has to hike — and maybe substantially — to be anywhere close to the position where the Fed was in Greenspan's time at the dawn of a major technological revolution.
paras.zh: 底线：美联储看起来必须加息——而且可能是大幅加息——才能接近格林斯潘时代重大技术革命初期美联储的水平。

paras.en: - The nominal Fed funds rate was substantially higher in 1995 than it is today. The real, or inflation adjusted, funds rate was a positive 3.75% back then, and it's now at zero. So the Fed was leaning against the dotcom boom. Greenspan just decided not to lean more. Today, at a zero real rate, the Fed could be said to be fueling the boom.
paras.zh: - 1995 年名义联邦基金利率比现在高得多。当时的实际基金利率（或经通胀调整后）为 3.75%，而现在为零。因此，美联储倾向于反对互联网泡沫。格林斯潘只是决定不再倾斜。如今，在实际利率为零的情况下，美联储可以说正在推动经济繁荣。

paras.en: - Inflation, as measured by the personal consumption expenditures price index, was substantially lower, right about target at 1.99% (even though there wasn't a formal 2% target then). It's above target now, at 3.8% according to government data published today, and going the wrong way.
paras.zh: - 以个人消费支出价格指数衡量的通货膨胀率大幅降低，接近 1.99% 的目标（尽管当时没有正式的 2% 目标）。根据今天公布的政府数据，现在已经超出了 3.8% 的目标，而且走错了路。

paras.en: - The current investment boom now is absolutely off the charts compared with the dot-com era. No real comparison. In 1995, spending on information processing equipment rose 15% year over year. In 2025, it was 27%. Looking at the latest data reported today, it grew 60% in the third quarter at an annualized rate. In the second quarter of 1995, it was 18%.
paras.zh: - 与互联网时代相比，当前的投资热潮绝对是超乎想象的。没有真正的比较。 1995年，信息处理设备的支出同比增长15%。 2025年，这一比例为27%。从今天公布的最新数据来看，第三季度按年率计算增长了60%。 1995年第二季度为18%。

paras.en: - Government deficit spending is substantially more stimulative now than it was then. In 1995, the deficit was just 2.2% of GDP. Today, it's 6.2%.
paras.zh: - 政府赤字支出现在比以前更具刺激性。 1995年，赤字仅占GDP的2.2%。今天，这个数字是 6.2%。

paras.en: - Add higher oil prices, higher tariffs and the recent tax cuts and accelerated depreciation on investments, and there's a lot for the Fed to lean against.
paras.zh: - 再加上油价上涨、关税上涨以及最近的减税和投资加速折旧，美联储有很多可以依靠的因素。

paras.en: It may be that the massive capex spending on AI will mean more productivity and less inflation down the road. But the front-end build-out is proving to be more inflationary, and more challenging, to a Fed already dealing with high inflation. In many ways, that's the opposite of what Greenspan had to handle.
paras.zh: 人工智能上的巨额资本支出可能意味着未来生产力的提高和通货膨胀的减少。但事实证明，对于已经在应对高通胀的美联储来说，前端扩张会带来更大的通胀，也更具挑战性。在很多方面，这与格林斯潘必须处理的事情相反。

articles.title: The U.S. Army is blowing up five tons of toxic lead azide in Iowa

paras.en: The U.S. Army detonated five tons of lead azide, used in munition manufacturing, at a site in Iowa on Wednesday. Any toxic material released by the blast could extend for miles, affecting parts of Iowa and neighboring Missouri, and would pose a significant danger to people's health, experts say.
paras.zh: 周三，美国陆军在爱荷华州的一处地点引爆了五吨用于弹药制造的叠氮化铅。专家表示，爆炸释放的任何有毒物质都可能延伸数英里，影响爱荷华州部分地区和邻近的密苏里州，并对人们的健康构成重大威胁。

paras.en: Officials said prior to the blast that they anticipated “zero release” of toxins because of mitigation efforts. Two controlled explosions occurred at 10 A.M. EST. A New York Times reporter on the scene said he saw a plume of smoke rise into the sky and drift south. It is unclear whether any toxic material escaped at this time, but early reports suggest the material was largely contained at the site. Independent scientists are also trying to verify whether any lead exposure occurred.
paras.zh: 官员们在爆炸前表示，由于缓解措施，他们预计毒素将“零释放”。上午 10 点发生两起受控爆炸。美国东部时间。 《纽约时报》现场记者称，他看到一缕浓烟冲天而起，并向南飘去。目前尚不清楚此时是否有任何有毒物质逸出，但早期报告表明该物质大部分被控制在现场。独立科学家也在试图验证是否发生了铅暴露。

paras.en: An Environmental Protection Agency site tracking lead concentration in the air around the blast zone had so far failed to detect the element as of noon on Wednesday. Iowa’s governor-elect Rob Sand said in a social media post that, by all indications, “Iowans are safe” but that the “lead-up to the detonation should never have been so chaotic and unclear,” adding that “Iowans ... are understandably alarmed and scared.”
paras.zh: 截至周三中午，环境保护局监测爆炸区周围空气中铅浓度的站点迄今未​​能检测到该元素。爱荷华州当选州长罗布·桑德在社交媒体上发帖称，从各种迹象来看，“爱荷华州人是安全的”，但“爆炸的前因后果不应该如此混乱和不明朗”，并补充道，“爱荷华州人……感到震惊和害怕是可以理解的。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “Lead can cause irreversible neurological effects and has been linked to increased miscarriages,” says Patrick McNamara, an engineering professor at Marquette University. “To put into perspective, lead pills were used as abortion pills years ago.”
paras.zh: 马凯特大学工程学教授帕特里克·麦克纳马拉说：“铅会导致不可逆转的神经系统影响，并与流产增加有关。” “从长远来看，铅丸多年前就被用作堕胎药。”

paras.en: Residents in the surrounding area had been urged to evacuate prior to the explosion. Any remaining members of the public were told to block and secure their windows and doors to prevent any potential released lead from entering their homes.
paras.zh: 爆炸发生前，当局已敦促周边地区的居民撤离。剩余的公众被告知封锁并固定门窗，以防止任何潜在释放的铅进入他们的家中。

paras.en: The Army has estimated that exposure to any toxic material could last about one hour after the explosions. State officials recommended that any residents in the potential blast zone to stay inside with their windows and doors closed for at least 24 hours. McNamara recommends anyone nearby should do whatever they can to avoid bringing lead indoors, such as by taking off outdoor shoes and clothes before entering their homes. “Lead does not go away; it only moves around,” he says.
paras.zh: 陆军估计，爆炸后接触任何有毒物质的情况可能会持续大约一小时。州官员建议潜在爆炸区域的所有居民留在室内并关闭门窗至少 24 小时。麦克纳马拉建议附近的任何人都应尽其所能避免将铅带入室内，例如在进入家中之前脱掉户外鞋和衣服。 “铅不会消失；它只会四处移动，”他说。

paras.en: The explosion was necessary, the Army said, because the 68 drums of lead azide had degraded in storage, forming unstable crystals that could explode spontaneously at room temperature. It was so unstable that the material could not be moved, touched or left in place. In a blog post for Science, chemist Derek Lowe pointed out that crystallization is a “foreseeable problem” and suggested that the lead azide wasn’t stored properly in the first place. “The larger picture is that someone, or a series of someones over time, has grievously screwed up,” he wrote.
paras.zh: 军方表示，这次爆炸是必要的，因为 68 桶叠氮化铅在储存过程中已经降解，形成不稳定的晶体，在室温下可能会自爆。它非常不稳定，无法移动、触摸或留在原处。在《科学》杂志的一篇博客文章中，化学家德里克·洛（Derek Lowe）指出，结晶是一个“可预见的问题”，并暗示叠氮化铅一开始就没有正确储存。 “更大的图景是，随着时间的推移，某个人或一系列人严重搞砸了，”他写道。

paras.en: The Army built a mitigation zone around the lead azide in the hope of containing any such dust, including tanks of water and foam blocks, as well as containment screens. Still, the Army released maps showing the potential path of any dust plume should any of the material have escaped.
paras.zh: 陆军在叠氮化铅周围建立了一个缓解区，希望能够容纳任何此类灰尘，包括水箱和泡沫块，以及防护屏。尽管如此，陆军还是发布了地图，显示了如果有任何物质逸出，任何尘埃羽流的潜在路径。

paras.en: EPA head Lee Zeldin said on Tuesday, ahead of the explosion, that the agency would monitor the area’s water, air and soil for signs of contamination in the aftermath of the blast.
paras.zh: 美国环保局局长李·泽尔丁周二在爆炸发生前表示，该机构将监测该地区的水、空气和土壤，寻找爆炸后污染的迹象。

paras.en: “I would be as concerned about lead settling onto soil on someone’s property as I would it getting into waterways and crops,” McNamara says. “A lot of lead exposure in urban areas comes from soil, paint chips and old materials. If lead is on soil on someone’s property, it presents a direct route of exposure for children. All folks in this area should consider testing their blood lead levels over time.”
paras.zh: “我担心铅会沉积在某人的土地上，就像我担心铅会进入水道和农作物一样，”麦克纳马拉说。 “城市地区的大量铅暴露来自土壤、油漆碎片和旧材料。如果某人房产的土壤中含有铅，那么这就是儿童的直接暴露途径。该地区的所有居民都应该考虑随着时间的推移检测自己的血铅水平。”

paras.en: Editor’s Note (11/25/26): This is a developing story and will be updated.
paras.zh: 编者注（11/25/26）：这是一个正在发展的故事，将会更新。

articles.title: Why AI’s proof of the Riemann hypothesis is so bittersweet

paras.en: I have ζ(s), the zeta function at the center of the Riemann hypothesis, tattooed on my leg, so I took last Friday’s news harder than most. That morning I read my colleague Joseph Howlett’s story: Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, said he had proved the hypothesis, with a heavy dose of help from the company’s artificial intelligence model Claude. By Saturday, outside experts had validated the proof.
paras.zh: 我的腿上纹有 δ(s)，即黎曼假设中心的 zeta 函数，所以我比大多数人都更加认真地对待上周五的新闻。那天早上，我读了同事 Joseph Howlett 的故事：Anthropic 的数学家 Levent Alpöge 表示，在公司人工智能模型 Claude 的大力帮助下，他已经证明了这一假设。到周六，外部专家已经验证了这一证据。

paras.en: This is likely the capstone of AI’s yearlong rampage through mathematics. Earlier results dazzled mathematicians and former mathematicians like me, but this was the first one to flip my stomach. Honestly, I felt like I was going to throw up.
paras.zh: 这很可能是人工智能长达一年的数学横冲直撞的顶峰。早期的结果让数学家和像我这样的前数学家眼花缭乱，但这是第一个让我反胃的结果。老实说，我感觉我要吐了。

paras.en: The Riemann hypothesis and I have history. In college I studied it and its connections to the primes and cryptography, and after about 18 months I made the relationship permanent. My tattoo artist admitted he had limited experience with math but said he enjoyed learning more about primes once he had heard my request. Like many math lovers, Alpöge among them, I revere the problem.
paras.zh: 黎曼猜想和我有历史渊源。在大学里，我研究了它及其与素数和密码学的联系，大约 18 个月后，我使这种关系永久化。我的纹身师承认他在数学方面的经验有限，但他说一旦听到我的请求，他就喜欢了解更多关于素数的知识。和许多数学爱好者（其中包括 Alpöge）一样，我热爱这个问题。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Friday should have been cause for celebration. Instead math’s most famous problem was resolved in a way that, so far, no one can figure out. And figuring it out is meant to be the fun part.
paras.zh: 星期五本来应该值得庆祝。相反，数学最著名的问题是以一种迄今为止无人能解的方式解决的。弄清楚它应该是有趣的部分。

paras.en: Much of this problem’s beauty lies in how every aspect of it unfurls until it touches far-flung areas of mathematics. The zeta function starts as a simple sum over the integers, but a mathematical trick rewrites it as a product over the primes. That’s usually the first hint of what lies beneath the surface.
paras.zh: 这个问题的美妙之处很大程度上在于它的各个方面如何展开，直到它触及广泛的数学领域。 zeta 函数一开始是整数的简单求和，但数学技巧将其重写为素数的乘积。这通常是表面之下的第一个暗示。

paras.en: Mathematicians can then extend it across the entire complex plane, the plane containing numbers with real and imaginary parts. There, other formulas tie it to other famous functions, such as the factorial. The hypothesis itself can be generalized to an infinite family of functions, which Alpöge says he proved. Even the problem’s consequences seem limitless because the primes are the building blocks of numbers.
paras.zh: 然后，数学家可以将其扩展到整个复平面，该平面包含具有实部和虚部的数字。在那里，其他公式将其与其他著名的函数联系起来，例如阶乘。这个假设本身可以推广到无限个函数族，阿尔波格说他证明了这一点。甚至这个问题的后果似乎也是无限的，因为素数是数字的组成部分。

paras.en: Understanding the Riemann hypothesis is like sticking your finger into a puddle, expecting to hit bottom quickly, only to realize the pool stretches deeper than you can reach.
paras.zh: 理解黎曼猜想就像把你的手指伸进水坑里，期望很快触底，却发现水坑比你够得着的更深。

paras.en: Honestly, I felt like I was going to throw up.
paras.zh: 老实说，我感觉我要吐了。

paras.en: Yet most of us, myself included, had long assumed the hypothesis was true. The first 10 trillion or so solutions to the function were already known to satisfy the hypothesis, and there was little reason to think the streak would end. Even the Clay Mathematics Institute, which offers a $1-million prize for a resolution, mentions only “a proof that it is true” in a summary.
paras.zh: 然而，我们大多数人，包括我自己，长期以来一直认为这个假设是正确的。已知该函数的前 10 万亿个左右的解可以满足假设，并且没有理由认为这种连续现象会结束。就连克莱数学研究所（Clay Mathematics Institute）为一项决议提供了 100 万美元的奖金，但在摘要中也只提到了“证明其正确性的证据”。

paras.en: The way I always heard it, the real prize would be the techniques used to prove it. Nobody had any idea how. Whoever finally cracked it would have to dredge up something from the depths, and that discovery could lead to whole new ways of thinking about numbers.
paras.zh: 我一直听说，真正的奖品是用来证明这一点的技术。没有人知道怎么做。无论谁最终破解了它，都必须从深处挖出一些东西，而这一发现可能会带来思考数字的全新方式。

paras.en: It’s more than a little ironic, then, that the problem is now solved, and those techniques have yet to surface. Or rather they’re stuck inside millions of lines of code written in the programming language Lean and in an AI-written explanation that Alpöge hasn’t released. (He first said that explanation ran past 250,000 pages and then backpedaled on X, calling the number a joke: “I find big number extremely hilarious.”) Some experts say true human understanding could be months or years away. And who knows what that understanding will be worth next to the models of a couple of years from now?
paras.zh: 那么，问题现在已经解决了，而这些技术还没有浮出水面，这就有点讽刺了。或者更确切地说，它们被困在用 Lean 编程语言编写的数百万行代码中，以及 Alpöge 尚未发布的人工智能编写的解释中。 （他首先说这个解释已经超过了 250,000 页，然后在 X 上反悔了，称这个数字是一个笑话：“我发现大数字非常搞笑。”）一些专家表示，人类真正的理解可能需要几个月或几年的时间。谁知道这种理解对于几年后的模型来说价值几何呢？

paras.en: I used to think the issue at the heart of AI and mathematics was labor, the same concern artists have raised about AI’s use in their own field. My mathematician and computer scientist friends worry most about their jobs: whether there will be any and what the work will look like. Anyone finishing a typical American Ph.D. this year probably started it before ChatGPT existed. They had no way of knowing the job description would one day include interpreting an AI oracle.
paras.zh: 我曾经认为人工智能和数学的核心问题是劳动力，就像艺术家对人工智能在自己领域的使用提出的同样的担忧。我的数学家和计算机科学家朋友最担心的是他们的工作：是否会有工作以及工作会是什么样子。任何完成典型美国博士学位的人都可以。今年可能在 ChatGPT 出现之前就开始了。他们无法知道有一天工作描述会包括解释人工智能预言。

paras.en: I still believe labor is an essential part of the conversation, but Friday showed me what AI’s prowess means for doing math in its purest and most mathemagical sense. And while I am in awe of what we’ve seen so far and excited for what is to come, I do feel a little emptier, still waiting on an answer to the real question: How?
paras.zh: 我仍然相信劳动是对话的重要组成部分，但周五向我展示了人工智能的能力对于最纯粹、最神奇的数学意义上的数学意味着什么。虽然我对迄今为止所看到的感到敬畏，并对即将发生的事情感到兴奋，但我确实感到有点空虚，仍在等待真正问题的答案：如何？

articles.title: In 2022 NASA struck an asteroid. Now we are finally seeing the massive impact up close

paras.en: In 2022 NASA smashed a spacecraft into an asteroid called Dimorphos to see what would happen—and now, some four years later, another space probe is finally revealing the effects of the impact up close.
paras.zh: 2022 年，美国宇航局 (NASA) 将一艘航天器撞向一颗名为 Dimorphos 的小行星，看看会发生什么——大约四年后的现在，另一个太空探测器终于近距离揭示了撞击的影响。

paras.en: On Wednesday the European Space Agency (ESA) released several new images of Dimorphos taken by Hera, a mission that launched in 2024 to study the asteroid in the impact’s aftermath. These observations offer new insights into how, in 2022, the Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) indelibly changed Dimorphos, a moonlet satellite of the larger asteroid Didymos. The impact altered Dimorphos’s orbit around Didymos and the entire binary system’s orbit around the sun, demonstrating, for the first time, that such a strategy could perhaps keep Earth safe from any asteroids found on a collision course with our planet.
paras.zh: 周三，欧洲航天局 (ESA) 发布了几张由 Hera 拍摄的 Dimorphos 的新图像，该任务于 2024 年启动，旨在研究这颗小行星撞击后的情况。这些观测结果为了解 2022 年双小行星重定向测试 (DART) 如何不可磨灭地改变了较大小行星 Didymos 的一颗小卫星 Dimorphos 提供了新的见解。这次撞击改变了迪莫福斯围绕迪迪莫斯的轨道以及整个双星系统围绕太阳的轨道，这首次证明这种策略也许可以保护地球免受任何在与我们的星球相撞过程中发现的小行星的伤害。

paras.en: The ESA images reveal that the DART impact left a massive crater on Dimorphos, which is itself a mere 151 meters in diameter. “The face struck by DART has been flattened into an impact crater the size of a sports stadium, which extends across the asteroid’s entire width,” said Hera principal investigator Patrick Michel in a statement. Until now, it was unclear if the DART mission had left a small crater or if it had reshaped the asteroid entirely, Michel said at a press conference on Wednesday.
paras.zh: ESA 图像显示，DART 撞击在 Dimorphos 上留下了一个巨大的陨石坑，而陨石坑本身的直径仅为 151 米。赫拉首席研究员帕特里克·米歇尔（Patrick Michel）在一份声明中表示：“被 DART 击中的表面已被夷为一个体育场大小的撞击坑，其宽度横跨小行星的整个宽度。”米歇尔在周三的新闻发布会上表示，到目前为止，尚不清楚 DART 任务是否留下了一个小陨石坑，或者是否完全重塑了小行星​​。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “It’s really strange because you have a big crater, and the rest seems not really perturbed, so we are perturbed actually,” Michel said. “Scientists are perturbed,” added Ian Carnelli, Hera mission lead.
paras.zh: 米歇尔说：“这真的很奇怪，因为有一个大陨石坑，而其余部分似乎并没有受到真正的干扰，所以我们实际上受到了干扰。” “科学家们感到不安，”赫拉任务负责人伊恩·卡内利补充道。

paras.en: The images also show that after DART struck Dimorphos, the little asteroid has been “tumbling wildly” in its orbit around Didymos, said Michael Küppers, ESA Hera mission scientist, in the same statement. In fact, Dimorphos appears to be the most chaotically rotating object in the solar system, Michel said at the Wednesday press event.
paras.zh: 欧空局赫拉任务科学家迈克尔·库珀斯在同一份声明中表示，这些图像还显示，在 DART 撞击 Dimorphos 后，这颗小行星一直在围绕 Didymos 的轨道上“疯狂翻滚”。米歇尔在周三的新闻发布会上说，事实上，双形态似乎是太阳系中旋转最混乱的天体。

paras.en: Hera launched to space in October 2024. Accompanied by two small CubeSats, the mission is designed to assess how DART altered Dimorphos and its structure, as well as its composition and gravity. These data will help refine planetary defense models. The Hera mission has also found hundreds of boulders in the binary system that the team previously did not know about, adding targets for future observation.
paras.zh: Hera 于 2024 年 10 月发射升空。在两颗小型立方体卫星的陪伴下，该任务旨在评估 DART 如何改变 Dimorphos 及其结构、成分和重力。这些数据将有助于完善行星防御模型。赫拉任务还在双星系统中发现了数百块团队之前不知道的巨石，为未来的观测增加了目标。

paras.en: During Wednesday’s press conference, officials discussed how, in Earth’s past, catastrophic asteroid impacts had led to planetary-scale mass extinctions, most famously eradicating the nonavian dinosaurs at the end of the Cretaceous period.
paras.zh: 在周三的新闻发布会上，官员们讨论了在地球过去，灾难性的小行星撞击如何导致全球范围内的大规模灭绝，最著名的是白垩纪末期非鸟类恐龙的灭绝。

paras.en: “We just heard the story that happened 66 million years ago,” Carnelli said. “Clearly, that day dinosaurs had a very bad day, but they didn’t have a space agency. So today we are a better species. We have wonderful space agencies, and we know what to do.”
paras.zh: “我们刚刚听说了 6600 万年前发生的故事，”卡内利说。 “显然，那天恐龙度过了非常糟糕的一天，但他们没有航天机构。所以今天我们是一个更好的物种。我们有很棒的航天机构，我们知道该怎么做。”

paras.en: Editor’s Note (11/25/26): This is a developing story and may be updated.
paras.zh: 编者注（11/25/26）：这是一个正在发展的故事，可能会更新。

articles.title: Math’s holy grail, the Riemann hypothesis, appears solved with AI’s help
articles.author: Kathryn Hulick

paras.en: A long-sought pinnacle of mathematics has apparently been reached. In a feat that will go down in mathematics history, a human working with AI appears to have solved the most famous puzzle in math, proving the Riemann hypothesis. The problem has foiled repeated and valiant attempts at solution for more than a century.
paras.zh: 显然已经达到了长期以来寻求的数学顶峰。人类与人工智能的合作似乎已经解决了最著名的数学难题，证明了黎曼猜想，这是一项将载入数学史册的壮举。一个多世纪以来，人们多次勇敢地尝试解决这个问题，但都失败了。

paras.en: Now, mathematicians are working to understand the proof, posted by Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, on November 20. The Riemann hypothesis, if true, reveals the secrets of prime numbers. In a statement on his website, Alpöge said he’d developed the proof alongside Anthropic’s AI tool Claude.
paras.zh: 现在，数学家们正在努力理解 Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 于 11 月 20 日发布的证明。如果黎曼假设成立，它将揭示素数的秘密。 Alpöge 在其网站上的一份声明中表示，他与 Anthropic 的人工智能工具 Claude 一起开发了证明。

paras.en: By the next day, independent mathematicians had confirmed the result. “We have full confidence that Alpöge’s proof of the Riemann hypothesis is correct, and we congratulate him on this achievement,” read a joint statement from Lean Focused Research Organization and Mathlib Initiative.
paras.zh: 第二天，独立数学家证实了这一结果。 “我们完全相信 Alpöge 对黎曼假设的证明是正确的，我们祝贺他取得这一成就，”精益聚焦研究组织和 Mathlib Initiative 的联合声明中写道。

paras.en: A proof of the Riemann hypothesis is one of the most sought after achievements in mathematics. “As a mathematical landmark, it really doesn’t get bigger than this. I can’t think of a theorem proven not only in my lifetime, maybe in the history of mathematics that is as important as this,” says mathematician Ken Ono of Axiom Math and the University of Virginia in Charlottesville.
paras.zh: 黎曼猜想的证明是数学界最受追捧的成就之一。 “作为一个数学里程碑，它真的没有比这更伟大的了。我想不出一个不仅在我有生之年得到证明的定理，也许在数学史上也如此重要，”Axiom Math 和夏洛茨维尔弗吉尼亚大学的数学家肯·小野 (Ken Ono) 说道。

paras.en: “It’s an historic achievement,” says Bryna Kra, a mathematician at Northwestern University in Evanston, Ill.
paras.zh: “这是一项历史性的成就，”伊利诺伊州埃文斯顿西北大学的数学家布赖娜·克拉 (Bryna Kra) 说。

paras.en: Importantly, this was not the work of AI alone, Kra says. First of all, Claude had been trained on the work of thousands of human mathematicians, plus Alpöge was an experienced mathematician himself. He did not just ask for the proof then “push a button and wait,” Kra says.
paras.zh: 克拉说，重要的是，这不仅仅是人工智能的工作。首先，克劳德接受过数千名人类数学家工作的培训，而且阿尔波格本人也是一位经验丰富的数学家。克拉说，他不只是要求提供证据，然后“按下按钮然后等待”。

paras.en: Over six weeks, he worked back and forth with Claude. As an AI agent, Claude can use outside tools to perform tasks. The precise version of Claude that Alpöge used has not been disclosed, but the AI checked its work using Lean, software that converts mathematical arguments into code in order to confirm that a chain of logic holds up. It also had access to Mathlib, a library of known arguments already converted into Lean.
paras.zh: 六个星期以来，他与克劳德一起工作。作为人工智能代理，克劳德可以使用外部工具来执行任务。 Alpöge 使用的 Claude 的精确版本尚未公开，但人工智能使用 Lean 检查其工作，该软件将数学参数转换为代码，以确认逻辑链是否成立。它还可以访问 Mathlib，这是一个已经转换为 Lean 的已知参数库。

paras.en: The result is 250,000 pages of dense, complex math. The world’s mathematicians are still working to translate the proof into a form people can understand. “What’s amazing about this proof is that it involves so many different areas of mathematics,” Ono says. “And I don’t know how a single human being could hold all of the ideas in their mind.”
paras.zh: 结果是 250,000 页的密集、复杂的数学。世界上的数学家仍在努力将证明转化为人们可以理解的形式。 “这个证明的惊人之处在于它涉及数学的许多不同领域，”小野说。 “我不知道一个人怎么能把所有的想法都记在脑子里。”

paras.en: The Riemann hypothesis, which dates to 1859, is closely linked with prime numbers. Prime numbers seem to be sprinkled randomly along the number line, but the Riemann hypothesis reveals a hidden order. At play is a mathematical enigma called the Riemann zeta function. The zeros of this function — the values that, when plugged into the function, produce a zero — are closely related to prime numbers. The Riemann hypothesis says that certain zeros — of which there are an infinite number — all sit on a particular line on a graph. If that is true, it would reveal how many primes exist below a given number.
paras.zh: 黎曼猜想可以追溯到 1859 年，它与素数密切相关。素数似乎沿着数轴随机散布，但黎曼假设揭示了隐藏的顺序。起作用的是一个称为黎曼 zeta 函数的数学谜题。该函数的零点（当插入该函数时产生零的值）与素数密切相关。黎曼假设指出，某些零（其中有无限多个）都位于图上的特定线上。如果这是真的，它将揭示给定数字以下存在多少个素数。

paras.en: Because so much of mathematics involves prime numbers, many other mathematical statements rest on the correctness of the hypothesis. The new proof will have wide implications. “It’s an earthquake throughout mathematics,” Ono says.
paras.zh: 由于许多数学涉及素数，因此许多其他数学陈述都依赖于假设的正确性。新的证明将产生广泛的影响。 “这是整个数学界的一场地震，”小野说。

paras.en: Alpöge claims to have solved not only the Riemann hypothesis itself, but a more general form of it, called the generalized Riemann hypothesis, which extends the idea to related functions. Though he guided the AI, Alpöge wrote that “what I saw during the course of progress so amazed me that I believe it is one dawn across science of something far greater … Claude far outpaced me near the finish line.”
paras.zh: Alpöge 声称不仅解决了黎曼假设本身，而且还解决了它的更一般形式，称为广义黎曼假设，它将这一想法扩展到相关函数。尽管阿尔波格是人工智能的指导者，但他写道，“我在进展过程中所看到的一切让我感到非常惊讶，我相信这是科学界的一个黎明，它的意义要大得多……克劳德在终点线附近远远超过了我。”

paras.en: AI has been steadily felling major problems of mathematics, and this is the biggest one yet. But according to cognitive scientist Gary Marcus of New York University, AI’s genius at math will not carry over to more open-ended types of problems in biology, business or robotics. “In short, it’s not at all obvious that whatever Alpöge did has the generality many people are hoping for,” he wrote in a Substack post.
paras.zh: 人工智能一直在稳步解决数学的重大问题，这是迄今为止最大的一个。但根据纽约大学认知科学家加里·马库斯的说法，人工智能在数学方面的天赋不会延续到生物学、商业或机器人技术等更开放式的问题类型上。 “简而言之，无论 Alpöge 所做的事情是否具有许多人所希望的普遍性，这一点并不明显，”他在 Substack 帖子中写道。

paras.en: And some mathematicians have pushed back against the dominance of AI, disputing the utility of proofs created with the technology. The Association for Human Mathematics wrote in a November 20 statement on their website that no human being can claim to be responsible for the Riemann hypothesis proof, and that no mathematician can “confirm with full certainty that the proof is correct.”
paras.zh: 一些数学家反对人工智能的主导地位，质疑该技术创建的证明的效用。人类数学协会在其网站上11月20日的一份声明中写道，没有人可以声称自己对黎曼假设的证明负责，也没有数学家可以“完全确定地证实证明是正确的”。

paras.en: Kra has been critical of achievements where AI agents worked largely on their own, independent of human intervention. The recent solution, by OpenAI, to a puzzle about the Navier-Stokes equations that describe fluids came about that way. But Alpöge’s approach was different, Kra says. “There is someone to stand behind [the work],” she says. She just hopes that people don’t see this as an end to math. “I think that this is a beginning, this is opening up more questions than it answers. … I think we have to use our imagination and find what’s the next frontier.”
paras.zh: 克拉一直对人工智能代理在很大程度上独立于人类干预而独立工作的成就持批评态度。 OpenAI 最近提出的关于描述流体的纳维-斯托克斯方程难题的解决方案就是通过这种方式实现的。但克拉说，阿尔波格的方法有所不同。 “[工作]背后有人支持，”她说。她只是希望人们不要认为这是数学的终结。 “我认为这是一个开始，它提出的问题多于答案。……我认为我们必须发挥我们的想象力，找到下一个前沿领域。”

articles.title: Australia’s legless geckos evolved like snakes did
articles.author: Jake Buehler

paras.en: Australia’s limbless geckos look a lot like snakes. It turns out they’ve evolved like snakes too.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚的无肢壁虎看起来很像蛇。事实证明它们也像蛇一样进化。

paras.en: Snakes are technically a highly modified group of legless lizards. Dozens of other lizard lineages have independently lost their legs, too. But the legless pygopod geckos aren’t quite like their slithering nonsnake kin. Pygopods have dietary pickiness and physical diversity patterns that are more reminiscent of those found in snakes than in other legless lizards, researchers report in a preprint posted at bioRxiv.org on October 23.
paras.zh: 从技术上讲，蛇是一种经过高度改造的无腿蜥蜴。其他数十个蜥蜴谱系也独立地失去了腿。但无腿尾足类壁虎不太像它们滑行的非蛇类近亲。研究人员在 10 月 23 日发布在 bioRxiv.org 上的预印本中报告称，尾足类动物的饮食挑剔和身体多样性模式比其他无腿蜥蜴更容易让人想起蛇。

paras.en: The 50 recognized species of pygopod geckos are found throughout Australia and New Guinea. Pygopods range from a meter long to the size of half a cooked spaghetti noodle. They have odd tails, which in some species can be fantastically long, exceeding 400 percent of their less-than-1-centimeter-long bodies. Some use their tails like a spring to leap.
paras.zh: 50 种公认的尾足壁虎遍布澳大利亚和新几内亚。尾足类动物的长度从一米到半条煮熟的意大利面条大小。它们有奇怪的尾巴，在某些物种中尾巴可以长得惊人，超过它们不到 1 厘米长的身体的 400%。有些用尾巴像弹簧一样跳跃。

paras.en: “They create a little sine wave and they shoot themselves up in the air, and they can do successive jumps,” says Ian Brennan, an evolutionary biologist at the Queensland Museum Kurilpa in Brisbane, Australia.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚布里斯班库里尔帕昆士兰博物馆的进化生物学家伊恩·布伦南 (Ian Brennan) 说：“它们会产生一点正弦波，然后将自己射向空中，并且可以连续跳跃。”

paras.en: But not much else is known about them, Brennan says.
paras.zh: 但布伦南说，人们对它们知之甚少。

paras.en: “They’re real oddballs,” he says, noting that geckos are typically thought of as skilled climbers on walls or glass surfaces. “[Pygopods are] a group that’s gone the exact opposite direction.”
paras.zh: “它们真的很奇怪，”他说，并指出壁虎通常被认为是墙壁或玻璃表面上的熟练攀爬者。 “[Pygopods]是一个走向完全相反方向的群体。”

paras.en: As part of a large project tackling the genetics of Australia’s lizards and snakes, Brennan and his colleagues gathered data on pygopods’ genes, diet and physical features. They analyzed DNA from all 50 species of pygopod and generated an evolutionary tree. The team also put together data from the literature on the ratio of their body and tail lengths and compared this with a dataset of similar information on over 3,100 lizard and snake species.
paras.zh: 作为解决澳大利亚蜥蜴和蛇遗传学的大型项目的一部分，布伦南和他的同事收集了有关尾足动物基因、饮食和身体特征的数据。他们分析了所有 50 种尾足类动物的 DNA，并生成了进化树。研究小组还汇总了文献中关于它们身体和尾巴长度比例的数据，并将其与超过 3,100 种蜥蜴和蛇物种的类似信息数据集进行了比较。

paras.en: As they evolved, snakes got longer by lengthening their bodies. Limbed lizards tend to get longer by lengthening their tails. The team found that pygopods have done both, an unusual strategy among legless lizards. This dual strategy resulted in some unexpected physical diversity in tail and body ratio.
paras.zh: 随着进化，蛇通过延长身体而变得更长。有肢蜥蜴往往会通过加长尾巴来变得更长。研究小组发现尾足类动物两者都做到了，这在无腿蜥蜴中是一种不寻常的策略。这种双重策略导致了尾巴和身体比例的一些意想不到的身体多样性。

paras.en: Next, the team tackled diet, comparing between 1,738 lizard and snake species. Snakes as a group have a broad diet with lots of specialization, which might be partly why they’ve been so successful at diversifying into so many ecological roles in so many habitats, Brennan says. There are pythons that eat only large mammals and sea snakes that eat only fish eggs, for instance.
paras.zh: 接下来，研究小组解决了饮食问题，对 1,738 种蜥蜴和蛇进行了比较。布伦南说，蛇作为一个群体，有着广泛的饮食和很多专业化，这可能是它们在如此多的栖息地中如此成功地多样化、扮演如此多的生态角色的部分原因。例如，有只吃大型哺乳动物的蟒蛇和只吃鱼卵的海蛇。

paras.en: This pattern is rare in lizards. Most geckos eat insects such as beetles and cockroaches, Brennan says. This is especially true of the legless groups, which mostly gobble down whatever insects they happen to slither past.
paras.zh: 这种图案在蜥蜴中很少见。布伦南说，大多数壁虎以甲虫和蟑螂等昆虫为食。对于无腿群体来说尤其如此，它们大多会吃掉它们滑过的任何昆虫。

paras.en: But the team found that the wide variety in what pygopods as a group will eat is exceeded among reptiles only by monitor lizards and colubrid snakes, a hyperdiverse group of over 2,000 snake species. Within that broad dietary range, particular pygopods flirt with snakelike pickiness. Some pygopods chiefly hunt spiders and scorpions. Another group targets ants and termites. One predatory pygopod — the Lialis genus — gulps down other lizards snake-style.
paras.zh: 但研究小组发现，在爬行动物中，尾足类动物的食性种类繁多，仅次于巨蜥和游蛇，这是一个由 2000 多种蛇组成的高度多样化的类群。在如此广泛的饮食范围内，某些尾足类动物有着像蛇一样的挑剔。一些尾足类动物主要捕猎蜘蛛和蝎子。另一组的目标是蚂蚁和白蚁。一种掠食性尾足动物——蜥蜴属——会像蛇一样吞下其他蜥蜴。

paras.en: Pygopods’ evolutionary history may provide hints about how this heightened diversity developed. The team’s findings suggest they split off from other geckos in Australia 50 million years ago — much more recently than when the first snakes evolved around 160 million years ago, but before any modern snake groups reached Australia. Brennan thinks pygopods filled the roles of small snakes on the continent for millions of years in isolation.
paras.zh: 尾足类动物的进化史可能提供了关于这种高度多样性如何发展的线索。研究小组的研究结果表明，它们在 5000 万年前就从澳大利亚的其他壁虎中分离出来——比大约 1.6 亿年前第一批蛇进化时要晚得多，但在任何现代蛇类到达澳大利亚之前。布伦南认为，尾足类动物在数百万年来与世隔绝的情况下，在这片大陆上扮演着小蛇的角色。

paras.en: “Pygopods were probably on a trajectory to do something spectacular, like snakes,” says Brennan. “But then all of these [snake] groups showed up in Australia and filled into those niches.”
paras.zh: 布伦南说：“尾足类动物可能会做出一些惊人的事情，比如蛇。” “但随后所有这些[蛇]群体都出现在澳大利亚并填补了这些空白。”

paras.en: Sonal Singhal — an evolutionary biologist at California State University, Dominguez Hills in Carson — would like to see this study’s data combined with data on pygopods’ skull shape, their habitat use and how their bodies move.
paras.zh: 索纳尔·辛哈尔 (Sonal Singhal) 是加州州立大学卡森分校多明格斯山分校的进化生物学家，他希望看到这项研究的数据与尾足类动物的头骨形状、栖息地利用以及身体移动方式的数据相结合。

paras.en: “For example, Lialis can swallow prey whole because their jaws are so flexible and kinetic and their teeth hinge back and forth, allowing them to trap prey.”
paras.zh: “例如，利亚利斯可以吞下整个猎物，因为它们的下巴非常灵活和动能，而且它们的牙齿前后铰接，使它们能够捕获猎物。”

paras.en: For Brennan, a lesson from the findings is that lacking limbs need not be an evolutionary constraint. Both snakes and pygopods “have diversified to do really interesting things, either due to or in spite of being limbless,” he says.
paras.zh: 对于布伦南来说，研究结果的一个教训是，缺乏四肢不一定是进化的限制。他说，蛇和尾足类动物“无论是由于无肢还是尽管无肢，都已经多样化，可以做真正有趣的事情”。

articles.title: A cosmically close supernova may spill the stellar explosion’s secrets
articles.author: Meghan Bartels

paras.en: When astronomers first spotted the supernova now designated SN 2026ahvu, it was just one of the dozens detected every day. But scientists soon realized this one was something very special, and they’ve been hustling to study it ever since.
paras.zh: 当天文学家第一次发现这颗超新星（现在被命名为 SN 2026ahvu）时，它只是每天检测到的数十颗超新星之一。但科学家们很快意识到这是一种非常特别的东西，从那时起他们就一直在努力研究它。

paras.en: “I think almost everyone in the world is trying to trigger a telescope and look at this,” says astrophysicist Sumit Sarbadhicary of Johns Hopkins University.
paras.zh: 约翰·霍普金斯大学的天体物理学家苏米特·萨巴迪卡里 (Sumit Sarbadhicary) 表示：“我认为世界上几乎每个人都在尝试启动望远镜来观察这一现象。”

paras.en: Soon after scientists spotted the explosion on November 2, they determined it hadn’t yet peaked in brightness, giving scientists an early glimpse at the event. Even more thrilling, within a day of the explosion’s discovery, astronomers had classified it as a type Ia supernova. These particular outbursts are rare, but they’re astronomical superstars: Scientists use their trademark explosion pattern as a “standard candle” to measure distance into the universe — most notably to discover that the universe’s expansion is accelerating. And to round out a trifecta of reasons to be excited, these blasts rarely occur so close to Earth.
paras.zh: 11 月 2 日，科学家们发现爆炸后不久，他们确定爆炸的亮度尚未达到峰值，这让科学家们得以初步了解这一事件。更令人兴奋的是，在发现爆炸的一天之内，天文学家就将其归类为 Ia 型超新星。这些特殊的爆发很罕见，但它们是天文学上的超级巨星：科学家们使用它们标志性的爆炸模式作为“标准蜡烛”来测量宇宙的距离——最值得注意的是发现宇宙的膨胀正在加速。更令人兴奋的是，这些爆炸很少发生在距离地球如此近的地方。

paras.en: Astronomers know type 1a supernovas occur upon the reignition and resulting self-destruction of a white dwarf star, the small cool remnants of a star like the sun that’s too small to become a superdense neutron star or black hole at its demise. Scientists also know that powering back on requires reaching about 1.44 times the mass of the sun, which can occur only if something is giving the white dwarf extra mass.
paras.zh: 天文学家知道，1a 型超新星是在白矮星重新点燃并导致自毁时发生的，白矮星是像太阳这样的恒星的小型冷残余物，它太小而无法在死亡时成为超致密中子星或黑洞。科学家还知道，重新启动需要达到太阳质量的 1.44 倍，而只有在某些东西给予白矮星额外的质量时才会发生这种情况。

paras.en: But scientists aren’t sure what that something is — whether these supernovas are triggered by a second white dwarf or some sort of star that’s still burning. Usually, these explosions occur so far away that astronomers can’t get a good look at where they come from. But SN 2026ahvu is perhaps 50 million light-years or less away from Earth.
paras.zh: 但科学家们不确定那是什么东西——这些超新星是否是由第二颗白矮星或某种仍在燃烧的恒星引发的。通常，这些爆炸发生的距离很远，天文学家无法仔细观察它们的来源。但 SN 2026ahvu 距离地球可能 5000 万光年或更短。

paras.en: “They happen so rarely at this distance that it could hopefully help us figure out why this white dwarf exploded in the first place,” says astronomer Yvette Cendes of the University of Oregon in Eugene, who has been arranging for radio telescopes to observe the outburst.
paras.zh: 俄勒冈大学尤金分校的天文学家伊维特·森德斯（Yvette Cendes）表示：“在这么远的距离上，这种情况很少发生，因此它有望帮助我们弄清楚这颗白矮星爆炸的原因。”她一直在安排射电望远镜来观察这次爆发。

paras.en: Sarbadhicary and colleagues have already submitted preliminary findings November 6 at arXiv.org suggesting that the former white dwarf was less than 100 million years old. That’s remarkably young compared with other supernovas of this type, and may help scientists finetune their understanding of these outbursts.
paras.zh: Sarbadhicary 及其同事已于 11 月 6 日在 arXiv.org 上提交了初步调查结果，表明这颗前白矮星的年龄还不到 1 亿年。与其他此类超新星相比，它非常年轻，可能有助于科学家微调他们对这些爆发的理解。

paras.en: “These explosions have been enduring mysteries for us for decades, and whenever something happens this close, it’s just really exciting,” Sarbadhicary says.
paras.zh: 萨巴迪卡里说：“几十年来，这些爆炸对我们来说一直是个谜，每当如此接近的事情发生时，都会非常令人兴奋。”

articles.title: Earth's Strange New Moonlet Has Revealed Something Astronomers Predicted in 1878
articles.author: Michelle Starr

paras.en: The Solar System's orbital do-si-do can get far more complicated than our classroom pictures might suggest.
paras.zh: 太阳系的轨道 do-si-do 可能比我们课堂上的图片所暗示的要复杂得多。

paras.en: We are all taught, for instance, that Earth has just one Moon, compared to the hundreds that orbit Saturn and Jupiter.
paras.zh: 例如，我们都被告知，地球只有一颗月亮，而土星和木星周围有数百颗月亮。

paras.en: But that's not always the case. Sometimes, a smaller object can get temporarily caught up in Earth's gravitational net – a fleeting moonlet that hangs around for a few months before continuing on its way.
paras.zh: 但情况并非总是如此。有时，一个较小的物体可能会暂时陷入地球的引力网中——一个转瞬即逝的小卫星，它会在地球上停留几个月，然后继续前进。

paras.en: Our planet has just such a visitor right now.
paras.zh: 我们的星球现在就有这样一位访客。

paras.en: Its name is 2026 QQ8 – a small rock just a few meters across. It slipped into Earth orbit in April of this year, but its stay will be a short one.
paras.zh: 它的名字叫2026 QQ8——一块直径只有几米的小岩石。它于今年四月进入地球轨道，但停留时间很短。

paras.en: It is predicted to depart again on 7 December 2026 – but in its very brief time accompanying Earth, it has already given astronomers their first glimpse of a curious orbital configuration predicted nearly 150 years ago.
paras.zh: 预计它将于 2026 年 12 月 7 日再次离开——但在它陪伴地球的短暂时间内，它已经让天文学家第一次看到了近 150 年前预测的奇怪轨道结构。

paras.en: "Its unusual orbit lies close to the theoretical upper duration limit of an object captured in the Earth-Moon system, and has now been observed for the first time," writes a team led by astronomer Grigori Fedorets of the University of Turku in Finland in a preprint uploaded to arXiv.
paras.zh: 芬兰图尔库大学天文学家 Grigori Fedorets 领导的团队在上传到 arXiv 的预印本中写道：“它不寻常的轨道接近地月系统中捕获的物体的理论持续时间上限，现在首次被观测到。”

paras.en: By the time QQ8 was discovered, it had already been in Earth orbit for several months.
paras.zh: 当QQ8被发现时，它已经在地球轨道上运行了几个月。

paras.en: The first identification was made on 19 August 2026 by astronomer Krisztián Sárneczky at the Konkoly Observatory in Hungary – but it didn't take long for problems to emerge.
paras.zh: 2026 年 8 月 19 日，天文学家 Krisztián Sárneczky 在匈牙利康科利天文台首次进行了识别，但没过多久，问题就出现了。

paras.en: While the object's orbital relationship with Earth was immediately apparent, its identity was not – and astronomers could not immediately establish whether it was a natural object or a piece of space junk.
paras.zh: 虽然该物体与地球的轨道关系是显而易见的，但它的身份却并非如此，天文学家无法立即确定它是自然物体还是一块太空垃圾。

paras.en: This is a surprisingly common dilemma in astronomy. Humans have littered the space around Earth with so much junk that sometimes it can masquerade as something more cosmic in origin – even, potentially, a gamma-ray burst from the dawn of the Universe.
paras.zh: 这是天文学中一个令人惊讶的常见困境。人类在地球周围的空间散布了如此多的垃圾，有时它们可​​以伪装成更宇宙的东西——甚至有可能是宇宙诞生之初的伽马射线爆发。

paras.en: QQ8 shows that the problem can go the other way, too. And it caused quite some trouble for astronomers trying to get a bead on the thing.
paras.zh: QQ8 表明问题也可以从另一个角度解决。这给试图了解这件事的天文学家带来了相当大的麻烦。

paras.en: Objects suspected of being artificial – as most objects in Earth orbit are – are routinely removed from the Minor Planet Center's Near-Earth Object Confirmation Page, which astronomers use to coordinate follow-up observations of newly discovered objects. QQ8 was removed twice.
paras.zh: 被怀疑是人造的物体——就像地球轨道上的大多数物体一样——通常会从小行星中心的近地物体确认页面中删除，天文学家用它来协调对新发现物体的后续观测。 QQ8被下架两次。

paras.en: This threw a spanner into the works of astronomers trying to plan those follow-ups – but they were undeterred. As a workaround, they circulated their measurements directly to their colleagues via the Minor Planet Mailing List, allowing observations to continue.
paras.zh: 这给天文学家计划后续行动的工作带来了阻碍，但他们并没有被吓倒。作为一种解决方法，他们通过小行星邮件列表将测量结果直接分发给同事，以便继续进行观测。

paras.en: It wasn't until October 29 that the Minor Planet Center officially announced the discovery of Earth's newest natural satellite, giving it the designation 2026 QQ8 and the classification Temporarily Captured Object.
paras.zh: 直到10月29日，小行星中心才正式宣布发现了地球最新的天然卫星，并将其编号为2026 QQ8，分类为“临时捕获天体”。

paras.en: The confusion arises because, at such great distances, even powerful telescopes can resolve little more than a speck of light from such a small object – and figuring out what QQ8 actually was took some lovely astronomical detective work.
paras.zh: 造成这种混乱的原因是，在如此远的距离上，即使是强大的望远镜也只能分辨出来自如此小物体的一粒光，而要弄清楚 QQ8 到底是什么，需要一些可爱的天文侦探工作。

paras.en: One of the clues has to do with the faint pressure exerted on objects by the light of the Sun.
paras.zh: 线索之一与太阳光对物体施加的微弱压力有关。

paras.en: Photons – the particles that make up light – carry momentum, which they transfer to objects when they strike them. This generates a tiny force known as radiation pressure.
paras.zh: 光子——构成光的粒子——携带动量，当它们撞击物体时，它们会将动量传递给物体。这会产生一种微小的力，称为辐射压。

paras.en: How much this force alters an object's trajectory depends on the ratio of its cross-sectional area to its mass, among other things. A hollow, discarded rocket stage, for instance, is much more easily pushed around by sunlight than a similarly sized lump of solid rock.
paras.zh: 该力对物体轨迹的改变程度取决于其横截面积与其质量的比率等。例如，一个空心的、废弃的火箭级比一块类似大小的固体岩石更容易被阳光推动。

paras.en: By precisely tracking QQ8's movements, Fedorets and his colleagues were able to measure the effect of solar radiation pressure on its trajectory. That effect was much too small to be consistent with typical space debris, but well within the range expected for a natural object.
paras.zh: 通过精确跟踪 QQ8 的运动，Fedoret 和他的同事能够测量太阳辐射压力对其轨迹的影响。这种效应太小，与典型的空间碎片不相符，但完全在自然物体的预期范围内。

paras.en: The next line of evidence came from the way the object reflects light.
paras.zh: 下一个证据来自物体反射光的方式。

paras.en: Different materials absorb and reflect the light spectrum differently. By measuring QQ8's brightness through four different filters using the Nordic Optical Telescope in the Canary Islands, the researchers were able to determine that its pattern of reflectance was a close match to that of S-type asteroids – rocky objects rich in silicate minerals.
paras.zh: 不同的材料对光谱的吸收和反射不同。通过使用加那利群岛的北欧光学望远镜通过四个不同的滤光片测量 QQ8 的亮度，研究人员能够确定其反射率模式与 S 型小行星（富含硅酸盐矿物的岩石物体）的反射率模式非常匹配。

paras.en: Based on the typical albedo, or reflectivity, of S-type asteroids and QQ8's brightness, the researchers could then estimate its size – just 1.3 to 1.9 meters (4.3 to 6.2 feet) across.
paras.zh: 根据 S 型小行星的典型反照率或反射率和 QQ8 的亮度，研究人员可以估计它的大小——直径仅为 1.3 至 1.9 米（4.3 至 6.2 英尺）。

paras.en: Given that QQ8's closest approach to Earth is estimated to be 537,000 kilometers (334,000 miles), that level of detail is pretty amazing.
paras.zh: 鉴于 QQ8 距离地球最近的距离估计为 537,000 公里（334,000 英里），这种细节水平相当惊人。

paras.en: Which brings us, naturally, to its orbit – and why we can't confidently call QQ8 a minimoon.
paras.zh: 这自然而然地把我们带到了它的轨道上——这也是为什么我们不能自信地称 QQ8 为小卫星。

paras.en: Earth's temporary natural satellites fall into two categories: temporarily captured orbiters and temporarily captured flybys. It's the former that we call minimoons.
paras.zh: 地球的临时天然卫星分为两类：临时捕获的轨道卫星和临时捕获的飞越卫星。前者我们称之为小卫星。

paras.en: The key distinction lies in whether or not the object completes a full revolution around Earth before escaping its gravitational clutches.
paras.zh: 关键区别在于该物体在逃离其引力控制之前是否完成了绕地球一周的旋转。

paras.en: But what constitutes a full revolution is, it turns out, a surprisingly complicated question – because Earth isn't stationary in space. It moves around the Sun in its own orbit.
paras.zh: 但事实证明，什么构成一场完整的革命是一个令人惊讶的复杂问题——因为地球在太空中并不是静止的。它在自己的轨道上绕太阳运行。

paras.en: To make sense of the movements of Earth's temporary companions, astronomers use what's known as a co-rotating reference frame – a perspective that rotates with Earth as it orbits the Sun, keeping the positions of Earth and the Sun fixed relative to one another.
paras.zh: 为了理解地球临时伙伴的运动，天文学家使用了所谓的共同旋转参考系——一种在地球绕太阳运行时与地球一起旋转的视角，保持地球和太阳相对于彼此的位置固定。

paras.en: From this perspective, QQ8 travels only about three-quarters of the way around Earth during its capture, technically making it a temporarily captured flyby rather than a minimoon.
paras.zh: 从这个角度来看，QQ8 在捕获期间仅绕地球飞行了约四分之三的路程，从技术上讲，它是暂时捕获的飞越而不是小卫星。

paras.en: An alternative method of counting revolutions, however, based on how much the object's three-dimensional trajectory curves, yields a different result. In a separate preprint led by astronomer Bryce Bolin of Eureka Scientific, researchers calculated that QQ8 completes more than one revolution.
paras.zh: 然而，另一种计算转数的方法是根据物体的三维轨迹曲线的多少来计算的，会产生不同的结果。在尤里卡科学公司（Eureka Scientific）天文学家布莱斯·博林（Bryce Bolin）领导的另一份预印本中，研究人员计算出 QQ8 完成了不止一次革命。

paras.en: By that definition, it does qualify as a minimoon. Schrödinger's minimoon – it both is and is not, depending on your math.
paras.zh: 根据这个定义，它确实有资格成为小卫星。薛定谔的小月亮——它既是又不是，这取决于你的数学。

paras.en: What's less ambiguous is how long QQ8 is hanging around, and that's the more interesting part.
paras.zh: 更明确的是 QQ8 存在了多久，这才是更有趣的部分。

paras.en: The two previously identified temporarily captured flybys, 2022 NX1 and 2024 PT5, were gravitationally bound to Earth for only about a month each. QQ8's comparatively lengthy 7.5-month sojourn puts it among the longest-lasting 0.3 percent of theoretically modeled flybys.
paras.zh: 先前确定的两架临时捕获的飞越飞机，2022 NX1 和 2024 PT5，在重力作用下分别仅在地球上停留了大约一个月。 QQ8 相对较长的 7.5 个月逗留时间使其成为理论模型飞越中持续时间最长的 0.3% 之一。

paras.en: And the reason for this lies in a curious orbital configuration first proposed in 1878 by US astronomer and mathematician George William Hill, known as an orbit of maximum lunation.
paras.zh: 其原因在于美国天文学家和数学家乔治·威廉·希尔 (George William Hill) 于 1878 年首次提出的一种奇特的轨道结构，即最大月球轨道。

paras.en: In the co-rotating reference frame, an object on such a trajectory can appear to almost come to a standstill, even as it accompanies Earth around the Sun, lingering for months in regions of space roughly 90 degrees from the direction of the Sun, known as quadratures.
paras.zh: 在同向旋转参考系中，沿着这样的轨道运行的物体看起来几乎处于静止状态，即使它伴随着地球绕太阳运行，在与太阳方向成大约 90 度（称为正交）的太空区域中徘徊数月。

paras.en: QQ8 represents the first observational evidence that such orbits exist.
paras.zh: QQ8 代表了此类轨道存在的第一个观测证据。

paras.en: There may be other surprises in its tiny body, too. Bolin and his colleagues attempted to figure out where the heck the rock had come from.
paras.zh: 它小小的身体里可能还有其他惊喜。博林和他的同事试图弄清楚这块岩石到底是从哪里来的。

paras.en: Using observations from the Very Large Telescope in Chile and the Keck and Gemini North observatories in Hawaiʻi, the researchers compared QQ8's reflective properties not only with those of different asteroid types, but also with those of rocks brought back from the Moon.
paras.zh: 利用智利甚大望远镜以及夏威夷凯克和双子座北天文台的观测结果，研究人员不仅将 QQ8 的反射特性与不同小行星类型的反射特性进行了比较，还与从月球带回的岩石的反射特性进行了比较。

paras.en: Two basalt samples collected by the Apollo 17 astronauts in 1972 were particularly good matches.
paras.zh: 1972 年阿波罗 17 号宇航员采集的两块玄武岩样本的匹配度特别好。

paras.en: So, it's possible that QQ8 is a chunk of rock blasted off the Moon by an impact, sent careening into space to orbit the Sun before being temporarily recaptured by Earth.
paras.zh: 因此，QQ8 可能是一块因撞击而从月球上爆炸出来的岩石，在被地球暂时重新捕获之前，它被送入太空绕太阳运行。

paras.en: If that's the case, QQ8 could be a little larger than the estimate made by Fedorets and his colleagues. Based on the lower reflectivity of the lunar samples, Bolin's team calculated a diameter of around 2.5 meters.
paras.zh: 如果是这样的话，QQ8 的规模可能会比 Fedorets 和他的同事们的估计稍大一些。根据月球样本较低的反射率，博林的团队计算出其直径约为2.5米。

paras.en: The match isn't conclusive, though – the measurements are also consistent with a rocky asteroid. More detailed measurements of the light reflected by QQ8, particularly at infrared wavelengths, could help distinguish between the two possibilities.
paras.zh: 不过，这种匹配并不具有决定性——测量结果也与岩质小行星相符。对QQ8反射的光进行更详细的测量，特别是在红外波长下，有助于区分这两种可能性。

paras.en: In the meantime, the difficulties astronomers encountered in identifying QQ8 have highlighted the need for better procedures for recognizing Earth's temporary natural companions – especially since many more of them are predicted to be out there.
paras.zh: 与此同时，天文学家在识别QQ8时遇到的困难凸显了需要有更好的程序来识别地球的临时天然伴星，特别是因为预计还有更多这样的天体存在。

paras.en: QQ8 is only the fifth natural temporary Earth companion to be discovered – and the fourth since 2020 – but theoretical models suggest that our planet should have at least one at any given time.
paras.zh: QQ8 只是被发现的第五个天然临时地球伴星，也是 2020 年以来的第四个，但理论模型表明，我们的星球在任何特定时间都应该至少有一个。

paras.en: With the Vera C. Rubin Observatory poised to discover many more of them in the years to come, we may yet discover that our Moon has been sending us little rocky love letters all along.
paras.zh: 随着维拉·C·鲁宾天文台准备在未来几年发现更多这样的卫星，我们可能还会发现我们的月球一直在向我们发送小小的岩石情书。

paras.en: The two papers are available on arXiv. You can find Fedorets et al. here and Bolin et al. here.
paras.zh: 这两篇论文可以在 arXiv 上找到。您可以找到 Fedorets 等人。这里和博林等人。这里。

articles.title: Human 'Mini Brains' Spent 40 Days in Space. Scientists Found Clues to Alzheimer's.
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: There are multiple difficulties in studying Alzheimer's disease: it takes a long time to develop, involves many different neural processes, and happens deep in the brain where live tissue analysis is particularly tricky.
paras.zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病存在多种困难：它需要很长时间才能发展，涉及许多不同的神经过程，并且发生在大脑深处，而活体组织分析尤其棘手。

paras.en: Donor brains can be studied, but by then everything has stopped.
paras.zh: 捐赠者的大脑可以被研究，但到那时一切都停止了。

paras.en: One way to overcome these challenges could be to study Alzheimer's-affected brain cells in space, researchers think, and it's not as strange an idea as it might appear at first.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，克服这些挑战的一种方法可能是在太空中研究受阿尔茨海默病影响的脑细胞，而且这个想法并不像乍看起来那么奇怪。

paras.en: We have plenty of evidence that space speeds up cell aging and puts our biological systems under more pressure, with radiation and other stresses.
paras.zh: 我们有大量证据表明，太空会加速细胞老化，并使我们的生物系统承受更大的压力，包括辐射和其他压力。

paras.en: Space may give us the opportunity to better understand neurodegeneration, the way that brain cells wear down and lead to conditions such as dementia.
paras.zh: 太空可能让我们有机会更好地了解神经退行性病变，即脑细胞磨损并导致痴呆等疾病的方式。

paras.en: In a new study in Science Advances, researchers led by a team from the University of California, San Diego have reported on a batch of 'mini brains' (called organoids) that spent 40 days on board the International Space Station (ISS).
paras.zh: 在《科学进展》杂志上的一项新研究中，由加州大学圣地亚哥分校的一个团队领导的研究人员报告了一批“迷你大脑”（称为类器官），它们在国际空间站 (ISS) 上度过了 40 天。

paras.en: The lab behind it, led by Alysson Muotri, a neuroscientist and senior author of the study, has been flying brain organoids for years, and an earlier run helped set up a clinical trial of a candidate treatment for Rett syndrome.
paras.zh: 其背后的实验室由神经科学家、该研究的资深作者 Alysson Muotri 领导，多年来一直在飞行大脑类器官，早期的一次运行帮助建立了雷特综合征候选治疗方法的临床试验。

paras.en: When the organoids were analyzed upon their return, they showed shifts in their chemistry and composition that suggest this is an area of research worth pursuing.
paras.zh: 当这些类器官返回后进行分析时，它们显示出化学和成分的变化，这表明这是一个值得追求的研究领域。

paras.en: "Spaceflight provides a unique environment to study neural responses relevant to neurodegenerative diseases," write Muotri and team in their published paper.
paras.zh: “太空飞行提供了一个独特的环境来研究与神经退行性疾病相关的神经反应，”穆特里和团队在他们发表的论文中写道。

paras.en: "These exploratory findings indicate that spaceflight reshapes neuronal regulation in human brain organoids, revealing coordinated molecular responses relevant to Alzheimer's disease biology."
paras.zh: “这些探索性发现表明，太空飞行重塑了人脑类器官的神经元调节，揭示了与阿尔茨海默病生物学相关的协调分子反应。”

paras.en: The mini brains were grown in the lab to mimic some of the genetic mutations associated with Alzheimer's disease, with normal, 'healthy' versions included as controls.
paras.zh: 这些迷你大脑在实验室中培育，以模仿与阿尔茨海默病相关的一些基因突变，并以正常、“健康”的版本作为对照。

paras.en: Nothing special was done to the organoids while they were on board the ISS.
paras.zh: 当类器官在国际空间站上时，没有对它们进行任何特殊处理。

paras.en: They were kept sealed inside a laboratory box for the course of the visit and kept at body temperature, while more controls were kept in the same conditions on Earth.
paras.zh: 在访问过程中，它们被密封在实验室的盒子里并保持体温，而更多的对照则保持在与地球相同的条件下。

paras.en: "The space environment, characterized by microgravity, radiation exposure, variable magnetic fields, and circadian disruption, produces a combination of physiological stresses, including increased oxidative stress and mitochondrial impairment, as well as changes in the inflammatory systems," write the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“太空环境的特点是微重力、辐射暴露、可变磁场和昼夜节律紊乱，会产生一系列生理应激，包括氧化应激增加和线粒体损伤，以及炎症系统的变化。”

paras.en: When the space organoids returned, the Alzheimer's samples showed some notable differences.
paras.zh: 当太空类器官返回时，阿尔茨海默氏症样本显示出一些显着的差异。

paras.en: For example, some contained more of the amyloid-beta and phosphorylated (chemically tagged) tau proteins that congregate in the brains of people with Alzheimer's.
paras.zh: 例如，有些含有更多的β-淀粉样蛋白和磷酸化（化学标记）tau 蛋白，这些蛋白聚集在阿尔茨海默病患者的大脑中。

paras.en: Some of the signaling associated with early Alzheimer's development was spotted too. Cells in the organoids seem to respond to the extra stress of life in orbit by ramping up certain internal processes, including those generating energy.
paras.zh: 一些与早期阿尔茨海默病发展相关的信号也被发现了。类器官中的细胞似乎通过增强某些内部过程（包括产生能量的过程）来应对轨道上生命的额外压力。

paras.en: We're still at the early stages in terms of understanding what all of this means, but the mini brains showed enough Alzheimer's-related changes to indicate we could use them to study the disease in the future.
paras.zh: 我们仍处于理解这一切意味着什么的早期阶段，但迷你大脑显示出足够多的与阿尔茨海默氏症相关的变化，表明我们将来可以用它们来研究这种疾病。

paras.en: "Our results demonstrate that spaceflight exposure induces coordinated neuronal and molecular remodeling in Alzheimer's disease-derived organoids," write the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“我们的结果表明，太空飞行暴露会诱导阿尔茨海默病衍生的类器官中协调的神经元和分子重塑。”

paras.en: It's worth bearing in mind that these organoids aren't exact copies of our brains, and the genetic changes the researchers engineered in them relate to a very small number of Alzheimer's cases in humans. These factors have to be taken into account when interpreting the findings.
paras.zh: 值得记住的是，这些类器官并不是我们大脑的精确复制品，研究人员在其中设计的基因变化与极少数人类阿尔茨海默病病例有关。在解释研究结果时必须考虑这些因素。

paras.en: However, now that these experiments have concluded with encouraging results, more complex organoids can be tested on the ISS, using a system that automatically refreshes their growth medium.
paras.zh: 然而，现在这些实验已经取得了令人鼓舞的结果，可以使用自动刷新生长培养基的系统在国际空间站上测试更复杂的类器官。

paras.en: One potential next step is to add immune cells called microglia, to provide a more realistic simulation of Alzheimer's and its progression.
paras.zh: 下一步可能是添加称为小胶质细胞的免疫细胞，以提供对阿尔茨海默病及其进展的更真实的模拟。

paras.en: It's looking more probable than ever that the brain changes we see in astronauts might be beneficial to health research.
paras.zh: 我们在宇航员身上看到的大脑变化比以往任何时候都更有可能有益于健康研究。

paras.en: Figuring out how to keep humans protected on long-distance space missions could well overlap with research to treat the most stubborn diseases that we deal with here on Earth.
paras.zh: 弄清楚如何在长途太空任务中保护人类很可能与治疗我们在地球上面临的最顽固疾病的研究重叠。

paras.en: "[Further studies] will include mature neuroimmune assembloids and cortical organoids infused with microglia, thereby enabling a more comprehensive investigation of maturation, inflammation, and aging processes across diverse brain cell types under spaceflight conditions," write the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“[进一步的研究]将包括注入小胶质细胞的成熟神经免疫组合体和皮质类器官，从而能够对太空飞行条件下不同脑细胞类型的成熟、炎症和衰老过程进行更全面的研究。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Science Advances.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《科学进展》上。

articles.title: Ancient Killer Is Rapidly Gaining Resistance to Antibiotics, Warns Study
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: An ancient killer has plagued humans for millennia.
paras.zh: 一个古老的杀手已经困扰人类数千年。

paras.en: Although it's rarely considered a threat in developed countries today, it seems this long-term villain is still very much a danger in our modern world.
paras.zh: 尽管当今的发达国家很少将其视为威胁，但这种长期的恶棍似乎在我们的现代世界中仍然是一个很大的危险。

paras.en: Research published in 2022 revealed the bacterium that causes typhoid fever is evolving extensive drug resistance and is rapidly replacing strains that aren't resistant.
paras.zh: 2022 年发表的研究表明，引起伤寒的细菌正在进化出广泛的耐药性，并正在迅速取代不具有耐药性的菌株。

paras.en: Currently, antibiotics are the only effective treatment for typhoid, caused by the bacterium Salmonella enterica serovar Typhi (S. Typhi).
paras.zh: 目前，抗生素是治疗由伤寒沙门氏菌引起的伤寒的唯一有效方法。

paras.en: Yet over the past three decades, the bacterium's resistance to oral antibiotics has been growing and spreading.
paras.zh: 然而在过去的三十年里，细菌对口服抗生素的耐药性一直在增长和蔓延。

paras.en: In their study, scientists from multiple countries sequenced the genomes of 3,489 S. Typhi strains contracted from 2014 to 2019 in Nepal, Bangladesh, Pakistan, and India, and found a rise in extensively drug-resistant (XDR) Typhi.
paras.zh: 在他们的研究中，来自多个国家的科学家对 2014 年至 2019 年在尼泊尔、孟加拉国、巴基斯坦和印度感染的 3,489 株伤寒沙门氏菌进行了基因组测序，发现广泛耐药 (XDR) 伤寒沙门氏菌有所增加。

paras.en: Watch the video below for a summary of the study:
paras.zh: 观看下面的视频以了解该研究的摘要：

paras.en: XDR Typhi is not only impervious to frontline antibiotics, like ampicillin, chloramphenicol, and trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole, but it is also growing resistant to newer antibiotics, like fluoroquinolones and third-generation cephalosporins.
paras.zh: XDR 伤寒不仅对氨苄西林、氯霉素和甲氧苄氨嘧啶/磺胺甲恶唑等一线抗生素不敏感，而且对氟喹诺酮类和第三代头孢菌素等新型抗生素也越来越产生耐药性。

paras.en: Even worse, these strains are spreading globally at a rapid rate.
paras.zh: 更糟糕的是，这些菌株正在全球快速传播。

paras.en: While most XDR Typhi cases stem from South Asia, researchers have identified nearly 200 instances of international spread since 1990.
paras.zh: 虽然大多数 XDR 伤寒病例源自南亚，但自 1990 年以来，研究人员已发现近 200 例国际传播病例。

paras.en: Most strains have been exported to Southeast Asia, as well as East and Southern Africa, but typhoid superbugs have also been found in the UK, the US, and Canada.
paras.zh: 大多数菌株已出口到东南亚以及东部和南部非洲，但在英国、美国和加拿大也发现了伤寒超级细菌。

paras.en: "The speed at which highly resistant strains of S. Typhi have emerged and spread in recent years is a real cause for concern, and highlights the need to urgently expand prevention measures, particularly in countries at greatest risk," said Stanford University infectious disease researcher Jason Andrews when the results were published.
paras.zh: 斯坦福大学传染病研究员贾森·安德鲁斯在研究结果发表时表示：“近年来，高度耐药的伤寒沙门氏菌菌株出现和传播的速度确实令人担忧，这凸显了紧急扩大预防措施的必要性，特别是在风险最大的国家。”

paras.en: Scientists have been warning about drug-resistant typhoid for years now. In 2016, the first XDR typhoid strain was identified in Pakistan. By 2019, it had become the dominant genotype in the nation.
paras.zh: 多年来，科学家们一直对耐药伤寒发出警告。 2016年，巴基斯坦发现了第一个XDR伤寒毒株。到2019年，它已成为全国的主导基因型。

paras.en: Historically, most drug-resistant typhoid strains have been treated with third-generation antimicrobials, such as quinolones, cephalosporins, and macrolides.
paras.zh: 历史上，大多数耐药伤寒菌株都用第三代抗菌药物治疗，例如喹诺酮类、头孢菌素和大环内酯类。

paras.en: But by the early 21st century, mutations that confer resistance to quinolones accounted for more than 85 percent of all cases in Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Nepal, and Singapore.
paras.zh: 但到了 21 世纪初，在孟加拉国、印度、巴基斯坦、尼泊尔和新加坡，导致喹诺酮类药物耐药的突变占所有病例的 85% 以上。

paras.en: At the same time, cephalosporin resistance was also taking over.
paras.zh: 与此同时，头孢菌素耐药性也开始出现。

paras.en: Today, only one oral antibiotic is left: the macrolide, azithromycin. And this medicine might not work for much longer.
paras.zh: 如今，只剩下一种口服抗生素：大环内酯类药物阿奇霉素。而且这种药的作用可能不会持续太久。

paras.en: The 2022 study found that mutations that confer resistance to azithromycin are now also spreading, "threatening the efficacy of all oral antimicrobials for typhoid treatment".
paras.zh: 2022 年的研究发现，对阿奇霉素产生耐药性的突变现在也在扩散，“威胁到所有口服抗菌药物治疗伤寒的功效”。

paras.en: While these mutations have not yet been adopted by XDR S Typhi, if they are, we are in serious trouble.
paras.zh: 虽然 XDR S Typhi 尚未采用这些突变，但如果是的话，我们就有严重的麻烦了。

paras.en: If untreated, up to 20 percent of typhoid cases can be fatal, and in 2024, there were over 13 million cases of typhoid reported.
paras.zh: 如果不及时治疗，高达 20% 的伤寒病例可能会致命，到 2024 年，报告的伤寒病例将超过 1300 万例。

paras.en: Future outbreaks can be prevented to some extent with typhoid conjugate vaccines, but if access to these shots is not expanded globally, the world could soon have another health crisis on its hands.
paras.zh: 伤寒结合疫苗可以在一定程度上预防未来的疫情爆发，但如果不在全球范围内扩大这些疫苗的使用范围，世界可能很快就会面临另一场健康危机。

paras.en: "The recent emergence of XDR and azithromycin-resistant S. Typhi creates greater urgency for rapidly expanding prevention measures, including use of typhoid conjugate vaccines in typhoid-endemic countries," the authors write.
paras.zh: 作者写道：“最近出现的 XDR 和耐阿奇霉素伤寒沙门氏菌使迅速扩大预防措施变得更加紧迫，包括在伤寒流行国家使用伤寒结合疫苗。”

paras.en: "Such measures are needed in countries where antimicrobial resistance prevalence among S. Typhi isolates is currently high, but given the propensity for international spread, should not be restricted to such settings."
paras.zh: “目前伤寒沙门氏菌耐药率较高的国家需要采取此类措施，但考虑到国际传播的倾向，不应仅限于此类环境。”

paras.en: South Asia might be the main hub for typhoid fever, accounting for 70 percent of all cases, but if COVID-19 taught us anything, it is that disease variants in our modern, globalized world are easily spread.
paras.zh: 南亚可能是伤寒的主要中心，占所有病例的 70%，但如果说 COVID-19 教会了我们什么的话，那就是现代全球化世界中的疾病变种很容易传播。

paras.en: To prevent that from happening, health experts argue nations must expand access to typhoid vaccines and invest in new antibiotic research.
paras.zh: 为了防止这种情况发生，卫生专家认为各国必须扩大伤寒疫苗的使用范围并投资于新的抗生素研究。

paras.en: A 2021 study in India, for instance, estimated that if children are vaccinated against typhoid in urban areas, it could prevent up to 36 percent of typhoid cases and deaths.
paras.zh: 例如，印度 2021 年的一项研究估计，如果城市地区的儿童接种伤寒疫苗，可以预防高达 36% 的伤寒病例和死亡。

paras.en: Pakistan is leading the way on this front. It was the first nation in the world to offer routine immunization for typhoid.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦在这方面处于领先地位。它是世界上第一个提供伤寒常规免疫接种的国家。

paras.en: A small number of countries have now followed suit or are "planning or considering introduction".
paras.zh: 少数国家现已效仿或正在“计划或考虑引入”。

paras.en: The World Health Organization has prequalified four typhoid conjugate vaccines as of April 2025, according to the CDC, which states, "these vaccines are being introduced into childhood immunization programs in typhoid-endemic countries."
paras.zh: 据美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 称，截至 2025 年 4 月，世界卫生组织已对四种伤寒结合疫苗进行了资格预审，“这些疫苗正在被引入伤寒流行国家的儿童免疫计划中。”

paras.en: Related: A Western-Style Diet May Make Salmonella More Dangerous, Study in Mice Suggests
paras.zh: 相关：小鼠研究表明，西式饮食可能会使沙门氏菌更加危险

paras.en: Antibiotic resistance is one of the world's leading causes of death, claiming the lives of more people than HIV/AIDS or malaria.
paras.zh: 抗生素耐药性是世界上最主要的死亡原因之一，夺去生命的人数比艾滋病毒/艾滋病或疟疾还要多。

paras.en: Where available, vaccines are among the best tools we have to prevent future catastrophes.
paras.zh: 如果有的话，疫苗是我们预防未来灾难的最佳工具之一。

paras.en: The study was published in The Lancet Microbe.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《柳叶刀微生物》上。

articles.title: A space telescope hunting for dark matter just discovered something unexpected

paras.en: A space telescope hunting for dark matter just discovered something unexpected
paras.zh: 寻找暗物质的太空望远镜刚刚发现了一些意想不到的东西

paras.en: ESAâs Euclid space telescope has discovered its first previously unknown comet, despite being designed to study distant galaxies and the mysteries of the dark Universe. The icy object is approximately 1.3 billion kilometers from Earth and follows an unusual orbit that takes thousands of years to complete.
paras.zh: 欧空局的欧几里得太空望远镜发现了第一颗以前未知的彗星，尽管它的设计目的是研究遥远的星系和黑暗宇宙的奥秘。这个冰冷的物体距离地球大约13亿公里，沿着一条不寻常的轨道运行，需要数千年的时间才能完成。

paras.en: The European Space Agency's (ESA) Euclid space telescope has made an unexpected discovery in our own solar system. Images captured between September 16 and 24, 2026, revealed a previously unknown comet, the first discovered by the mission.
paras.zh: 欧洲航天局 (ESA) 的欧几里得太空望远镜在我们的太阳系中取得了意想不到的发现。 2026 年 9 月 16 日至 24 日期间拍摄的图像揭示了一颗以前未知的彗星，这是该任务首次发现的彗星。

paras.en: The achievement is particularly remarkable given that Euclid was built to capture detailed images of distant galaxies rather than track rapidly moving objects such as comets. The speed with which researchers identified and confirmed the discovery demonstrates that Euclid can detect new comets while they are still relatively far from the Sun. This capability could eventually help identify a target for ESA's upcoming Comet Interceptor mission.
paras.zh: 鉴于欧几里得是为了捕捉遥远星系的详细图像而不是跟踪彗星等快速移动的物体而建造的，这一成就尤其引人注目。研究人员识别和确认这一发现的速度表明，欧几里得可以在新彗星距离太阳相对较远的时候探测到它们。这种能力最终可以帮助欧空局即将到来的彗星拦截器任务确定目标。

paras.en: Mikko Pöntinen, a PhD student at the University of Helsinki, made the discovery with the Solar System Objects Science Working Group of the Euclid Consortium. Pöntinen developed specialized software to detect and track small solar system objects appearing in the telescope's images.
paras.zh: 赫尔辛基大学的博士生 Mikko Pöntinen 与欧几里得联盟太阳系天体科学工作组一起发现了这一发现。 Pöntinen 开发了专门的软件来检测和跟踪望远镜图像中出现的小型太阳系物体。

paras.en: "I was excited to see my software flag a 'streak' smeared across several images -- the result of a fast-moving object. By predicting its position I could identify it in other images, in total finding it in five image sets. Further inspection revealed that it had a fuzzy cloud around it, indicative of an active object like a comet that is shedding dust and gas."
paras.zh: “我很高兴看到我的软件在几张图像上标记出一条‘条纹’，这是一个快速移动物体的结果。通过预测它的位置，我可以在其他图像中识别它，总共在五个图像集中找到它。进一步检查发现它周围有一个模糊的云，表明它是一个活跃的物体，比如正在散发灰尘和气体的彗星。”

paras.en: The object appeared in a region of the sky known as the 'Euclid Deep Field North'. Over several days, the telescope captured it in five separate fields of view, taking between two and four exposures of each field for a total of 16 exposures.
paras.zh: 该物体出现在天空中一个被称为“欧几里得深空北区”的区域。几天后，望远镜在五个不同的视场中捕捉到了它，每个视场进行了两到四次曝光，总共曝光了 16 次。

paras.en: After searching catalogs of known asteroids and comets without finding a match, Pöntinen submitted the observations to the International Astronomical Union's Minor Planet Center (MPC) as a potential new comet. The report enabled astronomers using telescopes on Earth to carry out additional observations. On October 8, the MPC officially confirmed the discovery. The comet has been designated C/2026 S1 (Euclid).
paras.zh: 在搜索已知小行星和彗星目录但未找到匹配项后，彭蒂宁将观测结果作为潜在的新彗星提交给国际天文学联合会小行星中心 (MPC)。该报告使天文学家能够使用地球上的望远镜进行额外的观测。 10月8日，货币政策委员会正式证实了这一发现。这颗彗星被指定为 C/2026 S1（欧几里德）。

paras.en: The newly discovered comet is approximately 1.3 billion kilometers (about 800 million miles) from Earth. That distance is comparable to the distance from the Sun to a point somewhere between the orbits of Jupiter and Saturn.
paras.zh: 这颗新发现的彗星距离地球约13亿公里（约8亿英里）。这个距离相当于从太阳到木星和土星轨道之间某个点的距离。

paras.en: However, the comet is traveling well outside the relatively flat plane in which the planets orbit the Sun. It is currently positioned almost directly above the Sun, following a sweeping path over the solar system that will take thousands of years to complete.
paras.zh: 然而，这颗彗星正在远离行星围绕太阳运行的相对平坦的平面之外运行。它目前几乎位于太阳正上方，沿着太阳系上空的一条完整路径需要数千年才能完成。

paras.en: The International Astronomical Union's Minor Planet Center (MPC) serves as the central international hub for observations of asteroids and comets. It gathers data from observers around the world to verify discoveries, determine orbital paths, and assign official designations. As additional observations become available, astronomers will be able to calculate the orbital period of C/2026 S1 (Euclid) more precisely.
paras.zh: 国际天文学联合会的小行星中心 (MPC) 是小行星和彗星观测的国际中心枢纽。它从世界各地的观察者那里收集数据，以验证发现、确定轨道路径并分配官方名称。随着更多观测的出现，天文学家将能够更精确地计算 C/2026 S1（欧几里得）的轨道周期。

paras.en: Although Euclid has spotted comets before, all of them had already been discovered. Several aspects of the telescope's design and observing strategy make finding previously unknown objects within our solar system especially difficult.
paras.zh: 尽管欧几里得以前发现过彗星，但所有彗星都已经被发现了。该望远镜的设计和观测策略的几个方面使得在太阳系内寻找以前未知的物体变得特别困难。

paras.en: Euclid intentionally avoids the region of the sky surrounding the plane of the solar system, where large numbers of asteroids and comets can be found. Dust concentrated in this region produces unwanted light that could interfere with the telescope's sensitive observations of the distant universe.
paras.zh: 欧几里得有意避开了太阳系平面周围的天空区域，那里可以发现大量的小行星和彗星。集中在该区域的尘埃会产生不需要的光，可能会干扰望远镜对遥远宇宙的敏感观测。

paras.en: The spacecraft also follows a 'step-and-stare' observing strategy, typically imaging each section of the sky only once. This means researchers cannot readily direct Euclid back toward a newly detected comet to gather more information about it.
paras.zh: 该航天器还遵循“步进凝视”观测策略，通常只对天空的每个部分进行一次成像。这意味着研究人员无法轻易地将欧几里得引导回新发现的彗星以收集有关它的更多信息。

paras.en: Identifying objects within our solar system is nevertheless an important part of Euclid's scientific work. Researchers must account for everything appearing in its images so that unrelated features, including comet trails and unwanted light, can be removed without compromising the accuracy of its galaxy measurements.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，识别太阳系内的物体仍然是欧几里得科学工作的重要组成部分。研究人员必须考虑其图像中出现的所有内容，以便可以在不影响星系测量准确性的情况下去除不相关的特征，包括彗星轨迹和不需要的光。

paras.en: "Very few comets are expected to be discovered by Euclid so it was a happy coincidence that the combination of the comet's orbit and Euclid's scanning over those days captured the object in multiple images," says Bruno Altieri, Euclid Archive Scientist, and part of the discovery team.
paras.zh: 欧几里得档案馆科学家、发现团队成员布鲁诺·阿尔蒂里 (Bruno Altieri) 表示：“预计欧几里得会发现的彗星很少，因此彗星的轨道和欧几里得当时的扫描相结合，在多张图像中捕捉到了该物体，这是一个令人高兴的巧合。”

paras.en: Euclid's unexpected discovery also provides valuable experience for scientists working on ESA's future Comet Interceptor mission. Although the newly identified comet is not an appropriate destination for the spacecraft, the successful detection and rapid notification process demonstrates how the two missions could work together to identify potential targets.
paras.zh: 欧几里得的意外发现也为从事欧空局未来彗星拦截器任务的科学家提供了宝贵的经验。尽管新发现的彗星不是航天器的合适目的地，但成功的探测和快速通知过程展示了两个任务如何共同努力识别潜在目标。

paras.en: "While this particular comet is not a suitable candidate for Comet Interceptor, the process of discovery and alert gives us a real test case for how our two mission teams will coordinate in the future. And we are of course happy to have discovered a previously unknown comet for the Solar System community to follow-up on," adds Valeria Pettorino, Euclid Project Scientist.
paras.zh: “虽然这颗特殊的彗星不是彗星拦截器的合适候选者，但发现和警报的过程为我们的两个任务团队未来如何协调提供了一个真实的测试案例。我们当然很高兴为太阳系社区发现了一颗以前未知的彗星以进行后续跟踪，”欧几里得项目科学家瓦莱里娅·佩托里诺补充道。

paras.en: Comets are ancient bodies composed of ice and dust that remain from the formation of our solar system approximately 4.6 billion years ago. Most originate in the distant Kuiper Belt and Oort Cloud, regions located beyond the orbits of the outer planets (interstellar comets come from other solar systems).
paras.zh: 彗星是由冰和尘埃组成的古老天体，是大约 46 亿年前太阳系形成时残留的。大多数起源于遥远的柯伊伯带和奥尔特云，这些区域位于外行星轨道之外（星际彗星来自其他太阳系）。

paras.en: As a comet approaches the Sun, increasing temperatures cause its ice to turn directly into gas. Escaping gas and dust form a glowing, fuzzy cloud known as a 'coma,' as well as an extended tail.
paras.zh: 当彗星接近太阳时，温度升高导致其冰直接变成气体。逸出的气体和尘埃形成一团发光的、模糊的云，称为“彗发”，以及一条延伸的尾巴。

paras.en: Because comets native to our solar system have remained relatively unchanged since their formation, they preserve valuable evidence of the materials and environmental conditions that existed when the planets were taking shape. Studying these ancient objects may also help scientists understand the origins of Earth's water and the chemical building blocks of life.
paras.zh: 由于太阳系本土彗星自形成以来相对保持不变，因此它们保留了行星形成时存在的物质和环境条件的宝贵证据。研究这些古代物体还可以帮助科学家了解地球水的起源和生命的化学组成部分。

paras.en: Euclid's Hunt for Dark Matter and Dark Energy
paras.zh: 欧几里得寻找暗物质和暗能量

paras.en: The primary goal of the Euclid mission is to uncover how dark matter and dark energy influence the visible universe. During its six-year survey, the space telescope will examine the shapes and movements of billions of galaxies at distances reaching up to 10 billion light-years.
paras.zh: 欧几里得任务的主要目标是揭示暗物质和暗能量如何影响可见宇宙。在为期六年的调查中，这架太空望远镜将在距离达 100 亿光年的地方检查数十亿个星系的形状和运动。

paras.en: The comet discovery was reported on behalf of the Solar System Objects Science Working Group of the Euclid Consortium by M. Pöntinen, A. A. Nucita, A. Franco, M. Granvik, B. Altieri, S. Kruk, B. Y. Irureta-Goyena and B. Carry.
paras.zh: M. Pöntinen、A. A. Nucita、A. Franco、M. Granvik、B. Altieri、S. Kruk、B. Y. Irureta-Goyena 和 B. Carry 代表欧几里得联盟太阳系天体科学工作组报告了彗星的发现。

paras.en: Materials provided by European Space Agency. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由欧洲航天局提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Peppermint oil significantly lowers blood pressure in just 20 days

paras.en: Peppermint oil significantly lowers blood pressure in just 20 days
paras.zh: 薄荷油在短短 20 天内显着降低血压

paras.en: Peppermint oil may have a surprisingly powerful effect on blood pressure. In a randomized study of 40 adults, researchers found that taking small doses twice daily for 20 days lowered systolic blood pressure by an average of 8.5 mmHg. Those receiving a placebo experienced no significant improvement. The discovery points to a promising, low-cost natural approach to managing mildly elevated blood pressure.
paras.zh: 薄荷油可能对血压有惊人的强大作用。在一项针对 40 名成年人的随机研究中，研究人员发现，连续 20 天每天服用两次小剂量药物可使收缩压平均降低 8.5 mmHg。那些接受安慰剂的人没有出现明显的改善。这一发现指出了一种有前景、低成本的自然方法来控制轻度高血压。

paras.en: Peppermint oil, best known for its refreshing flavor and soothing effects on digestion, may also offer a surprising benefit for people with mildly elevated blood pressure.
paras.zh: 薄荷油以其清爽的味道和舒缓消化的作用而闻名，它也可能为血压轻度升高的人带来令人惊讶的好处。

paras.en: Researchers at the University of Lancashire found that consuming a small amount of peppermint oil each day for just 20 days significantly reduced systolic blood pressure (the top number in a blood pressure reading). Participants who received peppermint oil had systolic readings that were an average of 8.5 mmHg lower than those who received a placebo after accounting for their starting blood pressure.
paras.zh: 兰开夏大学的研究人员发现，每天摄入少量薄荷油，连续 20 天即可显着降低收缩压（血压读数中最高的数字）。考虑到起始血压后，服用薄荷油的参与者的收缩压读数平均比服用安慰剂的参与者低 8.5 mmHg。

paras.en: The findings, published in the journal PLOS One, suggest that peppermint oil could provide a simple, inexpensive, and well-tolerated way to help manage mildly elevated blood pressure.
paras.zh: 发表在《PLOS One》杂志上的研究结果表明，薄荷油可以提供一种简单、廉价且耐受性良好的方法来帮助控制轻度升高的血压。

paras.en: Lead author Dr. Jonnie Sinclair, Reader in Sport and Health Sciences, said: "High blood pressure is one of the biggest causes of heart disease and death worldwide, and it costs a huge amount of money to treat. Although medicines are commonly used to treat it, it's not always clear how well they work in the long-term, and they can cause unwanted side effects."
paras.zh: 主要作者、运动与健康科学读者乔尼·辛克莱博士说：“高血压是全世界心脏病和死亡的最大原因之一，治疗它需要花费大量资金。虽然药物通常用于治疗它，但它们的长期效果并不总是清楚，而且它们可能会引起不必要的副作用。”

paras.en: How Peppermint Oil May Lower Blood Pressure
paras.zh: 薄荷油如何降低血压

paras.en: Peppermint naturally contains several biologically active compounds, including menthol, which gives the plant its distinctive cooling sensation, and flavonoids, a group of plant compounds known for their antioxidant properties.
paras.zh: 薄荷天然含有多种生物活性化合物，包括薄荷醇（赋予植物独特的清凉感）和类黄酮（一组以其抗氧化特性而闻名的植物化合物）。

paras.en: Peppermint also has anti-inflammatory and vasodilatory properties, meaning it may help blood vessels relax and widen. When blood vessels widen, blood can flow more easily, potentially reducing the pressure exerted against artery walls. These properties may help explain peppermint oil's effects on blood pressure, although the precise mechanisms require further investigation.
paras.zh: 薄荷还具有抗炎和血管舒张特性，这意味着它可以帮助血管放松和扩张。当血管扩张时，血液可以更容易流动，从而可能减少对动脉壁施加的压力。这些特性可能有助于解释薄荷油对血压的影响，尽管确切的机制需要进一步研究。

paras.en: To examine these potential benefits, researchers recruited 40 adults between the ages of 18 and 65 with elevated blood pressure or stage 1 hypertension, an early stage of high blood pressure. Participants were randomly assigned to one of two groups.
paras.zh: 为了检验这些潜在的益处，研究人员招募了 40 名年龄在 18 岁至 65 岁之间、患有高血压或 1 期高血压（高血压的早期阶段）的成年人。参与者被随机分配到两组中的一组。

paras.en: One group consumed a total of 100 microliters of food-grade peppermint oil each day, equivalent to one-tenth of a milliliter, divided into two doses diluted in water. The other group received a peppermint-flavored placebo that contained none of the active peppermint oil compounds.
paras.zh: 一组每天总共消耗 100 微升食品级薄荷油，相当于十分之一毫升，分成两份用水稀释。另一组接受薄荷味安慰剂，不含任何活性薄荷油化合物。

paras.en: Significant Blood Pressure Improvements in Just 20 Days
paras.zh: 短短 20 天内血压显着改善

paras.en: After 20 days, average systolic blood pressure among participants taking peppermint oil fell from approximately 130 to 122 mmHg. Meanwhile, blood pressure remained virtually unchanged in the placebo group.
paras.zh: 20 天后，服用薄荷油的参与者的平均收缩压从大约 130 毫米汞柱下降到 122 毫米汞柱。与此同时，安慰剂组的血压几乎保持不变。

paras.en: Systolic blood pressure measures the force of blood against artery walls when the heart contracts. Persistently elevated readings can damage blood vessels over time and increase the risk of serious health problems, including heart attacks, strokes, and heart failure.
