articles.title: Porsche TPMS: The First Carmaker To The Game
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Porsche was the first manufacturer to use a tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) on a vehicle in 1986 for the 959 supercar. The 959 was another first because it was equipped with world’s first self-supporting run-flat tires made by Bridgestone. This TPMS setup was again used on the 928 for model years 1990 to 1994.
paras.zh: 保时捷于 1986 年在 959 超级跑车上成为第一家在车辆上使用轮胎压力监测系统 (TPMS) 的制造商。 959 是另一个第一，因为它配备了世界上第一款由普利司通制造的自支撑防爆轮胎。该 TPMS 设置再次在 1990 至 1994 年车型的 928 上使用。

paras.en: The 959 did not have a spare tire as standard equipment. Instead, the dealership would dispatch a technician with a spare if a customer had a flat or loss of inflation. The run-flat tires could be driven for a limited distance at 50mph. The wheels used a system that locked a compatible tire into a channel that locked the bead to the wheel. This was called the Denloc system and prevented the tire from coming off the rim and suddenly deflating in the event of a puncture. The rims also used an innovative hollow-spoke system.
paras.zh: 959 没有标配备胎。相反，如果客户出现故障或通货膨胀损失，经销商会派遣一名技术人员携带备件。防爆轮胎可以以 50 英里每小时的速度行驶有限的距离。车轮使用了一个系统，将兼容的轮胎锁定到一个通道中，将胎圈锁定到车轮上。这被称为 Denloc 系统，可防止轮胎在发生刺穿时脱离轮辋并突然泄气。轮圈还采用了创新的空心辐条系统。

paras.en: The early system used tire pressure sensors mounted in special holes in the valley of the wheel. This early tire pressure monitoring system was known as RDK, or Reifen Druck Kontrolle, which roughly translates to Tire Pressure Control.
paras.zh: 早期的系统使用安装在车轮谷底的特殊孔中的轮胎压力传感器。这种早期的轮胎压力监测系统被称为 RDK，或 Reifen Druck Kontrolle，大致翻译为“轮胎压力控制”。

paras.en: The sensors looked like a stack of poker chips. A diaphragm inside the sensors connected to switches that were set to a reference pressure. The receiver was mounted on the knuckle and was an inductive coil that would pass current through the sensors wirelessly. Depending on the position of the diaphragm and which switches were open or closed, the amount of current flowing through the receiver’s coils, would change the voltage.
paras.zh: 传感器看起来就像一堆扑克筹码。传感器内部的隔膜连接到设置为参考压力的开关。接收器安装在指关节上，是一个感应线圈，可以无线方式通过传感器传递电流。根据隔膜的位置以及打开或关闭的开关，流过接收器线圈的电流量会改变电压。

paras.en: In 2004, Porsche started to use a conventional TPMS system for the Cayenne and select Boxster and 911 models. These systems were a lot like those found on BMW, Mercedes-Benz and Audi vehicles.
paras.zh: 2004 年，保时捷开始在 Cayenne 以及部分 Boxster 和 911 车型上使用传统的 TPMS 系统。这些系统与宝马、梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪汽车上的系统非常相似。

paras.en: Porsche TPMS systems use four antennas mounted in the wheel wells and a designated module for the tire pressure. The sensors use a 433mHz frequency. On most models, the menu will have the option for two sets of tires and sensor IDs for summer and winter tires.
paras.zh: 保时捷 TPMS 系统使用安装在轮舱中的四个天线和一个指定的轮胎压力模块。传感器使用 433mHz 频率。在大多数车型上，菜单将提供两组轮胎以及夏季和冬季轮胎的传感器 ID 的选项。

paras.en: The system has a telltale malfunction indicator light and a low-pressure light. When the system detects a malfunction, the telltale light will flash for approximately one minute, and then will remain continuously illuminated. This sequence will continue upon subsequent vehicle startups, as long as the malfunction exists.
paras.zh: 该系统有一个指示故障的指示灯和一个低压灯。当系统检测到故障时，警示灯将闪烁大约一分钟，然后持续亮起。只要故障存在，后续车辆启动时就会继续执行此序列。

paras.en: If a sensor is not transmitting, the warning light in the speedometer flashes for one minute, and then remains continuously illuminated. Codes and data from the TPMS control module can be accessed with a scan tool. If there is a problem, it is typically communication errors with the four receivers in the wheel wells.
paras.zh: 如果传感器未进行传输，车速表中的警告灯会闪烁一分钟，然后持续亮起。可以使用扫描工具访问 TPMS 控制模块的代码和数据。如果出现问题，通常是轮舱中四个接收器的通信错误。

paras.en: It is also important to remember that the TPMS module starts hunting for sensor signals the second the ignition is turned on. Leaving the ignition in the “on” position when a wheel is removed may cause the information display to say, “Wheel change? Input new TPM settings.” Also, if the second set of wheels is in the vicinity of the vehicle, the same warning could be set.
paras.zh: 同样重要的是要记住，TPMS 模块在点火开关打开的那一刻就开始寻找传感器信号。拆下车轮后，将点火装置保持在“打开”位置可能会导致信息显示屏显示“更换车轮？输入新的 TPM 设置”。此外，如果第二组车轮位于车辆附近，则可以设置相同的警告。

paras.en: Before starting any relearn process, set the tire to the pressure specified in the doorjamb for the cold temperature. The relearn process starts with turning the ignition on, accessing the vehicle’s computer and entering into the tire pressure control menu. On most models, you will need to select the winter or summer set of tires. The system will then start to learn the sensor IDs and positions.
paras.zh: 在开始任何重新学习过程之前，将轮胎设置为门框上指定的低温压力。重新学习过程从打开点火开关、访问车辆计算机并进入轮胎压力控制菜单开始。在大多数车型上，您需要选择冬季或夏季轮胎。然后系统将开始学习传感器 ID 和位置。

paras.en: The onboard computer displays the message “TPM is learning.” The process may take 2 to 10 minutes, and the vehicle speed needs to be above 15-16 mph. During this time, the current tire pressures are not available on the display. The tire pressure warning light will remain lit until all wheels have been learned.
paras.zh: 车载计算机显示消息“TPM 正在学习”。该过程可能需要 2 到 10 分钟，车速需要高于 15-16 英里/小时。在此期间，显示屏上不会显示当前轮胎压力。轮胎压力警告灯将一直亮起，直到所有车轮都被学习为止。

paras.en: Position and pressure information will be displayed as soon as the TPMS system has assigned the wheels identified as belonging to the vehicle and to the correct wheel positions.
paras.zh: 一旦 TPMS 系统将识别为属于车辆的车轮分配到正确的车轮位置，就会显示位置和压力​​信息。

articles.title: AutoZone’s Phil Daniele on ‘Putting Customers First’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Phil Daniele, president and CEO of customer satisfaction at AutoZone.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 AutoZone 客户满意度总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Daniele。

paras.en: Daniele said the company’s commercial business has evolved significantly as it continues investing in the professional repair market. With commercial sales approaching $6 billion and programs in approximately 95% of its stores, AutoZone is strengthening its product quality, availability and delivery capabilities to better serve repair shops. Daniele emphasized the importance of OE-quality or better products, including its Duralast portfolio, alongside expanded assortments through its hub and mega hub strategy. Investments in technology, inventory optimization and a dedicated professional sales force are helping AutoZone get the right parts to shops faster while building stronger customer relationships.
paras.zh: Daniele 表示，随着公司继续投资专业维修市场，其商业业务已取得显着发展。 With commercial sales approaching $6 billion and programs in approximately 95% of its stores, AutoZone is strengthening its product quality, availability and delivery capabilities to better serve repair shops. Daniele emphasized the importance of OE-quality or better products, including its Duralast portfolio, alongside expanded assortments through its hub and mega hub strategy. Investments in technology, inventory optimization and a dedicated professional sales force are helping AutoZone get the right parts to shops faster while building stronger customer relationships.

paras.en: AutoZone’s recent milestone of 8,000 stores globally reflects decades of expansion and continued growth opportunities, Daniele explained. The company also celebrated its 1,000th store in Mexico, expanded distribution capabilities there and broke ground on another facility. Looking ahead, AutoZone plans to continue opening stores across the United States, Mexico and Brazil. Daniele said that expansion creates opportunities not only to serve more customers but also to develop future leaders within the organization. AutoZone’s promote-from-within culture has helped employees build long-term careers, with many executives beginning their careers in stores.
paras.zh: Daniele 解释说，AutoZone 最近在全球拥有 8,000 家门店的里程碑反映了数十年的扩张和持续增长机会。该公司还庆祝其在墨西哥开设第 1,000 家商店，扩大了当地的分销能力，并在另一家工厂破土动工。展望未来，AutoZone 计划继续在美国、墨西哥和巴西开设门店。 Daniele 表示，扩张不仅创造了服务更多客户的机会，而且还为组织内培养未来的领导者创造了机会。 AutoZone 的内部晋升文化帮助员工建立了长期的职业生涯，许多高管都是在商店开始他们的职业生涯的。

paras.en: Delivering strong customer service remains central to AutoZone’s culture and operating philosophy. Daniele said empowering approximately 130,000 AutoZoners to consistently exceed customer expectations requires strong systems, processes and accountability. That means delivering quality parts quickly, ensuring accurate transactions and understanding each customer’s specific needs. Daniele emphasized that every interaction, from sales representatives to delivery drivers, contributes to the customer experience. By combining operational execution with a customer-first mindset, AutoZone aims to strengthen relationships and deliver the level of service that keeps customers coming back.
paras.zh: 提供强大的客户服务仍然是 AutoZone 文化和运营理念的核心。 Daniele 表示，要让大约 130,000 名 AutoZoners 持续超越客户期望，需要强大的系统、流程和问责制。这意味着快速交付优质零件，确保准确的交易并了解每个客户的具体需求。 Daniele 强调，从销售代表到送货司机的每一次互动都有助于提升客户体验。通过将运营执行与客户至上的理念相结合，AutoZone 旨在加强关系并提供高水平的服务，让客户成为回头客。

paras.en: To hear more of Daniele’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.
paras.zh: 要了解 Daniele 的更多见解，请务必观看上面的视频。

paras.en: - How AutoZone is investing in product quality, inventory availability and delivery capabilities to better serve professional repair shops. (8:34)
paras.zh: - AutoZone 如何投资于产品质量、库存可用性和交付能力，以更好地为专业维修店提供服务。 （8:34）

paras.en: - How AutoZone’s hub and mega hub strategy and professional sales force support its growing commercial business. (11:07)
paras.zh: - AutoZone 的枢纽和大型枢纽战略以及专业销售队伍如何支持其不断增长的商业业务。 (11:07)

paras.en: - What AutoZone’s 8,000-store milestone represents for future expansion and employee career opportunities. (15:21)
paras.zh: - AutoZone 的 8,000 家门店里程碑对未来的扩张和员工职业机会意味着什么。 （15:21）

paras.en: - How AutoZone empowers 130,000 AutoZoners to consistently deliver WOW customer service. (21:34)
paras.zh: - AutoZone 如何帮助 130,000 名 AutoZoner 持续提供令人惊叹的客户服务。 (21:34)

paras.en: - Why AutoZone sees significant growth opportunities in the professional repair market. (30:10)
paras.zh: - 为什么 AutoZone 在专业维修市场看到了巨大的增长机会。 （30:10）

paras.zh: - 闪电轮：Daniele 分享了一些个人见解。 (32:03)

articles.title: The AAM Group Celebrates 20 Years of Total Truck Centers
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The AAM Group is celebrating the 20th anniversary of Total Truck Centers, its flagship marketing program for independent truck accessory retailers and installers. Looking back on the past two decades, The AAM Group said the need for greater support in the truck accessories aftermarket led to the creation of Total Truck Centers. Distributing large, difficult-to-ship products presented unique challenges. In 2005, four distributors—Weller’s Auto Supply, North Central Truck, Nelson Truck and Titan Equipment—joined The AAM Group. Their participation laid the foundation for a dedicated truck accessories program.
paras.zh: AAM 集团正在庆祝 Total Truck Centers 成立 20 周年，这是其针对独立卡车配件零售商和安装商的旗舰营销计划。回顾过去二十年，AAM 集团表示，卡车配件售后市场需要更大的支持，因此创建了全卡车中心。配送大型、难以运输的产品带来了独特的挑战。 2005 年，四家经销商（Weller’s Auto Supply、North Central Truck、Nelson Truck 和 Titan Equipment）加入了 AAM 集团。他们的参与为专门的卡车配件计划奠定了基础。

paras.en: Total Truck Centers officially launched in 2006 with a clear purpose: helping independent truck accessory retailers compete and grow.
paras.zh: Total Truck Centers 于 2006 年正式推出，其目标明确：帮助独立卡车配件零售商竞争和发展。

paras.en: As the truck accessories aftermarket has evolved, so have the challenges facing independent retailers. Jobbers often lack the time, staff and resources to manage their own marketing. Recognizing these challenges, The AAM Group developed four core tools to help level the playing field.
paras.zh: 随着卡车配件售后市场的发展，独立零售商面临的挑战也随之而来。兼职者往往缺乏时间、人员和资源来管理自己的营销。认识到这些挑战，AAM Group 开发了四个核心工具来帮助创造公平的竞争环境。

paras.en: Aftermarket Websites® helps retailers establish an online presence and connect with customers searching for products. ReadyPosts provides free social media content and automation to help shops stay visible without adding to their workload.
paras.zh: Aftermarket Websites® 帮助零售商建立在线形象并与搜索产品的客户建立联系。 ReadyPosts 提供免费的社交媒体内容和自动化，帮助商店保持可见性，而不增加他们的工作量。

paras.en: N-Store TV brings supplier product education into showrooms, streaming more than 3 million minutes of content each month. Meanwhile, PRO Rebates has returned thousands of dollars to participating jobbers.
paras.zh: N-Store TV 将供应商产品教育带入展厅，每月播放超过 300 万分钟的内容。与此同时，PRO Rebates 已向参与活动的工作人员返还了数千美元。

paras.en: “We started Total Truck Centers because we recognized a need to better support independent truck accessory retailers,” said Tim Oddom, president of The AAM Group. “Twenty years later, the tools have changed, but our purpose hasn’t. Everything we do comes back to helping our jobbers sell more products and grow their businesses.”
paras.zh: “我们创办 Total Truck Centers 是因为我们认识到需要更好地支持独立卡车配件零售商，”AAM 集团总裁 Tim Oddom 说道。 “二十年后，工具发生了变化，但我们的目的没有改变。我们所做的一切都是为了帮助我们的批发商销售更多产品并发展他们的业务。”

paras.en: As Total Truck Centers enters its next chapter, The AAM Group said it continues listening to its members and jobbers. The organization aims to understand their challenges and develop resources that meet their changing needs.
paras.zh: 随着 Total Truck Centers 进入新篇章，AAM 集团表示将继续倾听其会员和经销商的意见。该组织旨在了解他们的挑战并开发资源来满足他们不断变化的需求。

paras.en: “The past 20 years have been about listening to our members and jobbers and responding to their needs,” said Andy Stacy, marketing director. “That same commitment will guide us for the next 20 years. As the industry changes, we’ll continue finding ways to help independent retailers succeed.”
paras.zh: “过去 20 年我们一直在倾听我们的会员和从业者的意见并满足他们的需求，”营销总监安迪·史黛西 (Andy Stacy) 说道。 “同样的承诺将指导我们未来 20 年。随着行业的变化，我们将继续寻找帮助独立零售商取得成功的方法。”

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens New Store in Glen Allen
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its newest store in Glen Allen, Virgina, on November 19, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 10318 Washington Hwy. with a ribbon-cutting ceremony alongside local officials and representatives from Reynolds Community College who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 于 11 月 19 日在弗吉尼亚州格伦艾伦开设了最新的商店，为当地驾驶员和汽车专业人士提供更多零件、工具和专业知识。该公司在华盛顿高速公路 10318 号开设了这家商店。当地官员和雷诺兹社区学院的代表在现场接受了学校汽车技术项目的捐款，并举行了剪彩仪式。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training, and career opportunities through the school’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 此次捐赠将帮助学生通过学校的汽车技术项目获得实践经验、培训和职业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，熟练的汽车技术人员的需求量仍然很高，预计到 2034 年，每年大约有 70,000 个职位空缺。

paras.en: “We’re excited to continue growing with our second location in Glen Allen,” said Mike Fogarty, Regional Vice President, Advance Auto Parts. “This store will help us better serve the community by making it easier for customers to get the right parts and products they rely on. As we celebrate this opening, we’re also proud to team up with Reynolds Community College and support programs that help prepare students for careers in the automotive industry.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 区域副总裁 Mike Fogarty 表示：“我们很高兴能够在 Glen Allen 开设第二个工厂，继续发展。” “这家商店将帮助我们更好地服务社区，让客户更容易获得他们所依赖的正确零件和产品。在我们庆祝开业之际，我们也很自豪能够与雷诺社区学院合作并支持项目，帮助学生为汽车行业的职业生涯做好准备。”

paras.en: “We appreciate Advance Auto Parts’ support of our Automotive Technology students and program,” said Kendra Brinkley, Ph.D., dean of the School of STEM & Trades. “Gifts like this help us provide students with opportunities to apply what they learn in the classroom, gain valuable hands-on experience, and develop the skills they need to prepare for successful careers in the automotive industry.”
paras.zh: “我们感谢 Advance Auto Parts 对我们汽车技术学生和项目的支持，”STEM 与贸易学院院长 Kendra Brinkley 博士说。 “这样的礼物帮助我们为学生提供机会应用他们在课堂上学到的知识，获得宝贵的实践经验，并培养他们为在汽车行业取得成功职业生涯做好准备所需的技能。”

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens New Store in Ocala
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its newest store in Ocala today, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 3770 SE Maricamp Rd. with a ribbon-cutting ceremony alongside local officials and representatives from Marion Technical College who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 今天在奥卡拉开设了最新的商店，为当地驾驶员和汽车专业人士提供更多零件、工具和专业知识。该公司标志着位于 3770 SE Maricamp Rd. 的商店开业。与当地官员和马里恩技术学院的代表一起举行了剪彩仪式，他们在现场接受了学校汽车技术项目的捐款。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training, and career opportunities through the school’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 此次捐赠将帮助学生通过学校的汽车技术项目获得实践经验、培训和职业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，熟练的汽车技术人员的需求量仍然很高，预计到 2034 年，每年大约有 70,000 个职位空缺。

paras.en: “We’re excited to open our new store in Ocala and continue growing our presence in the community,” said Mark Ortiz, regional vice president, Advance Auto Parts. “Whether serving drivers or professional technicians, our goal is to help customers get the parts and support they need to keep vehicles on the road. We’re also proud to support Marion Technical College and recognize the important role its programs play in preparing the next generation of skilled professionals.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 区域副总裁 Mark Ortiz 表示：“我们很高兴在奥卡拉开设新店，并继续扩大我们在社区的影响力。” “无论是为驾驶员还是专业技术人员提供服务，我们的目标都是帮助客户获得让车辆继续行驶所需的零件和支持。我们也很自豪能够支持马里恩技术学院，并认识到其项目在培养下一代熟练专业人员方面发挥的重要作用。”

paras.en: “We’re grateful to Advance Auto Parts for supporting the students enrolled in Marion Technical College’s automotive technology program,” said Meghan Magamoll, executive director of the Public Education Foundation of Marion County. “Partnerships like this help reinforce the connection between education and industry, giving students valuable encouragement as they prepare for careers in the automotive field.”
paras.zh: 马里恩县公共教育基金会执行董事 Meghan Magamoll 表示：“我们感谢 Advance Auto Parts 对马里恩技术学院汽车技术项目学生的支持。” “这样的合作伙伴关系有助于加强教育与行业之间的联系，为学生在汽车领域的职业生涯做准备提供宝贵的鼓励。”

articles.title: NexaMotion Group Names Inaugural Vendors of the Year
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: NexaMotion Group (NMG) named UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) and Precision International the recipients of its first annual Vendor of the Year award. The program honors supplier partners whose commitment to NMG’s customers, team and strategy extends well beyond the purchase order.
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group (NMG) 将 UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) 和 Precision International 授予其首个年度供应商奖。该计划旨在表彰对 NMG 客户、团队和战略的承诺远远超出采购订单范围的供应商合作伙伴。

paras.en: For 50 years, from the founding of Transtar to the formation of NexaMotion Group, that kind of supplier partnership has been a cornerstone of how the company competes. Honorees were selected by NMG’s executive and supply chain leadership on availability, quality and responsiveness, and on a harder test: how far the supplier was willing to go in service of NMG’s strategy and its customers’ success.
paras.zh: 50 年来，从 Transtar 的成立到 NexaMotion 集团的成立，这种供应商合作伙伴关系一直是公司竞争的基石。获奖者是由 NMG 的高管和供应链领导层根据可用性、质量和响应能力以及更严格的测试选出的：供应商愿意在多大程度上为 NMG 的战略和客户的成功提供服务。

paras.en: “Anyone can fill an order. Our best partners help us build the business,” said Scott Weinstein, President of NexaMotion Group. “UAC and Precision International show up in the planning room, not just on the loading dock. They bring us coverage before our customers ask for it, they invest in our people and our shops, and when we make bold moves as a company they are right beside us. That is partnership, and it is what this award was created to honor.”
paras.zh: “任何人都可以填写订单。我们最好的合作伙伴帮助我们发展业务，”NexaMotion 集团总裁 Scott Weinstein 说道。 “UAC 和 Precision International 出现在规划室，而不仅仅是装货码头。他们在客户提出要求之前就为我们提供报道，他们对我们的员工和商店进行投资，当我们作为一家公司采取大胆行动时，他们就在我们身边。这就是合作伙伴关系，这也是这个奖项的设立的目的。”

paras.en: Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Mansfield, Texas, UAC designs and supplies automotive air conditioning components, from compressors and condensers to evaporators, driers, hose assemblies and electrical parts, backed by a factory audit process and an in-house validation team. NMG recently selected UAC as the lead air conditioning supplier for its general repair business, a decision shaped as much by UAC’s willingness to plan, train and invest alongside NMG’s teams as by the quality of its catalog. UAC is led by Francisco Coll, CEO, and Sophia Coll Crowley, CEO, with Luke Masters, Vice President of Business Development.
paras.zh: UAC 成立于 1988 年，总部位于德克萨斯州曼斯菲尔德，设计和供应汽车空调组件，从压缩机和冷凝器到蒸发器、干燥器、软管组件和电气零件，并有工厂审核流程和内部验证团队的支持。 NMG 最近选择 UAC 作为其一般维修业务的主要空调供应商，这一决定不仅取决于 UAC 与 NMG 团队一起计划、培训和投资的意愿，还取决于其产品目录的质量。 UAC 由首席执行官 Francisco Coll 和首席执行官 Sophia Coll Crowley 以及业务开发副总裁 Luke Masters 领导。

paras.en: Founded in 1975 by Dennis Marshall and based in Yaphank, New York, Precision International supplies more than 3,000 transmission kits and nearly 10,000 parts and components to rebuilders worldwide. The company is ISO 9001 certified and a five-time consecutive General Motors Supplier of the Year. Precision International is led by Tina Parente, President, with Frank Miller, Executive Vice President, and John Sollazzo, Vice President of Sales and Marketing.
paras.zh: Precision International 由丹尼斯·马歇尔 (Dennis Marshall) 于 1975 年创立，总部位于纽约州雅芬克 (Yaphank)，为全球重建商提供 3,000 多种变速箱套件和近 10,000 个零部件。该公司已通过 ISO 9001 认证，并连续五次荣获通用汽车年度供应商称号。 Precision International 由总裁 Tina Parente、执行副总裁 Frank Miller 以及销售和营销副总裁 John Sollazzo 领导。

paras.en: “Both companies share forecasts with us, solve problems before they reach a customer, and measure their success by whether our shops win the job,” said Tim Cox, EVP of Supply Chain, NexaMotion Group. “That is when a supplier relationship stops being a transaction and becomes a competitive advantage for everyone it touches.”
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group 供应链执行副总裁 Tim Cox 表示：“两家公司都与我们分享预测，在问题到达客户之前解决问题，并通过我们的商店是否赢得这份工作来衡量他们的成功。” “那时供应商关系不再是一种交易，而是成为它所接触的每个人的竞争优势。”

paras.en: NMG said it will present the Vendor of the Year award annually. UAC and Precision International products are available through NMG’s business brands and sales representatives.
paras.zh: NMG 表示将每年颁发年度供应商奖。 UAC 和 Precision International 产品可通过 NMG 的商业品牌和销售代表购买。

articles.title: Beaver Moon 2026: See a bright, full 'supermoon' rise tonight, and another on Christmas Eve
articles.author: Jamie Carter

paras.en: Editor's note: This article was updated on Tuesday (Nov. 24) to indicate that the full Beaver Moon rises tonight.
paras.zh: 编者注：本文于周二（11 月 24 日）更新，表明海狸满月将于今晚升起。

paras.en: November’s full moon, known as the "Beaver Moon," will rise in the east at dusk tonight (Nov. 24), marking the first of three consecutive supermoons.
paras.zh: 11 月的满月，被称为“海狸月”，将于今晚（11 月 24 日）黄昏从东方升起，这是连续三个超级月亮中的第一个。

paras.en: It will be the third and final full moon of fall in the Northern Hemisphere and the first in a series of unusually close full moons that includes December's spectacular Christmas supermoon — the closest full moon since 2018. These bright moons are just some of the many winter skywatching highlights headed our way in the coming months.
paras.zh: 这将是北半球秋季的第三次也是最后一次满月，也是一系列异常接近的满月中的第一个，其中包括 12 月壮观的圣诞超级月亮——2018 年以来最接近的满月。这些明亮的月亮只是未来几个月我们将看到的众多冬季天空观测亮点中的一部分。

paras.en: The Beaver Moon gets its name from the time of year when nocturnal beavers in North America traditionally build dams and prepare for winter under the full moon, according to TimeandDate. Other nicknames include the Frost Moon and Snow Moon, and the Anishinaabeg people in North America call it Baashkaakodin Giizis — the Freezing Moon — according to the Center for Native American Studies.
paras.zh: 据《TimeandDate》报道，“海狸月”得名于北美夜间活动的海狸传统上在满月下建造水坝并为过冬做准备的时间。根据美洲原住民研究中心的说法，其他昵称包括“霜月”和“雪月”，北美的阿尼什纳贝格人称其为“Baashkaakodin Giizis”——“冰冻月亮”。

paras.en: The moon will reach its full phase at 9:53 a.m. ET on Tuesday, when it will be below the horizon in North America. The best time to see the Beaver Moon is at moonrise that evening, as it rises in the east around the same time the sun sets in the west. That's when the moon will appear against a relatively bright twilight sky, making it easier to appreciate its size and color.
paras.zh: 月球将于美国东部时间周二上午 9 点 53 分达到满月，届时它将位于北美地平线以下。观赏海狸月的最佳时间是当晚的月出时，因为海狸月从东方升起的时间大约与太阳从西方落下的时间相同。那时月亮会出现在相对明亮的暮色天空中，从而更容易欣赏它的大小和颜色。

paras.en: The moon will appear full on Monday and Wednesday as well, but Tuesday offers the best opportunity to see it rise during twilight.
paras.zh: 周一和周三也会出现满月，但周二提供了在黄昏时看到月亮升起的最佳机会。

paras.en: The Beaver Moon will be the first of three consecutive supermoons, according to EarthSky. A supermoon occurs when a full moon coincides with the moon being relatively close to Earth in its elliptical orbit. The moon's distance from Earth changes throughout the month. On average, the moon is 238,900 miles (384,472 kilometers) from Earth. When a full moon occurs near perigee, or its closest point during its orbit, it appears slightly larger and brighter than usual. Here's what's coming up:
paras.zh: 据《地球天空》报道，海狸月将是连续三个超级月亮中的第一个。当满月与月球在椭圆轨道上距离地球相对较近时，就会出现超级月亮。月球与地球的距离在整个月都在变化。月球平均距地球 238,900 英里（384,472 公里）。当满月出现在近地点或其轨道上最近的点附近时，它看起来比平时稍大、更亮。以下是即将发生的事情：

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: - Full Beaver Supermoon on Nov. 24, 2026 (224,170 miles / 360,768 km)
- Full Cold Supermoon on Dec. 24, 2026 (221,667 miles / 356,740 km)
- Full Wolf Supermoon on Jan. 22, 2027 (222,229 miles / 357,644 km)

November's Beaver Supermoon is just the beginning: It's the smallest of the three upcoming supermoons. December's full Cold Moon will be the closest, biggest and brightest full moon of 2026, bringing the moon closer to Earth than at any time since Jan. 2, 2018, according to late astrophysicist Fred Espenak.
paras.zh: 十一月的海狸超级月亮只是一个开始：它是即将到来的三个超级月亮中最小的一个。已故天体物理学家 Fred Espenak 表示，12 月的冷月将是 2026 年最近、最大、最亮的满月，使月球比 2018 年 1 月 2 日以来的任何时候都更接近地球。

paras.en: How much do you know about the moon? Test your lunar smarts with our moon quiz!
paras.zh: 关于月球你了解多少？通过我们的月球测验测试您的月球智慧！

paras.en: Jamie Carter is a Cardiff, U.K.-based freelance science journalist and a regular contributor to Live Science. He is the author of A Stargazing Program For Beginners and co-author of The Eclipse Effect, and leads international stargazing and eclipse-chasing tours. His work appears regularly in Space.com, Forbes, New Scientist, BBC Sky at Night, Sky & Telescope, and other major science and astronomy publications. He is also the editor of WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com.
paras.zh: 杰米·卡特 (Jamie Carter) 是英国卡迪夫的一名自由科学记者，也是《Live Science》的定期撰稿人。他是《初学者观星计划》一书的作者，也是《日食效应》一书的合著者，并领导国际观星和日食追逐之旅。他的作品经常出现在 Space.com、福布斯、新科学家、BBC 夜间天空、天空与望远镜以及其他主要科学和天文学出版物上。他还是 WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com 的编辑。

articles.title: 2,900-year-old sanctuary discovered on Greek mountaintop may have been a destination for Artemis worship
articles.author: Tom Metcalfe

paras.en: The discovery of a 2,900-year-old mountaintop sanctuary on a Mediterranean island shows the ancient Greek veneration for high mountains and their link to the Greek gods, archaeologists say.
paras.zh: 考古学家表示，在地中海岛屿上发现一座拥有 2900 年历史的山顶保护区，体现了古希腊人对高山的崇拜及其与希腊诸神的联系。

paras.en: The sanctuary was found during new excavations on Euboea, a very large island only about 30 miles (50 kilometers) northeast of Athens. The sanctuary did not include any buildings, such as a temple. Archaeologists think it was used for offerings and feasting by worshippers for hundreds of years, from about the ninth century B.C. until the first or second century A.D., during Imperial Roman times.
paras.zh: 该保护区是在优卑亚岛 (Euboea) 的新发掘过程中发现的，优卑亚岛是一座非常大的岛屿，距雅典东北约 30 英里（50 公里）。圣所不包括任何建筑物，例如寺庙。考古学家认为，大约从公元前九世纪开始，数百年来，它一直被崇拜者用于祭祀和宴会。直到公元一世纪或二世纪，罗马帝国时期。

paras.en: "We know that in the ancient Greek world, religious life was not limited to large temples and urban sanctuaries," excavation leader Chloé Chezeaux, an archaeologist at the Swiss School of Archeology in Greece, told Live Science in an email. "There were also many places of worship in the countryside and in the mountains."
paras.zh: “我们知道，在古希腊世界，宗教生活并不局限于大型寺庙和城市圣所，”发掘负责人、希腊瑞士考古学院的考古学家克洛伊·切佐克斯 (Chloé Chezeaux) 在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。 “乡村和山区也有许多礼拜场所。”

paras.en: "An exceptional concentration of pottery"
paras.zh: “陶器的非凡集中”

paras.en: Chezeaux led the excavations this year near the summit of Elatias, one of the highest peaks of Mount Olympus on Euboea. It is not, however, the mainland Mount Olympus traditionally regarded as the abode of the Greek gods.
paras.zh: 切索今年领导了埃拉提亚斯山顶附近的发掘工作，埃拉提亚斯是优卑亚岛奥林匹斯山的最高峰之一。然而，它并不是传统上被视为希腊诸神的居所的奥林匹斯大陆。

paras.en: Chezeaux said that her team first spotted signs of the sanctuary during an archaeological survey in 2025. In excavations throughout Greece, "mountaintop sanctuaries are not uncommon," she said. "The problem is that these sanctuaries often left very little archaeological evidence, sometimes with no visible structures at all, which makes them particularly difficult to identify."
paras.zh: 切索说，她的团队在 2025 年的一次考古调查中首次发现了保护区的迹象。她说，在希腊各地的挖掘工作中，“山顶保护区并不罕见”。 “问题是这些保护区往往留下的考古证据很少，有时根本没有可见的结构，这使得它们特别难以识别。”

paras.en: The sanctuary on the Euboean Olympus, however, has yielded "an exceptional concentration of pottery," she said. The earliest is from at least the ninth century B.C., during the early Greek Geometric period — named after the distinctive patterns on ceramics of the time.
paras.zh: 然而，优卑亚奥林匹斯山上的圣所出产了“异常集中的陶器”，她说。最早的时期至少可以追溯到公元前九世纪，即早期希腊几何时期——以当时陶瓷上独特的图案命名。

paras.en: "This means that people were coming to this summit over several centuries, perhaps even for more than a thousand years," Chezeaux said.
paras.zh: 切索说：“这意味着人们花了几个世纪，甚至可能一千多年的时间才到达这座顶峰。”

paras.en: The sanctuary was used in ancient times mainly by people from the nearby city of Eretria, where the Swiss School of Archaeology is now based.
paras.zh: 该保护区在古代主要由附近埃雷特里亚市的人们使用，该市现在是瑞士考古学院的所在地。

paras.en: "Reaching the summit is quite a physical challenge even today," Chezeaux said. "The final part of our ascent involves walking about 3 kilometres [1.8 miles], with an elevation gain of 650 metres [2,130 feet]"
paras.zh: 切佐说：“即使在今天，登顶也是一项相当大的体力挑战。” “我们攀登的最后一部分需要步行约 3 公里 [1.8 英里]，海拔高度增加 650 米 [2,130 英尺]”

paras.en: Researchers now reach the summit from the nearest mountain pass in about an hour, but "it's difficult to estimate how long the journey would have taken in antiquity," she said. "Travel conditions were different, we don't know which routes people followed, and … not everyone visiting the sanctuary necessarily came from the city of Eretria."
paras.zh: 研究人员现在从最近的山口在大约一个小时内到达山顶，但“很难估计在古代这段旅程需要多长时间，”她说。 “旅行条件不同，我们不知道人们走的是哪条路线，而且......并非每个参观保护区的人都一定来自埃雷特里亚市。”

paras.en: The effort required to get to the mountaintop is part of the mystery.
paras.zh: 到达山顶所需的努力是这个谜团的一部分。

paras.en: "People were willing to devote considerable time and energy to reaching these places, and in our case they seem to have done so over many generations," Chezeaux said. This raised questions of what the mountain meant to worshippers, and why this particular summit remained important for so long, she said.
paras.zh: 切索说：“人们愿意投入大量时间和精力来到达这些地方，就我们而言，他们似乎已经这样做了好几代人。”她说，这引发了人们的疑问：这座山对崇拜者意味着什么，以及为什么这座特殊的山峰长期以来仍然如此重要。

paras.en: The immortal Greek gods of ancient myths were said to watch the affairs of mortal humans from their home on the summit of a different Mount Olympus, in a mountain range between the northern Greek regions of Thessaly and Macedonia. The highest mountain in Greece, it stands at over 9,500 feet (2,900 m) high, while the Euboean Olympus is almost 3,800 feet (1,100 m) high, and the Elatias peak on it is about 100 feet (30 m) lower than its highest peak.
paras.zh: 据说古代神话中不朽的希腊诸神在他们位于希腊北部色萨利和马其顿地区之间的一座山脉的另一座奥林匹斯山山顶的家中注视着凡人的事务。它是希腊最高的山峰，海拔超过 9,500 英尺（2,900 m），而优卑亚奥林匹斯山几乎高 3,800 英尺（1,100 m），其上的埃拉蒂亚斯峰比其最高峰低约 100 英尺（30 m）。

paras.en: The tradition of the northern Olympus on mainland Greece dates from the poems of Homer and Hesiod, which were written in about the eighth century B.C. But the name Olympus was already widespread for high mountains, and modern Greece has several mountains bearing this name.
paras.zh: 希腊大陆北部奥林匹斯山的传统可以追溯到公元前八世纪左右写的荷马和赫西俄德的诗歌。但奥林匹斯山这个名字已经广泛用于高山，现代希腊有几座山以这个名字命名。

paras.en: Chezeaux said religious ceremonies were often held at the sanctuary high on the Euboean Olympus, as well as at other sites on the island.
paras.zh: 切索说，宗教仪式经常在优卑亚奥林匹斯山的圣所以及岛上的其他地点举行。

paras.en: "In antiquity, Eretria had a very rich religious life, with sanctuaries both within the city and throughout its territory," Chezeaux said. "Mount Olympus dominates much of the surrounding region, and its prominent position probably played a role in the choice of this location."
paras.zh: “在古代，埃雷特里亚有着非常丰富的宗教生活，在城市内和整个领土上都有圣所，”切索说。 “奥林匹斯山占据了周边大部分地区，其突出的位置可能在这个地点的选择中发挥了作用。”

paras.en: High mountains held particular significance for the ancient Greeks, and the journey to reach the sanctuary may have been part of the religious experience, she noted.
paras.zh: 她指出，高山对于古希腊人来说具有特殊的意义，到达圣地的旅程可能是宗教体验的一部分。

paras.en: The excavation team has yet to find an altar at the sanctuary. While the chief Greek god Zeus is traditionally associated with mountaintops, an inscription at an ancient site in Eretria mentions "Artemis Olympia" — an epithet that suggests the wild nature goddess Artemis was worshipped at the mountaintop sanctuary.
paras.zh: 挖掘小组尚未在圣所找到祭坛。虽然希腊主神宙斯传统上与山顶联系在一起，但埃雷特里亚古代遗址的铭文提到了“阿尔忒弥斯·奥林匹亚”——这个绰号表明野生自然女神阿尔忒弥斯在山顶保护区受到崇拜。

paras.en: The remains of offerings found in crevices at the site include bones from sheep and goats.
paras.zh: 在现场裂缝中发现的祭品遗骸包括绵羊和山羊的骨头。

paras.en: "Several of them show signs of burning, sometimes at very high temperatures," Chezeaux said. "These finds naturally suggest practices involving animal sacrifice and ritual meals, which played an important role in ancient Greek religion."
paras.zh: 切索说：“其中一些有燃烧的迹象，有时温度非常高。” “这些发现自然表明涉及动物祭祀和仪式膳食的习俗，这在古希腊宗教中发挥了重要作用。”

paras.en: Tom Metcalfe is a freelance journalist and regular Live Science contributor who is based in London in the United Kingdom. Tom writes mainly about science, space, archaeology, the Earth and the oceans. He has also written for the BBC, NBC News, National Geographic, Scientific American, Air & Space, and many others.
paras.zh: 汤姆·梅特卡夫 (Tom Metcalfe) 是一名自由撰稿人，也是《Live Science》的定期撰稿人，常驻英国伦敦。汤姆主要撰写有关科学、太空、考古学、地球和海洋的文章。他还为 BBC、NBC 新闻、国家地理、科学美国人、航空航天等多家媒体撰稿。

articles.title: 'A new record in quantum error correction': Scientists say breakthrough brings powerful, fault-tolerant quantum computers closer to reality
articles.author: Owen Hughes

paras.en: Scientists at Quantinuum say they've set a new record in quantum error correction that brings large-scale, fault-tolerant systems one step closer.
paras.zh: Quantinuum 的科学家表示，他们在量子纠错方面创下了新纪录，使大规模容错系统又近了一步。

paras.en: The team claims their 98-qubit quantum system, Helios, demonstrated a failure rate of just 0.0005% in tests of its quantum memory, which is equivalent to an estimated five uncorrectable errors per million rounds of error checking.
paras.zh: 该团队声称，他们的 98 量子位量子系统 Helios 在量子存储器测试中的故障率仅为 0.0005%，相当于每百万轮错误检查中估计有 5 个不可纠正的错误。

paras.en: This rate bests the previous benchmark set by Google's 105-qubit Willow quantum chip, which demonstrated an estimated 772 uncorrectable errors per million rounds in comparable tests, for an error rate of 0.0772%.
paras.zh: 这一比率超过了谷歌 105 量子位 Willow 量子芯片之前设定的基准，该芯片在可比测试中显示每百万轮估计有 772 个不可纠正的错误，错误率为 0.0772%。

paras.en: The result brings quantum computing closer to the "megaquop regime," where systems can run over a million operations without encountering an error, the researchers said. They detailed their findings in a study uploaded Oct. 16 to the arXiv preprint server.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，这一结果使量子计算更接近“megaquop状态”，系统可以运行超过一百万次操作而不会遇到错误。他们在 10 月 16 日上传到 arXiv 预印本服务器的一项研究中详细介绍了他们的发现。

paras.en: In a statement, Robin Blume-Kohout, co-director of Sandia National Laboratories' Quantum Performance Lab, called the achievement "a significant milestone that quantum computing researchers have been working toward for many years."
paras.zh: 桑迪亚国家实验室量子性能实验室联席主任 Robin Blume-Kohout 在一份声明中称这一成就是“量子计算研究人员多年来一直致力于实现的一个重要里程碑”。

paras.en: "A scaled-up version of this system could reach the reliability required for useful fault-tolerant computation at a feasible size — less than a million physical qubits — which improves the outlook for practical quantum computing," added Blume-Kohout, who was not involved in the research.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的 Blume-Kohout 补充道：“该系统的放大版本可以在可行的尺寸（小于一百万个物理量子位）下达到有用的容错计算所需的可靠性，这改善了实用量子计算的前景。”

paras.en: Why is quantum computing so error-prone?
paras.zh: 为什么量子计算如此容易出错？

paras.en: Preserving the fragile information stored in qubits is one of quantum computing's greatest challenges and presents a major barrier to making systems practical.
paras.zh: 保存量子位中存储的脆弱信息是量子计算面临的最大挑战之一，也是系统实用化的主要障碍。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Qubits, the most basic units of quantum information, are extremely sensitive to interference. Their delicate quantum states can be easily disturbed by heat, vibrations and other forms of environmental "noise," and if this happens in the middle of a calculation, the result becomes far less reliable — if it survives at all.
paras.zh: 量子位是量子信息的最基本单位，对干扰极其敏感。它们微妙的量子态很容易受到热量、振动和其他形式的环境“噪声”的干扰，如果这种情况发生在计算过程中，结果就会变得不太可靠——如果它能幸存下来的话。

paras.en: Quantum error correction has become a focal point for researchers for this exact reason. It introduces redundancy to quantum systems to ensure that small, potentially manageable errors don't wipe out entire calculations.
paras.zh: 正是由于这个原因，量子纠错已成为研究人员关注的焦点。它为量子系统引入了冗余，以确保小的、可能可管理的错误不会消除整个计算。

paras.en: This involves spreading quantum information across multiple physical qubits to form a "logical" qubit. If a single qubit loses its quantum state due to interference, the redundancy provided by the logical qubit helps to keep the information it collectively stores intact.
paras.zh: 这涉及将量子信息传播到多个物理量子位以形成“逻辑”量子位。如果单个量子位由于干扰而失去其量子态，则逻辑量子位提供的冗余有助于保持其共同存储的信息完整。

paras.en: The challenge is packing enough qubits into computers to ensure redundancy for longer, more complex calculations. This presents something of a catch-22: Adding more qubits provides more redundancy, allowing for larger quantum systems, but it also increases the opportunity for errors.
paras.zh: 面临的挑战是将足够的量子位装入计算机中，以确保更长、更复杂的计算的冗余。这提出了某种第二十二条军规：添加更多的量子位可以提供更多的冗余，从而允许更大的量子系统，但它也增加了出错的机会。

paras.en: Flexible architecture and "leakage repumping"
paras.zh: 灵活的架构和“泄漏重新泵送”

paras.en: Unlike Google's Willow processor, which is based on superconducting circuits, Helios uses electrically charged barium ions that can be dynamically rearranged.
paras.zh: 与基于超导电路的谷歌 Willow 处理器不同，Helios 使用可以动态重新排列的带电钡离子。

paras.en: By shuttling ions around the processor, scientists can unite different pairs of qubits, allowing them to exchange information directly. That way, it doesn't have to pass through multiple qubits — a process that can introduce additional errors.
paras.zh: 通过在处理器周围穿梭离子，科学家可以将不同的量子位对结合起来，使它们能够直接交换信息。这样，它就不必通过多个量子位——这个过程可能会引入额外的错误。

paras.en: The team also developed a technique called "leakage repumping," which uses precise, split-second laser pulses to bring qubits that have slipped out of their information-storing quantum state back into a usable state.
paras.zh: 该团队还开发了一种称为“泄漏再泵浦”的技术，该技术使用精确的瞬间激光脉冲将已经脱离信息存储量子态的量子位带回可用状态。

paras.en: To test how effectively Helios could correct errors as more physical qubits were added, the researchers used a type of error-correcting code known as a color code. They tested three progressively larger versions — known as code distances 3, 5 and 7 — which could correct one, two and three physical-qubit errors, respectively.
paras.zh: 为了测试 Helios 在添加更多物理量子位时纠正错误的有效性，研究人员使用了一种称为颜色代码的纠错代码。他们测试了三个逐渐增大的版本（称为代码距离 3、5 和 7），分别可以纠正 1 个、2 个和 3 个物理量子位错误。

paras.en: They found that Helios became substantially more reliable as they added more physical qubits. Each increase in code distance reduced the likelihood of an uncorrectable error by roughly 12 times. At the highest level tested (distance 7), Helios achieved a record failure rate of approximately one uncorrectable error per 200,000 rounds.
paras.zh: 他们发现，随着添加更多物理量子位，赫利俄斯变得更加可靠。代码距离每增加一次，不可纠正错误的可能性就会减少约 12 倍。在测试的最高级别（距离 7）下，Helios 实现了创纪录的故障率，即每 200,000 轮大约有一个不可纠正的错误。

paras.en: In the study, which has not been peer-reviewed yet, the scientists suggested that future quantum computers using the same technology as Helios could achieve extremely low error rates without needing an impractically high number of physical qubits.
paras.zh: 在这项尚未经过同行评审的研究中，科学家们表示，使用与 Helios 相同技术的未来量子计算机可以实现极低的错误率，而不需要不切实际的大量物理量子位。

paras.en: - 'This moves the timeline forward significantly': Quantum computing breakthrough could slash pesky errors by up to 100 times
paras.zh: -“这大大推进了时间线”：量子计算的突破可以将讨厌的错误减少多达 100 倍

paras.en: - New quantum chip taps into weird quasiparticles to get qubits to communicate over long distances
paras.zh: - 新的量子芯片利用奇怪的准粒子使量子位进行长距离通信

paras.en: - Japan switches on its first full-stack room-temperature quantum computer — and scientists plan to scale it up to 10,000 qubits
paras.zh: - 日本启用第一台全栈室温量子计算机，科学家计划将其扩展至 10,000 个量子位

paras.en: According to estimates from Quantinuum representatives, a future trapped-ion system could support 100 logical qubits using approximately 30,000 physical qubits, compared with around 900,000 for a competing superconducting system.
paras.zh: 根据 Quantinuum 代表的估计，未来的俘获离子系统可以使用大约 30,000 个物理量子位支持 100 个逻辑量子位，而竞争性超导系统则需要大约 900,000 个物理量子位。

paras.en: "There is still substantial engineering ahead to scale to much larger systems and integrate all the elements of fault-tolerant computation, but this work demonstrates that our underlying hardware and error-correction approach can deliver the exponential improvement in reliability that large-scale quantum computers will depend upon," Dave Hayes, director of computational design and theory at Quantinuum, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: Quantinuum 计算设计和理论总监戴夫·海斯 (Dave Hayes) 在一封电子邮件中告诉《Live Science》：“要扩展到更大的系统并集成容错计算的所有元素，还需要进行大量的工程设计，但这项工作表明，我们的底层硬件和纠错方法可以实现大规模量子计算机所依赖的可靠性的指数级提高。”

paras.en: The researchers said they plan to apply their latest findings to Quantinuum's upcoming quantum
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，他们计划将他们的最新发现应用于 Quantinuum 即将推出的量子

paras.en: Lavasani, A., Reed, A. P., Dreiling, J. M., Park, A. J., Mills, M., Puviani, M., Matos, G., Allman, M. S., Berthusen, N., Brown, N. C., Colussi, V. E., Estey, B., Foltz, C., Gresh, D., Haghshenas, R., Isanaka, A., Kotibhaskar, N., Ransford, A., Ryan-Anderson, C., . . . Potter, A. C. (2026, October 16). Quantum error correction well below the color code threshold. arXiv.org. https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24077
paras.zh: Lavasani, A.、Reed, A. P.、Dreiling, J. M.、Park, A. J.、Mills, M.、Puviani, M.、Matos, G.、Allman, M.S.、Berthusen, N.、Brown, N.C.、Colussi, V.E.、Estey, B.、Foltz, C.、Gresh, D.、Haghshenas, R.、Isanaka, A., Kotibhaskar, N.、Ransford, A.、Ryan-Anderson, C., 。 。 。波特，A.C.（2026 年，10 月 16 日）。量子纠错远低于颜色代码阈值。 arXiv.org。 https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24077

paras.en: Owen Hughes is a freelance writer and editor specializing in data and digital technologies. Previously a senior editor at ZDNET, Owen has been writing about tech for more than a decade, during which time he has covered everything from AI, cybersecurity and supercomputers to programming languages and public sector IT. Owen is particularly interested in the intersection of technology, life and work – in his previous roles at ZDNET and TechRepublic, he wrote extensively about business leadership, digital transformation and the evolving dynamics of remote work.
paras.zh: 欧文·休斯 (Owen Hughes) 是一位自由撰稿人和编辑，专门从事数据和数字技术。 Owen 曾担任 ZDNET 的高级编辑，十多年来一直在撰写有关技术的文章，在此期间，他涵盖了从人工智能、网络安全和超级计算机到编程语言和公共部门 IT 的所有内容。 Owen 对技术、生活和工作的交叉点特别感兴趣 - 在他之前在 ZDNET 和 TechRepublic 任职期间，他撰写了大量有关商业领导力、数字化转型和远程工作不断发展的动态的文章。

articles.title: Almost 90 Years After Discovering a Ship Burial That Rewrote British History, Archaeologists Returned to Sutton Hoo. This Time, They Uncovered a Ghostly 'Sand Body'

paras.en: Archaeologists have discovered an unusual grave at Sutton Hoo, a cemetery in Suffolk, England best known for its seventh-century ship burial of an early medieval king. The newly discovered grave contains no human remains—only ghost-like impressions in the shape of a body.
paras.zh: 考古学家在英国萨福克郡的萨顿胡墓地发现了一座不寻常的坟墓，该墓地以其七世纪中世纪早期国王的船葬而闻名。新发现的坟墓中没有人类遗骸，只有身体形状的幽灵般的痕迹。

paras.en: The “sand body” was discovered toward the end of a month-long excavation in the summer of 2025. The dig was conducted by “Time Team,” a popular British archaeology television series, in partnership with the National Trust, a conservation charity, and FAS Heritage, a field archaeology and historic preservation company based in York, England.
paras.zh: 2025 年夏天，在为期一个月的挖掘工作即将结束时，人们发现了这具“沙体”。这次挖掘工作是由英国热门考古电视连续剧“时代团队”与保护慈善机构国民信托基金会和总部位于英国约克的实地考古和历史保护公司 FAS Heritage 合作进行的。

paras.en: Sand bodies are burials where “the bodies and bones had dissolved away in the acid soil, replaced by hard sand which held the form of the person,” Angus Wainwright, an archaeologist with the National Trust, says in a statement announcing the find.
paras.zh: 国家信托基金会的考古学家安格斯·温赖特 (Angus Wainwright) 在宣布这一发现的声明中表示，沙尸是一种墓葬，“尸体和骨头已经溶解在酸性土壤中，取而代之的是保持人形的硬沙”。

paras.en: In addition to the sand body, the archaeologists also found grave goods, including beads, tweezers, a knife and a brooch. They were also surprised to find evidence that suggests a second person might have been buried in the same grave. The discovery raises many questions, including whether the two individuals were buried there simultaneously or at different times. The relationship between the two individuals also remains a mystery.
paras.zh: 除了沙体外，考古人员还发现了随葬品，包括珠子、镊子、小刀和胸针。他们还惊讶地发现证据表明可能有第二个人被埋在同一个坟墓里。这一发现引发了许多问题，包括这两个人是同时埋葬的还是不同时间埋葬的。这两个人之间的关系也仍然是个谜。

paras.en: “As ever with archaeology, the more we uncover, the more questions we find ourselves asking,” says Tim Taylor, the creator and producer of “Time Team,” per the BBC’s George King.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司 (BBC) 的乔治·金 (George King) 报道，《时间团队》的创始人兼制片人蒂姆·泰勒 (Tim Taylor) 表示：“与考古学一样，我们发现的越多，我们发现自己提出的问题就越多。”

paras.en: Sand bodies have been discovered at Sutton Hoo before, during excavations conducted in the 1980s, as well as at other burial sites in the same region. In 2020, archaeologists announced the discovery of sand bodies, also known as “sand silhouettes,” at a seventh-century burial site in the town of Oulton, Suffolk. They recently found similar sand bodies at a “nationally significant” early medieval burial ground located near Theberton, Suffolk.
paras.zh: 在 20 世纪 80 年代进行的挖掘工作中，萨顿胡 (Sutton Hoo) 以及同一地区的其他墓地也曾发现过沙体。 2020 年，考古学家宣布在萨福克郡奥尔顿镇的一处七世纪墓地发现了沙体，也称为“沙剪影”。他们最近在萨福克郡塞伯顿附近的一个“具有全国意义”的中世纪早期墓地发现了类似的沙体。

paras.en: Sutton Hoo features two cemeteries dated to the sixth and seventh centuries. The site was discovered in the late 1930s, when landowner Edith Pretty hired self-taught archaeologist Basil Brown to explore her estate near the town of Woodbridge in Suffolk, England. One of the most significant discoveries was an 88-foot-long burial ship that once held human remains. Scholars suspect the ship burial may have been the final resting place of Raedwald, the ruler of the kingdom of East Anglia who died around 624 C.E.
paras.zh: 萨顿胡 (Sutton Hoo) 拥有两座可追溯至六世纪和七世纪的墓地。该遗址于 20 世纪 30 年代末被发现，当时地主伊迪丝·普雷蒂 (Edith Pretty) 聘请了自学成才的考古学家巴兹尔·布朗 (Basil Brown) 来探索她位于英格兰萨福克郡伍德布里奇镇附近的庄园。最重要的发现之一是一艘 88 英尺长的埋葬船，曾经埋葬过人类遗骸。学者们怀疑船葬可能是东安格利亚王国统治者雷德瓦尔德的最后安息之地，雷德瓦尔德于公元 624 年左右去世。

paras.en: The ship contained more than 260 items dating to the sixth or seventh centuries C.E., including a helmet, elaborately decorated weapons, armor, military equipment, gold coins and horse bridles.
paras.zh: 船上载有 260 多件可追溯到公元六世纪或七世纪的物品，包括头盔、装饰精美的武器、盔甲、军事装备、金币和马缰绳。

paras.en: Since then, archaeological investigations at Sutton Hoo have focused largely on the ship burial and other royal burial mounds. But, with their most recent digs, researchers wanted to learn more about the everyday people of the region.
paras.zh: 从那时起，萨顿胡的考古调查主要集中在船葬和其他皇家墓葬上。但是，通过最近的挖掘，​​研究人员希望更多地了解该地区的日常生活。

paras.en: In 2024, archaeologists began excavating a burial ground known as Garden Field, which they think may predate the famous ship burial. During that dig, they found the base of an intricately decorated, sixth-century container known as the Byzantine Bromeswell Bucket.
paras.zh: 2024 年，考古学家开始挖掘一个名为花园场 (Garden Field) 的墓地，他们认为这可能早于著名的船葬。在挖掘过程中，他们发现了一个装饰复杂的六世纪容器的底部，称为拜占庭布罗姆斯韦尔桶。

paras.en: They carefully transported the base to a laboratory, where testing revealed that it contained cremated humans and animal remains. Researchers discovered part of an ankle bone, fragments of a skull and a double-sided comb that’s probably made from antler.
paras.zh: 他们小心翼翼地将基地运送到实验室，测试显示里面有火化的人类和动物遗骸。研究人员发现了部分踝骨、头骨碎片和一把可能由鹿角制成的双面梳子。

paras.en: Archaeologists returned to Garden Field in June 2025, hoping to learn more about the size and scope of the cemetery, when it was used and whether the individuals buried there were connected to the communities associated with Sutton Hoo’s royal burial ground. They also explored a field located near the River Deben that they suspect might contain a ship, a medieval dock, a 19th-century saw pit or a modern cattle grave.
paras.zh: 考古学家于 2025 年 6 月返回花园场，希望更多地了解该墓地的大小和范围、使用时间以及埋葬在那里的个人是否与萨顿胡皇家墓地相关的社区有联系。他们还探索了德奔河附近的一块土地，他们怀疑那里可能有一艘船、一个中世纪码头、一个 19 世纪的锯坑或一个现代牛墓。

paras.en: A new four-part documentary series about the 2025 dig is being released on YouTube. The recent excavations have shed new light on Sutton Hoo, but many questions remain unanswered.
paras.zh: 关于 2025 年挖掘工作的新四集纪录片系列正在 YouTube 上发布。最近的发掘为萨顿胡提供了新的线索，但许多问题仍未得到解答。

paras.en: “There is still much to discover about this iconic site,” Helen Geake, an archaeologist with “Time Team,” says in the statement.
paras.zh: “这个标志性遗址还有很多东西有待发现，”“时间团队”的考古学家海伦·吉克在声明中说。

articles.title: Astronauts Living at NASA's Planned Future Lunar Base Might One Day Snack on Moon-Grown Potatoes

paras.en: NASA aims to build the first permanent moon base within the next decade, allowing astronauts to live and work there for extended periods. But those lunar residents probably can’t depend on receiving all their food from Earth. They’ll likely need to grow some crops on their own—and new research suggests potatoes could be a viable option.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的目标是在未来十年内建造第一个永久性月球基地，让宇航员能够在那里长期生活和工作。但这些月球居民可能不能依赖从地球获取所有食物。他们可能需要自己种植一些农作物——新的研究表明土豆可能是一个可行的选择。

paras.en: In a study published November 19 in the journal npj Microgravity, researchers report successfully growing edible potatoes in simulated lunar soil with an added nutrient-rich ingredient. The findings represent a promising avenue for lunar food-production systems and suggest that astronauts might one day feast on moon spuds.
paras.zh: 在11月19日发表于《npj Microgravity》期刊上的一项研究中，研究人员报告称，他们在添加了富含营养成分的模拟月壤中成功种植出了可食用的土豆。这一研究成果为月球粮食生产系统开辟了一条有希望的道路，并表明宇航员有朝一日可能享用月球土豆。

paras.en: “Potatoes provide more calories per land area than many other crops,” study co-author Aymeric Goyer, a plant biologist at Oregon State University, tells Reuters’ Will Dunham. “They are nutritious—they provide more potassium than a banana, are rich in vitamin C, have good proteins—and they have a high satiety index,” meaning they are very filling and satisfying.
paras.zh: 研究报告的合著者、俄勒冈州立大学的植物生物学家艾默里克·高耶 (Aymeric Goyer) 告诉路透社记者威尔·邓纳姆 (Will Dunham)：“马铃薯每单位土地面积提供的热量比许多其他作物更多。” “它们营养丰富，比香蕉提供更多的钾，富含维生素 C，含有优质蛋白质，而且饱腹感指数很高，”这意味着它们非常饱腹和令人满意。

paras.en: The researchers received funding from NASA to help figure out how to grow plants to feed future moon visitors. But the dirt there, called lunar regolith, doesn’t have nitrogen, which is one of plants’ essential macronutrients, Goyer tells El País’ Miguel Ángel Criado. It also contains low levels of organic matter to help supply other nutrients, as well as high levels of heavy metals, which can be toxic to plants and the people who eat them. What’s more, lunar regolith’s texture resembles that of tiny glass shards, which can be tough on tissues.
paras.zh: 研究人员获得了美国宇航局的资助，帮助研究如何种植植物来喂养未来的月球游客。但戈耶告诉《国家报》的米格尔·安赫尔·克里亚多，那里的泥土（称为月球风化层）不含氮，而氮是植物必需的大量营养素之一。它还含有低含量的有机物，有助于提供其他营养物质，以及高含量的重金属，这些重金属可能对植物和食用它们的人有毒。更重要的是，月球风化层的质地类似于微小的玻璃碎片，对组织来说可能很坚韧。

paras.en: So, the team tried to make a simulated moon dirt mixture more amenable to plant growth by adding vermicompost: a nutrient-rich organic ingredient that includes worm poop. They tested various proportions of vermicompost and imitation lunar regolith, resulting in three dirt combinations: one without vermicompost, one with 15 percent and one with 30 percent.
paras.zh: 因此，研究小组试图通过添加蚯蚓堆肥来使模拟的月球泥土混合物更适合植物生长：蚯蚓堆肥是一种营养丰富的有机成分，其中包括蠕虫粪便。他们测试了不同比例的蚯蚓堆肥和仿月球风化层，产生了三种污垢组合：一种不含蚯蚓堆肥，一种含有 15%，一种含有 30%。

paras.en: The experiments revealed that the simulant lunar regolith with the highest vermicompost content yielded just as many potatoes as those grown in Earth soil. Meanwhile, those planted without the nutrient-rich additive were stunted and had underdeveloped roots, signs associated with too much of the heavy metal copper.
paras.zh: 实验表明，蚯蚓堆肥含量最高的模拟月球风化层产生的土豆数量与地球土壤中种植的土豆一样多。与此同时，那些没有使用营养丰富的添加剂种植的植物发育不良，根部发育不全，这些迹象与重金属铜过多有关。

paras.en: The researchers also tested five different moon dirt simulants—mimicking regolith at different lunar locations—to make mixtures with 5 percent vermicompost. The smaller proportion of the additive allowed the team to measure the crop’s stress response, and it also represents the amount of organic matter that might go into moon dirt during an early stage. These plants grew, but they didn’t produce as many taters as the ones with the 30 percent mixture.
paras.zh: 研究人员还测试了五种不同的月球污垢模拟物——模仿月球不同位置的风化层——与 5% 的蚯蚓堆肥制成混合物。较小比例的添加剂使研究小组能够测量作物的应激反应，它也代表了早期可能进入月球污垢的有机物的量。这些植物生长了，但产出的土豆数量不如 30% 混合物的植物。

paras.en: Earlier this year, a different research team reported that they grew chickpeas in simulated moon dirt. They added vermicompost and mycorrhizal fungi—microbes that have a mutually beneficial relationship with most land plant species on Earth—to help with growth.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，另一个研究小组报告说，他们在模拟月球泥土中种植了鹰嘴豆。他们添加了蚯蚓堆肥和菌根真菌（与地球上大多数陆地植物物种具有互利关系的微生物）来帮助生长。

paras.en: “We believe the compost helps balance some of the toxicity we see in lunar regolith by reducing plant exposure to harmful compounds,” study co-author David Handy, a plant biologist at Oregon State University, says in a statement.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、俄勒冈州立大学植物生物学家大卫·汉迪在一份声明中表示：“我们相信，堆肥可以通过减少植物接触有害化合物来平衡我们在月球风化层中看到的一些毒性。”

paras.en: According to the researchers, the potatoes are safe to eat. They’re also just as nutritious and don’t contain more glycoalkaloids—natural potato toxins that can build up in stressed plants—than terrestrial spuds.
paras.zh: 据研究人员称，土豆可以安全食用。与陆生马铃薯相比，它们也同样有营养，并且不含更多的配糖生物碱（一种可以在受胁迫的植物中积聚的天然马铃薯毒素）。

paras.en: But are these simulated moon spuds just as tasty as the Earthly ones we know and love? Unfortunately, the team did not conduct a taste test. “We used what we harvested for lab analyses,” Goyer tells Reuters.
paras.zh: 但这些模拟的月球土豆和我们所熟悉和喜爱的地球土豆一样美味吗？不幸的是，该团队没有进行口味测试。 “我们将收获的东西用于实验室分析，”戈耶告诉路透社。

paras.en: Lunar regolith isn’t the only challenge that moon-grown potatoes would face, however. Our natural satellite has only about one-sixth the gravity we experience on Earth, so researchers will need a better understanding of how that might affect plant growth, Marshall Porterfield, a biological engineer at Purdue University who did not participate in the study, tells the Washington Post’s Eric Niiler. The lunar base’s greenhouse will also need devices that mix the air into the ideal cocktail of nutrients, water and carbon dioxide for the plants. Porterfield is skeptical that moon dirt, even with additives, could ever produce plants that can provide sufficient vitamins and minerals to people.
paras.zh: 然而，月球风化层并不是月球种植土豆面临的唯一挑战。我们的天然卫星的重力只有地球上的六分之一左右，因此研究人员需要更好地了解这可能如何影响植物生长，普渡大学的生物工程师马歇尔·波特菲尔德（未参与这项研究）告诉《华盛顿邮报》的埃里克·尼尔勒。月球基地的温室还需要将空气混合成植物所需的营养物、水和二氧化碳的理想混合物的设备。波特菲尔德怀疑月球污垢，即使含有添加剂，能否产生能为人类提供足够维生素和矿物质的植物。

paras.en: Nevertheless, the team is moving forward one step at a time. Their next study will identify which specific potato varieties fare best in imitation moon dirt.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，团队正在一步一个脚印地向前迈进。他们的下一项研究将确定哪些特定的马铃薯品种在仿月球泥土中表现最好。

articles.title: Biologists Discover a 'One-in-a-Million' Bright Yellow Burbot Fish in New York's Oswego Harbor

paras.en: Burbots typically blend into their surroundings with a mottled palette of olive green, earthy brown and golden yellow. So when biologists pulled a bright yellow fish from New York’s Oswego Harbor, they knew they had caught something unusual.
paras.zh: 江鳕通常以橄榄绿、土棕色和金黄色的斑驳色调融入周围环境。因此，当生物学家从纽约奥斯威戈港捞上一条亮黄色的鱼时，他们知道自己钓到了一些不寻常的东西。

paras.en: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) scientists were conducting a routine invasive species survey last month when they caught a vibrantly colored burbot, which would “make even the brightest fall foliage look pale in comparison,” according to a November 10 announcement about the find.
paras.zh: 根据 11 月 10 日有关这一发现的公告，美国鱼类和野生动物管理局 (USFWS) 的科学家上个月在进行例行入侵物种调查时捕获了一条色彩鲜艳的江鳕，“相比之下，即使是最明亮的秋天树叶也显得苍白”。

paras.en: The burbot had a rare biological condition called xanthochromism, which produces an unusually saturated yellow or orange hue in otherwise normally colored animals. It results from a genetic mutation that reduces the production of black-brown melanin, which allows yellow pigment to dominate.
paras.zh: 江鳕患有一种罕见的生物学病症，称为黄变现象，这种病症使其他正常颜色的动物产生异常饱和的黄色或橙色色调。它是由基因突变引起的，该突变减少了黑棕色黑色素的产生，从而使黄色色素占主导地位。

paras.en: Xanthochromism has been observed in dozens of fish species, as well as birds and amphibians. It’s only been recorded in a handful of mammals, including anteaters, tayras, opossums, pikas, martens, weasels and coatis.
paras.zh: 在数十种鱼类、鸟类和两栖动物中都观察到了黄变现象。仅在少数哺乳动物中发现了这种现象，包括食蚁兽、泰拉斯、负鼠、鼠兔、貂、黄鼠狼和长鼻浣熊。

paras.en: USFWS describes the bright yellow fish as “one-in-a-million.” In wild fish, the agency notes, xanthochromism is much less common than albinism, which causes unusually pale or white coloring, or melanism, which produces unusually dark coloring.
paras.zh: 美国鱼类和野生动物管理局将这种亮黄色的鱼描述为“百万分之一”。该机构指出，在野生鱼类中，黄变现象比白化病（导致异常苍白或白色）或黑化症（产生异常深色）少见。

paras.en: Burbots are native to the Great Lakes, but they typically live in cooler, deeper waters than those in Oswego Harbor on Lake Ontario. Yellow coloring aside, the fish was in rough shape. Biologists noticed that it was emaciated and appeared to be in poor health, so they sent it off for a health analysis. The fish could ultimately help scientists better understand the species’ struggles in the lake, where populations are extremely low for unknown reasons.
paras.zh: 江鳕原产于五大湖，但它们通常生活在比安大略湖奥斯威戈港更凉爽、更深的水域中。除了黄色之外，鱼的形状很粗糙。生物学家注意到它很瘦弱，而且健康状况似乎不佳，因此他们将它送去进行健康分析。这些鱼最终可以帮助科学家更好地了解该物种在湖中的挣扎，由于未知的原因，湖中的种群数量极少。

paras.en: Veterinarians at Cornell University College of Veterinary Medicine performed a necropsy on the fish, which revealed an array of issues. The fish had stopped eating, had multiple skin lesions and had an “overall poor body condition,” according to a November 17 social media update from the USFWS’s Lower Great Lakes Fish & Wildlife Conservation Office.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学兽医学院的兽医对这条鱼进行了尸检，发现了一系列问题。根据 USFWS 下五大湖鱼类和野生动物保护办公室 11 月 17 日在社交媒体上发布的最新消息，这条鱼已经停止进食，有多处皮肤损伤，并且“整体身体状况不佳”。

paras.en: The fish also had carcinoma, a type of cancer that originates from the epithelial cells lining the skin and organs, and it had a mild parasite infection in its kidneys. Scientists don’t know what causes cancer in this species, but they suspect age, contaminants, viruses and environmental conditions might play a role. Whatever the causes, this bright yellow individual will “help inform scientists about disease issues in this species, which can inform managers about causes for population decline,” according to the update.
paras.zh: 这条鱼还患有癌症，这是一种源自皮肤和器官内衬上皮细胞的癌症，并且它的肾脏有轻微的寄生虫感染。科学家们不知道是什么导致了这个物种的癌症，但他们怀疑年龄、污染物、病毒和环境条件可能起了一定作用。最新消息称，无论原因是什么，这只亮黄色的个体将“帮助科学家了解该物种的疾病问题，从而让管理者了解种群数量下降的原因”。

paras.en: In 2024, sport fishers caught a bright orange nurse shark with xanthochromism off the east coast of Costa Rica. The shark, which was ultimately released back into the Caribbean Sea, was the first known member of its species to exhibit the condition.
paras.zh: 2024 年，钓鱼者在哥斯达黎加东海岸捕获了一条带有黄色素性的亮橙色护士鲨。这条鲨鱼最终被放回加勒比海，是该物种中第一个已知出现这种情况的成员。

paras.en: Burbots, also known as ling, freshwater codfish and eelpout, are cold-adapted fish found throughout Canada, Alaska and the northern United States, living as far south as Kentucky and Missouri; they also live in northern Eurasia.
paras.zh: 江鳕，也被称为淡水鳕鱼和鳗鱼，是一种适应寒冷的鱼类，分布在加拿大、阿拉斯加和美国北部，南至肯塔基州和密苏里州。他们也生活在欧亚大陆北部。

paras.en: They can grow to about 33 inches long and can live for more than 20 years. When they’re young, burbots mainly eat insects and other creatures without backbones. However, by the time they reach age 5 or 6, they begin to feed almost exclusively on fish, including whitefish, sculpins, lampreys and other burbot; they also sometimes eat mice or shrews.
paras.zh: 它们可以长到约 33 英寸长，寿命可以超过 20 年。江鳕年轻时主要吃昆虫和其他没有脊椎的生物。然而，当它们长到 5 或 6 岁时，它们开始几乎只以鱼类为食，包括白鲑、杜父鱼、七鳃鳗和其他江鳕；它们有时也吃老鼠或鼩鼱。

paras.en: Burbots might not look like fearsome predators. But they’re voracious hunters that use their large mouths, strong jaws and inward-slanting teeth to chomp down on prey, feeding mostly at night.
paras.zh: 江鳕可能看起来不像可怕的掠食者。但它们是贪婪的猎人，利用大嘴、强壮的下巴和向内倾斜的牙齿来咀嚼猎物，主要在夜间进食。

paras.en: They’re becoming increasingly popular among anglers, in part because when cooked and dipped in butter, burbot tastes like lobster. (One of the species’ other nicknames is “poor man’s lobster.”)
paras.zh: 它们越来越受到垂钓者的欢迎，部分原因是江鳕煮熟并浸入黄油后，尝起来像龙虾。 （该物种的另一个绰号是“穷人的龙虾”。）

paras.en: “People think they’re ugly,” Andrew Shapiro, a biologist at Michigan State University, told Fox 2 Detroit’s Jack Nissen last year. “They eat stuff that other fish don’t. They’re pretty opportunistic and will eat anything, which has a negative connotation. But that’s changing. People think they’re pretty now. … In recent years, interest in burbot angling has been exponential.”
paras.zh: “人们认为自己很丑，”密歇根州立大学的生物学家安德鲁·夏皮罗去年告诉底特律福克斯 2 台的杰克·尼森。 “它们吃其他鱼不吃的东西。它们非常投机取巧，什么都吃，这具有负面含义。但这种情况正在改变。人们现在认为它们很漂亮……近年来，人们对江鳕垂钓的兴趣呈指数级增长。”

articles.title: ‘A True Giant of the Music Industry’: King Charles Remembers Ian ‘Molly’ Meldrum And Their Infamous Interview
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: In showbiz, W.C. Fields is famously quoted as saying, never work with kids or animals. For Ian “Molly” Meldrum, the late Australian broadcaster and record producer might’ve done well to avoid working with the future King of England.
paras.zh: 在演艺圈，W.C.菲尔兹有句名言：永远不要与儿童或动物一起工作。对于已故澳大利亚广播员和唱片制作人伊恩·“莫莉”·梅尔德鲁姆来说，避免与未来的英格兰国王合作可能会做得很好。

paras.en: Molly, as he’s known to millions, gave a gift that continues to give when he interviewed the-then Prince Charles on Countdown back in 1977. The subject was a fine one, albeit a switch-up from the regular kings of rock and pop who dropped by — some of whom weren’t on their best behavior for national TV.
paras.zh: 数百万人都知道莫莉，他在 1977 年在《倒计时》节目中采访当时的查尔斯王子时，送出了一份礼物，这份礼物至今仍在继续。这个话题很好，尽管与路过的摇滚和流行音乐之王的常规情况有所不同——其中一些人在全国电视节目中表现不佳。

paras.en: On that occasion, it was the host who bombed. Molly, despite conducting countless interviews for the camera, fumbled and sweated through the interview, so obviously star-stuck by his famous royal guest.
paras.zh: 那一次，是主持人炸了。莫莉尽管在镜头前进行了无数次采访，但在整个采访过程中却显得笨手笨脚、满头大汗，显然是被他著名的皇室客人迷住了。

paras.en: When news of Molly’s death reached Buckingham Palace, King Charles paid tribute to the late music legend and remembered the unforgettable exchange.
paras.zh: 当莫莉去世的消息传到白金汉宫时，查尔斯国王向这位已故的音乐传奇人物表示敬意，并回忆起这次难忘的交流。

paras.en: An aide to the King said he had been “deeply saddened” to hear of Meldrum’s death, the BBC reports.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司报道，国王的一名助手表示，听到梅尔德鲁姆的死讯，他“深感悲痛”。

paras.en: “His Majesty’s interview with Molly is a moment he and many others will never forget – he hopes that interview will once again raise a few smiles as Australians honor Molly’s legacy as a true giant of the music industry.”
paras.zh: “陛下对莫莉的采访是他和许多其他人永远不会忘记的时刻——他希望这次采访能够再次引起一些微笑，让澳大利亚人尊重莫莉作为音乐行业真正巨人的遗产。”

paras.en: Molly, the late ex-Countdown host and music industry veteran, died on Monday after a long illness, at the age of 83.
paras.zh: 已故的前 Countdown 主持人和音乐界资深人士莫莉 (Molly) 在长期患病后于周一去世，享年 83 岁。

paras.en: Elton John is one of many international stars of the music community who has remembered Molly as both “an Australian legend and an institution.”
paras.zh: 埃尔顿·约翰 (Elton John) 是音乐界众多国际明星之一，他将莫莉视为“澳大利亚传奇人物和风云人物”。

paras.en: Fellow Rock And Roll Hall of Fame inductees Duran Duran reflect on Molly as a loveable gateway for generations of international acts into the land down under.
paras.zh: 入选摇滚名人堂的杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 认为莫莉是几代国际音乐人进入澳大利亚的可爱门户。

paras.en: “Camp DD are all very sad to hear Molly has departed. He was a fabulous character with a golden heart and a very big hat,” reads a message on the band’s official social channels, written by founding keyboardist Nick Rhodes. “We met him the first time we went to Australia, to perform on the show he presented, Countdown. He was already a national icon at that point and it was easy to see why, he had remarkable charisma and a wicked sense of humour. He was a true music fan and relentlessly promoted the artists he believed in, we were lucky enough to be one of those acts.”
paras.zh: “听到 Molly 离开，DD 营的所有人都感到非常难过。他是一位出色的人物，拥有一颗金子般的心，戴着一顶很大的帽子，”乐队的官方社交频道上写道，由创始键盘手尼克·罗兹 (Nick Rhodes) 撰写。 “我们第一次去澳大利亚时就遇见了他，在他主持的节目《倒计时》中表演。那时他已经是全国偶像，原因很容易理解，他具有非凡的魅力和邪恶的幽默感。他是一位真正的音乐迷，不懈地宣传他所相信的艺术家，我们很幸运能够成为其中的一员。”

paras.en: Molly “introduced Duran Duran to an Australian audience and remained loyal and supportive throughout our career. We are eternally grateful for his friendship, everyone loved Molly, not least everyone in our band.”
paras.zh: Molly“将 Duran Duran 介绍给澳大利亚观众，并在我们的整个职业生涯中保持忠诚和支持。我们永远感谢他的友谊，每个人都爱 Molly，尤其是我们乐队中的每个人。”

paras.en: New wave heavyweights Blondie had a similar tale to tell. “Molly was instrumental in Blondie’s success in Australia, championing our music and introducing us to a whole new audience,” reads a statement on the U.S. band’s socials. “We will always be grateful for his belief in us and the doors he helped open. He had a true passion for music, a wonderful sense of humor, and was truly one of a kind. He will be greatly missed.”
paras.zh: 新浪潮重量级人物金发女郎也有类似的故事。 “莫莉对 Blondie 在澳大利亚的成功发挥了重要作用，她捍卫了我们的音乐，并将我们介绍给了全新的听众，”美国乐队社交媒体上的一份声明中写道。 “我们将永远感激他对我们的信任以及他帮助打开的大门。他对音乐充满热情，具有美妙的幽默感，而且确实是独一无二的。我们将非常怀念他。”

paras.en: Homegrown heavy rock titans AC/DC were regular performers on Countdown, which aired for 14 season until 1987. The band shared an hilarious image of Molly, dressed in drag, flanked by Angus Young and the late Bon Scott, during an early appearance. “Championing AC/DC since 1974,” the message reads.
paras.zh: 本土重摇滚巨头 AC/DC 是 Countdown 的常客，该节目在 1987 年之前共播出了 14 季。乐队在早期演出时分享了一张滑稽的照片，莫莉穿着变装，两侧是安格斯·杨 (Angus Young) 和已故的邦·斯科特 (Bon Scott)。消息中写道：“自 1974 年以来一直倡导 AC/DC。”

paras.en: Suzi Quatro remembered Molly as a “one off” and shared a poem for her friend. “The final countdown is over / this love we feel, it’s divine / a heavenly show needs a presenter / that is where ‘your’ light will always shine,” she writes. Peter Andre, the Australian pop singer who landed three No. 1 U.K. singles and a chart-topping album in just one year, 1996, thanked Molly for believing in his talents. “If it wasn’t for this man, I would not of (sic) had any of the chances I had to make it in any way in the entertainment industry back when it was near impossible to get noticed. He believed in me from day one and I am forever grateful to Ian ‘Molly’ Meldrum,” he writes. “I’ve had the chance over the last few years to call him many times and thank him for all he’s done. I was very happy I got to visit him recently at his home and reminisce about ‘the good ole days’. Molly did a lot for many people. A true icon, a friend. Someone I will miss dearly.”
paras.zh: 苏西·夸特罗 (Suzi Quatro) 记得莫莉是“一次性”，并为她的朋友分享了一首诗。 “最后的倒计时结束了/我们感受到了这种爱，它是神圣的/天堂般的表演需要一个主持人/那就是‘你的’光芒永远闪耀的地方，”她写道。澳大利亚流行歌手彼得·安德烈 (Peter Andre) 在 1996 年短短一年内就获得了三首英国单曲第一名和一张排行榜冠军专辑，他感谢莫莉相信他的才华。 “如果没有这个人，我就不会（原文如此）有任何机会在娱乐行业以任何方式取得成功，当时几乎不可能受到关注。他从第一天起就相信我，我永远感激伊恩·莫莉·梅尔德鲁姆，”他写道。 “在过去的几年里，我有机会多次给他打电话，感谢他所做的一切。我很高兴最近能去他家拜访他，回忆‘美好的旧时光’。莫莉为很多人做了很多事情。一个真正的偶像，一个朋友。我会非常想念的人。”

paras.en: Australia’s prime minister Anthony Albanese opened Question Time with a shoutout to Molly and his recounted his contributions to the music industry.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·艾博尼斯 (Anthony Albanese) 在提问时间开始向莫莉致敬，并讲述了他对音乐产业的贡献。

paras.en: “With an interview style that was inimitable and an enthusiasm that was uncontainable, Molly Meldrum loved music almost as much as we loved him,” the nation’s leader wrote in a separate post on X. “On Countdown and beyond, he championed Australian artists and brought international acts to our shores. He gave new artists a leg up and established artists a welcoming embrace. And over the years as he implored us to do ourselves a favour, he became a central part of the Australian soundtrack. We were lucky to have him. May Ian ‘Molly’ Meldrum rest in peace.”
paras.zh: 这位国家领导人在 X 上的另一篇文章中写道：“莫莉·梅尔德鲁姆（Molly Meldrum）以独特的采访风格和难以抑制的热情热爱音乐，几乎就像我们爱他一样。”“在倒计时及之后，他支持澳大利亚艺术家，并将国际表演带到我们的海岸。他为新艺术家提供支持，并欢迎老牌艺术家。多年来，当他恳求我们帮自己一个忙时，他成为澳大利亚配乐的核心部分。我们是愿伊恩·‘莫莉’·梅尔德鲁姆安息。”

paras.en: Meldrum was inducted into the ARIA Hall of Fame alongside Countdown in 2014, becoming the first inductees who weren’t recording artists. Just three years earlier, he suffered a life-changing head injury after falling from a ladder while putting up Christmas decorations at his home in Melbourne.
paras.zh: Meldrum 于 2014 年与 Countdown 一起入选 ARIA 名人堂，成为第一批非唱片艺术家的入选者。就在三年前，他在墨尔本的家中布置圣诞装饰品时从梯子上摔下来，头部受伤，改变了他的生活。

articles.title: ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Crowns Season 35 Champion
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Ezra Frech and Daniella Karagach shimmied off with the Len Goodman Mirrorball trophy after winning season 35 of ABC’s Dancing With The Stars.
paras.zh: 埃兹拉·弗雷奇 (Ezra Frech) 和丹妮拉·卡拉加奇 (Daniella Karagach) 在赢得 ABC 电视节目《与星共舞》第 35 季的冠军后，举起伦·古德曼镜球奖杯。

paras.en: In doing so, Frech, the two-time Paralympic gold medalist for Team U.S.A. in track and field, becomes the first amputee winner of the celebrity dance-off.
paras.zh: 两届残奥会田径美国队金牌得主弗雷奇由此成为名人舞蹈大赛中第一位截肢者获胜者。

paras.en: The finale episode on Tuesday night (Nov. 24) saw contestants compete in three rounds. First-up, the judges’ choice round, where each judge threw down the gauntlet by choosing the dance style for the final competitors. Next was the instant dance challenge, which meant the contestants needed to be fast learners, and quick on their feet.
paras.zh: 周二晚上（11 月 24 日）的最后一集，选手们进行了三轮比赛。首先是评委选择环节，每位评委都为最终选手选择了舞蹈风格。接下来是即时舞蹈挑战，这意味着参赛者需要快速学习，并且脚步敏捷。

paras.en: And finally, each couple contested the freestyle round — the make-or-break business end of the popular show.
paras.zh: 最后，每对情侣都参加了自由式比赛——这是这部流行节目的成败商业结局。

paras.en: The winning pair hit a freestyle soundtracked by Linkin Park’s “Numb.” Ezra began the number without his prosthetic on, and had a problem with it slipping during the routine. They recovered, and the judges loved it. Carrie Ann Inaba, Derek Hough and Bruno Tonioli awarded 30/30.
paras.zh: 获胜组合以 Linkin Park 的《Numb》为背景音乐即兴表演。埃兹拉在没有戴假肢的情况下开始了比赛，并且在训练过程中遇到了假肢滑动的问题。他们康复了，评委们也很喜欢。 Carrie Ann Inaba、Derek Hough 和 Bruno Tonioli 获得 30/30 分。

paras.en: They also nailed perfect scores for the instant dance challenge and judges’ choice, for an unbeatable night.
paras.zh: 他们还在即时舞蹈挑战和评委选择中获得了满分，打造了一个无与伦比的夜晚。

paras.en: In an earlier interview published in The Hollywood Reporter, Frech said it would be “very, very special” to become the first amputee winner of DWTS. “Of course, getting the opportunity to make the finale, to win the show, to get to represent the disabled community in that way and become the first amputee to win Dancing With the Stars would be very, very special, and would mean a lot to myself and hopefully to all people with disabilities and the community as a whole,” he remarked.
paras.zh: 在《好莱坞报道》早些时候发表的采访中，弗雷奇表示，成为 DWTS 第一位截肢者获奖者将“非常非常特别”。 “当然，有机会进入决赛，赢得比赛，以这种方式代表残疾人社区，并成为第一个赢得与星共舞的截肢者，这将是非常非常特别的，对我自己来说意义重大，希望对所有残疾人和整个社区也意义重大，”他说。

paras.en: After the final votes were counted, Amber Glenn and Pasha Pashkov came in second, with Connor Wood and Rylee Arnold completing the podium.
paras.zh: 最终计票结束后，安布尔·格伦和帕夏·帕什科夫获得第二名，康纳·伍德和莱利·阿诺德登上领奖台。

paras.en: Also during the final, season 34 winner Robert Irwin, son of the late Australian environmentalist Steve “Crocodile Hunter,” joined the broadcast to announce the return of Dancing With the Stars: The Next Pro, from which contestants will get a chance to join the season 36 cast.
paras.zh: 同样在决赛期间，第 34 季的冠军罗伯特·欧文（已故澳大利亚环保人士史蒂夫“鳄鱼猎人”的儿子）加入广播，宣布《与星共舞：下一个职业选手》回归，参赛者将有机会加入第 36 季的演员阵容。

paras.en: Watch Frech and Karagach’s “perfect” final efforts below.
paras.zh: 请观看下面弗雷奇和卡拉加奇“完美”的最后努力。

articles.title: 2 Chainz Shares Health Update After Cybertruck Crash, Reveals He Suffered Broken Ribs
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: 2 Chainz was involved in a frightening car accident, but assured fans he’s resting and doing OK while recovering. The Atlanta native posted footage of the gruesome scene that totaled his orange Tesla Cybertruck on Tuesday (Nov. 24), while also revealing he suffered broken ribs from the crash.
paras.zh: 2 Chainz 遭遇了一场可怕的车祸，但他向粉丝保证，他在康复过程中正在休息，一切都很好。这位亚特兰大本地人周二（11 月 24 日）发布了他的橙色特斯拉 Cyber​​truck 被撞毁的可怕场景的视频，同时还透露他在事故中肋骨骨折。

paras.en: Chainz claimed that there was no wrongdoing on his part and another driver swerved across the double-yellow line to avoid an opossum, which led to a head-on collision.
paras.zh: 查恩兹声称自己没有任何不当行为，另一名司机为躲避负鼠而突然转向越过双黄线，导致迎头相撞。

paras.en: “A lot of calls and concern on my well being , i appreciate everyone who reaching out , im good , just resting with broke ribs,” he wrote on IG. “No I wasn’t drinking,smoking ,sleeping or on auto pilot , the other driver dodged a possum and hit me head on , smh , hope that answers all of your questions , Blessed.”
paras.zh: 他在 IG 上写道：“接到了很多电话，对我的健康表示担忧，我感谢每一个伸出援手的人，我很好，只是肋骨骨折了。” “不，我没有喝酒，没有抽烟，没有睡觉，也没有开自动驾驶仪，另一位司机躲开了一只负鼠，迎头撞到了我，smh，希望这能回答你所有的问题，有福了。”

paras.en: Plenty of 2 Chainz’s hip-hop peers reached out to send their well-wishes following the accident. “Dam bro🙏🏽🙏🏽🙏🏽 Glad u was in the tank💪🏽 God Bless u,” DJ Paul wrote. “That other driver should’ve been on FSD, it saved my life a few times.”
paras.zh: 事故发生后，Chainz 的许多嘻哈同行纷纷伸出援手，送上祝福。 “兄弟🙏🏽🙏🏽🙏🏽 很高兴你在坦克里💪🏽 上帝保佑你，”DJ Paul 写道。 “另一个司机应该使用 FSD，它救了我好几次命。”

paras.en: DJ Premier added: “May Strength and Power be returned to your physical being. Glad it’s not worse!”
paras.zh: DJ Premier 补充道：“愿力量和力量回归你的身体。很高兴情况没有变得更糟！”

paras.en: Busta Rhymes said: “Blessings King. Grateful that you are good family. Prayers up, sending light and wishing you a speedy recovery family. We need you King.”
paras.zh: 布斯塔·莱姆斯说：“祝福国王。感谢你们是好家人。为你们祈祷，送去光明，祝愿你们一家早日康复。我们需要你们国王。”

paras.en: Mannie Fresh quipped: “Hope u didn’t mess up them polo pants lil brother!”
paras.zh: Mannie Fresh 打趣道：“希望你没有弄乱他们的马球裤，小兄弟！”

paras.en: The “No Lie” rapper posted on his Instagram Story hours later on Tuesday night, showing off the hefty amount of medication and painkilling pills he was prescribed, but had a wider message for fans about how easy it is for some to get hooked on pharmaceutical drugs like opioids.
paras.zh: 周二晚上，这位“No Lie”说唱歌手在他的 Instagram Story 上发帖，展示了他服用的大量药物和止痛药，但也向粉丝传达了一个更广泛的信息：有些人很容易对阿片类药物上瘾。

paras.en: “This what’s wrong with America right here,” he stated while taking a video of the pill bottle. “I had a little accident and they gave me all these. I guess they want me to become addicted to big pharma. You know the smaller they are, the more geeked you gon’ be. What I need all this s–t for?”
paras.zh: “这就是美国的问题所在，”他在拍摄药瓶视频时说道。 “我出了点小事故，他们给了我所有这些。我猜他们想让我对大型制药公司上瘾。你知道他们越小，你就越极客。我需要这些东西做什么？”

paras.en: The 46-year-old was involved in a scary car crash in Miami at Art Basel in December 2023, which resulted in him being hospitalized for his injuries.
paras.zh: 这位 46 岁的男子于 2023 年 12 月在迈阿密巴塞尔艺术展上遭遇了一场可怕的车祸，导致他受伤住院。

paras.en: On the music front, Chainz is gearing up for the release of his Playaz Only Live Once album, which is fully produced by Statik Selektah and arrives on Dec. 4. He’s released a trio of singles: “Reign,” “A Week in Paris” and “Situation” featuring Big Sean, Erykah Badu and Aasher Saintt.
paras.zh: 在音乐方面，Chainz 正准备发行他的 Playaz Only Live Once 专辑，该专辑由 Statik Selektah 完全制作，将于 12 月 4 日上市。他发行了三首单曲：“Reign”、“A Week in Paris”和“Situation”，与 Big Sean、Erykah Badu 和 Aasher Saintt 合作。

paras.en: The rest of the project is littered with star-studded appearances from the likes of Mary J. Blige, T.I., Leon Thomas, Cash Cobain, Young Nudy, Vory, Macy Gray, Westside Gunn, Muni Long, CeeLo Green, The-Dream, 6LACK and Dolla Boy.
paras.zh: 该项目的其余部分星光熠熠，包括 Mary J. Blige、T.I.、Leon Thomas、Cash Cobain、Young Nudy、Vory、Macy Gray、Westside Gunn、Muni Long、CeeLo Green、The-Dream、6LACK 和 Dolla Boy。

paras.en: 2 Chainz’s last solo album arrived with Dope Don’t Sell Itself in February 2022, which reached No. 23 on the Billboard 200. He teamed up with The Alchemist and Larry June for Life Is Beautiful in February 2025.
paras.zh: 2 Chainz 的上一张个人专辑于 2022 年 2 月发行，专辑《Dope Don’t Sell Itself》在 Billboard 200 排行榜上排名第 23 位。2025 年 2 月，他与 The Alchemist 和 Larry June 合作发行了《Life Is Beautiful》。

paras.en: Billboard has reached out to 2 Chainz’s reps for further comment.
paras.zh: Billboard 已联系 Chainz 的 2 名代表寻求进一步评论。

articles.title: Fubo Plans Now Include Free Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Unlimited and Fox One
articles.author: Erin Lassner

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: In an effort to combat industry-wide streaming inflation, Fubo has introduced a deal-savvy way to access additional services for your same dollar — four more services, to be exact.
paras.zh: 为了对抗全行业的流媒体通货膨胀，Fubo 推出了一种精明的交易方式，可以用同样的美元获得额外的服务——确切地说是另外四项服务。

paras.en: Following the standard free trial, Fubo Pro has a promotional rate of $63.99 for the first month, then costs $88.99 monthly thereafter, while Fubo Elite is $68.99 for the first month, then $98.99 monthly thereafter. The former features 201 channels, while the latter includes 265 channels and 4K.
paras.zh: 标准免费试用后，Fubo Pro 第一个月的促销价格为 63.99 美元，此后每月价格为 88.99 美元，而 Fubo Elite 第一个月的促销价格为 68.99 美元，此后每月价格为 98.99 美元。前者有201个频道，后者包括265个频道和4K。

paras.en: Related: Audible Subscriptions Drop to $1 Per Month for Black Friday
paras.zh: 相关：黑色星期五 Audible 订阅价格降至每月 1 美元

articles.title: ‘Dancing With the Stars: The Next Pro’ Renewed for Second Season
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Dancing With the Stars is going to find a new male professional dancer to add to its cast on the second season of The Next Pro.
paras.zh: 与星共舞将在《The Next Pro》第二季中寻找一位新的男性职业舞者加入其演员阵容。

paras.en: The spinoff series has been renewed for a second season, which will find a new male pro dancer to be added to the cast. It was announced during the season 35 finale of DWTS on Tuesday night.
paras.zh: 该衍生剧已续订第二季，演员阵容中将添加一位新的男性职业舞者。这是在周二晚上的 DWTS 第 35 季大结局中宣布的。

paras.en: Robert Irwin was present at the finale to announce the news, also revealing that fans will be paired with the eight prospective male pro dancers throughout The Next Pro.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·欧文 (Robert Irwin) 在决赛现场宣布了这一消息，并透露粉丝将在《The Next Pro》中与八位未来的男性职业舞者配对。

paras.en: Adele Zaikman was named the winner of the first season of DWTS: The Next Pro, which originally shot in Australia. It was unclear if the show would be renewed, as the pro cast of the series does not always consistently change each season, and dancers typically remain on the show for multiple seasons.
