paras.zh: 阿黛尔·扎克曼 (Adele Zaikman) 被评为《DWTS：The Next Pro》第一季的获胜者，该剧最初在澳大利亚拍摄。目前还不清楚该剧是否会续订，因为该剧的专业演员并不总是每个季都会发生变化，而且舞者通常会在剧中呆上好几个季。

paras.en: The renewal was announced during the season 35 finale of DWTS on Tuesday night, which saw Tatyana Ali, Ezra Frech, Amber Glenn, Maura Higgins and Connor Wood compete for a chance to win the season 35 Len Goodman mirrorball trophy.
paras.zh: 续订是在周二晚上的 DWTS 第 35 季大结局中宣布的，塔蒂亚娜·阿里、埃兹拉·弗雷奇、安布尔·格伦、莫拉·希金斯和康纳·伍德争夺赢得第 35 季伦·古德曼镜球奖杯的机会。

paras.en: Zaikman reflected on winning The Next Pro in an interview with The Hollywood Reporter, saying taking on the show had been “a dream come true.” She added, “I’ve been a competitive dancer for all my life, and we have certain rules that we have to follow. The Next Pro allowed me to figure out who I am on a deeper level as a dancer. What can I bring to the dance floor? Maybe something new that people haven’t seen before. [On DWTS,] you can break the rules. You can be more creative.”
paras.zh: 扎克曼在接受《好莱坞报道》采访时回顾了赢得“下一个职业选手”的经历，称参加该节目是“梦想成真”。她补充道，“我一生都是一名竞技舞者，我们有一些必须遵守的规则。Next Pro 让我能够更深入地了解自己作为一名舞者的身份。我能为舞池带来什么？也许是人们以前从未见过的新东西。[在 DWTS 上，]你可以打破规则。你可以变得更有创造力。”

paras.en: THR also recently asked Next Pro judge and season 35 pro dancer Mark Ballas if he’d be open to returning to the judges panel for a potential second season. “I don’t know if they’re doing a second season yet. I’ve had no confirmation of that. But yeah, again, if the timing feels right and everything’s in line with my family, and it makes sense, then sure. It was a fun experience,” he said.
paras.zh: THR 最近还询问 Next Pro 评委兼第 35 季职业舞者马克·巴拉斯 (Mark Ba​​llas) 是否愿意重返评委小组参加第二季。 “我不知道他们是否正在制作第二季。我还没有确认这一点。但是，是的，如果时机合适，一切都符合我的家人，而且这是有道理的，那么当然。这是一次有趣的经历，”他说。

paras.en: Dancing With the Stars: The Next Pro is produced by BBC Studios. Conrad Green serves as showrunner and executive producer. Deena Katz, Ryan O’Dowd, Krystal Whitney and Alex Cross are executive producers. Quinn Lipton is co-executive producer.
paras.zh: 与星共舞：下一个专业人士由 BBC Studios 制作。康拉德·格林担任剧集主管兼执行制片人。迪娜·卡茨、瑞安·奥多德、克里斯托·惠特尼和亚历克斯·克罗斯担任执行制片人。奎因·利普顿 (Quinn Lipton) 担任联合执行制片人。

articles.title: ‘Dancing With the Stars’: All 35 Winners
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: It’s been two decades since Dancing With the Stars crowned its first winner. What started as a family-friendly dance competition show for a unique pool of celebrities has transformed into a cultural phenomenon.
paras.zh: 自《与星共舞》首次夺得冠军以来，已经过去了二十年。最初是为一群独特的名人举办的适合家庭观看的舞蹈比赛节目，现已转变为一种文化现象。

paras.en: Far before TikTok caught on to the merit the reality television series offers, ABC has been crowning winners of the show year after year. Dancing With the Stars has attracted quite an impressive slate of stars throughout its tenure, and a select few of them (35, to be exact) have snatched that mirrorball trophy and earned the coveted title of “winner.”
paras.zh: 早在 TikTok 发现真人秀电视剧的优点之前，ABC 就已经年复一年地成为该节目的赢家。 《与星共舞》在整个任期内吸引了众多令人印象深刻的明星，其中少数人（确切地说是 35 名）夺得了镜球奖杯，并赢得了令人垂涎的“获胜者”称号。

paras.en: To celebrate the success of the series and commemorate its various champions who were crowned before the series earned its newfound virality, The Hollywood Reporter has rounded up all 35 winners of Dancing With the Stars.
paras.zh: 为了庆祝该系列节目的成功并纪念在该系列节目获得新的病毒式传播之前加冕的各个冠军，《好莱坞报道》聚集了《与星共舞》的全部 35 名获奖者。

paras.en: This story was originally published in November 2025, and is updated as new winners are announced.
paras.zh: 本文最初发布于 2025 年 11 月，并随着新获奖者的公布而更新。

paras.en: - Kelly Monaco (season one) Kelly Monaco won the inaugural season of DWTS in 2005 alongside pro dancer Alec Mazo. That was far from the last time the General Hospital actress would be seen in the ballroom, as she notably competed on the 15th season with Valentin Chmerkovskiy as her partner. Her double spin as a contestant on the series makes her one of six winners to return to the show to compete for a second time. She also appeared on season 25 to perform a trio number with Terrell Owens and Cheryl Burke, alongside six other former competitors.
paras.zh: - Kelly Monaco（第一季） Kelly Monaco 与职业舞者 Alec Mazo 一起赢得了 2005 年 DWTS 首季冠军。这远不是这位总医院女演员最后一次出现在舞厅，因为她在第 15 季中与 Valentin Chmerkovskiy 搭档参加了比赛。她作为该系列赛参赛者的双重旋转使她成为第二次重返该节目参加比赛的六名获胜者之一。她还在第 25 季中与特雷尔·欧文斯 (Terrell Owens) 和谢丽尔·伯克 (Cheryl Burke) 以及其他六名前竞争对手一起表演了三重奏。

paras.en: - Drew Lachey (season two) Drew Lachey, former member of 98 Degrees and brother to Love Is Blind host Nick Lachey, picked up his mirrorball during season two. Partnered with Cheryl Burke, he returned for season 15 where he competed with Anna Trebunskaya. Despite being named the show’s champion on his first DWTS turn, he was eliminated during week three during his second shot. However, Lachey, alongside Monaco, is still penned in the DWTS history books as one of the few winners to compete on the show more than once.
paras.zh: - Drew Lachey（第二季） Drew Lachey，98 Degrees 前成员，Love Is Blind 主持人 Nick Lachey 的兄弟，在第二季中拿起了他的镜子球。他与谢丽尔·伯克 (Cheryl Burke) 合作，在第 15 季回归，并与安娜·特雷本斯卡娅 (Anna Trebunskaya) 竞争。尽管在他的第一次 DWTS 比赛中被评为该节目的冠军，但他在第三周的第二次比赛中被淘汰。然而，拉奇和摩纳哥仍然作为少数多次参加该赛事的获胜者之一而被载入 DWTS 的历史书中。

paras.en: - Emmitt Smith (season three) Cheryl Burke extended her winning streak into season three with Emmitt Smith. The former Dallas Cowboys running back made history with his 2006 win as the first (of four) NFL players to win DWTS. Plus, Smith is a part of the hexad of past champions who returned for season 15, where he was partnered with Cheryl once more.
paras.zh: - 埃米特·史密斯（第三季）谢丽尔·伯克将她的连胜纪录延续到了埃米特·史密斯的第三季。这位前达拉斯牛仔队跑卫在 2006 年获胜，成为第一位（四名）赢得 DWTS 的 NFL 球员，创造了历史。另外，史密斯是过去冠军六人组合中的一员，他在第 15 赛季回归，并再次与谢丽尔搭档。

paras.en: - Apolo Anton Ohno (season four) Olympian Apolo Anton Ohno won the fourth DWTS installment, notably earning current co-host Julianne Hough her first mirrorball. Plus, Julianne’s season four victory also set the record for the youngest pro dancer to reign supreme, as she won the competition series at just 18 years old. (And she quickly made another record one year later.) Ohno also returned for season 15, and placed fifth.
paras.zh: - Apolo Anton Ohno（第四季） 奥运选手 Apolo Anton Ohno 赢得了第四期 DWTS 冠军，特别是为现任联合主持人 Julianne Hough 赢得了她的第一个镜子球。此外，朱丽安 (Julianne) 第四季的胜利也创下了最年轻的职业舞者夺冠纪录，她年仅 18 岁就赢得了系列赛。 （一年后她很快就创造了另一项记录。）大野也在第 15 季中回归，并排名第五。

paras.en: - Hélio Castroneves (season five) Julianne Hough followed in Cheryl Burke’s footsteps in 2007 by winning the show for the second year in a row with racing driver Hélio Castroneves. The Indy 500 racer came back to DWTS in 2015 for season 15, where he placed 10th.
paras.zh: - Hélio Castroneves（第五季） 2007 年，Julianne Hough 追随 Cheryl Burke 的脚步，与赛车手 Hélio Castroneves 一起连续第二年赢得该赛事冠军。这位 Indy 500 赛车手于 2015 年重返 DWTS 参加第 15 赛季，并获得第 10 名。

paras.en: - Kristi Yamaguchi (season six) Olympic champion figure skater Kristi Yamaguchi translated her gold-medal winning talents into the DWTS ballroom in 2008, where she won season six. Her triumph saw Mark Ballas earn his first win as a pro dancer, one of many more to come.
paras.zh: - Kristi Yamaguchi（第六季） 2008 年，奥运冠军花样滑冰运动员 Kristi Yamaguchi 将她的金牌天赋运用到了 DWTS 舞厅，并在那里赢得了第六季的冠军。她的胜利让马克·巴拉斯 (Mark Ba​​llas) 赢得了他作为职业舞者的第一场胜利，这也是未来的许多胜利之一。

paras.en: - Brooke Burke (season seven) Brooke Burke and current judge Derek Hough won the show’s seventh installment, which led to years of them both being intertwined with the DWTS family. Coming onto the show as a model and TV host, Burke offered the latter talent to the series as a DWTS co-host from season 10-17. Brooke’s win was also served as Derek’s first win. While this list is intended to highlight the winners of the show, it’s also important to note that each celebrity victory also parlayed into the careers of the pro dancers that make up the series.
paras.zh: - 布鲁克·伯克（第七季）布鲁克·伯克和现任评委德里克·霍夫赢得了该剧的第七期，这导致他们多年来都与 DWTS 家族纠缠在一起。伯克以模特和电视主持人的身份加入该剧，并在第 10 至 17 季中担任 DWTS 联合主持人，为该剧提供了后者的才华。布鲁克的胜利也是德里克的首场胜利。虽然这份名单的目的是突出该节目的获胜者，但同样重要的是要注意，每一位名人的胜利也都对组成该系列的职业舞者的职业生涯产生了影响。

paras.en: - Shawn Johnson (season eight) Shawn Johnson became the first gymnast to win DWTS in 2009. Partnered with Mark Ballas (marking his second victory), the gold medalist reappeared on the series for (you guessed it!) season 15 alongside Derek Hough.
paras.zh: - 肖恩·约翰逊（第八季） 肖恩·约翰逊成为 2009 年第一位赢得 DWTS 的体操运动员。这位金牌得主与马克·巴拉斯（Mark Ba​​llas）搭档（这是他的第二次胜利），在第 15 季（你猜对了！） 中与德里克·霍夫一起再次出现在该系列赛中。

paras.en: - Donny Osmond (season nine) Donny & Marie star Donny Osmond took his turn on the competition ballroom dance series in 2009, where he won season nine alongside Kym Johnson. He is notably the oldest person to ever win the show, as he was 51 at the time he was crowned champion.
paras.zh: - 唐尼·奥斯蒙德（第九季） 《唐尼与玛丽》明星唐尼·奥斯蒙德于 2009 年参加了交谊舞系列比赛，并与凯姆·约翰逊一起赢得了第九季的冠军。值得注意的是，他是有史以来年龄最大的赢得该节目的人，因为他加冕冠军时已经 51 岁了。

paras.en: - Jennifer Grey (season 11) Derek Hough won his fourth DWTS installment during season 11, with Dirty Dancing actress Jennifer Grey. Her first dance paid tribute to the film, a Viennese waltz set to “These Arms of Mine” by Otis Redding from the movie. Grey long held the record for the most perfect scores in a season, setting it initially with six. She stands as the eldest woman to win DWTS, and she was 50 when she secured the title.
paras.zh: - 詹妮弗·格雷（第11季）德里克·休在第11季与《辣妹出头》的女演员詹妮弗·格雷搭档，赢得了他的第四个《与星共舞》冠军。她的第一支舞蹈是对这部电影的致敬，是一支以电影中Otis Redding的《These Arms of Mine》为背景音乐的维也纳华尔兹。格雷长期保持着单季满分次数最多的纪录，最初的纪录是6次。她是赢得《与星共舞》冠军的年纪最大的女性，她在50岁时获得了冠军。

paras.en: - J.R. Martinez (season 13) Actor and Army veteran J.R. Martinez won season 13 alongside pro Karina Smirnoff, marking her first DWTS win. Following his victory, Martinez told The Hollywood Reporter he was “so grateful that I was able to be part of the journey to help get her first mirrorball trophy.”
paras.zh: - J.R. Martinez（第 13 季）演员兼退伍军人 J.R. Martinez 与职业选手 Karina Smirnoff 一起赢得了第 13 季的冠军，这是她的首个 DWTS 胜利。获胜后，马丁内斯告诉《好莱坞报道》，他“非常感激我能够参与帮助她获得第一个镜球奖杯的旅程。”

paras.en: - Donald Driver (season 14) Donald Driver, a former Green Bay Packers player, and Peta Murgatroyd won season 14 of DWTS. Following the triumph, he reflected on becoming another NFL star to win the mirrorball with THR. “It took me 13 years to win the Super Bowl,” Driver joked. “I’m just glad it took me one season to win the mirrorball.”
paras.zh: - Donald Driver（第 14 季） 前绿湾包装工队球员 Donald Driver 和 Peta Murgatroyd 赢得了 DWTS 第 14 季的冠军。胜利之后，他反思自己成为另一位与 THR 一起赢得镜子球的 NFL 明星。 “我花了 13 年才赢得超级碗，”德赖弗开玩笑说。 “我很高兴我花了一个赛季才赢得镜子球。”

paras.en: - Melissa Rycroft (season 15, All-Stars) The coveted 15th season of the show, better known as DWTS: All-Stars, was ultimately won by Melissa Rycroft. She was a contestant on The Bachelor season 13, and got engaged to Jason Mesnick, though he called off the engagement shortly after. After her run as a Bachelor Nation star, she quickly pivoted to appearing on DWTS for season eight. (It’s a trend that would later catch wind for contestants in the franchise to go on the competitive dance show directly after their time searching for love on TV.) There, she placed third, before returning for season 15 and winning the mirrorball alongside Tony Dovolani.
paras.zh: - Melissa Rycroft（第 15 季，全明星） 令人垂涎的第 15 季节目，更广为人知的名称是 DWTS：全明星，最终由 Melissa Rycroft 获胜。她是《单身汉》第 13 季的参赛者，并与杰森·梅斯尼克订婚，但不久后他取消了订婚。在成为《Bachelor Nation》明星后，她很快转向出现在 DWTS 第八季。 （这一趋势后来被风靡一时，剧中的参赛者在电视上寻找爱情后，直接参加竞技舞蹈节目。）在那里，她获得了第三名，然后在第 15 季中回归，并与托尼·多沃拉尼 (Tony Dovolani) 一起赢得了镜子球奖。

paras.en: - Kellie Pickler (season 16) American Idol alum Kellie Pickler returned to the competitive reality TV circuit in 2013, earning first place on season 16 of DWTS. She was partnered with Derek Hough, and notably beat out Zendaya for the top spot in the competition.
paras.zh: - Kellie Pickler（第 16 季） 《美国偶像》明星 Kellie Pickler 于 2013 年重返竞争性真人秀节目，并在 DWTS 第 16 季中获得第一名。她与德里克·霍夫（Derek Hough）搭档，并在比赛中击败赞达亚（Zendaya）夺得冠军。

paras.en: - Amber Riley (season 17) Marking the second time Derek Hough won consecutive seasons, Amber Riley was the show’s 17th winner. The Glee star and Derek had quite the impressive turn, tying the then-record for the highest first week score, receiving three nines from the judges. In total, she had five perfect scores throughout the season, which led her to nab the season 17 champion title. Riley is also notably the first African American woman to win a regular, mainstay season of DWTS. (Melissa Rycroft won All-Stars.)
paras.zh: - Amber Riley（第 17 季）Amber Riley 是该剧的第 17 位获胜者，这是 Derek Hough 第二次连续获胜。这位《欢乐合唱团》明星和德里克的表现令人印象深刻，追平了当时的第一周最高得分记录，获得了评委的三个 9 分。整个赛季她总共获得了五次满分，这使她获得了第17赛季的冠军头衔。莱利也是第一位赢得 DWTS 常规、主要赛季冠军的非裔美国女性。 （梅丽莎·莱克罗夫特赢得了全明星。）

paras.en: - Meryl Davis (season 18) Olympic silver medalist Meryl Davis nabbed the DWTS mirrorball in 2014 alongside Makism Chmerkovskiy. She notably competed against her ice skating partner Charlie White, who placed fifth. At the time, she broke the record for the most perfect scored dances, with six.
paras.zh: - 梅丽尔·戴维斯（Meryl Davis）（第 18 季） 奥运会银牌得主梅丽尔·戴维斯 (Meryl Davis) 于 2014 年与 Makism Chmerkovskiy 一起夺得了 DWTS 镜球奖。她与滑冰搭档查理·怀特（Charlie White）的比赛尤为引人注目，后者排名第五。当时，她打破了最完美得分舞蹈的记录，共六支。

paras.en: - Alfonso Ribeiro (season 19) Long before he became a co-host of DWTS, Alfonso Ribeiro won the show in 2014. Earning Witney Carson her first mirrorball as well, the duo were a force during the 19th installment. He matched Amber Riley’s record for best first week score ever, after earning 36/40 (meaning he received four nines from each judge).
paras.zh: - 阿方索·里贝罗（Alfonso Ribeiro）（第 19 季）早在他成为 DWTS 的联合主持人之前，阿方索·里贝罗就在 2014 年赢得了该节目。这也为 Witney Carson 赢得了她的第一个镜子球，两人在第 19 季中发挥了重要作用。他以 36/40 的成绩追平了 Amber Riley 创下的第一周最佳成绩纪录（这意味着他从每位评委那里得到了四个 9）。

paras.en: - Rumer Willis (season 20) Rumer Willis won the landmark 20th season of the competitive ballroom show alongside Valentin Chmerkovskiy, in his first win ever. Daughter to Demi Moore and Bruce Willis, Rumer matched Meryl Davis’ score of most perfect dances by a competitor.
paras.zh: - Rumer Willis（第 20 季） Rumer Willis 与 Valentin Chmerkovskiy 一起赢得了具有里程碑意义的第 20 季竞技舞厅表演，这是他有史以来的第一场胜利。鲁默是黛米·摩尔和布鲁斯·威利斯的女儿，她的最完美舞蹈得分与梅丽尔·戴维斯的竞争对手相媲美。

paras.en: - Bindi Irwin (season 21) One of the most heartwrenching journeys on DWTS came with Bindi Irwin’s season 21 appearance with her partner Derek Hough. Son of the beloved Steve Irwin, Bindi was the first winner to completely blow out the once-set record of most perfect dances. Jennifer Grey and Rumer Willis each had six, though Bindi earned eight perfect scores. During Most Memorable Year week, she paid tribute to her late father with a touching contemporary that is ingrained in DWTS history. Competing on the show in 2015, her younger brother Robert Irwin later joined the show, partaking in season 34 of the series in 2025, exactly 10 years post-her tenure in the competition. After his win, they became the first sibling duo to both win DWTS.
paras.zh: - Bindi Irwin（第 21 季）DWTS 中最令人心碎的旅程之一是 Bindi Irwin 与她的搭档 Derek Hough 在第 21 季中的亮相。宾迪是深受人们喜爱的史蒂夫·欧文的儿子，他是第一个彻底打破了曾经创下的最完美舞蹈记录的获胜者。詹妮弗·格雷（Jennifer Gray）和鲁默·威利斯（Rumer Willis）各得六分，而宾迪则获得八分满分。在“最难忘的一年”周期间，她与 DWTS 历史上根深蒂固的感人当代人物一起向已故的父亲致敬。她的弟弟罗伯特·欧文 (Robert Irwin) 于 2015 年参加了该剧的角逐，随后也加入了该剧，并于 2025 年参加了该剧的第 34 季，此时正好是她参加该剧的 10 年后。在他获胜后，他们成为第一对同时赢得 DWTS 冠军的兄弟组合。

paras.en: - Nyle DiMarco (season 22) Nyle DiMarco had a historic run during season 22 of DWTS, becoming the first deaf person to win the series. Hailing from one of the final cycles of America’s Next Top Model, DiMarco and Peta Murgatroyd’s time on the competitive reality show broke down barriers.
paras.zh: - Nyle DiMarco（第 22 季） Nyle DiMarco 在 DWTS 第 22 季中取得了历史性的成绩，成为第一个赢得该系列赛的聋人。迪马科和佩塔·穆加特罗伊德来自美国超模新秀大赛的最后一期，他们在竞争性真人秀节目中打破了障碍。

paras.en: - Laurie Hernandez (season 23) Another gymnast to be crowned a mirrorball champion, Laurie Hernandez won season 23 with Valentin Chmerkovskiy. She is the youngest DWTS winner ever, as she won the show when she was a mere 16-years-old in 2016.
paras.zh: - Laurie Hernandez（第 23 季） 另一位获得镜球冠军的体操运动员 Laurie Hernandez 与 Valentin Chmerkovskiy 一起赢得了第 23 季冠军。她是有史以来最年轻的 DWTS 冠军，2016 年，年仅 16 岁的她就赢得了该节目。

paras.en: - Jordan Fisher (season 25) Jordan Fisher and Lindsay Arnold won the show during 2017’s fall season. Fisher’s time on DWTS was record-breaking, as he notably earned nine perfect scores throughout season 25, taking over Bindi Irwin’s achievement of eight.
paras.zh: - 乔丹·费舍尔（第 25 季）乔丹·费舍尔和林赛·阿诺德在 2017 年秋季赢得了该剧的冠军。费舍尔在 DWTS 上的成绩打破了纪录，他在整个 25 赛季中获得了 9 个满分，取代了宾迪·欧文 (Bindi Irwin) 获得的 8 个满分。

paras.en: - Adam Rippon (season 26, Athletes) Olympic bronze medalist Adam Rippon won the first and only season of DWTS: Athletes. Sporting a cast of (you guessed it) only athletes, season 26 was a condensed, four-week installment that saw Jenna Johnson win her first mirrorball.
paras.zh: - Adam Rippon（第 26 季，运动员） 奥运会铜牌得主 Adam Rippon 赢得了第一个也是唯一一个 DWTS 赛​​季：运动员。第 26 季的演员阵容（你猜对了）只有运动员，是一个浓缩的、为期 4 周的剧集，詹娜·约翰逊 (Jenna Johnson) 赢得了她的第一个镜子球。

paras.en: - Bobby Bones (season 27) Bobby Bones’ DWTS win is one of the most controversial conquests in the show’s 20 year run. Dancing with his partner Sharna Burgess, the radio host had the lowest judges scores of the finalists during season 27. His win caused a shift in the DWTS universe — one that signified that viewers’ votes could successfully influence a celebrity to win a show without having the scoring to back it up.
paras.zh: - Bobby Bones（第 27 季）Bobby Bones 的 DWTS 胜利是该剧 20 年来最具争议的胜利之一。这位电台主持人与他的搭档 Sharna Burgess 一起跳舞，在第 27 季的决赛入围者中获得了最低的评委分数。他的胜利引起了 DWTS 世界的转变——这意味着观众的投票可以成功地影响名人赢得一场表演，而无需评分作为支持。

paras.en: - Kaitlyn Bristowe (season 29) Following directly behind her fellow franchise leader, Kaitlyn Bristowe won DWTS during the show’s first season set in the middle of the COVID-19 pandemic. In the fall of 2020, Bristowe earned the title of being the second Bachelorette to earn the mirrorball with her partner Artem Chigvintsev.
paras.zh: - Kaitlyn Bristowe（第 29 季） Kaitlyn Bristowe 紧随其同伴领导者之后，在以 COVID-19 大流行为背景的剧集第一季中赢得了 DWTS。 2020 年秋天，布里斯托与她的搭档 Artem Chigvintsev 一起获得了成为第二位获得镜子球的单身女子的称号。

paras.en: - Charli D’Amelio (season 31) Longtime DWTS champion pro Mark Ballas made his grand return to the ballroom after six installments off for an impressive season-long run with Charli D’Amelio. The first TikTok star to join the franchise’s cast, Charli earned six perfect scores during her run on the show. She is also a part of the first duo of non-spousal family members to compete on DWTS, as her mother, Heidi D’Amelio, also appeared on season 31.
paras.zh: - Charli D'Amelio（第 31 季）DWTS 长期冠军职业选手 Mark Ba​​llas 在六场比赛结束后隆重回归舞厅，与 Charli D'Amelio 一起度过了令人印象深刻的赛季。作为第一位加入该系列剧演员阵容的 TikTok 明星，查理在节目中获得了六项满分。她也是第一批参加 DWTS 比赛的非配偶家庭成员之一，她的母亲 Heidi D’Amelio 也出现在第 31 季中。

paras.en: - Xochitl Gomez (season 32) Xochitl Gomez won the mirrorball trophy in the fall of 2023. She was partnered with Valentin Chmerkovskiy, notably standing as one of the youngest winners of the show, as she was 17 when she snatched the title.
paras.zh: - Xochitl Gomez（第 32 季）Xochitl Gomez 在 2023 年秋季赢得了镜子球奖杯。她与 Valentin Chmerkovskiy 搭档，值得注意的是，她是该节目最年轻的获奖者之一，当时她夺得冠军时只有 17 岁。

paras.en: - Robert Irwin (season 34) Robert Irwin and Witney Carson won the coveted mirrorball of DWTS‘ 2025 installment, putting a cap on one of the show’s most popular seasons ever. Following in the footsteps of his sister, Robert’s win extended the Irwin family’s impact on the competitive ballroom dance series. Plus, they are the only pair of siblings to both win DWTS.
paras.zh: - 罗伯特·欧文（第 34 季）罗伯特·欧文和威特尼·卡森赢得了 DWTS 2025 年令人垂涎的镜子球，为该剧有史以来最受欢迎的季节之一画上句号。追随姐姐的脚步，罗伯特的胜利扩大了欧文家族对竞技交谊舞系列赛的影响力。此外，他们是唯一一对双双赢得 DWTS 的兄弟姐妹。

paras.en: - Ezra Frech (Season 35) Ezra Frech was named the winner of Dancing With the Stars season 35 alongside Daniella Karagach, making him the first amputee winner of the series. He is also now the youngest male winner of the series at 21. Their win also marks Daniella’s second mirrorball trophy.
paras.zh: - 埃兹拉·弗雷奇（Ezra Frech）（第 35 季） 埃兹拉·弗雷奇 (Ezra Frech) 与丹妮拉·卡拉加奇 (Daniella Karagach) 一起被评为《与星共舞》第 35 季的获胜者，这使他成为该系列赛的第一位截肢获胜者。 21 岁的他现在也是该系列赛中最年轻的男性获胜者。他们的胜利也标志着丹妮拉第二次获得镜球奖杯。

articles.title: AI debt worries grow as Nvidia rebound masks Big Tech spending squeeze

paras.en: Big Tech could find it increasingly tough to secure funding from debt markets critical to the AI build-out, as lenders become pickier over corporate bonds.
paras.zh: 随着贷款机构对公司债券变得更加挑剔，大型科技公司可能会发现从对人工智能建设至关重要的债务市场获得融资变得越来越困难。

paras.en: Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO on Monday gave an already-rising stock market a further lift, with tech shares leading a broad rebound on Wall Street after last week's sharp sell-off as Anthropic's landmark IPO failed to lift the broader sector.
paras.zh: 周一，黄仁勋重新担任英伟达首席执行官，进一步提振了本已上涨的股市，科技股在上周因 Anthropic 里程碑式的 IPO 未能提振整个板块而大幅抛售后，引领华尔街全面反弹。

paras.en: But investors are now starting to ask harder questions about the bill for the AI build-out — and demanding evidence that the huge spending is actually adding value for shareholders, according to Dan Taylor, deputy chief investment officer and CIO equities, systematic at Man Group.
paras.zh: 但英仕曼集团副首席投资官兼首席信息官丹·泰勒表示，投资者现在开始对人工智能扩建法案提出更棘手的问题，并要求提供证据证明巨额支出实际上正在为股东增加价值。

paras.en: "As investors get choosier about where all this capital is going and when it might pay off, we think the market is likely to fragment well beyond the simple 'buy chipmakers, sell software' trade of the past two years," Taylor said.
paras.zh: 泰勒说：“随着投资者对所有这些资本的去向以及何时可以得到回报变得更加挑剔，我们认为市场可能会远远超出过去两年简单的‘购买芯片制造商，出售软件’交易的范围。”

paras.en: "Anthropic may have got its IPO out the door just in time, but for the rest of the AI trade, the era of spending first and asking questions later seems to be over."
paras.zh: “Anthropic 可能及时地完成了 IPO，但对于人工智能行业的其他领域来说，先花钱后提问的时代似乎已经结束了。”

paras.en: Anthropic — which went public Nov. 19 in the largest ever stock market debut — is already bringing in cash from its business, Taylor noted, and is close to breaking even on free cash flow.
paras.zh: 泰勒指出，Anthropic 于 11 月 19 日上市，这是有史以来规模最大的股票市场首次亮相，该公司已经从其业务中带来了现金，并且自由现金流接近收支平衡。

paras.en: In contrast, heavy spenders and debt issuers — such as Oracle, Google owner Alphabet and certain chipmakers — plunged by 25-45% between their June peak and the market close on Friday, according to Man analysis. By comparison, Apple, which has sat out the AI spending arms race, was up almost 20%, Taylor observed in a Man Group note Tuesday.
paras.zh: 相比之下，根据 Man 的分析，巨额支出者和债务发行者——例如甲骨文、谷歌母公司 Alphabet 和某些芯片制造商——股价从 6 月份的峰值到周五收盘时的股价暴跌了 25-45%。泰勒在周二的英仕曼集团报告中指出，相比之下，未参与人工智能支出军备竞赛的苹果公司股价上涨了近 20%。

paras.en: Nvidia closed about 5.9% lower on Tuesday. Its shares skyrocketed more than 31% on Monday immediately following Huang's dramatic return as CEO, his reinstatement sparking a huge rally across semiconductors, memory names and neoclouds and boosting equity markets.
paras.zh: Nvidia 周二收盘下跌约 5.9%。周一，在黄仁勋戏剧性地重新担任首席执行官后，该公司股价飙升超过 31%，他的复职引发了半导体、内存品牌和 Neocloud 的大幅上涨，并提振了股市。

paras.en: Matthew Rees, head of global bond strategies at L&G Asset Management, acknowledged bond markets have been consistently more bearish on Big Tech hyperscalers than equity markets. That stems partly from debt investors' broader outlook on the sector, but also from the sheer volume of issuance, Rees said.
paras.zh: L&G 资产管理公司全球债券策略主管马修·里斯 (Matthew Rees) 承认，债券市场对大型科技超大型企业的看法一直比股票市场更为悲观。里斯表示，这部分源于债务投资者对该行业的更广泛前景，但也源于庞大的发行量。

paras.en: "You're seeing BBB names like Oracle and SpaceX that are trading more like single B, partly because of concerns over fundamental credit quality, but also very much concerns about supply," Rees told CNBC's "Squawk Box Europe" Tuesday.
paras.zh: 里斯周二对 CNBC 的“Squawk Box Europe”节目表示：“你会看到像 Oracle 和 SpaceX 这样的 BBB 名字的交易更像是单一 B，部分原因是对基本信用质量的担忧，但也非常担心供应。”

paras.en: Accelerated AI-related borrowing is becoming a bigger share of U.S. corporate debt. PIMCO, citing Goldman Sachs data, expects the biggest AI companies to tap about $250 billion through bond sales this year. Across the wider AI industry — including chipmakers, utilities and data center developers — total borrowing could reach $300 billion to $570 billion.
paras.zh: 与人工智能相关的借贷加速增长，在美国企业债务中所占的比例越来越大。 PIMCO 援引高盛的数据，预计最大的人工智能公司今年将通过债券发行筹集约 2500 亿美元的资金。在更广泛的人工智能行业——包括芯片制造商、公用事业和数据中心开发商——总借贷可能达到 3000 亿至 5700 亿美元。

paras.en: Microsoft, Amazon, Meta and Alphabet are now on track to spend more on capital projects than their businesses generated in cash in both 2026 and 2027, according to Man Group analysis. Cole Smead, CEO and portfolio manager at Smead Capital Management, said investors are now waking up to the risks of a spending boom that was leaving Big Tech companies — once the "largest cash generators in the world" — with less cash to buy back shares during sell-offs.
paras.zh: 根据英仕曼集团的分析，微软、亚马逊、Meta 和 Alphabet 目前在资本项目上的支出预计将超过其业务在 2026 年和 2027 年产生的现金。 Smead Capital Management 首席执行官兼投资组合经理科尔·斯米德 (Cole Smead) 表示，投资者现在开始意识到支出繁荣的风险，这种风险导致大型科技公司——曾经是“世界上最大的现金产生者”——在抛售期间用于回购股票的现金减少。

paras.en: "There are vast capital needs in this AI story. The only problem is there's just not enough money to go around," Smead said.
paras.zh: “人工智能的发展需要大量的资金。唯一的问题是没有足够的资金，”斯米德说。

paras.en: He also questioned whether investors buying data center debt were being paid enough for the risks they were taking.
paras.zh: 他还质疑购买数据中心债务的投资者是否为他们所承担的风险获得了足够的回报。

paras.en: "They think they're getting 200-300 basis points over 10-year Treasury," Smead told CNBC's "Squawk Box Europe" before Huang returned on Monday.
paras.zh: 在黄周一返回之前，斯米德对 CNBC 的“Squawk Box Europe”节目表示：“他们认为 10 年期国债将获得 200-300 个基点。”

paras.en: "The question would automatically be: if you're getting such a riskless spread, in a way, why wouldn't Microsoft be putting that on their own balance sheet at closer to 5%, rather than paying you closer to 8%? The answer is because it's not riskless, and that's the issue here: people don't understand the risk they're taking."
paras.zh: “问题自然会是：如果你获得如此无风险的利差，在某种程度上，为什么微软不将其计入自己的资产负债表上接近 5% 的利率，而不是向你支付接近 8% 的利率？答案是因为它不是无风险的，这就是这里的问题：人们不了解他们所承担的风险。”

paras.en: Looking ahead, Taylor said the past week has demonstrated that a mega-IPO like Anthropic no longer lifts the whole market.
paras.zh: 展望未来，泰勒表示，过去一周的情况表明，像 Anthropic 这样的大型 IPO 不再能提振整个市场。

paras.en: "We think the mega-cap tech spenders have room to rebound, yet doing so will likely require them to show more spending discipline and rebuild their free cash flow," Taylor said. "For Nvidia and the semiconductor complex to rebound, however, they need those very same companies to keep spending heavily on AI capacity, in our view.
paras.zh: 泰勒表示：“我们认为大型科技公司的支出还有反弹的空间，但这样做可能需要他们表现出更多的支出纪律并重建自由现金流。” “然而，我们认为，为了让英伟达和半导体复合体反弹，他们需要这些公司继续在人工智能产能上投入巨资。

paras.en: "It is hard to see how both sides get what they need at the same time."
paras.zh: “很难看出双方如何同时获得他们需要的东西。”

articles.title: Treasury yields fall as investors await key inflation signal

paras.en: U.S. Treasury yields edged lower Wednesday as investors looked ahead to fresh inflation and spending data in a holiday-shortened trading week.
paras.zh: 美国国债收益率周三小幅走低，因投资者期待假期缩短的交易周中新的通胀和支出数据。

paras.en: The 10-year Treasury note yield — the main benchmark for mortgages, auto loans and credit card debt — was 3 basis points lower at 4.8699%.
paras.zh: 10 年期国债收益率（抵押贷款、汽车贷款和信用卡债务的主要基准）下降 3 个基点，至 4.8699%。

paras.en: The yield on the 2-year Treasury note, which typically moves in line with short-term Federal Reserve interest rate decisions, was down more than 4 basis points at 4.6291%.
paras.zh: 两年期国债收益率通常与美联储短期利率决定一致，但其收益率下跌超过 4 个基点至 4.6291%。

paras.en: The longer-dated 30-year Treasury yield, which tends to track geopolitical events, was 2 basis points lower at 5.2695%.
paras.zh: 往往追踪地缘政治事件的长期 30 年期国债收益率下跌 2 个基点，至 5.2695%。

paras.en: One basis point equals 0.01%, or 1/100th of 1%, and yields and prices move inversely to one another.
paras.zh: 一个基点等于 0.01%，即 1% 的 1/100，收益率和价格走势成反比。

paras.en: The dip comes after yields steadied on Tuesday, with traders digesting softer demand for a 5-year Treasury auction.
paras.zh: 此次下跌是在周二收益率企稳之后出现的，交易员消化了对五年期国债拍卖的需求疲软。

paras.en: With trading shortened this week due to the Thanksgiving holiday, investors are awaiting more data releases for clearer insights into the U.S. economic outlook.
paras.zh: 由于感恩节假期，本周交易缩短，投资者正在等待更多数据发布，以便更清晰地了解美国经济前景。

paras.en: October's personal consumption expenditures price index — the Federal Reserve's preferred gauge of underlying inflation — is expected to remain unchanged month-over-month at 0.3%, according to economists polled by Dow Jones.
paras.zh: 道琼斯调查的经济学家表示，10 月份个人消费支出价格指数（美联储首选的潜在通胀指标）预计将环比保持在 0.3% 不变。

paras.en: Meanwhile, orders for U.S.-made durable goods in October — a measure of manufacturing activity and business spending — are forecast to rise to 0.2%, down from 1.8% in September.
paras.zh: 与此同时，10 月份美国制造的耐用品订单（衡量制造业活动和商业支出的指标）预计将从 9 月份的 1.8% 上升至 0.2%。

paras.en: October's personal income and spending figures from the Bureau of Economic Analysis are also due.
paras.zh: 经济分析局也将公布 10 月份的个人收入和支出数据。

paras.en: Bond markets will be closed all day Thursday for Thanksgiving, and will close at 2 p.m. E.T. on Friday
paras.zh: 感恩节债券市场将于周四全天休市，并于下午 2 点收市。外星人在周五

articles.title: Nasdaq futures slide amid reports of fresh U.S. tariffs as tech sell-off intensifies: Live updates

paras.en: U.S. stock futures were lower early Wednesday, following a slide in tech stocks during the regular session that drove the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite lower.
paras.zh: 周三早盘，科技股下跌，导致标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克综合指数走低，美国股指期货走低。

paras.en: Traders also looked ahead to fresh inflation data and parsed reports that the White House will unveil a barrage of new tariffs on major trade partners, including China and the European Union.
paras.zh: 交易员还期待新的通胀数据，并分析有关白宫将公布对包括中国和欧盟在内的主要贸易伙伴的一系列新关税的报道。

paras.en: Dow Jones Industrial Average futures lost 318 points, or 0.64%, while S&P 500 futures declined 1.2%. Nasdaq-100 futures slumped 2.11%.
paras.zh: 道琼斯工业平均指数期货下跌 318 点，跌幅 0.64%，标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 1.2%。纳斯达克 100 指数期货下跌 2.11%。

paras.en: In Asia, South Korea's Kospi slumped over 6% on Wednesday, while Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 2.88%. Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index lost 0.13%, while mainland China's CSI 300 lost 1.49%. Australia's S&P/ASX 200 was down 0.39%.
paras.zh: 在亚洲，韩国综合指数周三下跌超过 6%，日本日经 225 指数下跌 2.88%。香港恒生指数下跌0.13%，内地沪深300指数下跌1.49%。澳大利亚 S&P/ASX 200 指数下跌 0.39%。

paras.en: Ambarella plunged 37% in U.S. extended trading after the designer of low-power AI vision and video chips issued fourth-quarter revenue guidance of $70 million to $75 million. That fell massively short of the $112 million analysts polled by LSEG were expecting.
paras.zh: 低功耗 AI 视觉和视频芯片设计公司 Ambarella 发布了 7000 万至 7500 万美元的第四季度收入指引后，该公司在美国盘中交易中暴跌 37%。这远远低于 LSEG 调查分析师预期的 1.12 亿美元。

paras.en: Wall Street is coming off a losing session for the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite, after tech stocks gave back some of their gains from the prior session as Nvidia sank and Anthropic fell below its IPO price. The broader index fell 0.5% and the Nasdaq slid 1.5%. On the other hand, the 30-stock Dow, which has less exposure to tech, climbed more than 400 points, or 0.9%.
paras.zh: 由于英伟达股价下跌、Anthropic 股价跌破 IPO 价格，科技股回吐了前一交易日的部分涨幅，标普 500 指数和纳斯达克综合指数在华尔街迎来了下跌。综合指数下跌 0.5%，纳斯达克指数下跌 1.5%。另一方面，科技股占比较小的 30 只道琼斯指数上涨了 400 多点，涨幅为 0.9%。

paras.en: The choppy trading action was just the latest in a volatile month. Even before the ouster and reinstatement of Nvidia's Jensen Huang, and Democrats' sweep in the midterm elections, investors were deliberating the future of the artificial intelligence build-out amid a worsening macroeconomic outlook.
paras.zh: 此次波动的交易行为只是动荡的一个月中的最新一次。甚至在英伟达的黄仁勋被罢黜和复职以及民主党在中期选举中大获全胜之前，投资者就已经在宏观经济前景恶化的情况下思考人工智能发展的未来。

paras.en: "Let's remember that the sell-off in the AI ecosystem predated the news about Huang and Nvidia," Liz Ann Sonders, chief investment strategist at Schwab Center for Financial Research, told CNBC's "Closing Bell" on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 施瓦布金融研究中心首席投资策略师利兹·安·桑德斯 (Liz Ann Sonders) 周二在 CNBC 的“收盘钟”节目中表示：“让我们记住，人工智能生态系统的抛售早于黄仁勋和英伟达的消息传出。”

paras.en: "The concerns about capex, the data center build-out, the spread between the cost of capital and return on invested capital, the bifurcation that's happening in the market now between sort of profitable segments of the market and unprofitable," she added. "I think that is the bigger, more aggregate story."
paras.zh: 她补充道：“人们对资本支出、数据中心扩建、资本成本和投资资本回报率之间的利差以及目前市场上盈利部分和无利可图部分之间出现的分歧感到担忧。” “我认为这是一个更大、更综合的故事。”

paras.en: Traders are turning their attention toward the personal consumption expenditures price index for October, due on Wednesday morning. Economists polled by Dow Jones see the headline reading rising by 0.3% for the month and 3.8% annually. Weekly jobless claims are also due, arriving a day earlier than usual as U.S. markets will be closed on Thursday for the Thanksgiving holiday.
paras.zh: 交易商将注意力转向周三上午公布的 10 月份个人消费支出价格指数。道琼斯调查的经济学家预计本月总体数据上涨 0.3%，年率上涨 3.8%。由于美国市场将于周四因感恩节假期休市，每周初请失业金人数也将比平常提前一天公布。

paras.en: The Financial Times and Bloomberg report that the U.S. will impose fresh tariffs on major trading partners later on Wednesday. But it is expected to honor trade deals with partners struck over the last two years, with new levies capped for those countries.
paras.zh: 英国《金融时报》和彭博社报道称，美国将于周三晚些时候对主要贸易伙伴征收新关税。但预计它将履行过去两年与合作伙伴达成的贸易协议，并对这些国家征收新的关税。

articles.title: Why solving the Riemann hypothesis won’t break encryption

paras.en: In 2005 the CBS crime drama Numb3rs built a kidnapping plot around a juicy premise: whoever proved the Riemann hypothesis could break the encryption that protects the Internet.
paras.zh: 2005 年，CBS 犯罪剧《Numb3rs》围绕一个有趣的前提构建了一场绑架阴谋：无论谁证明了黎曼猜想，都可以破解保护互联网的加密技术。

paras.en: Last Friday brought the news that artificial intelligence had helped prove the generalized Riemann hypothesis (GRH), a broader version of that famous problem. By the weekend, that old TV episode’s premise was ripping across social media, minus the kidnapping. While mathematicians work out what the proof means for their field, everyone else wants to know what it actually means, especially for encryption.
paras.zh: 上周五有消息称，人工智能已经帮助证明了广义黎曼假设（GRH），这是这个著名问题的更广泛版本。到了周末，那部老电视剧的前提在社交媒体上疯传，但没有绑架事件。当数学家们弄清楚证明对于他们的领域意味着什么时，其他人都想知道它的实际含义，尤其是对于加密而言。

paras.en: Fortunately, the answer is—nothing much. The legend grew from a real connection. GRH does bear on primality testing, the job of figuring out whether a number is prime, which is how cryptographers find the giant primes that many encryption schemes are based on. But somewhere along the way, the story got twisted.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，答案是——没什么。这个传奇源于真实的联系。 GRH 确实与素数测试有关，即确定一个数字是否是素数的工作，这就是密码学家如何找到许多加密方案所基于的巨大素数的方法。但在这个过程中，故事发生了扭曲。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Researchers have been building on GRH for decades, even as its proof stretched out of reach. “We all thought it was true anyway,” says Eric Bach, a computer scientist at the University of Wisconsin–Madison.
paras.zh: 几十年来，研究人员一直在 GRH 的基础上进行研究，尽管它的证据仍然遥不可及。 “无论如何，我们都认为这是真的，”威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的计算机科学家埃里克·巴赫 (Eric Bach) 说。

paras.en: The Riemann hypothesis and its variants explain more about how the primes are spread out on the number line. Mathematicians have been able to make decent estimates of this distribution since at least the 19th century, and the Riemann hypothesis guarantees those estimates are never far off.
paras.zh: 黎曼假设及其变体更多地解释了素数如何在数轴上分布。至少从 19 世纪起，数学家就能够对这种分布做出正确的估计，而黎曼假设保证了这些估计永远不会遥远。

paras.en: Prime numbers serve as one of the building blocks of all of number theory, but they are also very mysterious. Sometimes they arrive in close pairs, like 17 and 19; other times hundreds of numbers or more go by without one. Primes are also the raw material of cryptography, most famously the RSA cryptosystem, named after its inventors, Ron Rivest, Adi Shamir and Leonard Adleman. The scheme works because multiplying two large primes is easy, while, for now, splitting the result back into primes seems to be brutally hard.
paras.zh: 素数是所有数论的基石之一，但它们也非常神秘。有时它们会成对出现，比如 17 和 19；其他时候，数百个或更多的数字却没有一个。素数也是密码学的原材料，最著名的是 RSA 密码系统，以其发明者 Ron Rivest、Adi Shamir 和 Leonard Adleman 的名字命名。该方案之所以有效，是因为将两个大素数相乘很容易，而目前将结果拆分回素数似乎非常困难。

paras.en: The fear, then, is that if someone could quickly test whether a number was prime, they could quickly find one of these secret primes and factor the large number. In reality, that’s already overengineered—probablistic tests are already plenty quick and reliable enough, yet they haven’t ripped open RSA. “A random test is quite adequate and faster still,” says Carl Pomerance, a number theorist at Dartmouth College, who has spent much of his career harnessing primes and designing primality tests. Randomized tests—which can’t definitively prove a number is prime—have long been the norm for any prime-finding fun, he says, and they will likely stay that way.
paras.zh: 那么，人们担心的是，如果有人能够快速测试一个数字是否是素数，他们就可以很快找到这些秘密素数之一并分解这个大数。事实上，这已经是过度设计了——概率测试已经足够快、足够可靠，但他们还没有破解 RSA。达特茅斯学院的数论学家卡尔·波默兰斯 (Carl Pomerance) 表示：“随机测试已经足够了，而且速度更快。”他的职业生涯大部分时间都在研究素数和设计素性测试。他说，随机测试（不能明确证明一个数字是素数）长期以来一直是任何素数寻找乐趣的常态，而且很可能会保持这种状态。

paras.en: The most famous of these is the Miller-Rabin primality test, named after computer scientists Gary Miller and Michael Rabin. In fact, Miller originally conceived of the test as deterministic, relying on a variant of the Riemann hypothesis; Rabin turned it into the now popular randomized form.
paras.zh: 其中最著名的是米勒-拉宾素性测试，以计算机科学家加里·米勒和迈克尔·拉宾的名字命名。事实上，米勒最初认为该检验是确定性的，依赖于黎曼假设的一个变体；拉宾将其变成了现在流行的随机形式。

paras.en: Bach is one of many researchers who spent decades working out what GRH would mean for other areas of math and computer science. In 1990 he showed just how efficiently GRH would let Miller’s original test determine, with absolute certainty, whether a number is prime. He says the billions of numerical checks the hypothesis had already passed helped convince him to look into its implications. “I’m guilty of that,” he admits.
paras.zh: 巴赫是花费数十年时间研究 GRH 对数学和计算机科学其他领域意味着什么的众多研究人员之一。 1990 年，他展示了 GRH 如何有效地让米勒的原始测试绝对确定地确定一个数字是否为素数。他说，该假设已经通过了数十亿次数字检验，这有助于说服他研究其含义。 “我对此感到内疚，”他承认。

paras.en: Now that GRH is proved, Miller’s original deterministic test officially works—but don’t expect anyone to switch. In practice, people will keep running the randomized version a few dozen times until they feel sure enough.
paras.zh: 现在 GRH 已得到证明，米勒最初的确定性测试正式发挥作用，但不要指望任何人会改变。在实践中，人们会继续运行随机版本几十次，直到他们觉得足够确定。

paras.en: The experts we spoke with were generally more excited about what GRH means beyond primality testing. For instance, Jeremy Rouse, a mathematician at Wake Forest University, notes that only through GRH can mathematicians know which numbers “could be written as a square plus a square plus seven times a square.” Good luck working that into a kidnapping plot.
paras.zh: 我们采访的专家普遍对 GRH 除了素性测试之外的含义更加兴奋。例如，维克森林大学的数学家 Jeremy Rouse 指出，只有通过 GRH，数学家才能知道哪些数字“可以写成一个平方加一个平方加七乘以一个平方”。祝你好运，将其纳入绑架阴谋。

paras.en: These purely mathematical pursuits, not encryption cracking, are the main lessons from this result. But the actual understanding is just beginning. Over the coming years, mathematicians will have to comb through hundreds of thousands of AI-generated pages to find the techniques and ideas that made the proof work. As Bach puts it, “That is going to have more impact than just the blank, flat-out ‘It’s true.’”
paras.zh: 这些纯粹的数学追求，而不是加密破解，是这个结果的主要教训。但真正的理解才刚刚开始。在接下来的几年里，数学家将不得不梳理数十万个人工智能生成的页面，以找到使证明有效的技术和想法。正如巴赫所说，“这将比空洞、直白的‘这是真的’产生更大的影响。”

articles.title: The number of babies getting vaccinated for hepatitis B at birth is dropping precipitously

paras.en: The number of babies born in U.S. who received a vaccine for hepatitis B within a day of birth has dropped sharply, according to a new study.
paras.zh: 一项新研究显示，在美国出生的婴儿在出生一天内接种乙型肝炎疫苗的人数急剧下降。

paras.en: Researchers at the health data firm Truveta and Callen-Lorde Community Health Center in New York City examined anonymized electronic health records from more than 1.3 million infants and found the percentage who received the shot within 24 hours of being born had fallen from 80 percent in 2022 to just 65.6 percent in 2026.
paras.zh: 纽约市健康数据公司 Truveta 和 Callen-Lorde 社区健康中心的研究人员检查了超过 130 万婴儿的匿名电子健康记录，发现出生后 24 小时内接种疫苗的比例已从 2022 年的 80% 下降到 2026 年的 65.6%。

paras.en: The decline extended to babies who were most at risk: up to 98 percent of mothers who tested positive for hepatitis B got their babies vaccinated in 2022, but that had fallen to just under 94 percent in 2026, the study found. The findings were published in the journal NEJM Evidence on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 研究发现，乙型肝炎检测呈阳性的母亲中有高达 98% 的婴儿在 2022 年接种了疫苗，但到 2026 年这一比例已降至略低于 94%。研究结果于周二发表在《NEJM Evidence》杂志上。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “The hepatitis B birth dose was designed to protect every newborn, including those whose mothers may not know they’re infected,” said Nina Masters, principal research scientist at Truveta and the study’s lead author, in a statement. “No screening system is perfect. That’s why it’s so concerning to see vaccination declining across the board, even among babies whose mothers have tested positive for hepatitis B.”
paras.zh: Truveta 首席研究科学家、该研究的主要作者尼娜·马斯特斯 (Nina Masters) 在一份声明中表示：“乙型肝炎出生剂量旨在保护每个新生儿，包括那些母亲可能不知道自己已被感染的新生儿。” “没有完美的筛查系统。这就是为什么疫苗接种率全面下降令人担忧，即使是母亲乙型肝炎检测呈阳性的婴儿也是如此。”

paras.en: Hepatitis B is a liver disease that can, if left untreated, lead to liver cancer or even death. The disease is transmissible through body fluids and can be passed from mother to baby in the womb.
paras.zh: 乙型肝炎是一种肝脏疾病，如果不及时治疗，可能会导致肝癌甚至死亡。该疾病可通过体液传播，并可在子宫内从母亲传染给婴儿。

paras.en: By extrapolating their data to the 3.6 million births that occur in the U.S. each year, the researchers concluded that as many as 360,000 infants are likely going without the shot. While prenatal screening is widely available, they also estimated that roughly 640 unvaccinated babies may be born to mothers who have been infected with hepatitis B but have not been screened.
paras.zh: 通过根据美国每年 360 万的出生数据推断，研究人员得出结论，可能有多达 36 万婴儿没有接受注射。虽然产前筛查已广泛开展，但他们还估计，感染乙型肝炎但未接受筛查的母亲可能会生出大约 640 名未接种疫苗的婴儿。

paras.en: The number of unvaccinated infants is “alarming,” says Michael Osterholm, director of the Center for Infectious Disease Research and Policy.
paras.zh: 传染病研究与政策中心主任迈克尔·奥斯特霍尔姆说，未接种疫苗的婴儿数量“令人震惊”。

paras.en: “They represent children who will develop chronic hepatitis B infections, cirrhosis of the liver and liver cancer,” he says. “They also send a clear signal to federal health leaders that they need a plan to address increasing rates of vaccine hesitancy other than misleadingly blaming it on the pandemic.”
paras.zh: “他们代表了将患上慢性乙型肝炎感染、肝硬化和肝癌的儿童，”他说。 “他们还向联邦卫生领导人发出了明确的信号，即他们需要一项计划来解决疫苗犹豫不决率上升的问题，而不是误导性地将其归咎于大流行。”

paras.en: In December 2025 the CDC’s vaccine advisory panel eliminated a decades-old recommendation that the hepatitis B vaccine be given universally at birth. Instead the panel recommended parents consult with a health care provider about when to give their baby the child’s first dose of the vaccine as long as the mother has tested negative for the disease.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月，疾病预防控制中心的疫苗咨询小组取消了已有数十年历史的建议，即在出生时普遍接种乙型肝炎疫苗。相反，专家组建议父母咨询医疗保健提供者，了解何时给孩子接种第一剂疫苗，前提是母亲的疾病检测呈阴性。

paras.en: The change quickly drew fire from public health experts, who said the decision ran contrary to the evidence and would increase infants’ vulnerability to infection.
paras.zh: 这一变化很快引起了公共卫生专家的批评，他们表示这一决定与证据相悖，会增加婴儿感染的可能性。

paras.en: The new study shows that vaccination rates were already declining before that policy change. The number of unvaccinated babies identified in the study grew from 20,473 in 2018 to more than 34,000 in 2022, peaking at more than 64,500 in 2025.
paras.zh: 这项新研究表明，在政策改变之前，疫苗接种率已经在下降。研究中确定的未接种疫苗的婴儿人数从 2018 年的 20,473 人增加到 2022 年的 34,000 多人，并在 2025 年达到峰值超过 64,500 人。

paras.en: “We’re talking about a vaccine that has protected generations of children from a potentially devastating infection,” said study co-author Demetre Daskalakis, chief medical officer at Callen-Lorde and former director of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s National Center for Immunization and Respiratory Illness, in the same statement. “And now we’re seeing fewer newborns receive it—even those we know are at greatest risk. These numbers aren’t just a trend line. Each data point represents a real child who may be left vulnerable to a preventable disease. At a time when vaccine policy is changing, we need more evidence guiding our decisions, not less.”
paras.zh: 研究报告合著者、卡伦洛德医院首席医疗官、美国疾病控制与预防中心国家免疫和呼吸系统疾病中心前主任德米特·达斯卡拉基斯 (Demetre Daskalakis) 在同一份声明中表示：“我们正在谈论一种可以保护几代儿童免受潜在毁灭性感染的疫苗。” “现在我们看到越来越少的新生儿接受疫苗接种，即使是那些我们知道面临最大风险的新生儿也是如此。这些数字不仅仅是一条趋势线。每个数据点都代表了一个可能容易感染可预防疾病的真实儿童。在疫苗政策发生变化的时候，我们需要更多而不是更少的证据来指导我们的决策。”

articles.title: Lightning strikes could more than double by 2100 thanks to climate change

paras.en: Lightning strikes could soon become so commonplace that we’ll need a new metaphor for rarity. In a new study published in Earth’s Future on Tuesday, researchers find “cloud-to-ground” lightning strikes—bolts that hit Earth’s surface—could more than double by 2100 compared with historical levels. And the reason is our warming world.
paras.zh: 闪电袭击可能很快就会变得如此普遍，以至于我们需要一个新的比喻来形容稀有性。在周二《地球未来》杂志上发表的一项新研究中，研究人员发现，到 2100 年，“云对地”雷击（击中地球表面的闪电）可能比历史水平增加一倍以上。原因是我们的世界正在变暖。

paras.en: Lightning is already becoming more common: between 1995 and 2014, the researchers found, lightning across the world increased by 11 percent compared with the early 20th century. In the coming years, it could jump by between 76 percent and 140 percent over the 1995–2014 period, much more than previous estimates suggest.
paras.zh: 闪电已经变得越来越普遍：研究人员发现，从 1995 年到 2014 年，全世界的闪电比 20 世纪初增加了 11%。未来几年，1995 年至 2014 年期间这一数字可能会跃升 76% 至 140%，远高于之前的估计。

paras.en: “I was quite surprised that the projections were so high,” said the study’s lead author Andreas Krause, who studies Earth sciences modeling at the Technical University of Munich, in a statement. “I expected smaller changes.”
paras.zh: 该研究的主要作者、慕尼黑工业大学研究地球科学模型的安德烈亚斯·克劳斯（Andreas Krause）在一份声明中表示：“我对预测如此之高感到非常惊讶。” “我预计会有较小的变化。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The reason has to do with how lightning forms: as thunderstorm clouds develop, positively charged particles collect near the top of the cloud while negatively charged particles amass near the bottom. According to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, most lightning occurs inside these clouds. But sometimes negatively charged particles in the cloud can connect with positively charged particles on the ground, generating a thunderbolt—or “cloud-to-ground” lightning.
paras.zh: 原因与闪电的形成方式有关：随着雷暴云的形成，带正电的粒子聚集在云的顶部附近，而带负电的粒子则聚集在云的底部附近。根据国家海洋和大气管理局的说法，大多数闪电发生在这些云层内。但有时云中的带负电的粒子可以与地面上的带正电的粒子连接，产生雷电或“云对地”闪电。

paras.en: How dangerous lightning is depends somewhat on where you live. In the U.S. lightning strikes kill an average of 21 people per year and cause an estimated 24,600 fires per year. Countries such as India see a disproportionately high number of lightning strikes each year.
paras.zh: 闪电的危险程度在一定程度上取决于您居住的地方。在美国，雷击每年平均造成 21 人死亡，估计每年会引发 24,600 起火灾。印度等国家每年遭受雷击的次数异常多。

paras.en: As the climate warms, the study authors found, heat rising from Earth’s surface is more prone to shake up the atmosphere, creating more potential for electric fields—and cloud-to-ground lightning—to form.
paras.zh: 研究作者发现，随着气候变暖，从地球表面升起的热量更容易震动大气，从而为形成电场和云对地闪电创造更多可能性。

paras.en: Places with cooler climates, such as Alaska, stand to see the greatest rate of increase in lightning from previous levels. Other research suggests that lightning in the Arctic has tripled in recent years.
paras.zh: 气候较凉爽的地方，例如阿拉斯加，闪电的增幅将比之前的水平最高。其他研究表明，近年来北极的闪电数量增加了两倍。

articles.title: How do tumors talk to nerves? This scientist is finding out
articles.author: Anna Mattson

paras.en: This is a human-written story voiced by AI. Got feedback?
paras.zh: 这是一个由人工智能配音的人类书写的故事。有反馈吗？

paras.en: Sebnem Ece Eksi did a double take. Proteins typically studied in the brain were turning up in prostate cancer cells from high-risk patients. These proteins, called neuronal adhesion molecules, play a key role in the circuitry associated with memory.
paras.zh: Sebnem Ece Eksi 愣了一下。通常在大脑中研究的蛋白质出现在高危患者的前列腺癌细胞中。这些蛋白质被称为神经元粘附分子，在与记忆相关的电路中发挥着关键作用。

paras.en: The finding, made during her Ph.D. days at the University of Illinois Chicago, raised so many questions to which Eksi is still seeking answers. Now at the Oregon Health & Science University in Portland, Eksi has made it her lab’s goal to find out how nervous systems communicate with cancer. What were once two separate fields might be connected more closely than previously thought.
paras.zh: 这一发现是她在攻读博士学位期间做出的。在伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校的几天里，提出了很多问题，而 Eksi 仍在寻找答案。现在，在波特兰的俄勒冈健康与科学大学，埃克西的实验室目标是找出神经系统如何与癌症沟通。曾经两个独立的领域之间的联系可能比之前想象的更加紧密。

paras.en: “What we’re learning is that tumors are actively communicating with the nervous system,” Eksi says. “In a way, it makes sense to me that a growing tumor in our bodies, in an organ, would be immediately sensed and detected by the nervous system.”
paras.zh: “我们了解到，肿瘤正在与神经系统积极沟通，”埃克西说。 “在某种程度上，对我来说，神经系统会立即感知和检测到我们体内某个器官中不断生长的肿瘤，这是有道理的。”

paras.en: Eksi now plans to test an AI image-based recognition algorithm to identify nerve fibers in human patients. This is exciting, she says, because these nerves aren’t normally visible in patient tumors. But through biopsies, she hopes to map out and observe how the nervous system — which impacts sleep, cognition and pain — changes as cancer progresses. The implications are significant, she says. Could experts use the nervous system to detect cancer early? Can they improve patients’ quality of life?
paras.zh: Eksi 现在计划测试一种基于人工智能图像的识别算法，以识别人类患者的神经纤维。她说，这很令人兴奋，因为这些神经在患者肿瘤中通常不可见。但通过活检，她希望了解并观察影响睡眠、认知和疼痛的神经系统如何随着癌症的进展而变化。她说，其影响是重大的。专家能否利用神经系统早期发现癌症？它们能改善患者的生活质量吗？

paras.en: “This field of cancer neuroscience can change all different stages of cancer diagnosis and treatments,” Eksi says. “It’s growing so quickly, the field itself.”
paras.zh: “癌症神经科学这一领域可以改变癌症诊断和治疗的所有不同阶段，”埃克西说。 “这个领域本身发展得非常快。”

articles.title: Motion under the ocean explains the depth of the world’s deepest spot
articles.author: Carolyn Gramling

paras.en: Challenger Deep is the deepest valley in the deepest trench in the ocean, plunging to roughly 11,000 meters below sea level.
paras.zh: 挑战者深渊 (Challenger Deep) 是海洋最深海沟中最深的山谷，深度约低于海平面 11,000 米。

paras.en: Now, scientists have a new clue about how it got to be so … well, deep.
paras.zh: 现在，科学家们找到了关于它如何变得如此……嗯，深的新线索。

paras.en: Challenger Deep is found within the Mariana Trench, a crescent-shaped gouge in the seafloor east of the Philippines in the Pacific Ocean. The trench is the scene of a slo-mo tectonic collision called a subduction zone: The Pacific plate is diving beneath the Mariana plate, bending downward as it sinks into the mantle, forming a steep trench on the ocean floor.
paras.zh: 挑战者深渊位于马里亚纳海沟内，马里亚纳海沟是菲律宾东部太平洋海底的一个新月形凿痕。海沟是慢速构造碰撞的场景，称为俯冲带：太平洋板块潜入马里亚纳板块下方，在沉入地幔时向下弯曲，在海底形成陡峭的海沟。

paras.en: All subduction zones are deep, but “it’s interesting why this is the deepest spot in the Earth’s ocean,” says geoscientist Robert Stern, an emeritus professor at the University of Texas at Dallas and a visiting researcher at the University of California, Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 所有俯冲带都很深，但“有趣的是，为什么这里是地球海洋最深的地方”，德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校名誉教授、加州大学洛杉矶分校客座研究员地球科学家罗伯特·斯特恩说。

paras.en: He and colleagues employed a remotely operated robot called ROV Jason/Medea to descend to more than 6,000 meters and explore the Mariana Trench seafloor around the edges of Challenger Deep. The rocks turned out to contain pyroclastic deposits, evidence of an erstwhile explosive volcanic eruption. Those deposits included platelike blocks that could indicate eruption pulses, and lobe-shaped rocks where the volcanic flows ended and quickly cooled.
paras.zh: 他和同事使用名为 ROV Jason/Medea 的远程操作机器人下降到 6,000 多米深处，探索挑战者深渊边缘的马里亚纳海沟海底。事实证明，这些岩石中含有火山碎屑沉积物，这是昔日火山喷发的证据。这些沉积物包括可以指示喷发脉冲的板状块体，以及火山流结束并迅速冷却的叶状岩石。

paras.en: These are the deepest pyroclastic deposits found on Earth, the scientists report November 23 in Frontiers in Earth Science.
paras.zh: 科学家们于 11 月 23 日在《地球科学前沿》上报告称，这些是地球上发现的最深的火山碎屑沉积物。

paras.en: How explosive an eruption is at Earth’s surface depends on the chemical makeup of the magma. When the molten rock contains a high proportion of volatile gases, including water vapor, those gases suddenly expand when the magma reaches the surface, producing a violent explosion.
paras.zh: 地球表面喷发的爆炸性取决于岩浆的化学成分。当熔岩含有高比例的挥发性气体（包括水蒸气）时，当岩浆到达地表时，这些气体会突然膨胀，产生剧烈的爆炸。

paras.en: Such explosive volcanism shouldn’t be possible in the deep sea; the pressure is too high for any escaping gases to expand, Stern says. Along with that mystery, the volcanic deposits were found unusually close to the trench, compared with what would be expected for a subduction zone.
paras.zh: 这种爆发性的火山活动在深海中是不可能发生的；斯特恩说，压力太高，任何逸出的气体都无法膨胀。除了这个谜团之外，与预期的俯冲带相比，火山沉积物的发现异常靠近海沟。

paras.en: Stern and his colleagues developed a hypothesis that incorporates these disparate pieces of evidence: The extreme depth of Challenger Deep, they say, may be at least partially due to an especially sharp bend in the Pacific Plate as it sinks into the mantle.
paras.zh: 斯特恩和他的同事提出了一个包含这些不同证据的假设：他们说，挑战者深渊的极端深度可能至少部分归因于太平洋板块在沉入地幔时发生的特别急剧的弯曲。

paras.en: That tighter bend would explain why volcanism is happening closer to the subduction zone than usual. The classic subduction zone scenario is that the sinking plate heats up and melts partially as it descends; the magma rises through the overhanging plate and erupts, forming volcanic island arcs several hundred kilometers from the collision zone. Here, the volcanic deposits were just a hundred kilometers or so from the trench — which makes sense if the plate is dipping more steeply.
paras.zh: 这种更紧的弯曲可以解释为什么火山活动发生在比平常更靠近俯冲带的地方。典型的俯冲带情景是下沉板块在下降时升温并部分熔化；岩浆穿过悬垂的板块上升并喷发，形成距碰撞区数百公里的火山岛弧。这里的火山沉积物距离海沟仅一百公里左右——如果板块倾斜得更陡的话，这是有道理的。

paras.en: As for the pyroclastics, “we can’t answer if the eruptions were really explosive,” Stern says. But at those pressures, any gases such as water vapor contained in the magma wouldn’t be able to explosively expand as they would at the surface.
paras.zh: 至于火山碎屑，“我们无法回答火山喷发是否真的具有爆炸性，”斯特恩说。但在这些压力下，岩浆中含有的任何气体（例如水蒸气）都无法像在地表那样爆炸性膨胀。

paras.en: Instead, the pyroclastic rocks might have formed through a new version of deep-sea eruption, one in which water emerging from the magma is initially in a supercritical fluid state. That would minimize any explosive expansion during the eruption and could also produce fragmented, dense deposits like those seen by Jason/Medea.
paras.zh: 相反，火山碎屑岩可能是通过一种新的深海喷发形成的，其中从岩浆中喷出的水最初处于超临界流体状态。这将最大限度地减少火山喷发期间的爆炸性扩张，并且还可能产生像杰森/美狄亚所看到的那样碎片化、致密的沉积物。

paras.en: The discovery of deep-sea pyroclastics is “surprising and unprecedented,” says William Chadwick, a geologist at Oregon State University in Newport. Challenger Deep may be the only place on Earth “with the ingredients to produce explosive volcanism in the super-deep ocean,” he says. “Imagining this happening is … pretty mind-boggling.”
paras.zh: 俄勒冈州立大学纽波特分校的地质学家威廉·查德威克表示，深海火山碎屑岩的发现“令人惊讶且前所未有”。他说，挑战者深渊可能是地球上唯一一个“拥有在超深海中产生爆炸性火山活动的成分”的地方。 “想象这种情况发生……真是令人难以置信。”

paras.en: A lot more work remains to be done to evaluate all of these new ideas, Stern says. “But a lot of things are now coming together.”
paras.zh: 斯特恩说，评估所有这些新想法还有很多工作要做。 “但现在很多事情都融合在一起了。”

articles.title: Extinct, long-legged grasshoppers walked on water alongside dinosaurs
articles.author: Jake Buehler

paras.en: Nearly 100 million years ago, spindly legged grasshoppers may have scooted across water like modern day water striders. The clues are in the fossilized insects’ legs and feet.
paras.zh: 近一亿年前，细长腿的蚱蜢可能像现代水黾一样在水面上快速移动。线索就在昆虫化石的腿和脚上。

paras.en: Special hairs and leaf-shaped leg adornments, exquisitely preserved in amber, suggest the insects — members of a newfound family of insects — could balance and slide around on surface tension, researchers report November 24 in Proceedings of the Royal Society B. The discovery suggests at least three insect groups evolved independently to move across water.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 11 月 24 日在《英国皇家学会学报 B》上报道称，琥珀中精美保存的特殊毛发和叶形腿部装饰表明，这些昆虫（新发现的昆虫家族的成员）可以在表面张力的作用下保持平衡和滑动。这一发现表明，至少三个昆虫群体独立进化以在水中移动。

paras.en: Paleontologist Chunpeng Xu and his colleagues first encountered the strange insects while studying a collection of 99-million-year-old amber. Frozen in time were three pieces of amber containing wingless grasshoppers with short bodies and incredibly long, skinny legs. Due to their unorthodox body shape, Xu didn’t recognize them as grasshoppers at first and thought they might be harvestmen or stick insects.
paras.zh: 古生物学家徐春鹏和他的同事在研究一批 9900 万年前的琥珀时首次遇到了这种奇怪的昆虫。三块琥珀被及时冻结，里面有无翼的蚱蜢，它们的身体很短，腿又长又瘦。由于体型奇特，徐一开始并没有认出它们是蝗虫，还以为它们可能是收割者或竹节虫。

paras.en: “I was genuinely amazed,” says Xu, of the Nanjing Institute of Geology and Paleontology in China. “They are among the most bizarre insects.”
paras.zh: “我真的很惊讶，”中国南京地质古生物研究所的徐说。 “它们是最奇怪的昆虫之一。”

paras.en: Under the microscope, two details stood out: Front legs with water repellant hairs and rear lower legs with leaf-shaped paddlelike structures. Estimates of the insects’ weight show they could have ridden on the water’s surface tension, with help from the repellant hairs on their legs and their spread-out footprint across the surface of the water. And the paddlelike lower legs would have propelled them forward.
paras.zh: 在显微镜下，有两个细节引人注目：前腿有防水毛，后小腿有叶状桨状结构。对昆虫重量的估计表明，在腿部的驱虫毛和遍布水面的足迹的帮助下，它们可以依靠水的表面张力来行走。桨状的小腿会推动它们前进。

paras.en: The researchers named the insects Hydrelcana zhangi, placing them in the new family Hydrelcanidae.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这种昆虫命名为“Hydrelcana zhangi”，将它们归入新的Hydrelcanidae科。

paras.en: “Walking on water is a pretty rare skill in nature,” Xu says. Until now, only two insect groups were known to have evolved to live on the water’s surface: water striders and their kin, and a similar looking but unrelated, long extinct family called Chresmodidae.
paras.zh: “在水上行走是自然界中一项非常罕见的技能，”徐说。 Until now, only two insect groups were known to have evolved to live on the water’s surface: water striders and their kin, and a similar looking but unrelated, long extinct family called Chresmodidae.

paras.en: The grasshoppers had a different gait from other water-walking insects. The common pond skater (Gerris lacustris), by comparison, rows with its middle limbs.
paras.zh: 蚱蜢的步态与其他水上行走昆虫不同。相比之下，常见的池塘溜冰者（Gerris lacustris）则用中肢划船。

paras.en: And whereas modern water-walking insects are predators and scavengers, the ancient grasshoppers were also probably herbivorous, given their mouthparts and lack of claws. The researchers found nine of them preserved in the same amber chunk, suggesting the insects may have gathered in large numbers to feed. It’s possibly the earliest record of such swarming behavior in grasshoppers or crickets, the team says.
paras.zh: 现代水中行走的昆虫是捕食者和食腐动物，而古代蚱蜢也可能是草食性的，因为它们有口器且没有爪子。研究人员发现其中九只保存在同一块琥珀中，这表明这些昆虫可能大量聚集在一起取食。研究小组表示，这可能是蚱蜢或蟋蟀此类集群行为的最早记录。

articles.title: Scientists Discover a Natural Sugar That May Help to Burn Visceral Fat
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: When it comes to weight loss, sometimes it can feel like it's you against the world.
paras.zh: 当谈到减肥时，有时你会感觉自己在对抗世界。

paras.en: As it happens, a multitude of invisible organisms living inside the gut have mysterious effects on the fat we carry.
paras.zh: 事实上，生活在肠道内的大量看不见的生物体对我们携带的脂肪有着神秘的影响。

paras.en: The better we can understand this hidden microbial relationship, the better we can stop weight gain from happening, and maybe even one day prevent obesity.
paras.zh: 我们越了解这种隐藏的微生物关系，我们就越能阻止体重增加，甚至有一天可以预防肥胖。

paras.en: In a new study in Cell Host & Microbe, scientists identified a bacterium that might prove helpful in the cause, called Clostridium immunis.
paras.zh: 在《细胞宿主与微生物》杂志上的一项新研究中，科学家们发现了一种可能有助于解决这一问题的细菌，称为免疫梭菌。

paras.en: Researchers had previously found that C. immunis can help protect mice against intestinal inflammation, but that's not all this particular microbe does.
paras.zh: 研究人员此前发现，免疫梭菌可以帮助保护小鼠免受肠道炎症的影响，但这并不是这种特殊微生物的全部作用。

paras.en: In an experiment with mice, animals given a single oral administration of the bacterium had 3 percent lower body weight in one week compared to control animals, and saw a 25 percent reduction in blood triglycerides.
paras.zh: 在一项小鼠实验中，与对照动物相比，单次口服该细菌的动物一周内体重降低了 3%，血液甘油三酯降低了 25%。

paras.en: Crucially, compared to control mice, the treated mice had about one-third less visceral fat – a type of fatty tissue that wraps around vital organs inside the abdominal cavity, which is linked to serious health risks if you have too much.
paras.zh: 至关重要的是，与对照组小鼠相比，接受治疗的小鼠的内脏脂肪减少了约三分之一，内脏脂肪是一种包裹腹腔内重要器官的脂肪组织，如果内脏脂肪过多，则会带来严重的健康风险。

paras.en: In a separate experiment, mice were fed a high-fat diet for 12 weeks. Control animals experienced 50 percent weight gain during the test, but mice treated with weekly doses of C. immunis showed 13 percent less weight gain that their control counterparts.
paras.zh: 在另一项实验中，小鼠被喂食高脂肪饮食 12 周。对照动物在测试期间体重增加了 50%，但每周接受免疫念珠菌治疗的小鼠的体重增加比对照小鼠少 13%。

paras.en: Subsequent experiments revealed the metabolic effects were due to a bioactive compound being released by the bacterium, which the researchers eventually discovered was a complex sugar molecule called an exopolysaccharide (EPS).
paras.zh: 随后的实验表明，代谢效应是由于细菌释放的生物活性化合物所致，研究人员最终发现这种化合物是一种称为胞外多糖（EPS）的复杂糖分子。

paras.en: When mice were given the EPS by itself, it produced the same weight-loss and fat-reduction effects in treated animals, suggesting it's the sugar, not the bacterium itself, that's responsible for the benefits seen.
paras.zh: 当小鼠单独服用 EPS 时，它在接受治疗的动物中产生了相同的减肥和减少脂肪的效果，这表明是糖，而不是细菌本身，才是所看到的好处的原因。

paras.en: The researchers found that the EPS molecule, which carries a chemical group called phosphocholine, reduces intestinal immune cells called ILC3 cells, suppressing their production of a signaling protein known as IL–22.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，携带磷酸胆碱化学基团的 EPS 分子会减少称为 ILC3 细胞的肠道免疫细胞，抑制其产生称为 IL-22 的信号蛋白。

paras.en: As IL–22 levels fall in the small intestine and visceral fat, more cells containing a protein called UCP1 appear in visceral fat.
paras.zh: 随着小肠和内脏脂肪中 IL-22 水平下降，内脏脂肪中会出现更多含有 UCP1 蛋白质的细胞。

paras.en: Because UCP1 is linked to thermogenesis – the process of burning energy to generate heat – this makes visceral fat more metabolically active, increasing the amount of energy the mice expend.
paras.zh: 因为 UCP1 与生热作用（燃烧能量产生热量的过程）有关，这使得内脏脂肪的代谢更加活跃，从而增加了小鼠消耗的能量。

paras.en: Remarkably, the mice achieved this without eating less or becoming more physically active.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，小鼠在没有减少饮食或增加体力活动的情况下实现了这一目标。

paras.en: "What surprised us was that this bacterial sugar did not work by reducing food intake or increasing activity," says first author and medical researcher Chin Yee Tan from Singapore General Hospital, who worked on the research at Duke-NUS Medical School in Singapore.
paras.zh: “令我们惊讶的是，这种细菌糖并不能通过减少食物摄入或增加活动来发挥作用，”新加坡中央医院的第一作者、医学研究员 Chin Yee Tan 说，他在新加坡杜克-新加坡国立大学医学院从事这项研究。

paras.en: "Instead, it changed how visceral fat used energy. That gives us a completely different way of thinking about how gut bacteria can influence metabolism."
paras.zh: “相反，它改变了内脏脂肪使用能量的方式。这让我们以完全不同的方式思考肠道细菌如何影响新陈代谢。”

paras.en: While there's a lot we still don't fully understand about how the process works, the EPS sugar produced by C. immunis appears to release a handbrake in the immune system that limits the energy-burning capacity of visceral fat, making the animals burn fat more effectively even when their eating and behavior were unchanged.
paras.zh: 虽然我们对这个过程的运作方式还有很多不完全了解，但免疫梭菌产生的 EPS 糖似乎会释放免疫系统的手刹，限制内脏脂肪的能量燃烧能力，使动物即使在饮食和行为不变的情况下也能更有效地燃烧脂肪。

paras.en: It's unknown for now whether the same kind of treatment would work safely in humans, as for now this has only been tested in mice, but there are some promising signs of related biological mechanisms at play in people.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚同样的治疗方法在人类中是否安全有效，因为目前这仅在小鼠身上进行了测试，但有一些有希望的迹象表明相关的生物机制在人类中发挥作用。

paras.en: As part of the study, the researchers investigated gut microbiome data from more than 4,000 individuals, finding that a bacterial gene involved in producing phosphocholine was less abundant in people with obesity. A separate analysis also linked lower abundance of the gene with higher blood triglyceride levels.
paras.zh: 作为该研究的一部分，研究人员调查了 4000 多人的肠道微生物组数据，发现肥胖人群中参与产生磷酸胆碱的细菌基因含量较低。一项单独的分析也将较低的基因丰度与较高的血液甘油三酯水平联系起来。

paras.en: Although it will fall to future studies to confirm the full implications, the researchers suggest their findings are consistent with the effects seen in mice being "generalizable to humans", which is huge if true.
paras.zh: 尽管完整的影响将由未来的研究来证实，但研究人员表示，他们的发现与在小鼠中观察到的“可推广到人类”的效果是一致的，如果属实的话，这是巨大的。

paras.en: "Our findings reveal how some gut bacteria are able to uniquely communicate with the human body – they generate distinctive molecules by chemically modifying the sugars they produce," says senior author and physician-scientist Neeraj Surana from Duke University.
paras.zh: “我们的研究结果揭示了一些肠道细菌如何能够与人体进行独特的交流——它们通过化学修饰它们产生的糖来产生独特的分子，”杜克大学的资深作者、医师兼科学家 Neeraj Surana 说。

paras.en: "This opens up a new perspective on how the microbiome can influence human metabolism and points to new opportunities for developing treatments for metabolic diseases."
paras.zh: “这为微生物组如何影响人类新陈代谢开辟了新的视角，并为开发代谢疾病的治疗方法提供了新的机会。”

paras.en: The findings are reported in Cell Host & Microbe.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《细胞宿主与微生物》杂志上。

articles.title: Slime Mold 'Intelligence' Might Just Be Physics After All
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: Slime molds are famous for their apparent intelligence.
paras.zh: 粘菌因其明显的智力而闻名。

paras.en: The strange organisms aren't true molds, and aren't even fungi. They have no brain or nervous system, but have the ability to solve complex mazes, learn, and 'make decisions'. As they move, they leave a yellow tube along the path they take.
paras.zh: 这些奇怪的生物体并不是真正的霉菌，甚至都不是真菌。他们没有大脑或神经系统，但有能力解决复杂的迷宫、学习和“做出决定”。当他们移动时，他们会沿着所走的路径留下一条黄色的管子。

paras.en: A new mathematical study offers a physical explanation for why slime mold might solve problems the way it does – and it could have less to do with 'intelligence' and more to do with efficiency.
paras.zh: 一项新的数学研究为为什么粘菌能够以它的方式解决问题提供了物理解释——它可能与“智力”关系不大，而与效率关系更大。

paras.en: The yellow strands, or tubes, that trail the slime mold as it spreads actually carry fluid through its body.
paras.zh: 当粘菌扩散时，黄色的丝或管子实际上将液体输送到其体内。

paras.en: When the researchers modeled two tubes of different lengths joining the same points, they found that the combined cost of moving fluid and maintaining the tubes was lowest when only the shorter tube remained.
paras.zh: 当研究人员对连接相同点的两根不同长度的管道进行建模时，他们发现，当仅保留较短的管道时，移动流体和维护管道的综合成本最低。

paras.en: The research builds upon a maze experiment reported in Nature in 2000.
paras.zh: 该研究以 2000 年《自然》杂志报道的一项迷宫实验为基础。

paras.en: The slime mold, a species called Physarum polycephalum, was already spread through the passages of the maze when researchers placed food at two points.
paras.zh: 当研究人员将食物放在两个点时，粘菌（一种称为多头绒泡菌）已经在迷宫的通道中传播。

paras.en: As time passed, the mold withdrew from dead ends. The tube linking the two food sources followed the shortest route through the maze.
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，模​​具从死胡同退出。连接两个食物源的管道沿着迷宫中最短路线走。

paras.en: Those tubes aren't fixed. Rhythmic contractions push fluid back and forth through the slime mold's body, and the tubes change in response.
paras.zh: 这些管子没有固定好。有节奏的收缩推动液体在粘菌体内来回流动，管道也会随之变化。

paras.en: An earlier mathematical model captured how this might work. In the model, tubes that carry more flow get wider, which makes it easier for fluid to pass through. Tubes that carry little flow shrink.
paras.zh: 一个早期的数学模型描述了它是如何工作的。在模型中，承载更多流量的管道会变得更宽，这使得流体更容易通过。流量较小的管子会收缩。

paras.en: Over time, that feedback can turn a network with several possible routes into one with a single main connection.
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，这种反馈可以将具有多个可能路由的网络转变为具有单个主连接的网络。

paras.en: Ricard Solé and Jordi Pla-Mauri from Pompeu Fabra University in Spain, who led the new study, wanted to know why, so they looked at the problem in terms of energy.
paras.zh: 领导这项新研究的西班牙庞培法布拉大学的 Ricard Solé 和 Jordi Pla-Mauri 想知道其中的原因，因此他们从能源的角度来研究这个问题。

paras.en: They represented the two routes as the two sides of a ring, with both tubes linking the same pair of points.
paras.zh: 他们将两条路线表示为环的两侧，两条管道连接同一对点。

paras.en: First, they calculated how fluid would move through tubes of a given width. Then they looked at how the cost of running the network changed as the tubes widened or narrowed.
paras.zh: 首先，他们计算了流体如何通过给定宽度的管道流动。然后，他们研究了随着管道变宽或变窄，运行网络的成本如何变化。

paras.en: It comes down to a trade-off. Friction drains energy from fluid as it moves through a tube, and widening the tube reduces that resistance. But in the model, a wider tube also costs more to maintain.
paras.zh: 这归结为一个权衡。当流体穿过管道时，摩擦会消耗流体的能量，而加宽管道会减少阻力。但在该模型中，更宽的管子的维护成本也更高。

paras.en: The researchers worked out which tube widths gave the lowest total cost for both keeping the network in place and moving fluid through it.
paras.zh: 研究人员找出了哪种管宽可以使网络保持到位和使流体通过其中的总成本最低。

paras.en: When one side of the ring was longer, the cheapest option was to send all the flow through the shorter tube and let the longer one disappear.
paras.zh: 当环的一侧较长时，最便宜的选择是将所有流量通过较短的管子，让较长的管子消失。

paras.en: With two routes of equal length, any split of the flow could reach the same minimum cost, as long as the tube widths matched that split. In that case, how the flow ended up dividing depended on the condition of the tubes at the start.
paras.zh: 在两条长度相等的情况下，只要管宽度与该分流相匹配，任何分流的流量都可以达到相同的最低成本。在这种情况下，流体最终如何分开取决于管道开始时的状况。

paras.en: The researchers also tested the model on branching networks. A dead-end branch that carried no flow gradually vanished. But when the setup required fluid to reach several endpoints, the branches connecting them to the source stayed.
paras.zh: 研究人员还在分支网络上测试了该模型。一根没有流动的死枝渐渐消失了。但是，当设置需​​要流体到达多个端点时，将它们连接到源头的分支就会保留下来。

paras.en: Because the model makes specific predictions, it can be tested against real slime mold. In the ring setup, for example, researchers could keep both routes the same length, vary the starting widths, and see whether those differences predict how the flow ends up being shared.
paras.zh: 由于该模型会做出具体的预测，因此可以针对真实的粘菌进行测试。例如，在环形设置中，研究人员可以保持两条路线相同的长度，改变起始宽度，并看看这些差异是否可以预测流量最终如何共享。

paras.en: There are limits, though. People design the maze and decide where the food goes, so the layout already defines the problem the slime mold appears to solve. And the model only kicks in once the organism has formed a connected network in that layout.
paras.zh: 但也有限制。人们设计迷宫并决定食物的去向，因此布局已经定义了粘菌似乎要解决的问题。只有当生物体在该布局中形成一个连接的网络时，该模型才会生效。

paras.en: It doesn't explain how a slime mold explores new ground or finds food in the first place. It also doesn't cover other behaviors seen in different experiments, including learning and habituation – a weakening response to a repeated stimulus.
paras.zh: 它并没有解释粘菌最初是如何探索新的土地或寻找食物的。它还没有涵盖不同实验中看到的其他行为，包括学习和习惯——对重复刺激的减弱反应。

paras.en: What it does explain is how a web that already spans several passages can end up with a single tube linking the food sources. And it hints that the answer might have less to do with thinking, and more to do with not wasting energy.
paras.zh: 它所解释的是，已经跨越多个通道的网如何最终成为连接食物源的单个管子。它暗示答案可能与思考关系不大，而与不浪费精力关系更大。

paras.en: The research has been published in Journal of the Royal Society Interface.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《皇家学会界面杂志》上。

articles.title: There Is One Predator That Terrifies Bears And Mountain Lions Alike
articles.author: Michelle Starr

paras.en: The wilds of North America can be a hazardous place.
paras.zh: 北美的荒野可能是一个危险的地方。

paras.en: It's there that some of the most intimidating predators make their home – black and brown bears that could eviscerate a person with one swipe of a mighty paw, and mountain lions that stalk almost silently on padded feet.
paras.zh: 一些最令人生畏的掠食者在这里安家——黑熊和棕熊可以用强大的爪子一击就将人掏出内脏，而山狮则用带衬垫的脚几乎无声无息地潜行。

paras.en: Many hikers will gird themselves against the possibility of an attack from one of these feared beasts.
paras.zh: 许多徒步旅行者都会做好准备，以防这些可怕的野兽袭击的可能性。

paras.en: But, as two recent papers explain, there's an animal out there that even the most formidable predators will try to avoid.
paras.zh: 但是，正如最近的两篇论文所解释的那样，有一种动物即使是最强大的掠食者也会试图避开。

paras.en: In fact, attacks by these animals are so uncommon that, in North America, people are far more likely to be struck by lightning.
paras.zh: 事实上，这些动物的袭击非常罕见，以至于在北美，人们被闪电击中的可能性要大得多。

paras.en: The research suggests one reason why: Bears and mountain lions go to remarkable lengths to stay away from humans whenever they can.
paras.zh: 这项研究提出了一个原因：熊和山狮会尽可能地远离人类。

paras.en: "These discoveries change the narrative about human-carnivore conflict," writes Yale University ecologist Oswald Schmitz in a Current Biology dispatch tying together two studies, one on bears and the other on mountain lions.
paras.zh: “这些发现改变了关于人类与肉食动物冲突的叙述，”耶鲁大学生态学家奥斯瓦尔德·施密茨在《当代生物学》快报中写道，该快报将两项研究结合在一起，一项是关于熊的，另一项是关于山狮的。

paras.en: In North America, brown, or grizzly, bears (Ursus arctos) attack, on average, around 11.4 humans per year.
paras.zh: 在北美，棕熊（Ursus arctos）平均每年攻击约 11.4 人。

paras.en: Mountain lions (Puma concolor) attack just 4 to 6 people per year, and the rate of black bear (Ursus americanus) attacks is unknown, but just 63 human fatalities due to black bear attacks were documented between 1900 and 2009.
paras.zh: 山狮 (Puma concolor) 每年仅攻击 4 至 6 人，黑熊 (Ursus americanus) 的攻击率尚不清楚，但 1900 年至 2009 年间仅记录了 63 人因黑熊攻击而死亡。

paras.en: By contrast, across the US and Canada, around 580 people are struck by lightning every year.
paras.zh: 相比之下，在美国和加拿大，每年约有 580 人被闪电击中。

paras.en: Looking purely at the numbers, lightning strikes outnumber brown bear attacks by roughly 50 to 1 (although, of course, the actual risk depends on other factors such as where you live and how much time you spend in bear-filled woods).
paras.zh: 单纯从数字来看，闪电袭击与棕熊袭击的数量大约为 50 比 1（当然，实际风险取决于其他因素，例如您居住的地方以及您在熊出没的树林中度过的时间）。

paras.en: According to the two studies, the answer is that these animals don't simply react to humans showing up. Instead, they actively change their behaviors to avoid us.
paras.zh: 根据这两项研究，答案是这些动物不会简单地对人类的出现做出反应。相反，他们主动改变自己的行为来避开我们。

paras.en: In a study led by wildlife biologist Philip Manlick of the USDA Forest Service, researchers studied bears and other predators feeding along salmon streams in southeast Alaska.
paras.zh: 在美国农业部林务局野生动物生物学家菲利普·曼利克领导的一项研究中，研究人员研究了在阿拉斯加东南部沿鲑鱼溪流捕食的熊和其他食肉动物。

paras.en: They placed salmon by the streams, and motion-triggered speakers played recordings of either gull calls, off-road vehicles, or human voices whenever an animal approached. Cameras recorded what happened next.
paras.zh: 他们将鲑鱼放在溪边，每当有动物靠近时，动作触发扬声器就会播放海鸥叫声、越野车或人声的录音。摄像机记录了接下来发生的事情。

paras.en: The animals – bears, bald eagles, and ravens – were twice as likely to beat a hasty retreat when they heard vehicle sounds compared to the gull sounds.
paras.zh: 熊、秃鹰和乌鸦等动物在听到车辆声音时匆忙撤退的可能性是听到海鸥声音时的两倍。

paras.en: They were almost 10 times more likely to flee from the sound of human voices.
paras.zh: 他们逃离人类声音的可能性几乎高出十倍。

paras.en: This has implications far beyond bear-human interactions.
paras.zh: 这所产生的影响远远超出了熊与人类的互动范围。

paras.en: A 2024 study in British Columbia used chemical signatures in 226 hair samples from grizzly bears across 22 salmon rivers to estimate how much salmon each bear ate.
paras.zh: 2024 年，不列颠哥伦比亚省的一项研究使用了 22 条鲑鱼河流中灰熊的 226 个毛发样本中的化学特征来估计每只熊吃了多少鲑鱼。

paras.en: Where riverside areas had more human disturbance – mostly from industry – the researchers found bears' salmon consumption strongly decreased (by up to 59 percent in females).
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，在人类干扰较多的河滨地区（主要来自工业），熊的鲑鱼消费量大幅下降（雌性熊的鲑鱼消费量下降高达 59%）。

paras.en: Bears take the salmon they catch into nearby forests, leaving behind decaying remnants that help fertilize the ecosystem. Disrupting that nutrient transport has knock-on effects on other ecosystem processes.
paras.zh: 熊将捕获的鲑鱼带到附近的森林，留下腐烂的残余物，帮助肥沃生态系统。破坏养分运输会对其他生态系统过程产生连锁反应。

paras.en: At sites playing human sounds, Manlick and colleagues reported that animals fed more at night, and bears' overall effect on decomposition in the forest was weaker than at the quiet control sites.
paras.zh: 曼利克和同事报告说，在播放人类声音的地点，动物在夜间进食更多，而且熊对森林分解的总体影响比安静的对照地点要弱。

paras.en: The mountain lion paper, led by environmental scientist John Morgan of the University of California, Santa Cruz, told a similar tale.
paras.zh: 由加州大学圣克鲁斯分校环境科学家约翰·摩根领导的山狮论文也讲述了类似的故事。

paras.en: The researchers analyzed six years of GPS data collected from 36 tagged wild mountain lions in the Santa Cruz Mountains.
paras.zh: 研究人员分析了从圣克鲁斯山脉 36 只标记的野生美洲狮收集的六年 GPS 数据。

paras.en: They mapped this data against data from the GPS fitness-tracking app Strava, which showed where and when people were hiking, biking, and using trails.
paras.zh: 他们将这些数据与 GPS 健身追踪应用程序 Strava 的数据进行了映射，该应用程序显示了人们徒步旅行、骑自行车和使用小径的地点和时间。

paras.en: The mountain lions didn't just respond to the presence of humans.
paras.zh: 山狮不仅仅对人类的存在做出反应。

paras.en: Rather, they seemed to anticipate where and when human activity was likely to be heavy, and proactively avoided those places at those times.
paras.zh: 相反，它们似乎预见到了人类活动可能在何时何地变得频繁，并在那时主动避开了这些地方。

paras.en: Even when mountain lions lived in areas with lots of human activity, though, they were not more likely to be involved in conflicts, including sightings, attacks on pets or livestock, and, rarely, attacks on people.
paras.zh: 然而，即使山狮生活在人类活动频繁的地区，它们也不太可能卷入冲突，包括目击事件、攻击宠物或牲畜，以及在极少数情况下攻击人类。

paras.en: Conflict was better explained simply by more frequent encounters between people and mountain lions.
paras.zh: 冲突可以通过人与美洲狮之间更频繁的接触来更好地解释。

paras.en: Taken together, the two studies suggest that the animals take actions that indicate they perceive humans as a significant threat.
paras.zh: 总的来说，这两项研究表明，动物采取的行动表明它们将人类视为重大威胁。

paras.en: Bears abandon their feeding opportunities. Mountain lions plan their movements around predictable human routines.
paras.zh: 熊放弃了进食机会。山狮根据可预测的人类惯例来计划它们的行动。

paras.en: They're already doing a lot of the heavy lifting that prevents dangerous encounters with our own species.
paras.zh: 他们已经做了很多繁重的工作，以防止与我们自己的物种发生危险的遭遇。

paras.en: For our end of the bargain, the mountain lion study suggests, we can try to avoid forcing them into situations where their avoidance strategies fail.
paras.zh: 山狮研究表明，为了讨价还价，我们可以尽量避免迫使它们陷入回避策略失败的境地。

paras.en: In February 2026, California's Fish and Game Commission voted to list mountain lion populations along the Central Coast and in Southern California, including those in the Santa Cruz Mountains, as threatened under the state's Endangered Species Act.
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月，加州渔猎委员会投票将中央海岸和南加州（包括圣克鲁斯山脉的山狮）种群列为该州《濒危物种法》所威胁的种群。

paras.en: "Mountain lions in the Santa Cruz Mountains are at increased risk of extinction, due to a lack of genetic diversity and habitat connectivity," Morgan explains.
paras.zh: 摩根解释说：“由于缺乏遗传多样性和栖息地连通性，圣克鲁斯山脉的美洲狮面临着更大的灭绝风险。”

paras.en: Related: A Wild Puma Was Caught on Camera Hunting in an Unexpected Place
paras.zh: 相关：一只野生美洲狮被摄像机拍到在一个意想不到的地方狩猎

paras.en: The popular image of the relationship between humans and carnivorous predators is that the predator is the aggressor, and the human is the helpless prey that stands to lose the most from an encounter.
paras.zh: 关于人类和肉食性掠食者之间关系的流行印象是，掠食者是侵略者，而人类是无助的猎物，在遭遇中损失最大。

paras.en: In reality, Schmitz argues, humans have not just the power but the responsibility to do all that we can to keep those animals safe.
paras.zh: 施密茨认为，事实上，人类不仅有权力，而且有责任尽一切努力保护这些动物的安全。
